Yangyang: I see. Shall we go and retrieve the parts now, Rover?
[Dialogue Option]  Okay.



Yangyang: I mentally prepared myself for the worst, but this place looks... much better than Mr. Mortefi's description, I think?
Yangyang: Thought it is a bit hard to figure out where we should start...

Yangyang: This should be it. It's quite a boxful.
Yangyang: Let's go back and show it to Mr. Mortefi.

title: First Resonance
content:
Yangyang: This should be it. It's quite a boxful.
Yangyang: Let's go back and show it to Mr. Mortefi.



Yangyang: Mr. Mortefi, we found the parts.
Mortefi: Good, bring it to me.
Baizhi: The test results are in.
[Dialogue Option]  I'm all ears.
[Dialogue Option]  Found anything?
Baizhi: The mangosteen is just an ordinary fruit. It's suitable for regular consumption. We found nothing unusual about it.
Baizhi: From the purple leaf you presented, I detected subtle fluctuations in Tacet Discord's frequency from two distinct sources, but they were overlapping and difficult to distinguish.
Baizhi: This is a rare occurrence.
Baizhi: The scattered nature of these fluctuations rules out the possibility of them being left behind through contact.
Baizhi: This is not an ordinary leaf, but it doesn't seem to be a Tacet Discord, either. Based on the data we gathered, I believe it was sampled from an area struck with the Waveworn phenomena.
[Dialogue Option]  The Waveworn phenomena?
Yangyang: Yes. The anomalies that occurred after the Lament, including the formation of Tacet Fields, Etheric Sea, Retroact Rain, and gravity loss... These are collectively called the Waveworn phenomena.
Yangyang: And the Lament was the start of it all.
Baizhi: As for the sugar pearl... It has been determined to be a type of oral vaccine.
Baizhi: This sugar pearl expired over 20 years ago. The low-temperature storage life for this vaccine is about 2 years.
Yangyang: A 20-year-old vaccine...
Yangyang: ...
Yangyang: Could it be related to the children's epidemic in Jinzhou two decades ago?
Baizhi: The archives in the Academy should have information on the sugar pearl.
Baizhi: The archives here are organized in a unique way. You can start by searching the keywords at the lobby terminal.
Yangyang: Mr. Mortefi?
Mortefi: The missing pointer has been installed, and now the sundial should be complete.
Yangyang: So the discs are rotatable now...
Mortefi: Yes. Align the correct markers with the pointer we just installed, and then you should be able to open it.
[Dialogue Option]  (The Earthly Branches represent time.)
[Dialogue Option]  (The Four Symbols represent cardinal directions.)
[Dialogue Option]  (Just force it open.)
Mortefi: You... Ugh, hold on!
Mortefi: Remember when I said don't force it open?
Mortefi: Crack that thing another five degrees, and not even Xiangli Yao will be able to save it.
Yangyang: The Earthly Branches and Four Symbols...
Yangyang: These symbols are related to the Sexagenary Cycle. It's an intricate way of recording time in Huanglong. Nowadays it is mainly reserved for calendars, numerology, and indexing, but it's falling out of daily use.
Yangyang: Now what kind of information could it represent...
Baizhi: ...It's the filing system.
Baizhi: Most of Huanglong's libraries and databases still use this method to organize their archives. Namely, the Grand Libraries.
[Dialogue Option]  The Grand Libraries?
Yangyang: Yes. The large data repositories located in Huanglong's major cities.
[Dialogue Option]  So it's like a time-based filing system?
Yangyang: Exactly. Languages may evolve, names may change, but time remains constant.
Mortefi: It's an elegant system, indeed.
[Dialogue Option]  Baizhi just mentioned...
Baizhi: The Academy's public archives are organized in this manner, too.
[Dialogue Option]  I see.
[Dialogue Option]  Let's go find the archives about this sugar pearl.
[Dialogue Option]  Follow me.

title: First Resonance
content:
[Dialogue Option]  I see.
[Dialogue Option]  Let's go find the archives about this sugar pearl.
[Dialogue Option]  Follow me.



Yangyang: I found it... It's located on the "Wei" shelf.

Yangyang: Mao, Chen, Si... Wu, Wei. Rover, it's here.

title: First Resonance
content:
[Objective: (After interacting with .)]
Yangyang: There are two photos here...
One photo shows a group of researchers led by a woman in her thirties. Everyone looks excited and happy.
The other photo shows an infant in diapers, with a slender hand holding a spoon with a sugar pearl in it, directed towards the infant.
Yangyang: ...

title: First Resonance
content:
[Objective: (After interacting with .)]
Yangyang: If I remember correctly, Jinzhou was established during a Year of Wei, several cycles ago. The Jinzhou City Hall and Huaxu Academy were built in the same year.
Yangyang: The Gorges of Spirits Battle sparked Jinzhou's founding.
Yangyang: And the formidable Tacet Discord described here... I believe it is the "Crownless".

title: First Resonance
content:
Yangyang: And the formidable Tacet Discord described here... I believe it is the "Crownless".



Yangyang: Rover, about the sugar pearl...
[Dialogue Option]  Talk about the sugar pearl.
Yangyang: Life has never been easy after the Lament, but I still remember that sweetness from my childhood.
Yangyang: The battle against the epidemic in Jinzhou was grueling. Once infected, children either died or suffered life-long disabilities, Resonators or not. With Tacet Discords ravaging Jinzhou and severing all communication with other cities, desperation ran high.
Yangyang: Words are not enough to convey how desperate people must have felt. They resorted to self-experimentation with a newly developed vaccine, risking everything for a chance. If they failed...
[Dialogue Option]  They made it.
[Dialogue Option]  They were heroes.
Yangyang: We owe our presence here to those who came before us. It's important to remember their sacrifices.
Yangyang: If the sugar pearl points to the information and reports we have just read, what is Madam Magistrate trying to convey?
Yangyang: Is it related to your past? Or is it...
[Dialogue Option]  I believe it's about my past.
Yangyang: According to the reports, the vaccine's creator died three years after its development, with the rest of the team now over fifty.
Yangyang: ...
Yangyang: You mean... You could be that infant shown in the footage?
Yangyang: They should be around your age by now.
Yangyang: Hmm... But he/she doesn't have your golden eyes...
[Dialogue Option]  I'm one of the children that were saved.
Yangyang: But you are not from Jinzhou... Maybe the place you came from had a similar situation?
Yangyang: With this thought, perhaps, the reports about the sugar pearl are just one part of the clues. The other part telling your past and memories is hidden in the documents on the "Wei" shelf. What do you think?
[Dialogue Option]  Is she implying I'm a hero?
Yangyang: A hero...
[Dialogue Option]  Maybe she's trying to tell us something else.
Yangyang: Are you saying that the infomation contained in the sugar pearl doesn't directly point to your identity?
[Dialogue Option]  Talk about the founding of Jinzhou.
Yangyang: Jinzhou was the most recent city established in Huanglong. The Mountains of Spirits running from north to south divide Huanglong in two. The capital and the five cities are located in the Inner Huanglong, while Jinzhou is in Outer Huanglong.
Yangyang: The Battle of Gorge of Spirits was the catalyst to found Jinzhou. Tacet Discords were born in the Norfall Barrens and their invasion route was originally traceable. However, the emergence of the Crownless changed it.
[Dialogue Option]  The Crownless?
Yangyang: The Crownless is a Tacet Discord that embodies war itself. The hatred of the fallen warriors and the fear of the survivors are the ingredients for it.
Yangyang: In the limited information available, some researchers have speculated its connection with the Threnodian.
[Dialogue Option]  What is Threnodian?
Yangyang: When it comes to the Threnodian, there is a lot to tell. For now, you can think of it this way: the Threnodian is the most powerful Tacet Discord. The Battle of the Threnodian that happened before was to fend it off.
Yangyang: According to the reports, the Crownless is very similar to the formidable Tacet Discord we encountered.
[Dialogue Option]  And it was in the Gorges of Spirits, too.
Yangyang: Our Sentinel, Jué, manifested before us in that battle.
[Dialogue Option]  Talk about the time indicated on the sundial.
Yangyang: We have the symbol "Wei" now. This should go with the time part.
Yangyang: But we can't yet solve the puzzle with this alone.
Yangyang: Maybe we can figure out the cardinal direction part by looking into the tokens again. It might have something to do with how we got one of the clues.
[Dialogue Option]  That's what I thought.
[Dialogue Option]  I enjoy solving puzzles.
[Dialogue Option]  That's a lot of hoops to jump through.
Yangyang: What do you think, Rover?
[Dialogue Option]  (Talk about the Magistrate.)
Yangyang: I've only seen our Magistrate once at the Appointment Ceremony, so I can't comment on her personality.
Yangyang: But her policies have proven effective and greatly benefited us since she took office.
Yangyang: Some believe that the remarkably far-sighted and profound decisions were actually devised by Counselor "Changli", due to the young age of the Magistrate.
[Dialogue Option]  Counselor Changli?
Yangyang: Lady Changli is our Magistrate's advisor and former teacher. She once held a high position in the Central Secretariat, but she requested a transfer to Jinzhou.
Yangyang: I've also heard about rumors painting her as a cunning manipulator rather than a loyal servant...
[Dialogue Option]  So the Magistrate is good at utilizing talents.
Yangyang: You seem to hold Madam Magistrate in high regard.
[Dialogue Option]  Maybe not.
Yangyang: But rumors are just that, rumors.
[Dialogue Option]  (Discuss all the tokens.)
[Dialogue Option]  (Talk about all the tokens.)
[Dialogue Option]  (Share your thoughts.)
Rover: Let's look back on what we've gathered so far: Our clues point to the sugar pearl as a key in solving the sundial's puzzle.
Rover: Simply put, one token can lead to multiple targets and one may hold several pieces of information.
Rover: We both had our reason for a meeting: the Magistrate had information to share, while I had questions to ask.
Rover: However, her tokens contain both what she wants to tell me and what I want to ask her, making it seem like she is complicating matters.
[Dialogue Option]  Or maybe...
Rover: ...Maybe she was running out of time. That's why she could only offer us scraps of the puzzle, instead of actually putting it together.
Rover: Or perhaps she's indeed a master strategist, leaving breadcrumbs for us to follow. The initial clues may simply be a test to...
[Dialogue Option]  ...to weed out the wrong recipients.
Rover: She needed to ensure that those who may come across these tokens without understanding their true meaning would not be able to use them for access.
[Dialogue Option]  ...to mislead ill-intentioned people.
Rover: In other words, there are people who need to be misled, and they may obtain these tokens.
Rover: (It seems there may be hidden dangers lurking in Jinzhou...)
Yangyang: ...
Rover: If it were you, Yangyang, what would you do to make sure the recipient gets what you mean?
Yangyang: ...I would emphasize my true message by repeating it, again and again.

title: First Resonance
content:
Yangyang: ...I would emphasize my true message by repeating it, again and again.



Chixia: I'm back. I'm back! Finally done with my patrol. How's it going, Rover? Feeling spry as ever?
[Dialogue Option]  You make it sound like I'm old.
[Dialogue Option]  Yeah, feeling spry as ever.
Yangyang: Baizhi said he/she is in great health, no issue to report.
Yangyang: We've made some progress in investigating the tokens, too.
[Dialogue Option]  How did it go for you?
Chixia: Nothing special, a typical patrol. Well, Uncle Zhang's cat climbed a tree, and on its way down, it landed on Uncle Chenpi's Head, causing him to take a tumble. Some dogs kept barking and have been scaring the passersby, so I went there to calm them down.
Chixia: I received a report about someone going missing. I just logged the case and talked to the person who reported it. You're not the one they're searching for, though. Anyhow, I'll need to visit the person who reported the case tomorrow.
Chixia: Oh, I also tried searchin' for Rover's terminal number, but the system came up with nothing. The latest record was from today when I took Rover for registration. That's pretty much the update for now.
[Dialogue Option]  That's quite a lot. You almost put me to sleep.
Chixia: It's the middle of the night. Course you're tired.
[Dialogue Option]  That's quite a lot. You've got me feeling hungry.
Chixia: It's the middle of the night. Course you're hungry.
[Dialogue Option]  Looks like you had a fruitful day.
Chixia: You betcha!
[Dialogue Option]  Do you want me to come along tomorrow?
Chixia: Huh? Are you not gonna investigate the tokens?
Chixia: Oh right, I still owe you a meal! The night markets are closed though. Let's grab breakfast at Panhua's Restaurant tomorrow before my shift. Meet you guys there in the morning. Be there or be square!
[Dialogue Option]  What do we do now?
Chixia: Time to hit the hay, obviously, Don't tell me you're planning on some nightly activities?
[Dialogue Option]  Night is the time to beat up Tacet Discords.
Chixia: Then you'll feel right at home with the Midnight Rangers. Or more like the "Midnight Danger".
[Dialogue Option]  Night is the time to meet up with Jinhsi.
Chixia: What? You're hanging out with our Magistrate already? Quit bluffing.
[Dialogue Option]  Don't you ever stop!
Chixia: Stop it! We deserve 8-hour workdays!
[Dialogue Option]  Bedtime it is.
[Dialogue Option]  I'll be there.
Yangyang: Do you have a place to stay, Rover?
[Dialogue Option]  Sanhua has prepared a room for me.
Chixia: Talk about hospitality!
[Dialogue Option]  I'll be staying at the City Hall.
Chixia: Talk about hospitality! Boy, I wonder what it's like to live in the City Hall.
[Dialogue Option]  Not yet. Poor me.
Yangyang: I-I have a vacant guest room in my house, and if you don't mind coming over...
Chixia: Aren't you forgetting something, Yangyang? Rover told us this morning that he/she has been offered a stay at the City Hall...
Chixia: Alright, enough chatter or the sun's gonna come up. Let's get Rover back to the City Hall and we'll leave the rest to tomorrow!
[Dialogue Option]  No need for the trouble.
[Dialogue Option]  I'd like some time alone.
[Dialogue Option]  Okay.

title: Echoing Marche
content: Quest Objective: As the tides of danger retreat, Jinzhou appears tranquil and vibrant. But beyond its borders lies a fierce and desperate battleground.

title: Echoing Marche
content:
[Objective: (Meet Chixia at Panhua's Restaurant)]
Chixia: Mrs. Panhua, g'morning! Three bowls of extra spicy noodles, please!
Chixia: What did I tell ya? Nothing beats a bowl of spicy noodles in the morning!
Chixia: What do you say, Rover?
[Dialogue Option]  I haven't had my first bite yet.
[Dialogue Option]  It's way too spicy.
[Dialogue Option]  I love it. It's just the way I like!
Chixia: Looks like Baizhi's locked herself in the lab again, hasn't left since yesterday. Bet we won't see her til she's done with her research.
Chixia: No, wait. Since you're the subject of that research, we could use you as bait to lure her out. We can tie you up at the Academy's entrance ...
Chixia: And with just a few tugs of the rope, I bet every researcher will come running at you, with Baizhi leading the pack. Hook, line, and sinker!
[Dialogue Option]  We could give it a try.
Chixia: In case of an emergency! Rover, roll out!
[Dialogue Option]  Hahaha.
[Dialogue Option]  That sounds dangerous.
Chixia: Oops. I got carried away. My bad!
[Dialogue Option]  Let's not try that.
Chixia: By the way. Now that we've figured out the sugar pearl and the sundial, all that's left is that weird leaf and run-of-the-mill mangosteen, right?
Chixia: So it only took us one trip to the Academy to solve half of our problems. Either Rover's really smart, or Madam Magistrate was gonna make it easy for us to begin with.
Yangyang: What's our next plan of action, Rover?
[Dialogue Option]  Look into the mangosteen first.
Chixia: As for the mangosteen, we've got people selling these at the market nearby. Might find some clues there.
Yangyang: Mangosteens are not from Jinzhou. These fruits are usually brought in by boat. Should we start from the harbor?
[Dialogue Option]  Let's leave the city.
Yangyang: Do you think the token is guiding us outside the city?
[Dialogue Option]  Look into the strange leaf first.
Yangyang: Baizhi said the leaf bears the frequencies of Tacet Discords, so it must be from a tree near a Tacet Field.
Yangyang: Then we must leave the city to pursue this lead.
[Dialogue Option]  We've got two more days. Might as well just wait.
Yangyang: Yes, that may work too. Any plans for the next two days, Rover?
[Dialogue Option]  I have other plans.
[Dialogue Option]  (Tell them about the dream you had.)
Yangyang: An ocean of stars ... A dark-haired girl ... An inverted Etheric Sea ... And the Resonance Chord flowing from your Tacet Mark ..
Yangyang: And you said it was flowing in a certain direction. The nearest places are the Gorges of Spirits and the Norfall Barrens ...
Yangyang: You've never mentioned this before.
[Dialogue Option]  I couldn't find the right moment.
[Dialogue Option]  I thought it was just a dream.
Yangyang: The Etheric Sea and Resonance Chords in your dreams are real, possibly leading to the Gorges of Spirits and Norfall Barrens.
Yangyang: Perhaps ... It was more than just a dream.
Yangyang: That girl might be the key to recovering your memories. Madam Magistrate's information aside, it seems to me your dream points toward the Norfall Barrens.
Yangyang: It's the site of the Threnodian War and the source of all TD Outbreaks. The Midnight Rangers' frontlines base is stationed there as well.
[Dialogue Option]  Madam Magistrate gave me the Access Pass for that.
Yangyang: The Access Pass may be another hint...
Yangyang: There are usually no checkpoints set up in the city besides the City Hall. A pass isn't required unless you have to leave the city borders.
Chixia: Now why didn't I think of that? Gotta hand it to ya, Yangyang!
[Dialogue Option]  My body aches for battle!
Chixia: That's the spirit! Been beating my brain up until now, it's time to get these joints cracking for a change!
[Dialogue Option]  I don't know who I am.
[Dialogue Option]  I don't know why I'm here.
[Dialogue Option]  All I know is I must kill!
Chixia: Whoooah! He's fast! He's furious! He's a TD killing machine!
Yangyang: ...Please stop it, you two.
Chixia: It's a no-go for me if you're leaving the city, my shift's coming up. Protect Rover well and shoot me a message if you need anything, alright Yangyang?
[Dialogue Option]  I'm sure you meant the other way around.
[Dialogue Option]  I'm really strong, you know.
[Dialogue Option]  You can just wait for the good news.
[Dialogue Option]  Yangyang is safe with me.
Chixia: I believe in ya!
Yangyang: Without a doubt.

title: Echoing Marche
content:
[Objective: Huanglong 1 Act 1 Echoing Marche [Unlocked]]
Guarding Soldier: Access Pass is required if you're heading to the Norfall Barrens. That place is now off-limits.
Shifting Soldier: ...
Shifting Soldier: What is your business, young lady? It's my third shift and you're still here.
??: Oh, you must be the soldier on duty at noon yesterday. Nice to see you again.
??: I'm a Resonator and a trained martial artist. I can handle myself. Please, I need to go look for someone.
??: I've promised the missing man's grandfather to bring him back. Would you let me through?
Guarding Soldier: Be that as it may, I cannot let you given the current circumstances. My apologies.
??: Well, everything seems fine in the city. Are things really that bad on the frontlines?
Shifting Soldier: That's why we must stay vigilant, so people in the city can go on peacefully with their lives.
Guarding Soldier: Besides, General Jiyan is currently there at the Norfall Barrens base. Dangerous as it is, he will keep an eye on every soldier, including the one you're looking for.
Shifting Soldier: We have already sent a report on your case. You could just go home and wait for the good news. What's the point of staying here?
??: Thank you, but I have already asked the Patrol Station for help and tried every method I could think of. Please, let me through. I promised him, so I gotta give it my all.
??: I understand your concern.
??: I don't want to be a bother. Would it help if I hid my presence and stayed somewhere further away? How about five miles? Or maybe a hundred? A thousand might be too far though, I wouldn't be able to see you clearly...
Shifting Soldier: Listen. Nobody knows when the soldiers will return, and even if they do, you might not find the one you seek.
Shifting Soldier: It's a dangerous road ahead if you want to reach the frontlines, and you don't even have an Access Pass...
Shifting Soldier: ...Ahem. Your Access Pass has been verified.
Guarding Soldier: Just you two?
[Dialogue Option]  Yes
??: Greetings. I'm Jianxin. Could you please do me a favor?
Jianxin: I want to go look for someone outside the city, but I don't have an Access Pass, so... May I tag along?
[Dialogue Option]  Okay.
Jianxin: Thank you for your kindness!
[Dialogue Option]  What can you do for us?
Jianxin: I'm a jack-of-all-trades: Tai Chi, cooking, tea-making, mining, foraging, errand-running, fixing utilities, and caring for animals. Got something else in mind? I'm always up for learning new skills.
[Dialogue Option]  Alright then.
[Dialogue Option]  What do I get out of this?
Jianxin: I see. I've got three Guokui Flatbreads, 34 Shell Credits, and the Mirrors of Clarity. They're all yours.
[Dialogue Option]  You seem to live a humble life.
[Dialogue Option]  You can keep them.
[Dialogue Option]  You'll have to ask the guards about that.
Jianxin: You're right. I should be open about my request. I don't want to lie and cause further trouble for the soldiers.
[Dialogue Option]  The monk over there is coming with us.
??: Thank you for your help! I really appreciate it!
Jianxin: I intend to leave the city with them, and they have agreed. Will it be an issue for you?
Shifting Soldier: I, uh...
[Dialogue Option]  Is it allowed?
[Dialogue Option]  Please.
Guarding Soldier: Well, it says you have the highest level of access, so no procedural issues here.
Shifting Soldier: (Honestly, he/she could lead an entire troop out of the city with that Access Pass and no one would question it...)
[Dialogue Option]  Let's go.
[Dialogue Option]  Master Jianxin?
Jianxin: Sure!
Jianxin explained why she wanted to leave the city. She told you about the person she is looking for.

title: Echoing Marche
content:
Jianxin: Sure!
Jianxin explained why she wanted to leave the city. She told you about the person she is looking for.



Yangyang: So you're looking for the relative of a veteran, and you believe he's in the Midnight Rangers camp in Desorock Highland?
Jianxin: Exactly.
[Dialogue Option]  What's your relationship with the person you're looking for?
Jianxin: His name is Zhiyuan. I don't know him in person. On my way down the mountain, I ran into his grandfather, who was looking for his grandson on his own but ended up lost.
Jianxin: I couldn't just leave an elderly person like him out there. So I thought I'd escort him to the nearest city and make further plans once we're safe.
Yangyang: You're willing to go to such lengths for someone you don't know...
Yangyang: You have a kind soul, Master Jianxin.
Jianxin: It's all thanks to many kind-hearted people. Without them, Mr. Zongye and I wouldn't have made it to Jinzhou.
[Dialogue Option]  Why is it so important for you to find him?
Jianxin: Mr. Zongye seemed confused. He's gone through a lot searching for his enlisted grandson. Lending a helping hand was the least I could do.
Jianxin: I reported his situation to the Patrol Station, but with the chaos on the frontline, Mr. Zongye has been extremely worried about his grandson's safety... He'd sneak out to look for his grandson the moment no one was watching.
[Dialogue Option]  Do you know anything about the mangosteen?
Jianxin: This mangosteen?
Jianxin: It's got some fresh-looking leaves, soft springy skin, and eight fleshy segments fully ripened inside. It looks like a nice fruit.
[Dialogue Option]  Good to know.
[Dialogue Option]  Well... thanks for the tip on how to pick out the good ones.
[Dialogue Option]  How do you know that?
Jianxin: Oh, one more thing I forgot to mention. There's a bruise at the bottom. If you don't eat that part soon, it'll spoil.
[Dialogue Option]  Nothing else?
[Dialogue Option]  Where are you from?
Jianxin: I grew up in my sect on a mountain. Spent most of my time training with my masters.
Jianxin: One day, I was told training in seclusion was not enough. I must engage with the world to further my skills.
Jianxin: So I started my self-cultivating journey. I've been to various cities and gained valuable lessons, but there is still so much more to learn.
[Dialogue Option]  Got it.
Jianxin: ...According to what I've gathered, Mr. Zongye's grandson is very likely in the Desorock Highland.
Jianxin: Thanks to your help, I can finally leave the city to find him.
[Dialogue Option]  That's where we are heading too.
[Dialogue Option]  Let's go together.
[Dialogue Option]  Master Jianxin, please keep us safe.
Jianxin: Of course.

title: Echoing Marche
content:
[Objective: (Ask the soldiers about Zhiyuan)]
Passing Midnight Ranger: You don't look like soldiers. Why are you here? The frontlines are right up ahead.
Yangyang: I am Yangyang, an Outrider of the Midnight Rangers.
Yangyang showed her Midnight Rangers badge and Jianxin asked him about Zhiyuan.
Passing Midnight Ranger: A missing person... Zhiyuan...
Passing Midnight Ranger: The one you're looking for. Is he an average person? Not a Resonator, I suppose?
Jianxin: Yes, have you seen him? Is he alright?
Passing Midnight Ranger: I met him once. He's not officially enlisted, but he seemed determined to join us. He's been secretly following our troops since last year.
Passing Midnight Ranger: I think a quartermaster of the Rearguards escorted him away, so if he's not in the city ...
Passing Midnight Ranger: He must be in the Rearguards camp. He can't be anywhere else; the actual frontlines are right up ahead, and we the Midnight Rangers would never allow non-servicemen to approach and risk getting killed.
[Dialogue Option]  I see.
[Dialogue Option]  Master Jianxin.
Jianxin: Thank you!
Passing Midnight Ranger: Now if you're heading that way, I have a request for you, my Outrider comrade.
Passing Midnight Ranger: On your way there, you should run into two Detection Beacons. They just went offline. Could you go check on them?
Yangyang: Sure, we will.
Passing Midnight Ranger: Great. I'll send the coordinates to your Terminal.

title: Echoing Marche
subsection: (Follow the patrol route to find the Detection Beacon)
content:
[Objective: (Follow the patrol route to find the Detection Beacon)]
Jianxin: Is that the Beacon? Why are there so many people?
Yangyang: They don't look like soldiers...

Jianxin: Greetings. What might interest you here? It's dangerous.
Strange Civilian?: Oh. We, uh... Nothing, really. You see, we're just on our way south, to the city.
[Dialogue Option]  Stop lying. I saw it.
Yangyang: Excuse me, about this Detection Beacon...
Strange Civilian?: Run, everyone!
[Dialogue Option]  Something's fishy about them.
[Dialogue Option]  Don't let them run off.

metadata.subsection: (Follow the patrol route to find the Detection Beacon)

title: Echoing Marche
subsection: (Follow the patrol route to find the Detection Beacon)
content:
Strange Civilian?: Run, everyone!
[Dialogue Option]  Something's fishy about them.
[Dialogue Option]  Don't let them run off.



Timid Civilian?: I-I can't move... So hungry...
Flustered Civilian?: P-Please don't arrest us! We really had no choice!
Jianxin: What happened? Do you need help?
Timid Civilian?: The battles are getting real bad up north, and we couldn't live there anymore. Figured we have to go back to the city.
Timid Civilian?: We ain't eaten in ages, and we're broke. Some of us can barely move 'cause we're so damn hungry.
Timid Civilian?: Then we found some expensive looking stuff here. Now that the military's out there fighting and nobody's really using these thingies, we thought it might get us a few pennies.
Yangyang: A damaged Detection Beacon might result in a sudden TD invasion from the direction it covers.
Yangyang: Our frontline troops would face attacks from both sides. Have you thought about the consequences?
Flustered Civilian?: We ain't got the time for that! If we don't steal, we'd starve to death before the Tacet Discords kill us.
Jianxin: You shouldn't be stealing public property. Please return the parts.
Jianxin: There's still some distance from here to Jinzhou city. Here, you can have my flatbreads.
Jianxin: And here's some money. This should be enough for you to reach the city.
Timid Civilian?: You're giving us ... all of these? Thank you. Thank you!
Flustered Civilian?: Hey! You! Come over and say thank you before you eat!
Jianxin: It was nothing. Master once told me, "The sage takes care of all men,and abandons none."
Rover: Watch out!

metadata.subsection: (Follow the patrol route to find the Detection Beacon)

title: Echoing Marche
subsection: (Follow the patrol route to find the Detection Beacon)
content:
Jianxin: It was nothing. Master once told me, "The sage takes care of all men,and abandons none."
Rover: Watch out!



Strange Civilian?: Hmph, a tough nut, aren't you?
Jianxin: I just helped you. Why did you attack us?
Strange Civilian?: You're not feedin' all of us with ya bread and pennies. Hand over your goods and grub or face the consequences.
Strange Civilian?: We ain't messin' with no kids, but don't test our patience. Just do as you're told!

metadata.subsection: (Follow the patrol route to find the Detection Beacon)

title: Echoing Marche
subsection: (Follow the patrol route to find the Detection Beacon)
content:
Strange Civilian?: We ain't messin' with no kids, but don't test our patience. Just do as you're told!



Flustered Civilian?: We're beggin' ya, stop! We surrender. Take us in!
Jianxin: Why did you attack us when I already gave you food and funds?
Jianxin: Do you have other mouths to feed, aside from what we see here?
Yangyang: They seem trained... These are not ordinary people.
[Dialogue Option]  Who are you?
Elder Exile: O-of course we are ordinary people! We just ... we just joined the Exiles recently.
Elder Exile: We done some wrongs. Tried to run from them Patrollers and left the city, but dang, didn't know the battles up north were so crazy. Our new boss ran outta food before we could even figure out the camp. Figured we'd be better off just to go back to the city and get worked up.
Timid Exile: Then we ran outta food and cash halfway. So we turned to thieving.
Timid Exile: We ain't got the balls to rob the army, but with stuff just sitting around, why not?
Timid Exile: Hey, since you're being so generous, how about you throw a little extra cash our way? There's a bunch of us, some injured too. Your first amount ain't gonna cut it for us to survive.
[Dialogue Option]  We have some spare supplies.
Jianxin: Wait. What I gave them was more than enough for them to make it to Jinzhou.
[Dialogue Option]  We shouldn't give them more.
Jianxin: Wait. What I gave them was enough for them to make it to Jinzhou, even when they are so many.
Jianxin: I used to travel alone when I left my Master. I know how much it takes for someone to survive.
Elder Exile: Hey! What's wrong with you, girlie? It won't hurt to give us more!
Jianxin: Pain comes with coveting. He who knows he has enough is rich. It was only meant to sustain you long enough for you to reach the city.
Timid Exile: You don't understand, girl. You don't make money very easily in a time like this. If we can't find jobs in the city, we gonna starve again.
Jianxin: I came from a seclusive place, learning the ways of the world from scratch. It's been a hard time, but even I have managed to make a living with my own hands.
Jianxin: If you really can't find any job in the city, come to Liuxian Teahouse and ask for Jianxin. I'll gladly help you search for jobs and work alongside you.
Elder Exile: Tsk... Fine! Fine! We'll go.
Elder Exile: Hurry, move! Let's get outta here. I'm not listening to this lecture anymore.
Jianxin: I wasn't trying to... Wait, please put that down.
Elder Exile: Ugh, quite the sharp eye you got. Fine! Here you go!
Yangyang: Is this the only Detection Beacon you messed with?
Elder Exile: Heck yeah! Just the first one we were trying to stal and you bumped right into it.
Yangyang: Really? Then why does that one over there seem broken too?
Elder Exile: That ain't got nothing to do with us! It has been that way for ages. Plus, we ain't ever reaching it with all those thorns.
Yangyang: I see. You may leave now.
Yangyang: The military's base is not far from here. Shall we fix the Beacons before going?
[Dialogue Option]  Okay.

metadata.subsection: (Follow the patrol route to find the Detection Beacon)

title: Echoing Marche
content:
[Objective: (Check the other Detection Beacon)]
Jianxin: The thorns are blocking our path. Weird. We'll have to clear them before we can reach the Beacon.
Jianxin: Please be careful, they look sharp. Maybe we can find something nearby to help us deal with them?

title: Echoing Marche
content:
[Objective: (Arrive at the Rearguards Base)]
Yangyang: Master Jianxin, are you alright?
Jianxin: This is my first time on a battlefield. It feels so different here.

title: Echoing Marche
subsection: (Ask the staffs about the current situation)
content:
[Objective: (Ask the staffs about the current situation)]
Xiulan: I know another shipment of supplies has just arrived. I've confirmed it, but it's not nearly enough. We must reach out to the city again and demand more supplies immediately.
Logistics Specialist: But the approval process is going to ...
Xiulan: Tell them it's an emergency. We are working around the clock here. Any delay could mean the end of our defense. Do they not comprehend? Here's the list of what we need.
Xiulan: I'll talk to them if you can't make them listen! Now go go go!
Xiulan: Move, move! What is it? Why are we still not done distributing these?
[Dialogue Option]  Hello.
Xiulan: You new here? Are you backups too?
Xiulan: Wait, you don't look like one of us...
Yangyang: I am Yangyang, an Outrider of the Midnight Rangers. And they are...
Yangyang showed her Midnight Rangers badge.
Xiulan: Excuse me. One moment, please.
Xiulan: Careful! This chest holds vital medical supplies. If the wounded return and find no medicine, it's on you. Handle with care and precision!
Xiulan: An Outrider? So you are part of the backup force, right? Now, I've got wounded soldiers coming soon, and you're just in time to help.
Xiulan: Sorry. Have to answer this.
Xiulan: Yes. What is it?
Xiulan: An Overclocked Resonator? Understood. I'll be there immediately.
Xiulan: I'm sorry... Erm, could you do me a favor?
Xiulan: The wounded soldiers are being sent back from the frontlines. We need someone to escort them to the medics, but I've got to deal with the Overclocked Resonator now. Could you please take care of them?
Jianxin: What exactly do you need us to do?
Xiulan: Just make sure they are safe. The medics will take care of their wounds.
[Dialogue Option]  Sure. Leave it to us.
Xiulan: Thank you.
Jianxin: It's so busy here... Looks like they don't even have the time to catch their breath.
Yangyang: Supplies, medical care, equipment maintenance, personnel management, and logistics ... They must carefully manage these matters to provide vital support for our fighters.
Jianxin: So this is what a real war looks like. I had no idea it could get this bad.
Yangyang: Most people would never have the chance to witness any of this. It's natural for you not to know.
Yangyang: I think this is exactly what our military strives for—to ensure peace and safety for our citizens. It's a sacrifice made so others don't have to live in fear.
[Dialogue Option]  The wounded soldiers are here. Let's go check on them.

metadata.subsection: (Ask the staffs about the current situation)

title: Echoing Marche
content:
[Objective: (Help the wounded soldiers (1/2))]
Xinyu: Hah... hah...
Jianxin: Are you alright?
Xinyu: I'm okay... just... a little... out of breath...
[Dialogue Option]  You don't seem okay.
Xinyu: It's okay... I'm fine...
Jianxin: I'll go find a medic.
You brought the medic over to take care of Xinyu.

title: Echoing Marche
content:
[Objective: (Help the wounded soldiers (2/2))]
Suihe: Like I said, it's not a big deal! No need to fix me up! Let me go!
Jianxin: Please calm down. Your wound is still bleeding.
Suihe: That's barely a scratch! You can't stop me!
[Dialogue Option]  Now is not the time for bravado.
Suihe: That's not bravado! My wounds can close on their own. It's my Resonance ability. The medics should go take care of other people in need!
Medical Personnel: Stop squirming, will you? We're here because you need our help. Calm down and stay where you are!
Medical Personnel: Please hold him still for me.
Jianxin: Sure...
After some chaos, you helped medics in treating the wounded.

title: Echoing Marche
content:
[Objective: (Talk to the medics)]
Medical Personnel: Thank you for your assistance. You must be tired. Please take some rest.
Jianxin: They look badly injured...
Medical Personnel: Don't worry. They've received proper treatment now. They will recover in time. Thanks to General Jiyan, we've seen a significant drop in the number of casualties.
Medical Personnel: I've heard from veterans that our soldiers used to be ordinary people, not Resonators. The battles were even brutal back then, with the stench of blood lingering through the rain.
Medical Personnel: But things have improved.
Medical Personnel: Each injury represents countless Tacet Discords eliminated by our brave soldiers.
Medical Personnel: Resonators in the Midnight Rangers are incredible warriors. Those who have to retreat from injury must have already taken out hundreds of enemies.
[Dialogue Option]  They are our heroes.
Jianxin: They are the ones keeping our people safe. What I've been doing is not worth mentioning compared to them.
Medical Personnel: Please don't put it like that. Without your help. we couldn't have helped so many wounded soldiers in such a short time.
Medical Personnel: Now that they are all safe, you should go and take care of your own issues.
Jianxin: Thank you. May I ask where the quartermaster is?
Medical Personnel: The quartermaster isn't here. He's on the floor above, directing munitions distribution. Just take that lift and you should find him there.
Yangyang: Rover, where are we going next?
[Dialogue Option]  Let's follow Master Jianxin.
[Dialogue Option]  I want to talk to the quartermaster, too.
Jianxin: Here are some recipes for dietary supplements from my sect. They might help the wounded recover sooner.
Medical Personnel: Oh? Great. You have my thanks.

title: Echoing Marche
content:
[Objective: (Ask the quartermaster about the situation)]
Rearguard Battalion Camp Officer: Have you confirmed the inventory? What about the spare list? Sort out the consumables as soon as possible. Check our communication lines while you're at it...
Rearguard Battalion Camp Officer: Yue, deliver this list to Ase. Oh, you're not Yue. Where is she? What do you need?
Yangyang: Excuse me. I'm an Outrider of the Midnight Rangers. This is Rover, and this is Master Jianxin who came here to look for someone.
[Dialogue Option]  You seem very busy.
Rearguard Battalion Camp Officer: Jinzhou is the gateway to Huanglong, and the Desorock Highland is the gateway to Jinzhou. A single breach could have dire consequences. Our defense must hold at all costs.
Rearguard Battalion Camp Officer: The Tacet Discords are not humans. They don't do truces or ceasefires. For as long as they exist, this war will rage on endlessly.
Rearguard Battalion Camp Officer: Supply is the lifeblood of our army, and I am tasked with keeping it flowing. But now, we are facing a shortage.
[Dialogue Option]  Do you need our help?
Rearguard Battalion Camp Officer: I saw you help arrange the wounded there. Xiulan would need your help more than I do.
Rearguard Battalion Camp Officer: Thank you, but I must remain to oversee vital military supplies.
[Dialogue Option]  (Tell him about the person Jianxin's looking for.)
Jianxin asked the quartermaster about Zhiyuan's whereabouts.
Rearguard Battalion Camp Officer: Zhiyuan...
Rearguard Battalion Camp Officer: So he never sent a letter home? Not even once?
Rearguard Battalion Camp Officer: The Midnight Rangers are no longer recruiting non-Resonators lately, but Zhiyuan was a stubborn boy. Last year when the battles hadn't gotten so intense, he would trail us Rearguards, eager to join the frontline.
Rearguard Battalion Camp Officer: We sent him back to the city, time and time again, and he just kept finding ways to come back. Eventually I caved and took him in to help us here at the base.
Rearguard Battalion Camp Officer: With the battle escalating, it's getting increasingly dangerous out here. I shouldn't keep him here any longer. I was just thinking about having the logistics team bring him back to the city when you guys showed up.
Rearguard Battalion Camp Officer: Oh, now I remember. He should be currently on the floor above.
[Dialogue Option]  Master Jianxin, do you want to go look for Zhiyuan first?
Jianxin: Sure. Please excuse me. I'll join you later.
[Dialogue Option]  We'll be meeting up with you.
[Dialogue Option]  We'll be there soon.
Jianxin did a brief salute and left.

title: Echoing Marche
content:
[Dialogue Option]  We'll be meeting up with you.
[Dialogue Option]  We'll be there soon.
Jianxin did a brief salute and left.



[Dialogue Option]  (Take out the mangosteen.)
Rearguard Battalion Camp Officer: What... what are you doing!
[Dialogue Option]  What's going on?
[Dialogue Option]  (Hold your hands up.)
Rearguard Battalion Camp Officer: Oh... Please excuse me. Thought that was a grenade... Is this... a mangosteen?
[Dialogue Option]  A grenade?
Rearguard Battalion Camp Officer: It's a type of old-fashioned explosive. The Lament caused a global technological regression and shortage of resources.
Rearguard Battalion Camp Officer: While Tacetite Weapons were being developed, most people had limited knowledge of Tacetite as an energy source. As a result, primitive products combining old and new technology emerged.
Rearguard Battalion Camp Officer: The hand grenade was one of them. With the rapid growth of Tacetite Weapons, these crude explosives were eventually phased out in favor of more advanced weaponry.
[Dialogue Option]  What do you know about the mangosteen?
Rearguard Battalion Camp Officer: Well... it's not a local fruit, so we can only get it through imports. But, with the recent Tacet Discord outbreaks, we've had to prioritize bringing in the essentials. We'll get back to importing more of these after General Jiyan makes his triumphant return.
Rearguard Battalion Camp Officer: Currently, there's only one waterway open, from Port Gunchao in the  of the city. The Rearguards would regularly go there to escort goods.
Rearguard Battalion Camp Officer: Hmm... What more do I know... The military rarely buys this fruit for rations due to its short shelf life. Plus, it looks too much like a grenade, and that could cause some issues.
[Dialogue Option]  Thank you.

title: Echoing Marche
subsection: (Ask Jianxin about how it went for her)
content:
[Objective: (Ask Jianxin about how it went for her)]
Yangyang: Master Jianxin, have you found the person you're looking for?
Jianxin: Yes, I've found Zhiyuan. We will return to the city with the logistics team. We will go find Mr. Zongye to let him know he is safe.
[Dialogue Option]  I heard Zhiyuan didn't want to leave?
Jianxin: Zhiyuan is a man full of courage. Influenced by his veteran grandpa's tales, he longs to join the military and aid in humanity's battle against Tacet Discords.
Jianxin: The journey with you has exposed me to immense suffering, but the battles on the frontline must be even more brutal than what I've witnessed.
Jianxin: Countless lives have been lost in this war...
Jianxin: Master Rongfu once told me, "The best sages gain enlightenment in the military, the mediocre sages gain enlightenment in the bustling cities, and the worst sages gain enlightenment in seclusion."
Jianxin: I do share some of Zhiyuan's feelings.
Jianxin: However, Zhiyuan disagreed with the intense training and tests required to join the military. He saw no distinction between ordinary people and Resonators, and believed he could contribute on the battlefield, however small that contribution might be.
[Dialogue Option]  I agree with him.
[Dialogue Option]  Everyone has a part to play.
[Dialogue Option]  He's only causing trouble by staying on the battlefield.
[Dialogue Option]  He can contribute better without fighting on the frontlines.
Jianxin: I, too, found what Zhiyuan said was reasonable to an extent, and I couldn't change his mind with words. So I tried to imagine what my masters would do. They'd set up a spar in this case. And if I won, they'd let me do what I wanted.
[Dialogue Option]  So you beat him up?
[Dialogue Option]  Anything that works for you, I guess.
Jianxin: I didn't mean to beat him up for nothing. My masters taught me valuable lessons through sparring, and I gained important insights from those fights. Now, who do you think won that fight?
[Dialogue Option]  You pretended to lose.
Jianxin: "The shape changes, but not the forms; the more it moves, the more it yields. Less thinking, more knowing. Simplify for clarity."
Jianxin: Yes, I pretended to lose, but Zhiyuan saw it through.
Jianxin: After our fight, Zhiyuan admitted he saw the gap between Resonators and ordinary people. He seemed to realize how he was still far from being able to fight the Tacet Discords.
Jianxin: He realized how he was just trying to convince himself that he could make a difference, not wanting to acknowledge his own limitations. Fighting on the battlefield requires physical and mental strength, and he was not yet prepared for that.
[Dialogue Option]  You won.
Jianxin: "All tangles untied, all glare tempered, all dust smoothed. It is like a deep pool that never dries. " How true! I've come to understand this line more.
Jianxin: I promised not to use my Forte in battle, but Zhiyuan still couldn't take a single blow from me.
Jianxin: After his defeat, Zhiyuan seemed to realize his weakness. Talking about confronting the Tacet Discords on the battlefield would be mere lip service, he said. He was just trying to convince himself that he could make a difference, not wanting to acknowledge his own limitations.
Jianxin: I heard you two still have other matters to attend to. When you have the time, let's catch up at Liuxian Teahouse.
Jianxin: It's my great pleasure to have met you.
[Dialogue Option]  Farewell.
[Dialogue Option]  See you.
[Dialogue Option]  I see. Farewell, Master Jianxin.

metadata.subsection: (Ask Jianxin about how it went for her)

title: Echoing Marche
content:
[Objective: (Discuss your plans with Yangyang)]
Yangyang: Us running into Master Jianxin was a one-off incident. If the mangosteen indicates something about war, what is Madam Magistrate trying to convey?
[Dialogue Option]  That civilizations are born from war and suffer from war.
[Dialogue Option]  Perhaps she wants me to meet someone.
[Dialogue Option]  Perhaps the moment hasn't arrived yet.
[Dialogue Option]  She's just giving me a chance to do a certain thing.
Yangyang: Have you thought of something, Rover?
Rover: I think...
[Dialogue Option]  (Mention the Tacet Discord outbreak.)
Yangyang: So Madam Magistrate wants to tell us about the TD outbreak?
Yangyang: If those Tacet Discords break through our defenses, it would be a disaster for not just Huanglong, but for all of humanity...
[Dialogue Option]  (Mention the mangosteen's route of transportation.)
Yangyang: So Madam Magistrate wants to tell us something about the mangosteen's route of transportation?
Yangyang: That quartermaster said the mangosteens are transported by boat from the South.
[Dialogue Option]  (Mention the general you saw.)
Yangyang: So Madam Magistrate wants to tell us about General Jiyan, or about the war against Tacet Discords?
Yangyang: We haven't reached the frontlines yet, but I can already smell the iron in the air... I sense tension and unease. Our soldiers stationed at the borders... I hope they are okay...

title: Echoing Marche
content:
[Objective: (Cutscene plays)]
???: Food... Food...
Soldier: General!
Jiyan: Follow the Qingloong. To war!

title: Echoing Marche
subsection: (Stand your ground. Defeat all Tacet Discords)
content:
[Objective: (Stand your ground. Defeat all Tacet Discords)]
Hearing Yangyang's calls, you slowly reclaimed consciousness...
Yangyang: What's the matter? Are you alright?
[Dialogue Option]  I... I had a vision.
[Dialogue Option]  I may have resonated with a Tacet Discord.
Yangyang: I was worried... You just stood there and gazed into the distance. You were unresponsive when I tried talking to you. What did you see?
Rover: It felt as if I was seeing through the eyes of a Tacet Discord. I think... I saw what was happening in the Norfall Barrens.
[Dialogue Option]  (Describe the general in teal first.)
Yangyang: An imposing warrior wielding the power of a Qingloong (teal dragon)... The Qingloong is the Midnight Rangers' emblem. It's also the symbol of General Jiyan, the leader of all Midnight Rangers.
Yangyang: The front lines are not far from here. General Jiyan must be there, fighting alongside our soldiers to keep the Tacet Discords away.
[Dialogue Option]  But I've never met him.
Yangyang: It doesn't seem like a coincidence. We arrived near the battlefield right when General Jiyan was leading an attack against the Tacet Discords...
[Dialogue Option]  (Describe the woman in red first.)
Yangyang: A woman in red who can control the Tacet Discord...
Yangyang: Could it be... One of the Fractsidus...
Yangyang: Your vision... It might be what was happening on the battlefield not far away...
[Dialogue Option]  It's real.
[Dialogue Option]  Something's not right.
Yangyang: The battle itself is a clear sign of an anomaly.
Yangyang: The Streams from the Norfall barrens feel more suffocating than ever.
Yangyang: Rover... something on that battlefield must be connected to you, though we have no idea what it is.
[Dialogue Option]  There's something inside me.
Yangyang: Resonate with Tacet Discords...?
[Dialogue Option]  There's always been a voice.
Yangyang: But I didn't hear anything... or sense any frequencies.
[Dialogue Option]  Whatever it is.
[Dialogue Option]  Maybe I can...

metadata.subsection: (Stand your ground. Defeat all Tacet Discords)

title: Echoing Marche
subsection: (Stand your ground. Defeat all Tacet Discords)
content:
Yangyang: But I didn't hear anything... or sense any frequencies.
[Dialogue Option]  Whatever it is.
[Dialogue Option]  Maybe I can...



Yangyang: Rover?
Rover: According to Baizhi, the leaf showed residual fluctuations of tacet Discords.
Rover: Those fluctuations pointed to a certain set of coordinates.
Yangyang: And that is... Qichi Village, in the Central Plains.

title: Ominous Star
content: Quest Objective: Forbidden memories of the past lay buried in ashes and ruins. The ominous "fractured star" beckons, holding untold secrets within its shadows. Secrets that still burn within a cindered heart.

title: Ominous Star
subsection: (As the player goes to the designated location)
content:
[Objective: (As the player goes to the designated location)]
Yangyang: This must be the place...

metadata.subsection: (As the player goes to the designated location)

title: Ominous Star
content:
[Objective: (Clear the Tacet Field)]
Yangyang: I sensed something ominous from the leaf back there, but I couldn't pinpoint its source...
Yangyang: And now, the hatred and pain is so strong in this place. I don't even need to concentrate to feel it...
Yangyang: Rover, something terrible must have happened here.
Yangyang: We have to be cautious. This is a Tacet Field. Let's take out those Tacet Discords first.

title: Ominous Star
content:
[Objective: (Huanglong I - Act III Ominous Star [Unlocked])]
Yangyang: I think I've found something, Rover.

title: Ominous Star
content:
[Objective: (Investigate the tattered wooden plaque)]
Yangyang: Ritualistic wooden plaques...
Yangyang: But why are they here? These plaques are usually placed in ancestral shrines...
Yangyang: And they seem to belong to a different time...
Yangyang: I remember reading about something like this. People held large-scale ancient rituals periodically in their villages, driven by certain beliefs.
Rover: I see... Let's check somewhere else.

title: Ominous Star
content:
[Objective: (Investigate the suspicious embers)]
Yangyang: The area's a mess, but it doesn't look like a warzone. Someone was hurt and dragged away.
Yangyang: Look, there are many footprints here. These are... traces left by a fight.
Yangyang: Someone was injured...

title: Ominous Star
content:
[Objective: (Investigate the strange Tacet Discord)]
Yangyang: Watch out!

Strange Tacet Discord: Ugh... Uh? Uhh...
Yangyang: Something's not right. Why wouldn't it attack us?

Strange Tacet Discord: Nngh... brother...
Strange Tacet Discord: Help... Help...
[Dialogue Option]  (Talk to it.)
Strange Tacet Discord: Brother... help...

title: Ominous Star
content:
Strange Tacet Discord: Help... Help...
[Dialogue Option]  (Talk to it.)
Strange Tacet Discord: Brother... help...



Strange Tacet Discord: Ugh...
[Dialogue Option]  Who is your brother?
Strange Tacet Discord: Help...
[Dialogue Option]  (Attack it.)
Yangyang: W-wait! It doesn't look like it's trying to attack us...
[Dialogue Option] Do Tacet Discords have consciousness too?
Strange Tacet Discord: Help...
Strange Tacet Discord: ...Brother...
Strange Tacet Discord: ...
Yangyang: It seems to only repeat these lines... This is not a common Tacet Discord.
Yangyang: Tacet Discords attack other living beings, because they need to feed on those frequencies to make themselves whole again. When frequencies are scattered and recombined, a new Tacet Discord is born.
Yangyang: This one probably devoured the frequencies of... humans.
Yangyang: Turning the last bits of a human's consciousness into such monotonous mumbles... Are these words the last cries of someone innocent? Who is behind this twisted plot?
Yangyang crouched down, hand on the Tacet Discord's head. As she focused on the Streams, sorrow filled her expression.
Yangyang: I'm sorry...
[Dialogue Option]  Are you talking to it?
Yangyang: No, that's beyond my ability. I just sensed some complex feelings from it... A mixture of deep sadness and eager anticipation.
Yangyang: Rover... I think I know what's going on here.
[Dialogue Option]  Go ahead.
Yangyang: It seems to be begging for help, but it's not asking us to help it. I can sense the pained cries of this Tacet Discord... No, the cries of this whole village.
Yangyang: The village is crying, waiting for rescue.
Yangyang: Something truly awful must have happened here... And the victims'  still linger.
Yangyang: Based on the evidence we've found and the condition of these ruins, that didn't happen all too long ago. I can still feel it in the Streams.
Yangyang: Perhaps the Tacet Field has kept this village from being discovered, or maybe someone has been intentionally concealing it. Anyway...
Yangyang: There must be something we can do. We may find the victims nearby. I can feel someone connected to what happened here is still close... This place is dangerous.
Yangyang: I'll inform Chixia about what happened here. Can we continue our search before the official investigators arrive?
Yangyang: Sorry, I know it doesn't sound very convincing... It's just a hunch of mine, and I don't have any evidence to back it up.
[Dialogue Option]  No, not at all. I believe you.
[Dialogue Option]  This is where Jinhsi's token has pointed to.
Yangyang: Thank you, Rover. Please stay vigilant.
Yangyang: As for the little one here... Let's leave it be.

title: Ominous Star
content:
Yangyang: Thank you, Rover. Please stay vigilant.
Yangyang: As for the little one here... Let's leave it be.



Yangyang: These cards... I see...
Yangyang: The Fractsidus is likely behind it all.
Rover: The Fractsidus?
Yangyang: Yes. I don't know much about the Fractsidus, but as an Outrider, I've worked on related cases.
Yangyang: It's a group of extremists obsessed with fusing humans with Tacet Discords. They've caused terror attacks of various scales around the world.
Rover: Fusing humans and Tacet Discords...
Yangyang: We've seen signs of their presence in Jinzhou, left by lower-ranked members called "Artificers".
Yangyang: Above the Artificers are the Overseers, leaders with eerie abilities and unknown intentions. They pose a far bigger threat...
Yangyang: No one knows their true intentions. Some members speak of world destruction, while others claim they seek eternal power.
Yangyang: And there is one particularly insane Overseer. He's crazy even by Fractsidus standards...
Yangyang: A man who sees no order and revels in destruction... I've seen similar cards in the physical evidence file of the Fractsidus-related cases.
Yangyang: They belong to this one Overseer I'm talking about. They call him... Scar.
Yangyang: If he's responsible for what happened to these villagers... Who knows what kind of cruel and twisted atrocities he's capable of...

title: Ominous Star
content:
[Dialogue Option]  You are... Scar?
Scar: If you need to hear it from me, then... Yes, I am Scar.
Scar: "Cruel and twisted maniac."
[Dialogue Option]  Where is Yangyang?
Scar: We deserve a meeting free of such disturbances, don't you agree?
Scar: That girl... She's gonna sway your judgement.
[Dialogue Option]  What do you want?
[Dialogue Option]  Give her back to me!
Scar: Aw, so you really care about her.
Scar: Don't worry, I don't plan to make you hate me just yet... She is safe now.
Scar: Well, let's just enjoy our time together for the moment. Forget about that irrelevant person, will you? I have a lot to share with you.
Scar: To begin with... I heard you've lost your memories?
[Dialogue Option]  How did you know?
Scar: So it's true.
Scar: That makes sense, given how fragile you were when you woke up. Or I would've questioned the authenticity of those rumors.
[Dialogue Option]  You followed me.
Scar: So you noticed? Aww, I'm flattered.
Scar: No need to be so on edge. By now you should've realized I'm just one of the onlookers.
Scar: But out of all the onlookers, I'm the only one who came forward to meet you, with absolute honesty.
[Dialogue Option]  Answer my question first.
Scar: Hehe... Indeed. I'll tell you then.
Scar: Before you knew anything about this world, you were already the center of conflict.
Scar: You are the unknown variable we've been waiting for. Forces have been fighting for possession over you.
Scar: From the moment you opened your eyes, everyone you've met, including that girl you care so much about... They all knew how valuable you are.
Scar: The world is a cruel place. You are a living, breathing person, but you're just a pawn to many.
Scar: That's why I'm here... Because I see you as a dear friend, and I want to tell you the truth. I am so, so sorry for everything you are about to face.
Scar: But truth hurts sometimes.
[Dialogue Option]  As if you were any different.
Scar: Hehe, I know you are not one I can sway with simple words.
[Dialogue Option]  You're just trying to make me join your side.
Scar: You could say I'm looking forward to your choice.
Scar: My goal is simple. I just want to deepen our mutual understanding, nothing more.
Scar: Come on. Observe the surroundings a little more, and tell me what you see.
Scar: As you learn more about this world, your true desires will surface, and our little game will become... even more entertaining.
Scar: And before that, I don't want anyone to disturb my precious alone time with you... That's all.
[Dialogue Option]  What did the Fractsidus do to this village?
Scar: Aww. Why do you have to assume we are the culprits?
Scar: Maybe you should be asking me what actually happened here.
Scar: I won't tell you everything just yet. That's too boring. As I said, why don't you take a look around and see for yourself?
Scar: So. Go ahead, what do you see?
[Dialogue Option]  A large-scale ritual.
[Dialogue Option]  People were injured.
[Dialogue Option]  A strange Tacet Discord.
Scar: Bravo! Didn't think you'd catch on to that!
Scar: Now, what is the conclusion you've drawn?
[Dialogue Option]  The Fractsidus manipulated the villagers.
Scar: Ah, how typical. The age-old tale of savage wolves and helpless lambs. Good and evil as clear as day. It's a tired story that people cling to in their mundane lives. Oh, how it keeps them in check.
Scar: But let me ask you this: do you truly believe the real world can be that simple?
[Dialogue Option]  The villagers killed each other.
Scar: I see you don't really trust those villagers.
Scar: Ah... So they were right about you. You are indeed quite exceptional.
Scar: I like it. Your keen observation, precise judgment, and accurate understanding of human nature...
Scar: Let me give you a couple more tips.
Scar: The truth is far more complicated than you think.
Scar: First, who are the players in our tale?
Scar: An innocent girl, a revered leader, and a flock of simple villagers.
Scar: Next, what makes up our main plot?
Scar: False devotion, fleeting kindness, collective deceit, senseless killings, and... The one vulnerable soul, pushed onto a path of destruction by the masses.
Scar: Now, Rover, the story is yours to spin.
Scar: I'm eager to hear your version after you've learned more.

title: Ominous Star
content:
[Objective: (Optional - Talk to Scar)]
Scar: Huh? What is it? Are you back for some chit-chat?
[Dialogue Option]  I need another hint.
Scar: I see. So you want to cheat, huh?
Scar: A clever move, unbound by convention. I like it.
Scar: But I'm not telling you more. Not yet. Wouldn't want our first conversation to become a boring exchange of words, just parroting each other's lines.
[Dialogue Option]  Just tell me the truth. All of it.
Scar: Ahahaha... No. I refuse.
Scar: Oh, and don't try to threaten me. You're not in a place to bargain, remember?
Scar: You don't want to disappoint me so soon, Rover.
[Dialogue Option]  ...Fine. I'll go look for clues.
(dialogue ends)
[Dialogue Option]  (Attack him.)
Scar: C'mon. No need to get so worked up.
Scar: I see you're itching for a fight, but our game isn't over yet.
Scar: Strike now and risk being crippled. And what a shame it would be to miss out on these crucial clues right in front of you.
Scar: After all this effort, do you truly want to throw it all away?
[Dialogue Option]  ...Fine. I'll go look for clues.
(dialogue ends)
[Dialogue Option]  (Attack him.)
Scar: Aww, are you serious going to judge me off of those rumors alone?
Scar: I knew it... Gentle lambs like me are bound to suffer. Never given a chance to speak for ourselves...
Scar: Well then, I suppose I'll have to be a little more ruthless with you.
Scar: Play nice and go investigate the clues in this village, then I might show your girl some "gratitude" for leaving us be.
Scar: Otherwise... You may have to bid her farewell. Forever.
Scar: What do you say?
[Dialogue Option]  ...Fine. I'll go look for clues.
(dialogue ends)
[Dialogue Option]  Shut up and fight me properly!
Scar: HAHAHAHA! You never cease to amaze me!
Scar: Such a burning desire for battle... How could I have the heart to decline?
Scar: As you wish, then...
(Cutscene: Scar materializes a card, then brings Rover along with him into his domain.)
;(Proceed to "Defeat Scar and break out of his Elysium" step)

title: Ominous Star
content:
[Objective: (Investigate the clues Scar provided)]
A crumpled page from a children's book rests on a torn piece of diary paper with childish handwriting.
[Dialogue Option]  (Read the diary.)
Scar: Our story begins here...
Scar: Once upon a time, in a peaceful village lived a flock of carefree lambs.
Scar: In the day they toiled for food, and when evening fell, they sought refuge from the looming threat of wolves.
[Dialogue Option]  Quite the storyteller, aren't you?
Scar: Fables, stories told and retold through the ages. The ancient art of conveying hidden truths through fiction.
Scar: But they always draw from real life, don't they?
Scar: The same story gets told by many, and each person brings their own spin, their own focus.
Scar: Whatever you learn from it is just one of countless different interpretations.
Scar: Like us now, caught in a carefully crafted plot line... A scheme I had no hand in.
Scar: This village marks the beginning of my story with Jinzhou... Hehe....
Scar: So that Magistrate led you here to meet me. Heh, such a clever move on her part.

title: Ominous Star
subsection: (Follow the TD to find more clues)
content:
[Objective: (Follow the TD to find more clues)]
The tree branches are loaded with paper slips, each containing someone's wish. The words on most of the notes are soaked and no longer legible.
[Dialogue Option]  (Read the paper slips.)
Another crumpled page from a children's book, half-buried in the mud.
Scar: One day, a shepherd visited the village.
Scar: The shepherd brought them promises of abundance and protection. The lambs, drawn in by his words, soon lived in comfort and security...
[Dialogue Option]  Is that... the end of your story?
Scar: No, quite the opposite! The shepherd's arrival is only the beginning.
Scar: With a wave of his hand, the shepherd could grant their every wish.
Scar: His flock obeyed, bowing their heads, pleading for better food and shelter.
Scar: They no longer had to struggle for survival, as their once meager lives were replaced with endless luxury.
Scar: The flock worshipped their shepherd-turned-god, praising him and holding him in the highest regard...
[Dialogue Option]  ...
Scar: What's wrong? Does my story make you uncomfortable?
Scar: Imagine you were one of those lambs, facing irresistible temptation and pressure from your peers. Wouldn't you bow down and beg for food from your master?
[Dialogue Option]  We are all created equal. There should be no hierarchy.
Scar: Haha... So we agree already.
Scar: You are right, but the world we live in falls short of our ideals. The shepherd still reigns, and the lambs have grown complacent.
Scar: It's up to the two of us to make that ideal world a reality.

metadata.subsection: (Follow the TD to find more clues)

title: Ominous Star
subsection: (Follow the TD to find more clues)
content:
[Objective: (Follow the TD to find more clues)]
A crumpled page from a children's book, silently resting on the ground.
Scar: The lambs reveled in endless bonfire parties, celebrating their new god every night, except... the one little black lamb.
Scar: As each night passed, it was the only one to notice how its flock was dwindling away.
Scar: Rover, do you think someone would give you what you want without taking anything from you?
[Dialogue Option]  I believe in quid pro quo.
Scar: Hehe...
Scar: I once believed that too. Thought as long as I paid a high enough price, I could get my desired outcome.
Scar: But true equality is scarce. Always has been.
Scar: The world was never a fair place. Wouldn't you agree?
Scar: To receive equal retribution, one must give more, and more... and more.
Scar: When every wish comes with a hefty price, people weigh their options carefully.
Scar: But when they can make someone else bear the price...
Scar: They all rush to make more wishes. They don't consider they too may one day pay for another's selfish desire.
Scar: Funny, isn't it...

You find some markings on the walls.
As you lean in closer to look, you notice some faint markings on the wall.
Words like "MONSTER", "WITCH", "BANISH HER" and "ALL HER FAULT" are written thickly on the wall.
A crumpled page from a children's book, silently resting on the ground.
Scar: Later, the shepherd openly blamed the black lamb for the flock's decline.
Scar: On the next day, the white lambs welcomed the rising sun as usual, but the black lamb was nowhere to be found.
Scar: The shepherd introduced an unspoken rule to this village, one that our black lamb violated by telling the truth.
Scar: Suddenly, the once doting "god" stopped fulfilling wishes, because no more sacrifices were being made.
Scar: After witnessing the black lamb's actions, and hearing from their almighty shepherd... What do you suppose the white lambs did?
Scar: Ah, those oblivious lambs. Little did they know, the most fearsome demon was right under their noses.

title: Ominous Star
subsection: (Tell Scar your theory of what had happened)
content:
[Objective: (Tell Scar your theory of what had happened)]
Scar: Well done. You didn't let any detail slip.
Scar: Now, I wonder. What is your takeaway from this story?
Scar: Answer me, and I'll reveal the truth of what happened.
Scar: Who was the real culprit behind the diminishing number of lambs?
[Dialogue Option]  The shepherd.
Scar: Indeed, the direct culprit was the shepherd.
Scar: He held all the power, fulfilling wishes at a price. The lambs knew the risks, yet succumbed to temptation.
Scar: Unfortunately, in the face of such temptation, they disregarded all the hidden risks, as disaster had yet to befall them.
Scar: If they were given another chance... I believe they would still choose the same path.
Scar: Inevitably, they accepted their fate and paid the price when their time came.
[Dialogue Option]  The white lambs.
Scar: Brilliant answer. You saw past the obvious.
Scar: The true culprit was not the shepherd, but the white lambs who chose to follow his rules.
Scar: The shepherd never forced them into anything. He merely presented a choice, a possibility.
Scar: No one would have been killed if they simply refrained from making those wishes. Their greed and indifference were the cause of it all.
[Dialogue Option]  The black lamb.
Scar: Oh? So you're siding with the white lambs, blaming it all on the one who challenged the status quo?
Scar: Haha... But in another version of this story, the black lamb got to unleash its vengeful wrath upon the flock and the shepherd, eventually becoming the new rule-maker.
Scar: Is that the kind of ending you were hoping to hear?
Scar: Now, my second question: What price did the lambs pay for their wishes?
[Dialogue Option]  Their lives.
Scar: Of course, as always. Life was the most valuable thing they had to offer.
[Dialogue Option]  Everything they owned.
Scar: But that's what they wanted in the first place.
Scar: Why would they trade their wealth for a wish, when they were risking lives for it anyway?
[Dialogue Option]  Their sincerity.
Scar: They must have poured their sincerity into it, no doubt.
Scar: But that's not much of a price, is it?
Scar: Here's my final question... What happened to the black lamb?
Scar: Nuh uh... Don't rush, Rover. Take your time.
Scar: What is the truth you've uncovered?
[Dialogue Option]  It was murdered by its flock and the shepherd.
Rover: The shepherd was granting wishes by sacrificing the lives of lambs. The flock found out the truth but chose to be his accomplices, and they willingly offered the black lamb as another sacrifice.
Scar: Hahaha, that's right!
[Dialogue Option]  It was executed because its flock was deceived.
Rover: The shepherd was granting wishes by sacrificing the lives of lambs. The flock never found out about it. They were deceived into believing the black lamb was the culprit.
Scar: Almost there, Rover.
[Dialogue Option]  It survived along with all the other lambs.
Rover: The shepherd was granting wishes by sacrificing the lives of lambs. The flock never found out about it. Someone came to their rescue, and they all made it out alive.
Scar: Pfft... Really? You're such a good little lamb. So innocent, so sweet.
Scar: Do you really believe a hero would show up and save the day?

metadata.subsection: (Tell Scar your theory of what had happened)

title: Ominous Star
content:
[Objective: (Cutscene plays)]
Scar: Little lambs cowered and huddled in their village, terrified of the relentless wolf packs.
Scar: Until a shepherd arrived, bearing the gift of wishes and providing shelter and sustenance.
Scar: Slowly, the shepherd gained control over the flock, and the lambs lived contented lives... but this is not the end of our story.
Scar: The shepherd found the solitary black lamb in his flock, and offered to grant any wish it desired. In exchange, he wanted one of its companions as a sacrifice.
Scar: The black lamb refused, and it was shunned by its flock, left without shelter or sustenance.
Scar: After the black lamb's exile, more lambs continued to vanish...
Scar: The shepherd then blamed that black lamb for breaking the rules, and withheld his wish-granting power as punishment.
Scar: From the very beginning, the lambs knew the risk of making wishes—they too could become sacrifices for those of others.
Scar: But they always believed it wouldn't be them.
Scar: Meanwhile, some lambs reasoned that since they had already risked being sacrificed for someone else's wish...
Scar: It was then only fair to pass on that risk for a chance at fulfilling their own desires. And so, they continued to play the game.
Scar: They all knew the consequences, but chose to remain silent.
Scar: Fearful yet greedy, they followed the shepherd's orders and made wishes again and again...
Scar: Until one day a brave black lamb spoke up, shattering their façade of a peaceful and happy life.
Scar: The black lamb got in their way and the shepherd's greedy pursuit, sparking hatred in their hearts.
Scar: Suddenly, they could no longer ignore the blood and ashes of past sacrifices littering the ground.

title: Ominous Star
content:
Scar: How do you like my story, Rover?
Scar: What really happened here? I suppose you already have it figured out.
Scar: The black lamb who rebelled against the rules, and the white lambs who succumbed to their greed.
Scar: The innocent maiden sacrificed, and the villagers who turned on each other in a ruthless frenzy.
Scar: ...They had it coming.
Scar: All the shepherd had to do was execute the rebel. That's how he kept the flock in check and maintained the status quo.
[Dialogue Option]  Is that why you became a "shepherd" yourself?
Scar: Fun answer, but no. Not even close.
Scar: I was never the "shepherd". Never will be. You and I... We are the "black lamb", the one who breaks the rules.
[Dialogue Option]  "He who fights too long against dragons becomes a dragon himself."
Scar: Hahaha... Interesting, Rover! I'm liking you more and more!
Scar: Well then. Let's see if this black lamb is going to end up like you say!

title: Ominous Star
content:
[Objective: (Head to the designated location)]
Scar: Welcome to the realm of endless chaos...
Scar: Now is your time to think, Rover. What is the right path to take?

title: Ominous Star
content:
[Objective: (After reaching the second grapple point)]
Scar: Oh? You've found us already?

title: Ominous Star
content:
[Objective: (Defeat enemies inside the Elysium)]
Scar: Shake and shiver, blink an eye, a flock of lambs come passing by.
Scar: Fleece of white, black and red, who's the sweetest one ahead?

title: Ominous Star
subsection: (After defeating the first batch of enemies)
content:
[Objective: (After defeating the first batch of enemies)]
Scar: Watch out, my dear. Your pioneers are lying at your feet.
Scar: Don't look back. Join them on this right path, and I've got a scorchingly delightful welcome for you up ahead!

content:
[Objective: (After reaching the fifth grapple point)]
