content:
[Objective: (After putting out the first Flare Crest)]
Changli: The glowing patterns on that gate... It's a Flare Crest.
[Dialogue Option]  Did the Court of Savantae build this too?
Changli: Yes. The Flare Crests have a complex structure, but they can be deciphered with patience.
Changli: See how each star represents a Flare Stone?
Changli: That mechanism we accidentally solved earlier should be one of them.
[Dialogue Option]  That's why the corresponding star has dimmed.
Changli: Yes, we still need the other two Flare Stones to open it.
Changli: ...Wait.
Changli: The blood and scales here... It's Jinhsi.
[Dialogue Option]  Jinhsi was injured?
[Dialogue Option]  What happened?
Changli: ...She is likely teethering on the edge of Overclocking now.
Changli: ...We are running out of time.

Changli: Decades have passed, but those researchers' presence still lingers in this place...

metadata.subsection: (After putting out the first Flare Crest)

title: Truthseeker's Pass (Quest)
content:
Changli: The Sentinel's situation is worse than we thought. It had already sustained severe injuries when it descended on Mt. Firmament...
Changli: "With one of the Temporal Programs lost"... It no longer had the power to restore time, instead it could only stop and rewind it.
Rover: So the Sentinel protected Hongzhen with its power, but it couldn't return things back to normal?
Changli: It would seem so...
Changli: According to their theories, the Sentinel's injury would worsen over time. And if the Sentinel perishes... the Temporal Disruptions will spiral out of control, engulfing all of Jinzhou.
...
Changli: So the Fractsidus just added a pinch of salt to the already gaping wounds on Mt. Firmament...
[Dialogue Option]  Is there any way to cure the Sentinel?
Changli: There is nothing we can do. At least that's what it says on these records.
Changli: Only the Mianloong Chamber can provide temporary relief for the Sentinel, but it won't heal it completely.
Changli: In the end, the Sentinel and the "peculiar visitor" who was immune to Time Disruptions would have to come up with a last resort.
[Dialogue Option]  The Chronosorters.
[Dialogue Option]  The "Resonance".
Changli: The Sentinel couldn't be fixed, so they decided to replicate its power onto a Resonator through induced Resonance...
Changli: Their experiments resulted in the first Chronosorter—a manmade Resonance Object.
[Dialogue Option]  So it worked?
Changli: No. A Chronosorter can only rewind time within a narrow range. It's no match for the Sentinel's immense power.
[Dialogue Option]  If objects didn't work, then... What if it was a person...
[Dialogue Option]  Jinhsi...
Changli: We are getting closer and closer to the truth.
Changli: Two more Flare Stones left. Everything aside, first we must find Jinhsi.

title: Truthseeker's Pass (Quest)
content:
Changli: Is that so...
[Dialogue Option]  What does it say?
Changli: So, this file confirms that the Chronosorters are artificial Resonance Objects.
Changli: They activate when hit with a strong impact to create the corresponding Resonance Effects.
Changli: And this also answers my previous question: the Chronosorters rewind time through resonating with the Sentinel.
[Dialogue Option]  That sounds really powerful.
Changli: No, it was nowhere near enough. The Chronosorters shut down once they are removed from the Sentinel's range or the abnormal time flow on Mt. Firmament.
Changli: Plus, as artificial Resonance Objects, their capacity is limited.
Changli: According to the Court of Savantae researchers, there was a hypothesis that could potentially make them more powerful—the Second Resonance Awakening hypothesis.
Changli: Which states the collision between two resonating frequencies might cause a Second Resonance Awakening...
[Dialogue Option]  That prophecy...
[Dialogue Option]  A destined fight between Jinhsi and the Sentinel...
Changli: ...Yes. That fight has to happen to trigger a Second Resonance Awakening for Jinhsi, so she may exert even stronger Resonance Abilities... One that allows her to restore the flow of time.
[Dialogue Option]  Did the Court of Savantae's research succeed?
Changli: Countless Chronosorters were made to collide with the Sentinel's frequencies, but they were no match. All the machines turned to dust.
[Dialogue Option]  ...
[Dialogue Option]  Without exception?
Changli: One Chronosorter briefly showed the power to restore time before breaking apart.
Changli: This proved that a Second Awakening can indeed improve Resonance Ability.
Changli: The research log mentioned that all Chronosorters were in working in an overdrive mode.
Changli: —It's similar to how human Resonators experience Overclocking, they wrote.
[Dialogue Option]  What is Overclocking?
Changli: Overclocking happens when a Resonator overexerts their ability. And this researcher who wrote this suggests that it might be the key to triggering a Second Awakening.
[Dialogue Option]  It doesn't sound like a good thing.
Changli: No, it's not. Exhausting oneself will only result in destruction...
Changli: In addition, I noticed another detail in these records.
Changli: The Chronosorters required manual control, while the Sentinel Jué appeared to be under someone else's command.
Changli: In that only incident of success, just as the 'Chronosorter' was about to break down, that "peculiar visitor" gave an order to the Sentinel.
Changli: And the Sentinel successfully transferred some kind of energy to the Chronosorter thanks to that order.
[Dialogue Option]  Overclocking...
[Dialogue Option]  When the Chronosorter almost broke down...
[Dialogue Option]  Energy transmission...
Changli: Rover, do you have an idea?

title: Truthseeker's Pass (Quest)
subsection: (When player is going deeper into Truthseeker's Pass)
content:
[Objective: (When player is going deeper into Truthseeker's Pass)]

Changli: Jinhsi...

metadata.subsection: (When player is going deeper into Truthseeker's Pass)

title: Truthseeker's Pass (Quest)
subsection: (When player is going deeper into Truthseeker's Pass)
content:
Jinhsi: You...
Changli: Don't worry. Rover is special. The Temporal Dusruption  can't hurt him.
Jinhsi: I... *cough*... but Changli, your...
Changli: Shh...
Changli: I gave my word to be your pawn and I intend to keep it. As your teacher and courtier, it is only right for me to do so.
Changli: And let's not forget, without me playing the Wayfinder for Rover, we wouldn't even have him here.
Changli: Rover has a strong connection to this place. You need his help to resolve Mt. Firmament's crisis.
Jinhsi: But... We already owe Rover a lot.
[Dialogue Option]  I don't mind helping you again
Jinhsi: Thank you, Rover... Thank you.
[Dialogue Option]  I'm here to find out about my past.
Changli: As we headed toward Mt. Firmament, Rover mentioned a strange dream he had. It may have been a flashback of his lost memories.
Changli: Rover, Jué, and Mt. Firmament... There must be some kind of crucial connection between the three. Rover has his own reasons for being here.
Jinhsi: I see...
Jinhsi: Rover, I will do everything I can to rescue the Sentinel as soon as possible, then we can finally talk to it in person. It will surely have the answers you want.
Changli: Let's cut to the chase.
Changli: What did you find in Truthseeker's Pass, Jinhsi?
Jinhsi: According to the Court of Savantae's records... the Sentinel was already injured upon its arrival at Mt. Firmament.
Jinhsi: As time passed and its condition worsened, the flow of time became unstable here, causing Temporal Disruptions that could potentially threaten Jinzhou.
Jinhsi: Only the Sentinel's Appointed Resonator can restore its Temporal Mandate (ability to control time)...
Jinhsi: Their records indicate a solution.
Jinhsi: To reverse the rapid aging effect from Temporal Disruptions, I must deliberately collide with the Sentinel's resonance power during combat—triggering my Second Resonance Awakening. That will enhance my power beyond its limits.
Changli: Let's say you can achieve all that, but Jinhsi... Do you understand what is at stake for yourself?
Jinhsi: I understand.
Jinhsi: ...I share a Resonance connection with Jué, but I never took the time to truly get to know it... I've been blind to its suffering for so long...
Jinhsi: Sentinel Jué has been guiding us since the city's founding with its wise words and well-crafted decisions.
Jinhsi: The Temporal Disruptions we face are just a side effect of its efforts to protect local people.
Jinhsi: ...Without the Sentinel blocking out Tacet Discords through its time-manipulation power, Jinzhou would be a barren wasteland today.
Changli: So what do you plan to do, Jinhsi?
Changli: If the Sentinel's condition is indeed incurable... Nobody knows how far the Temporal Disruptions will continue to spread.
Changli: Today it's Mt. Firmament, but tomorrow it could be all of Jinzhou.
Jinhsi: I... I will...
Jinhsi: If it truly comes down to that, I'll fulfill Jué's prophecy myself.
Jinhsi: According to the Court of Savantae's records... the Sentinel was already injured upon its arrival at Mt. Firmament.
Changli: Have you thought about the consequences, Jinhsi?
Changli: Trying to trigger a Second Awakening by fighting the Sentinel... It could make you Overclock at any moment.
Changli: We both know what that means. You could lose your mind forever, or even disintegrate into dust... You don't want to end up like those Chronosorters, shredded under immense pressure.
Changli: On top of that... Do you honestly believe you can fight in your current condition?
Changli: I can see right through your façade, Jinhsi. You're essentially committing suicide at this point.
Jinhsi: You're one to talk, my teacher.
Jinhsi: I learned from the best. When have you ever backed down from risking your life for what you believe in?
Changli: Oh? I don't remember ever teaching you that.
Changli: We all die eventually, but we need to stay alive as long as we can to achieve more.
Changli: Jinhsi, you must live and inherit the Sentinel's power. Then you can save and protect these people for years to come.
Jinhsi: Changli... I...
Changli: ... Jinhsi, I don't intend to stop you. I know you have made up your mind.
Changli: That's why I brought Rover here.
Changli: You may have already guessed it. Rover is indeed the hero who fought by our Sentinel's side during Jinzhou's early days. He is also the mysterious visitor spoken of in tales about Mt. Firmament.
Changli: All evidence we've gathered points to this being true.
Changli: If anyone can help us with the situation at Mt. Firmament, it must be Rover.
[Dialogue Option]  I don't remember anything, but I can fight.
[Dialogue Option]  I'm strong. It wouldn't hurt to help.
[Dialogue Option]  There might be other options.
Jinhsi: Thank you, my teacher... Jinhsi will keep your words in mind.
Changli: Lastly, we still don't know for sure how the Fractsidus is keeping our Sentinel trapped. This will determine if you can actually meet it face to face.
[Dialogue Option]  Maybe the Fractsidus are just really strong...
[Dialogue Option]  They might be using the Court of Savantae's mechanisms.
[Dialogue Option]  Maybe they manipulated the Sentinel's weakness.
Changli: Yes, it could be any of these scenarios. Lady Xinyi is already on the case. We should get an answer soon.
Changli: The Cipher Key should be inside the stone chamber, behind its entrance gate. There is one more Flare Stone to work out. Let's get moving.

title: Road of Pilgrimage
content:
In the depths of Truthseeker's Pass, you find the Cipher Key needed to unlock the Mianloong Chamber. Changli tells you that she has successfully fulfilled her mission to bring you to Jinhsi and chooses to stay behind to handle the troublesome Fractsidus.

You and Jinhsi return to Hongzhen, and with Xinyi's help, unlock the Mianloong Chamber. You discover that the Fractsidus has used a Court of Savantae creation to generate a special force field that prevents Jué from drawing energy from the chamber, effectively trapping it.

title: Road of Pilgrimage
content:
Head to the Central Chamber
Retrieve the Cipher Key
Return to Hongzhen
Enter the Secret Chamber
Leave the Chamber
Head to Mianloong Chamber
Continue Forward
Inspect the Hibernation Pod

title: Road of Pilgrimage
content: Quest Objective: The hibernating deity silently awaits the pilgrims' arrival. To distinguish truth from lies, seek answers from this divine being.

title: Road of Pilgrimage
content:
[Objective: (When player approaches the Cipher Key)]
Jinhsi: The Cipher Key...

title: Road of Pilgrimage
content:
Changli: Rover, take good care of the Cipher Key.
Changli: I'm leaving the rest to you and Jinhsi.
[Dialogue Option]  What about you?
Changli: Please don't forget: I am your Wayfinder. I journeyed with you into the mountains to ensure you meet up with Jinhsi.
Changli: From this point onward, I will be counting on you both to go and confront the Sentinel.
Changli: This is all I can do for you.
Changli: I'm here to guide, not intervene. The path is yours to choose.
Changli: Not to mention... the Fractsidus has been pestering us non-stop.
Changli: You'll need someone to keep them at bay.
[Dialogue Option]  The Fractsidus are here for me.
Changli: Yes, they've been constantly watching you, interested in your every move. They can never seem to take their eyes off of you.
Changli: By all means, please carry on without me. As for myself...
Changli: I have a more fitting location to make my contributions from.
Changli: Oh, "speak of the devil"...

title: Road of Pilgrimage
content:
[Objective: (Cutscene plays)]
Changli: How rude. This is not how we greet people here.
Changli: Allow me to demonstrate the proper etiquette.

title: Road of Pilgrimage
content:
[Objective: (Cutscene ends)]

You leave the Truthseeker's Pass with Jinhsi on the Carrier Lift.
Rover: Changli...
Jinhsi: Those Artificers are nothing to worry about. Rover, don't worry. Changli has her plans.
Jinhsi: I don't believe we will run into more ambushes on the way.

title: Road of Pilgrimage
subsection: (When player is heading to the secret chamber)
content:
[Objective: (When player is heading to the secret chamber)]
Bing'ge: It's Madam Magistrate! She's back!
Bing'ge: I must go tell Lady Xinyi!

metadata.subsection: (When player is heading to the secret chamber)

title: Road of Pilgrimage
content:
[Objective: (When player approaches Xinyi)]
Xinyi places the Cipher Key onto the Keyforge.
Xinyi: The Mianloong Chamber is open now. You can proceed inside.
Xinyi: Before you go, there's something important I need to tell you.
[Dialogue Option]  About how the Fractsidus imprisoned your Sentinel?
Xinyi: Changli was right. They used the Court of Savantae's research to trap our Sentinel in its resting chamber.
[Dialogue Option]  How did they do it?
Xinyi: They used the Chronosorters.
Xinyi: Our captured Artificer revealed that the Fractsidus sent a death squad to invade Mt. Firmament. They had a two-fold plan...
Xinyi: First, to place the Chronosorter in the Mianloong Chamber while it was still operational; and second, to lure the Sentinel back to Mt. Firmament.
Xinyi: Although their death squad was no match for the Sentinel, by forcing its hand, the powerful Resonance Ability of the Sentinel would clash with the energy of the Chronosorter. This would ultimately cause harm to itself.
[Dialogue Option]  Would that really make any difference?
[Dialogue Option]  How could some Chronosorters trap the Sentinel?
Xinyi: What if the Fractsidus modified those Chronosorters?
Xinyi: A whole bunch of them, pushed to their limits, all working together to deliver one massive blow.
Xinyi: But not even that was enough to take down the Sentinel.
Xinyi: After the first hit, they set up modified Flare Crests in the Mianloong Chamber to form a special force field along with those Chronosorters.
Xinyi: It prevented the Sentinel from replenishing energy and eventually restricted its movement and perception.
Jinhsi: So... We must free the Sentinel from that force field first.
Xinyi: ...It would be a task more complicated than it sounds.
Xinyi: The people of Hongzhen have lived with the Sentinel for generations. We can usually tell if it's in good shape or not.
Xinyi: But now, the Fractsidus want to capture the Sentinel... They won't just stop at Mt. Firmament. Madam Magistrate, I'm sure you didn't come here just for the Sentinel...
Xinyi: Please tell us what you know, Madam Magistrate.
Jinhsi: Yes, I will tell you everything.
Jinhsi updates Xinyi on her findings at Truthseeker's Pass and shares her theory about the situation. She then outlines her current plans.
Xinyi: So the Sentinel is actually injured, and it's been getting worse... The Fractsidus attacked while it hasn't healed yet. Their plans are devious as always.
Xinyi: Madam Magistrate, you've already laid out this plan so far.
Xinyi: It's always a challenge to decipher the Sentinel's intentions, but there were many theories about it in City Hall at the time. I couldn't fathom why it went through such great lengths to retrieve you from Mt. Firmament and raise you within our walls.
Xinyi: But now that I reflect on it, perhaps the Sentinel saw in you the potential to one day restore the Temporal Program and ensure the survival of Jinzhou's inhabitants.
Xinyi: I just never thought.. You'd be willing to follow through with that prophecy...
Jinhsi: It was here on this very mountain that I first encountered the Sentinel.
Jinhsi: Back then, I was too young to remember anything. Even the image of Mt. Firmament has slipped from my mind.
Jinhsi: But this time... As soon as I stood at the base of Mt. Firmament, I felt a wave of recognition wash over me. Memories long buried resurfaced with sudden clarity.
Jinhsi: Lady Xinyi... I was born with my life, my everything connected to our Sentinel.
Jinhsi: But my duty as its Appointed Resonator is not the only reason for my decision.
Jinhsi: ...I'm following the heart of my younger self before I became Jinhsi: The girl who used to laugh with pure joy as she felt the snow from Mt. Firmament on her face.
Jinhsi: I am a seed, born on Mt. Firmament, carried by the wind to every corner of Jinzhou. But now, I have returned to my place of origin.
Jinhsi: It's time for me to take root and grow into something greater...
Xinyi: Sigh... No matter what happens or what choices you make, please remember: the people of Hongzhen will always have your back.
Xinyi: Mt. Firmament has been stagnant for eternity. Perhaps a sudden crack of lightning is what we need to break through the fog of uncertainty that has lingered over us for far too long.

title: Road of Pilgrimage
content:
Xinyi: Once you pass through Hongzhen, keep your eyes open for a cave on the northern cliff. That will lead you to a shortcut towards Mianloong Chamber.
Xinyi: The place is directly under Mt. Firmament's iconic Loong-shaped cliff. I wish you two the best of luck.

Rover: Jinhsi, so far, everything we know about the Sentinel is still just speculation.
Jinhsi: You are right. But my weakening Resonance Ability and my connection to the Sentinel leave me no choice but to explore these theories...
Jinhsi: Whether it's fact or fiction, truth or a lie...
Jinhsi: I have to confront the Sentinel and see for myself.

title: Road of Pilgrimage
subsection: (When player is heading into Mianloong Chamber)
content:
[Objective: (When player is heading into Mianloong Chamber)]
Jinhsi: The Mianloong Chamber should be deep in the cave.
Jinhsi: Let's go.

Jinhsi: ...
Jinhsi: ...This must be the Mianloong Chamber.
Jinhsi: We should now help the Sentinel break free from the Flare Crest's binds.
[Dialogue Option]  The water surface isn't moving at all.
Jinhsi: Chronosorters nearby may have frozen this body of water in time, or it could be caused by the Temporal Disruptions here.
Jinhsi: Either way, we can use it to our advantage... We can walk over the water now.
Jinhsi: ...We are too far away to see what's going on inside.
Jinhsi: Rover, let's go. I still need more information to determine what we should do next.

title: Mianloong Chamber (Quest)
content:
You learn about Jinhsi's past. Jinhsi is adamant about fulfilling her duty. The prophesied battle between her and the Sentinel was meant for the distant future, but she is willing to confront the Sentinel now if it is the only way to keep everyone safe. She expresses her gratitude for your companionship.

Upon entering the Mianloong Chamber, you find a body of water frozen in time. Can you walk across the water's surface to get to the other side?

On the summit of Mt. Firmament, Jué waits in the Sonoro Sphere for a challenger. Jinzhou's fate is in Jinhsi's hands, and she will fight for it in her own way. You support her decision and open the door to the Sonoro Sphere, ready to witness this key moment in Jinzhou's history.

title: Mianloong Chamber (Quest)
content:
[Objective: (Cutscene plays)]
Jinhsi & Narrator: ...Once Tacet Discords terrorized the land. The region of Jinzhou was under siege.
Narrator: A mother and her newborn child were hiding in ruins, trying to avoid the deadly creatures
Narrator: They weren't safe for long as the Tacet Discords found them. The mother sacrificed herself to protect her child
Narrator: ...but with her gone, it was difficult for the newborn to survive. In a couple minutes, its loud cries gradually died out
Narrator: Fortunately, the newborn's cries echoed through the forest, with a unique resonance that reached the ears of the mighty Sentinel
Narrator: With a burst of energy, our Sentinel dispelled the surrounding evils
Narrator: But sadly, it was too late
Narrator: That night, Mt. Firmament shook with the roars of a Loong, and dark clouds gathered. The Sentinel returned with a dead infant in its embrace
Narrator: As if by magic, somber clouds parted and shooting stars lit up the sky. With Mt. Firmament's unique flow of time, the Sentinel brought the deceased infant back to life
Jinhsi & Narrator: The resurrected infant became known as the Sentinel's Appointed Resonator, and went on to become the Magistrate of Jinzhou...

title: Mianloong Chamber (Quest)
content:
Jinhsi: ...
[Dialogue Option]  The "deceased infant" here, is it...
Jinhsi: Yes... It's me.
Jinhsi: I've lived in Jinzhou my whole life and never ventured into Hongzhen, yet even I know of the legend.
Jinhsi: To me, Jué is more than just our Sentinel or a revered divine being... It raised me and saved me from certain death.
Jinhsi: I've been thinking about it on our way here.
Jinhsi: If the Sentinel predicted our fight, why would it even bother saving me in the first place?
Jinhsi: Now I understand why. Because I am the Sentinel's Resonator. I may not have any extraordinary abilities, but I do possess the Temporal Program that it accidentally lost.
Jinhsi: If Jinzhou ever faces a similar time crisis, I... I might be the only one who can set things right.
Jinhsi: ...In our Sentinel's prediction, the battle between us is supposed to happen in the distant future.
Jinhsi: It had been waiting for an opportunity, a right moment to tell me the truth. That's why it didn't explain.
Jinhsi: Now may not be the opportunity the Sentinel has been waiting for, but my body cannot hold up much longer...
Jinhsi: I have to go and face it while I still can... to learn about the truth, or complete our destined battle.
[Dialogue Option]  You can still give up.
[Dialogue Option]  As your friend, I don't want to see you suffer.
Jinhsi: Give up... my duty? I never thought about it...
Jinhsi: To be honest... I did doubt myself many times.
Jinhsi: It was the endless kindness of you, Changli, Xinyi, and everyone in Jinzhou that gave me the courage to push on.
Jinhsi: Even Jué's decision to bring me back to life... Whether out of pity or not, I am truly grateful. The thought of it warms my heart every time.
Jinhsi: Jinzhou holds everything that's dear to me. Even without the title of Magistrate, I could never leave Jinzhou behind.
[Dialogue Option]  But your wounds...
Jinhsi: I'm okay...
Jinhsi: The pain I'm feeling is nothing compared to those trapped in the Temporal Disruptions.
Jinhsi: I must find the Sentinel as soon as possible. We draw from the same source of power—saving it means saving myself.
[Dialogue Option]  Do you have to fight the Sentinel?
Jinhsi: If there is truly no other option in the end...
Jinhsi: Then I will have to fight it. I refuse to back down.
Jinhsi: I will fight. To protect the Sentinel, and to defend Jinzhou. One life may be lost, but many will be saved.
Jinhsi: If it means keeping everyone safe, then I have no regrets giving my own life.
Jinhsi: But let me make one thing clear—I am not planning on dying yet. I am here to fight for a chance at survival, no matter how slim that chance may be.
Jinhsi: We're not in a situation where death is our only option, are we?
[Dialogue Option]  I trust your decision.
[Dialogue Option]  I will help you.
Jinhsi: Thank you for placing your trust in me.
Jinhsi: Come to think of it, many good things have happened to me since you arrived in Jinzhou.
Jinhsi: Thank you, Rover.
[Dialogue Option]  I am always here for you.
[Dialogue Option]  I'll make sure you turn out safe.
[Dialogue Option]  I'll go meet the Sentinel with you.
Jinhsi: My teacher Changli told me it's up to both of us to solve the crisis at Mt. Firmament. As I know you have a special connection with our Sentinel, I need your support in this decision.
Jinhsi: But don't worry, I'm prepared. This isn't about succumbing to destiny, it's about embracing it fully.
Jinhsi: I am grateful to have you by my side through it all.

title: Mianloong Chamber (Quest)
content:
"Jué": Jinhsi, it has been quite some time.
"Jué": And greetings, Lord Arbiter. Or should one address you as "Rover" now?
"Jué": One cannot discern the cause of your arrival, yet its significance heralds Jinzhou's fateful juncture.
"Jué": Shall a "child" who has lost their memories take up arms and fight for their fate? Or shall they retreat to their cradle and slumber?
"Jué": The seed of the future shall be sown in this very moment.
[Dialogue Option]  What do you mean by "Arbiter"? What should I do?
[Dialogue Option]  I don't understand. Care to explain again?
"Jué": Once the situation settles, an explanation shall be provided. For now, one must implore you to simply engage, decide, and observe.
"Jué": Jinhsi, your journey has been an arduous one. Aside from aiding one in this predicament, surely there are other inquiries you wish to make?
Jinhsi: I cannot bring myself to ask for more. All I seek is the truth.
Jinhsi: Mt. Firmament is in grave danger... Regarding the Temporal Mandate and your injuries... Please, do not keep the truth from me any longer.
"Jué": One understands your concerns. The timing may not be optimal for this disclosure, yet in the midst of crisis, one must act with expedience.
"Jué": For one will soon perish.
Jinhsi: ...
"Jué": One such as this, of immortal nature, is designed to endure for all time.
"Jué": Yet one suffered severe harm in ancient times, and now relies on the Mianloong Chamber for survival.
"Jué": This is not the optimal solution.
"Jué": For a long time, one has had to use this chamber to replenish energy, hoping to delay the inevitable doom.
"Jué": Yet fate cannot be defied. The Fractsidus have conspired against this one. Now, the injury only worsens... The Mianloong Chamber can no longer prolong one's life.
[Dialogue Option]  If you die, what will happen to Jinzhou?
"Jué": Jinzhou... The city of Jinzhou will be no more.
Jinhsi: ...
"Jué": Ever since one descended upon Mt. Firmament, using the power of Temporal Mandate to repel Tacet Discords, time has been in disarray within this location. The fate of Jinzhou was sealed from that moment on.
"Jué": Over the past millenia, one has defied the laws of nature and sustained Jinzhou at the cost of one's own life force.
"Jué": Otherwise, the Temporal Disruption would wreak havoc not only on Mt. Firmament, but on the entire region of Jinzhou. If this were to happen, all life will be engulfed in a chaotic storm of twisted time flow.
[Dialogue Option]  What would happen to them?
"Jué": Jinzhou shall forever remain frozen in time. The past and the future meld into one, rendering life indistinguishable from death. The ceremonial rituals and endless battles persist, intertwining joy and sorrow into an eternal blur.
"Jué": All inhabitants of Jinzhou shall endure this perpetual fate until time itself ceases to exist.
"Jué": ...It is this one's own doing, and one must put an end to it.
"Jué": In the coming days, one will exert every ounce of strength to freeze the time in Jinzhou at the cost of one's remaining life.
"Jué": In that moment, Jinzhou will fall into stillness, but not perish. In the distant future, the people of Huanglong may discover a method to rescue Jinzhou.
Jinhsi: Is there truly nothing else we can do?
"Jué": This is not the optimal solution, but it suffices as an option.
Jinhsi: Please forgive me... but I cannot do as you say.
Jinhsi: A decade, a century... What if nobody comes up with a solution? By that time, the world will have turned its back on this forgotten city...
Jinhsi: ...And who would be willing to spend precious resources rescuing a small city in a far-off corner of the world?
Jinhsi: Jinzhou's fate deserves better than an uncertain future.
"Jué": Whilst one may not live to witness the future, one can still envision endless possibilities yet to come. In my deduction, this method proves to be the most effective and stable.
"Jué": Magistrate Jinhsi, as you express doubts, pray tell how do you propose to solve this issue?
"Jué": The flow of time upon Mt. Firmament is in disarray, and it can only be contained through one's utmost effort.
"Jué": If one does not freeze the time now, the situation in Jinzhou shall surely worsen a hundredfold, or even a thousandfold, after one's passing.
Jinhsi: ..You once predicted a destined battle between us... Is it true?
"Jué": Correct.
Jinhsi: ...I was lost at first, struggling to grasp the prophecy's meaning. Only when I learned of your actions alongside the Court of Savantae did it all become clear—
Jinhsi: By clashing two resonating powers, a Second Resonance Awakening can be induced. Through this, I am able to push my Resonance Ability beyond its limits and invoke the Temporal Mandate to restore the flow of time.
Jinhsi: ...Though I will be forced to raise my blade against you...
"Jué": RIDICULOUS!
"Jué": If you clash with my resonance power, even the smallest mistake will result in Overclocking and leave you nothing but an empty husk.
"Jué": You are well aware of its excruciating effects. The pain you feel now is but a faint scratch in comparison to its true torment.
"Jué": Moreover, you will be trapped within the fissures of time itself. Your being will be relentlessly shredded and mended, day after day, denied any respite for eternity.
Jinhsi: But I can restore the errors in the flow of time. Isn't that why you saved me all those years ago? I'm just doing what you've been doing all along... Going against fate to keep Jinzhou safe.
"Jué": Jinhsi, you are given one last opportunity. Let me freeze the time, and I can ensure your safety.
[Dialogue Option]  There must be another way.
[Dialogue Option]  What if I help her? I am here for a reason.
[Dialogue Option]  Is there really no chance for her to live?
"Jué": You are only here to witness before the  right time  arrives.
"Jué": But you are not compelled to remain idle. Should you intervene, we may augment Jinhsi's odds of survival by a fraction.
"Jué": Command me to transfer my Temporal Mandate access to Jinhsi at the right moment.
"Jué": —The moment of her Resonance Ability's depletion, when she is teetering on the brink of Overclocking and near death. Then, we may still save her life.
"Jué": Miss that moment by even the slightest margin, and Jinhsi's fate will be sealed.
[Dialogue Option]  I will do everything I can to keep Jinhsi safe.
[Dialogue Option]  So a fight between you two is unavoidable.

title: Mianloong Chamber (Quest)
content:
[Objective: (Cutscene plays)]
Jinhsi: ...I should have died a long time ago... but I was lucky enough to be saved by you, allowing me the chance to see the glittering lights of Jinzhou for myself.
Jinhsi: ...You rewinded time to save me. I am responsible.
Jinhsi: Jinzhou is my home. If it's ever in danger, I will do everything in my power to protect what I hold dear, even at the cost of my own life.
"Jué": Such a valiant speech!
"Jué": Do you know the weight of this decision?
Jinhsi: I understand your concerns. I will reach my Second Awakening with our destined confrontation, and restore the time flow.
Jinhsi: Are you willing to bet on me?
"Jué": Restore the time flow? Pray, from where does this confidence arise?
"Jué": You are my Resonator, but your strength is only a fraction of mine.
"Jué": There is little chance for you to retreat unscathed.
Jinhsi: But I can at least win some hope for our people!
Jinhsi: Even if it costs me my soul, my everything... I cannot die without trying.
Jinhsi: I may only bear your power for a fleeting moment... It's all I need to secure a better future for Jinzhou, defying all of your predictions. And I can keep you safe.
Jinhsi: If there is anyone who can face you in a fight...That person has to be your Resonator.
Jinhsi: I will be your final winning move in this game.
"Jué": HAHAHAHAHA!
"Jué": Are you truly ready to challenge a being worshipped by your kind? Will you not regret it when you meet your bitter demise?
Jinhsi: I will not regret it, no matter what.
"Jué": Very well! Magistrate of Jinzhou!
"Jué": Come to the summit. Demonstrate your prowess!
"Jué": Show me how you shall be my triumphant ace.

title: The Commander of Time
content:
As the dust settles, Jué meets with you as promised. You learn that you were once Jué's master and established Jinzhou with its assistance. Jué notices something usual about your Tacet Mark just as Abby appears and the two confront each other. Even Jué is uncertain of Abby's origins, but suggests that you visit the Black Shores, the starting point of your journey in this world.

The flow of time has returned to normal. Mt. Firmament thrives once more, and you journey to Hongzhen to meet with Changli and Xinyi. All is not what it seems, however. The Fractsidus is planning its next move...

title: The Commander of Time
content:
Leave Mianloong Chamber
Confront the Sentinel "Jué"
Leave the Temporal Loop

title: The Commander of Time
content: Quest Objective: It is the deity that commands time. It is the deity that bestows blessings. Now is your time to confront Sentinel Jué.

title: The Commander of Time
content:
[Objective: (Cutscene starts)]
"Jué": Lord Arbiter, one is curious about your choice this time.
"Jué": Wherever the tides may take us, you will bear witness to our fight.
Xinyi: Government must be guided by virtue. Hsi, do you keep this in mind?
Jinhsi: Yes, virtue must come first. Politics, commerce—it all must serve the people.
"Jué": From now on, you shall be known as "Jinhsi," bearing Jinzhou's name as your own.
"Jué": What do you think of this world?
Jinhsi: Like... here. Darkness clings, but lights flicker in the gloom...
"Jué": A guiding light is not easily lit.
Jinhsi: That's why they stand out so brightly against the darkness.

title: The Commander of Time
content:
"Jué": This entrance leads to one's Sonoro Sphere. Magistrate Jinhsi, one shall await you there.
"Jué": Rover, this battle is related to the fate of Jinzhou, and only you can open this Sonoro Sphere. The key to Jinzhou's future lies in your hands.
Rover: ...If I open it, Jinhsi is bound to face you in the ultimate battle.
Rover: The ideal outcome would be for her to absorb your power at the critical moment and restore the time flow without any loss of life.
Rover: But there's also a chance that she could push herself too far and end up dying from Overclocking.
Rover: Though... if I do nothing, you'll use your remaining power to freeze all of Jinzhou in time.
"Jué": Correct.
"Jué": Now, please let us know your choice.
Jinhsi: Rover...
[Dialogue Option]  I will open the entrance once you're ready.
Jinhsi: I have been preparing for this moment.
[Dialogue Option]  There will be no turning back...
Jinhsi: I understand. I have made up my mind since before I stepped foot on Mt. Firmament.
Jinhsi: Leaving Jinzhou behind fills me with regret, knowing I may never again bask in its glorious sunshine or witness the purity of its snowflakes.
Jinhsi: But that's why I'm here—to ensure that others can still experience the wonders of nature.
Jinhsi: Our city has a rich history, with generations witnessing endless sunrises and sunsets at the border. Our people have sacrificed their blood and tears to protect Huanglong's safety.
Jinhsi: They deserve a bright future.
Jinhsi: I want to protect Jinzhou in my own way, as Jinhsi, as a citizen of Jinzhou, and as Jinzhou's Magistrate.
Jinhsi: Rover, let's begin.

title: The Commander of Time
content:
[Objective: (Cutscene ends)]

"Jué": Quite the impressive feat, Magistrate Jinhsi.
"Jué": However, you are still a long way from inheriting my power.
"Jué": Back down now while you still can.
Jinhsi: I have made up my mind, and I will not back down.
Jinhsi: You once said it's not easy to become a candle of light...
Jinhsi: But I still want to try. I want to see if I can ignite a spark of hope for Jinzhou!

title: The Commander of Time
content:
"Jué": Jinhsi has recovered. One will soon send her back to Jinzhou for recuperation. Please do not worry.
"Jué": With all matters resolved, as per the agreement, it is time for one to address you.
"Jué": One is prepared to answer any inquiries you may have.
[Dialogue Option]  (Ask about your past.)
"Jué": I am Jué the Sentinel, the guide of Jinzhou's civilization. Everything about Jinzhou has been stored in my mind.
"Jué": You, Rover, are my Arbiter, and my former master.
"Jué": In bygone days, I stood by your side as you established the Jinzhou city. You tasked me with safeguarding its prosperity.
[Dialogue Option]  So why did I lose my memories?
[Dialogue Option]  Who am I?
"Jué": This one begs your pardon, for it is not all-knowing. All my knowledge came from you.
[Dialogue Option]  "Jué": One is prepared to answer any inquiries you may have.
[Dialogue Option]  (Ask about the "choice" and the "access".)
"Jué": In the past, one was granted the key to that Sonoro Sphere by your hand.
"Jué": You said you planned to participate in history, to make choices and witness the development of civilizations.
"Jué": One had previously requested for permission to transfer the Temporal Mandate to Jinhsi, as that is how one is designed to function.
"Jué": Every ounce of my existence, from life to death and even the passing on of power, is subject to your approval.
[Dialogue Option]  "Jué": One is prepared to answer any inquiries you may have.
[Dialogue Option]  (Ask about Jinhsi's condition.)
"Jué": Since Jinhsi has inherited my power, the Temporal Programs are now complete. Jinzhou is no longer under threat.
"Jué": Jinhsi has fully assumed the mantle of leadership. From this day forth, one shall only offer aid when it is truly needed.
[Dialogue Option]  Why didn't you tell Jinhsi about it eariler?
"Jué": This situation has been analyzed before, but the number of variables made reaching a safe conclusion impossible.
"Jué": To accomplish her goal, Jinhsi must possess both strength and confidence. Revealing the truth to her earlier would only add to her troubles and not aid in improving her abilities.
"Jué": Today was not the ideal moment for our destined battle to unfold, but the Fractsidus has remarkably escalated its arrival.
[Dialogue Option]  "Jué": One is prepared to answer any inquiries you may have.
[Dialogue Option]  (Ask about the current situation in Hongzhen.)
"Jué": The flow of time on Mt. Firmament has been restored to its natural pace, but the citizens of Hongzhen must still contend with shortened lifespans should they attempt to depart.
"Jué": Fortunately, with Jinhsi's Resonance Ability, they can stay safe as long as they remain on the mountain.
"Jué": For lack of a better solution, this is the best we can do.
"Jué": Through countless ages, the imposing Mt. Firmament stood firm against the storms. But as spring brings thunder and change, one feels a spark of transformation in the air.
[Dialogue Option]  "Jué": One is prepared to answer any inquiries you may have.
[Dialogue Option]  I have no other questions.
"Jué": The people of Hongzhen have a bright future ahead, one that can be steered in the right direction within mere days. With proper leadership.
"Jué": Your Tacet Mark... There is something unusual.
[Dialogue Option]  You mean Abby?
[Dialogue Option]  Abby, wake up. Someone's asking about you.
Abby: Whoa... What... What's wrong?!
Abby: Rover, who's bullying you?!
Abby: Is it you, big thing?! Huh?! How dare you, I'm gonna teach you a le...
Abby: Hmm? Wait, pause... I don't think it has any bad intentions... It smells like the "unnatural" smell I smelled in Jinzhou before...
[Dialogue Option]  Well, about the Sentinel I was looking for...
Abby: Ooh, so you must be that Sentinel! Hehe, hello there big one!
Abby: Rover, why didn't you wake me up earlier? I've got a feeling I missed out on a lot of fun!
"Jué": ...It does feel similar to me, but there is some difference.
[Dialogue Option]  Do you know what it is?
"Jué": ...This entity is unfamiliar to me. As it resides within your Tacet Mark, one can only assume you granted it access intentionally.
[Dialogue Option]  Then who else can answer my questions?
"Jué": Lord Arbiter, have you heard of the Black Shores?
[Dialogue Option]  The Black Shores? I've heard of them.
[Dialogue Option]  Yeah, I know those people.
"Jué": The Black Shores is the starting point of your journey in this world. If you have doubts, this one suggests a visit to that island.
[Dialogue Option]  I'll keep it in mind.
"Jué": Worry not.
"Jué": The wuthering waves ebb and flow. They shall send you back to where you belong.

title: Dawn of Snowstorm
content:
Quest Objective: Time resumes and the snow clears. Mt. Firmament emerges from its long seclusion, ready to embrace its revival.

"Jué": One suggests heading back to Hongzhen to reunite with your companions, Lord Arbiter.
"Jué": With Mt. Firmament no longer posing a threat, surely Hongzhen will undergo significant changes.

title: Dawn of Snowstorm
content:
[Objective: (When player returns to Hongzhen)]

Storyteller: Mt. Firmament glowed with the sun's light, high above the clouds and snow. Then suddenly, they vanished, revealing a distant blue sky.
Storyteller: And amidst it all stood a white-haired maiden, like a goddess descended from the heavens.

Storyteller: With a mere wave of her hand, she brought forth a new season, transforming the streets below.

Storyteller: This maiden was none other than the dead infant, now reborn as the Magistrate of Jinzhou.

Storyteller: "When thunder roars in spring's embrace, the sun shall shine upon this place."
Storyteller: "For only through death and strife, can one truly embrace new life."

title: Dawn of Snowstorm
content:
Storyteller: "For only through death and strife, can one truly embrace new life."



Phrolova: Hmm... I see. Doesn't matter. That's not important for our goal.
Phrolova: We have the answers we wanted already.
Phrolova: —With the Second Resonance Awakening, we will tap into powers that rival the Sentinels... Complete control of the artificial Resonator Awakening process is within reach.
Phrolova: And lastly, about that Rover...
Phrolova: This trip was worth it. We've collected many wonderful notes, haven't we?
Phrolova: It's about time.
Phrolova: Get moving. Can't let a certain someone wait too long behind bars.

title: From the Echoes of Destruction
content:
Yangyang has sent word that a Bloom Bearer from the Black Shores is currently in the Port City of Guixu and may have important information about your identity. Upon your arrival in the city, you happen to run into Chenpi's apprentice, Youhu...
In the Port City of Guixu, you meet Niya, a Bloom Bearer who quickly recognizes you. She warns of an abnormal frequency detected in Guixu that must be urgently brought back to the Black Shores. If left unresolved, it might trigger another Lament...
Upon arriving at the coordinated provided by Niya, you find the bodies of several Black Shores members who have died under mysterious circumstances. There, you encounter a mysterious Bloom Bearer named Hoda, who claims to know about your past but cannot divulge the details. Before disappearing, Hoda directs you to Youhu for further clues...
Youhu reveals that the clue Honda mentioned is an artifact from Mt. Firmament, discovered by her and Master Chenpi. Now, it seems connected with the Black Shores. The frequency tied to Hoda is hidden within this artifact, and it seems linked to the deaths of the Bloom Bearers. Reporting this matter to Niya and the Black Shores is now a matter of urgency.
As you traverse the Sonoro Sphere, you finally arrive at your true beginnings. Yet, the person who waits here remains beyond your grasp...

title: From the Echoes of Destruction
content: Quest Objective: The future is still unknown, and the past remains buried beneath the waves. After your journey across Mt. Firmament, all clues now point to a hidden island in the sea—the Black Shores. Yangyang's message hints that in the Port City of Guixu, you might find the Bloom Bearer now stationed in Jinzhou.

title: From the Echoes of Destruction
content:
[Objective: (Head to the designated location)]
???: Well, well! Look who I bumped into—a Midnight Ranger!
Yangyang: Ah! Rover, you're finally here...
???: So you're the Rover, huh? Delighted to make your acquaintance.
Yangyang: This is Youhu from Jinzhou. Like Mr. Chenpi, she's an expert in antiques.
Youhu: That's me!
[Dialogue Option]  What brings an antiques expert here?
Youhu: To uncover clues about hidden antiques, of course! Since Mt. Firmament reopened, Master and I noticed artifacts from there popping up in the market.
Youhu: Aside from Court of Savantae gadgets, there are still plenty of mystery items that don't exactly scream Mt. Firmament, ya know?
Youhu: So...
[Dialogue Option]  So...
Youhu: So I'm betting they're from the Port City of Guixu!
[Dialogue Option]  I received a message from Yangyang.
Yangyang: Yes, I remember you mentioned wanting to learn more about your past ties to the Black Shores.
Yangyang: The battle in Norfall Barrens is over, and the Black Shores should be withdrawing... but they've asked the Midnight Rangers to monitor the area around the Port City of Guixu.
Yangyang: I thought this might be your chance to gather more information about them...
[Dialogue Option]  I'm touched you remember what I said.
Yangyang: Ah!?
Yangyang: You, er, brought it up before.
Youhu: Aw, Yangyang's got a soft spot for you, huh? Are you her SPECIAL someone?
Yangyang: Oh, come on. I-I just know it means a lot to you.
Youhu: Relax, I'm just teasing. So Rover, you're tracking the Black Shores too?
[Dialogue Option]  I still have this Blake Bloom that Aalto gave me.
[Dialogue Option]  This should lead me to them, right?
Youhu: Since we're on the same trail, how about teaming up?
Youhu: Let THIS master be your guide! You and me, dream team. Nothing is going to slow us down.
[Dialogue Option]  That's a little dramatic, to say the least.
Youhu: Not to boast, but epic adventures tend to have a way of finding me.
Yangyang: Since Rover's here, let's talk to that Bloom Bearer first.

title: From the Echoes of Destruction
content:
[Objective: (Talk to the Black Shores Member)]
Black Shores Member: That's weird. These parameters are correct, but nothing's happening. What's going on...?
[Dialogue Option]  Are you a Bloom Bearer from the Black Shores?
Black Shores Member: Yes. Need something?
Black Shores Member: Oh!? So... y-you're the one Aalto invited earlier?
[Dialogue Option]  The one and only.
Black Shores Member: Ohhh! Sorry I didn't recognize you!
Black Shores Member: Golden pupils and this Blake Bloom. Yeah, it's you alright!
Niya: I'm Niya, A Bloom Bearer from the Black Shores. Didn't expect to meet someone as important as you under these circumstances...
Niya: I know it's unusual, but... could you help me out now that we're working together?
[Dialogue Option]  Hold on, I haven't decided if I want to join the Black Shores.
Niya: Really? But Encore mentioned you'd be joining soon...
[Dialogue Option]  Can you explain what's going on first?
Niya: Actually, we're monitoring abnormal parameters and detected a problematic frequency that needs to be taken back to the Black Shores.
Niya: The Port City of Guixu was decimated by the Lament. If this frequency goes unchecked, it could trigger another catastrophe...
[Dialogue Option]  Are the stakes really that high?
Niya: Yes, that's why the Tethys System sent us to locate and recover this frequency as soon as possible, to prevent a potential disaster.
Niya: Our agents relayed the coordinates, but...
Niya: Since then, I've lost contact with them, which doesn't sit well... I'm stuck here monitoring, can't leave my post.
Niya: Do you think you could help check out what happened?
Niya: If things aren't looking good, we might need to inform Jinzhou's City Hall, like we did before.
Yangyang: We will need to act fast, then.
Niya: That's the worst-case scenario. If we contain the frequency as the Tethys System advises, nothing bad will happen.
Yangyang: Rover, I want to help her.
Yangyang: As an Outrider, it's my duty to safeguard the peace.
[Dialogue Option]  Guess I'll take charge. No surprise there.
[Dialogue Option]  You're right. We can't just sit this out.
Niya: Thank you! It's reassuring to have a Midnight Ranger with us. I'll send you the coordinates of the abnormal frequency.
[Dialogue Option]  By the way, what do you mean by "abnormal frequency"?
Niya: Could be the Reverberations or something in the Sonoro Spheres.
Niya: In Solaris, frequencies can be anything. One thing's for sure though, this frequency represents gravity.
Niya: It's abnormal because... it has its own gravitational center. You should be able to feel a palpable anomaly near it. That's how you can locate it.
Niya: I trust you'll handle it smoothly. But remember, your safety matters most. Don't hesitate to retreat if you run into any real danger.
Niya: And once you're back, we'll hurry to the Black Shores to upload it to the Tethys System... Oh! I forgot you haven't been to the Black Shores, have you?
[Dialogue Option]  Not yet, at least.
Niya: No worries. I'll be your guide then.

title: From the Echoes of Destruction
content:
[Objective: (Head to the designated location)]
Yangyang: I sense the presence of Tacet Discords below.

title: From the Echoes of Destruction
content:
[Objective: (Approach the Tacet Discords)]
Unknown Tacet Discord: R... Run...
Unknown Tacet Discord: The building collapsed...
Unknown Tacet Discord: They're all trapped... It's completely jammed...

title: From the Echoes of Destruction
content:
[Objective: (Head to the designated location)]
Youhu: What...
Yangyang: Look for survivors, quick!
Yangyang: It's... too late.
Youhu: So, they're the agents Niya was waiting for...
Yangyang: What happened here...
???: Welcome.
???: Astral Modulator, the Rover herself. We have awaited this reunion for a long time.
[Dialogue Option]  We?
???: Yes... WE.
???: We are the gravitational force you seek.
???: Time... is running out. Hoda. My name is Hoda.
???: This is MY name. I once lived under it... as a Bloom Bearer.
[Dialogue Option]  Is this your doing with the Bloom Bearers?
???: Heh heh, "you"? Which one of us are you talking to? Men or women, elders or children?
???: Do you hear the echoes of our "lament"?
???: Remember... Remember it all...
???: Remember your past, the past you turned your back on... The past as one of the Black Shores...
???: And respond... respond to the promises you made, to the future we're bound to share.
???: Salvation... is forging a world where saving is no longer needed.
???: No, no! They want you to become a part of them. I can't let it happen.
???: Run! RUN! Rover!
???: What you seek... is on the girl...
???: She has it...
Youhu: Eugh! What does any of this have to do with me?!
Yangyang: Where did it go? No, wait. Don't go over there, Rover!
[Dialogue Option]  It claimed it was the gravitational center we're looking for.
[Dialogue Option]  It must be the abnormal frequency the Black Shores want recovered.
Yangyang: The remaining frequency there is in extreme chaos. It's dangerous.
Youhu: Hold on! Hey, what's happening?! It's starting to glow!
Youhu: It must be from the Black Shores! Look at this!
A mysterious object pulses with rhythmic light, seemingly harboring some form of frequency.

title: From the Echoes of Destruction
content:
Youhu: It must be from the Black Shores! Look at this!
A mysterious object pulses with rhythmic light, seemingly harboring some form of frequency.



Youhu: I need to learn more about this thing. My master and I guessed it's from the Black Shores, and now it looks like we were right!
Yangyang: The abnormal frequency definitely links to the deaths of those Bloom Bearers.
Yangyang: Now it's hiding in this object, but I can still feel its strong attachment to the Black Shores.
Yangyang: Solving this issue is beyong our capabilities. Besides, they also mentioned Rover and the fall of the Port City of Guixu.
Youhu: We should meet with that Bloom Bearer first and explain the situation. This is best left to the experts.
[Dialogue Option]  You're right. We need to keep her informed.
Yangyang: Let's go, Rover. I've a bad feeling about this.
Yangyang: I sense there's more to this than meets the eye...
Yangyang: Port City of Guixu must hold secrets waiting to be discovered.
As the group moves forward, Yangyang informs the Midnight Rangers of the situation and begins preparations to recover the Bloom Bearers' bodies...

title: From the Echoes of Destruction

title: Hidden Between the Waves
content:
Passing through the mist, you encounter Aalto on patrol. After you recount your recent experience, he speculates that the blue figure you just saw might be The Shorekeeper from the Black Shores. However, the immediate priority is to upload the abnormal frequency to the Tethys System for analysis. Meanwhile, the Black Shores seem to be grappling with certain anomalies...
You hand over the data to the specialized robot at the Black Shores, which swiftly uploads it into the Tethys System. The merchant known as KU-Money, perhaps mistaking you for one of their own, rewards you with a substantial sum of money. However, despite its extensive knowledge of the Black Shores, the robot knowns nothing of Hoda's true identity.
Even Monica, the chief administrator of the Black Shores, has never heard of the name Hoda. Right after your discussion, another quake shakes the Black Shores, echoing the disaster in the Port City of Guixu. To safeguard the Tethys System, Monica instructs you to inspect the Modulation Device in the Greenhouse.
In the Greenhouse, you encounter two robots that recognize you as the lone Rover of Solaris. They speak of Blake Blooms as if you share a connection with them, but it appears that the Tethys System is somehow restraining them from revealing the truth of your identity...

title: Hidden Between the Waves
content:
With the Anchor at the TD Observatory restored, a true frequency rises from the depths, bringing a voice to your mind. It reveals that your awakening in the Gorges of Spirits was no mere coincidence. Before Yangyang found you, a mysterious figure had been watching your every move...
With all restorations complete, you scarcely have a moment to res tbefore the enigmatic Bloom Bearer Hoda reappears, addressing you as the mentor she has been following. Shortly after, the Shorekeeper hersekf elerges, welcoming your return...
The Shorekeeper explains that during your absence, she and the Tethys System had taken over the running of the Black Shores. She confirms that it was indeed she who saved you, Yangyang, and Youhu in the Port City of Guixu. To address the threats posed by Hoda and the looming crisis in both the Black Shores and the Port City of Guixu, the Shorekeeper requests that you venture underground, to where the starry sky awaits...
