title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
content:
[Objective: (Optional - Talk to Iuno)]
Iuno: Hmm? Rover, the Dark Tide hasn't stabilized yet. Don't go pacing holes into the ground, I'll let you know the moment something changes.
[Dialogue Option]  It looks like tracking the Dark Tide is not for the faint of heart...
Iuno: It's really about searching for certainty within the uncertainty of Chaos. The Priestesses, myself included, have long made a habit of that.
[Dialogue Option]  I thought Septimont's Central Hub can monitor the Dark Tide...?
Iuno: It can. But many Resonance Beacons were destroyed during the last Tidespawn assault. The data is riddled with noise.
Iuno: Besides, the Priestesses, myself included, have long made a habit of chasing certainty in the uncertainty of Chaos.
Iuno: We're more attuned to the Dark Tide's rhythm than any device. So the burder of watching it... naturally falls to us.
Iuno: But you, you of all people... you're the one who insists on doing everything yourself...
Iuno: Take these materials. Have the blacksmiths at camp forge you something worthy of your hand.
Iuno: Let it serve as a reminder. No matter how far into the dark you go, we are still with you. Don't forget.

title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
subsection: (Optional - Talk to Chamber of Discipline Acolyte and Wounded Gladiator)
content:
[Objective: (Optional - Talk to Chamber of Discipline Acolyte and Wounded Gladiator)]
;Chamber of Discipline Acolyte This might sting a little.
;Wounded Gladiator Hss...
Chamber of Discipline Acolyte: How do you feel now?
Wounded Gladiator: Much better. The dizziness is almost gone, and I can move a lot more easily.
Wounded Gladiator: This potion feels almost magical... and it even has a kind of fragrance to it?
Chamber of Discipline Acolyte: It was supplied by the Fisalia family. It can slow the spread of Dark Tide corruption, or suprress the festering wounds left by Tidespawn.
Wounded Gladiator: Really? I'll have more!
Chamber of Discipline Acolyte: But it hasn't gone through the Order's analysis or approval. Too much, and your whole body could go numb, and you might even start hallucinating.
Wounded Gladiator: Wow, that's unexpected...
Chamber of Discipline Acolyte:...You're not the first to come asking for more of it.

metadata.subsection: (Optional - Talk to Chamber of Discipline Acolyte and Wounded Gladiator)

title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
subsection: (Optional - Talk to Montelli Member and Weary Gladiator)
content:
[Objective: (Optional - Talk to Montelli Member and Weary Gladiator)]
;Weary Gladiator  ...Thank you.
;Montelli Member If only the family had brought more firearms...
Montelli Member: Facing those monsters with nothing but cold  steel is a bit challenging.
Montelli Member: But you seem used to it, don't you?
Weary Gladiator: For years, we've been "hunting" to earn a glorious death today.
Weary Gladiator: The only  thing I can count on is the touch of striking them down with my spear.
Montelli Member: And I bet that touch is pretty damn good, huh?
Weary Gladiator: Ha... of course.
Weary Gladiator: But you're not bad yourself. All dressed up, yet you've still got some real fight in you.
Montelli Member: When you're ready, let's head back and keep fighting side by side.
Montelli Member: I'll cover your back.

metadata.subsection: (Optional - Talk to Montelli Member and Weary Gladiator)

title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
subsection: (Optional - Talk to Worried Gladiator and Diggy Duggy Echo)
content:
[Objective: (Optional - Talk to Worried Gladiator and Diggy Duggy Echo)]
;Worried Gladiator What are you saying?
;Diggy Duggy...!?
Worried Gladiator: Oh, Lord Rover! Can you understand them?
Worried Gladiator: Ever since the reinforcements arrived from Ragunna, we've been seeing a lot of Echoes like this one.
Diggy Duggy:...
[Dialogue Option]  It sounds like...
[Dialogue Option]  They've brought food.
Worried Gladiator: Really? Thank you!
Worried Gladiator: If you're dropping off supplies, head to the other side, and you'll find the spot there! I wonder what Ragunna's dishes taste like...

metadata.subsection: (Optional - Talk to Worried Gladiator and Diggy Duggy Echo)

title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
content:
[Objective: (Find the Huanglong visitor from earlier)]
???:  You're here... Harbinger of the Dark Tide.
Rover:  Who are you? How do you know about this?
Qiuyuan:  Qiuyuan.
Qiuyuan:  The capital sent me to retrieve a fugitive... and gather intel on the Threnodian's Resonator.
Qiuyuan:  I came searching for Ragunna's Blessed Maiden. Instead, I found the Primus.
Qiuyuan:  He was tied to the Threnodian. Knew the truth of it all. But the Dark Tide silenced him.
Qiuyuan:  In his final moments, he passed this lantern to me. Said it was meant for you.
Rover:  So he's...
Qiuyuan:  His ambition and his crimes were buried in blood. But he paid the price. Gave his life to drive back the Dark Tide beneath Ragunna's seas.
Qiuyuan:  That's how the relic reached your hands. Think no more on it. Think only of what's ahead.
[Dialogue Option]  Maybe that was his atonement...
[Dialogue Option]  Maybe that's the debt he owed...
Qiuyuan:  Death is a cheap way to pay for transgressions. He knew it wouldn't be enough.
Qiuyuan:  Listen. Every Harbinger of the Dark Tide, Fenrico, Mya, the rest... they all met the same end.
Qiuyuan:  ...Death.
[Dialogue Option]  I know.
[Dialogue Option]  I'm not afraid.
Rover:  I accepted this long ago.
Qiuyuan:  You've already been touched by the Dark Tide. Even the Sentinel's power cannot reverse it.
Rover:  That's why we're not arguing over who goes in first. Anyone else would just suffer longer.
Qiuyuan:  You've been resisting the Threnodian's corruption this whole time, suppressing your Resonance Ability so Tidespawn wouldn't surface. Everything you said was just to hide the truth. Deliberately.
[Dialogue Option]  I didn't want them to worry.
[Dialogue Option]  The fewer who know, the better.
[Dialogue Option]  Don't forget, I'm also the Harbinger of hope.
Qiuyuan:  You're prepared to walk into death alone.
Rover:  You've traveled so far just to honor a dying stranger's final wish. I'll ask for just one more for me. Please...
Qiuyuan:  ... The Dark Tide rejects outsiders of Rinascita. But you're different.
Qiuyuan:  I'll do what I can. I'll hold the line here. You do what must be done.
[Dialogue Option]  Thank you.
Qiuyuan:  When you're truly prepared to die, death doesn't come so easily.
Rover:  I never act with sacrifice as a given. Not even my own.
Qiuyuan:  One last thing. The Magistrate of Jinzhou asked me to send her regards.
Qiuyuan:  The people you helped... They're still waiting for your return.
Qiuyuan:  Farewell.

title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
content:
Qiuyuan:  The people you helped... They're still waiting for your return.
Qiuyuan:  Farewell.



Rover: ...I wonder what's happening with the Dark Tide. I should check in with Augusta and Iuno.

title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
subsection: (Go to the Dark Tide's point of convergence and talk to Augusta and luno)
content:
[Objective: (Go to the Dark Tide's point of convergence and talk to Augusta and luno)]
Augusta:  Iuno. Status report.
Iuno:  The frequency is stabilizing. If you're going in, this is your best window.
Iuno:  Remember that stretch of Chaos we once crossed?
Iuno:  If Leviathan has shaped this world through the Dark Tide... expect something similar. Shifting sands, obscuring fog. Every step, a gamble into the unknown.
Iuno: That Discord Slayer, Galbrena, was it? She's bound to the Dark Tide. If she dared to hunt the Threnodian, she must know how to navigate its depths.
Iuno:  Once inside, find her existence in the Chaos. Reunite with her. She'll guide you forward.
[Dialogue Option]  So this time, I need to Anchor to her.
Iuno:  You catch on quickly. I believe you know what to do.
[Dialogue Option]  What exactly does that mean? What do I do?
Iuno:  Don't tell me you forgot already? It's about the Anchoring! You've done it before.
Iuno:  Immerse yourself in her rhythm. Feel it. Understand it. Find a trace of her within the chaotic frequencies. And when you find her... don't let her go.
Augusta:  Rover... Keep your wits about you once you're inside the Dark Tide.
Abby:  Don't worry! I'll stick with him every step of the way!
[Dialogue Option]  Then I'm counting on you, Abby.
[Dialogue Option]  You should rest while you can, Abby.
Augusta:  Just remember, you're not going in alone, Rover. When the time comes, we will be right behind you.
[Dialogue Option]  Don't worry. I've faced worse.
[Dialogue Option]  I believe in all of you, as you believe in me.
Augusta:  If you're ready. Step forward.
[Dialogue Option]  I'm more than ready.
Augusta:  May the eternal sun light your path. And may each step bring you closer to victory.
[Dialogue Option]  I need more time.

metadata.subsection: (Go to the Dark Tide's point of convergence and talk to Augusta and luno)

title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
subsection: (Go to the Dark Tide's point of convergence and talk to Augusta and luno)
content:
Augusta:  May the eternal sun light your path. And may each step bring you closer to victory.
[Dialogue Option]  I need more time.



Abby:  Whoa, I didn't think there's actually a whole other world inside the Dark Tide. It kinda feels... holy somehow...
Abby:  (Sniffs) Feels a bit like Chaos, but colder... and creepier. Like something's whispering to me... Eek!
Abby:  Anyway, let's focus! Like Iuno said, if we do what we did back in the Chaos, we can Anchor to Galbrena and find her, right?
Abby:  Now let me remember... Something about "Anchoring to the memories, feelings, and connections in the Chaos." But the problem is...
[Dialogue Option]  She's a mystery.
[Dialogue Option]  We barely know anything about her.
Abby:  Yeah! Galbrena's always like, whoosh! She's there. And then whoosh! She's gone! Doesn't really say much either...
???:  In life, chaos. In death, silence. A stillness veils the teeming multitudes. Glory... is washed clean in suffering's tide.
???:  The hesitant shall not return. The timid shall not pass. Tell me, little lamb, whence do you come? And where does your path lead?
Abby:  Ugh, it's that creepy guy again!
Chimera:  Little lamb, your hostility pains me. I came to aid you. You wish to Anchor to her? A simple task.
Chimera:  Surely you've heard, the Dark Tide preserves memory. Her past is scattered through its depths, tangled in the currents like fractured glass.
Abby:  Then we'll just go find them ourselves!
Chimera:  Hehehehe... The Dark Tide mirrors the chaos of the human mind-shifting, twisting. A fleeting thought, and the path ahead may vanish beneath your feet.
Chimera:  Leviathan lurks in the depths of this world, building Its kingdom, bending this place into Its image.
Chimera:  This place is molded by the Journeying Paradise's frequency. A vision of perfection, unmarred by flaw.
Chimera:  But behold, the Dark Tide's true face. A world of hatred, fear, and despair. The world your kind calls... Hell.
Chimera:  Leviathan merged Paradise and Hell with Its power of assimilation, cloaking rot in radiance.
Chimera:  Yet the mask is flawed. The Paradise is incomplete. These twin worlds bleed into one another to create spatial anomalies.
Chimera:  Countless souls caught between light and shadow, adrift without rudder or self... Lured by false hope, they stumble into Its waiting arms.
Chimera:  Not yet. Save its light.
Chimera:  I will guide you. Walk with me through this wasteland. If you wish to "see" her, then walk her path. Endure what she endured.
Chimera:  You will hear despair's screams. See the dead beg for death. Watch souls willingly burn in cleansing fire... What is it, are you afraid?
[Dialogue Option]  Did Galbrena send you?
Chimera:  "We" share an enemy. "We" need you.
[Dialogue Option]  Are you trying to deceive me?
Chimera:  Deceive you? No. "I" thirst for true, brutal battle. If I wished you dead, I would not skulk in shadow.
[Dialogue Option]  Ha. I fear nothing.
Chimera:  Good... I've seen many enter this realm, valiant, burning with purpose, just like you. But in the end... Heheheh. I hope you endure longer than most.
Chimera:  Her plan is bold. But an unwonted frequency has mingled into the Dark Tide. I know not who it is. This path will prove less smooth than she hoped.
Chimera:  But for now, you have no choice, do you?
Chimera:  Come, little lamb. Open your eyes, sharpen your claws. It's time we journey into the underworld.

metadata.subsection: (Go to the Dark Tide's point of convergence and talk to Augusta and luno)

title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
content:
[Objective: (Follow Chimera)]
Chimera:  The flow of time here is slower than in your world. We have plenty of it. Be patient, little lamb. I shall keep watch over the outside.
Chimera:  Speaking with you through the Mark of the Dark Tide saves me considerable energy.
Chimera:  As for that small pest, put it to rest lest its corruption worsen... My presence alone is enough.
Rover:  Abby, you can get some rest.
Abby:  But, but... Alright, fine. If you say so, Rover. But if anything happens, call me right away! I'll face it with you!
Chimera:  This is the "borderlands of Hell" where the boundaries between worlds tear and rend with the most savage delight.
Chimera:  Seconds ago, we basked in the light of Paradise. Now, we're plunged into the pit of endless damnation.
Chimera:  In this infinite cycle of hope and despair, you must learn to struggle. That, little lamb, is your first lesson.

title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
content:
[Objective: (Continue Forward)]
Rover:  Is that... Galbrena, up ahead?
Chimera:  Ah, a memory. The moment she first fell into the Dark Tide. She was just a little girl...

title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
subsection: (Perceive the Memory Shard found inside the Dark Tide)
content:
[Objective: (Perceive the Memory Shard found inside the Dark Tide)]
Young Galbrena:  ... I won.
Cheering Youth:  Did you see that? That Resonance Ability? Can a child really wield that kind of power?
Impressed Senator:  She'll be a force to be reckoned with. Perhaps even rise to challenge for Ephor one day!
Arkyria:  Damn it... I was so close. If it hadn't been for the difference in our Resonance Ability, I could've-
Arkyria:  What did you do to get that kind of power?!
Young Galbrena:  My power? It's always been there. Since the day I was born.
Arkyria:  Born with it... Hah! How unfair.
Arkyria:  I... I can't take it! I trained harder. Endured more. Bled more!
Young Galbrena:  I know... You're all stronger than me, and all worthy opponents. But please, you should tend to your injuries now.
Arkyria:  Are you... mocking us? People like you, born lucky, never understand what it means to struggle! To fight for your strength!
Young Galbrena:  No, I really meant what I said...
Young Galbrena:  (They are stronger than me... in body and in spirit. So many here are... They just don't have the same Resonance Ability...)
Young Galbrena:  (...Why? Why was I the only one gifted with this power?)
Chimera:  For those who cannot stomach defeat, even sincerity tastes of cruelty.
Chimera:  Fate is never fair. It bestows gifts without reason. Whether blessing or mockery, mankind must learn to carry it with grace.
Rover:  So she is from Septimont. Why did she leave? And why has she stayed away until now?
Rover:  Her Resonance Ability was bright and radiant back then. Now, it feels... different.
Chimera:  The curse of the Dark Tide.
Chimera:  Had she returned untempered, with curse still unclaimed as gift, Rinascita would have burned for her folly. A fitting fate, don't you agree?
Rover:  You claim to stand against Leviathan, yet you speak so coldly of human lives. Whose side are you really on?
Chimera:  The two are not in conflict. Many a mighty alliance has thrived on loathing alone.
Chimera:  And I? I am a Tacet Discord. A devourer and killer by nature. My allegiance lies only with myself.
[Dialogue Option]  But you live inside her.
[Dialogue Option]  But sometimes you listen to her.
[Dialogue Option]  But sometimes you fight alongside her.
Chimera:  We each take what we need. She, too, accepted my "gift." Left to her own strength, she would have fallen long ago.
Chimera:  Do not be so eager for answers. Go live them. Feel them instead.

metadata.subsection: (Perceive the Memory Shard found inside the Dark Tide)

title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
content:
[Objective: (Continue Forward)]
Chimera:  She carved a path through this underworld for you. But the true danger does not lie in shadow. It hides in the light...
Chimera:  Leviathan toils endlessly to bring Its Paradise into being.
Chimera:  So "perfect." So faultless... so dreadfully dull. A corpse in glass.
Chimera:  A paradise so pristine, it begs to be defiled. Let it be painted in blood and fury.

title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
content:
[Objective: (Defeat the enemies)]
Chimera:  Ah, I was right about you. Beneath that calm shell beats a heart that burns for battle.
Chimera:  Congratulations, little lamb. You've survived the trials of the borderlands.
Rover:  Are these... Galbrena's traces?
Chimera:  Go now. Claim the rewards of the brave.

title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
subsection: (Perceive the Memory Shard found inside the Dark Tide)
content:
[Objective: (Perceive the Memory Shard found inside the Dark Tide)]
Chimera:  Perhaps you have heard of the great Dark Tide that swept through Septimont sixteen years ago. It swallowed her whole...
Chimera:  Once touched by the Dark Tide, a human's Resonance Ability and frequency are devoured... piece by piece.
Young Galbrena:  I was just in Oak Hollow... Where am I?
Young Galbrena:  I... I can't use my Resonance Ability. Why...?
Arkyria:  Because the Dark Tide loved you, but you rejected its gift. Now, it will consume you instead. You, your power, and everything that was once yours.
Young Galbrena:  Arkyria...? Is that really you?
Arkyria:  You could have risen above us all. With your gift, you might have become the Hero of Heroes. Why did you stop? Why did you reject it? Don't you crave that glory?
Young Galbrena:  Honestly, I never understood why I was born with this power. You and so many others... You deserved it more than I ever did.
Young Galbrena:  I've asked myself again and again... What does it mean to be strong?
Young Galbrena:  You once told me real strength comes from the heart, not from outside. And someone else said... She said real strength is meant to protect.
Young Galbrena:  The Dark Tide twisted me into a monster. People ran from me. So no, I won't accept this "gift."
Arkyria:  Heh... Well said. My frequency is nearly gone... Looks like I'll never get the chance to surpass you now.
Arkyria:  So take what remains of my strength... Live on... Live for me... Live for all of us...
Young Galbrena:  But why give this to me...?
Arkyria:  You're not completely lost yet. You still have a chance to escape... More than any of us. And this... this is our wish...
The Dark Tide's "Whispers":  Within the Dark Tide lies fate itself... No one can escape the net it casts...
Arkyria:  I always knew... You, quiet as you seem... If someone struck you down, you'd rise up and strike back twice as hard.
Arkyria:  I didn't want to admit it before. But in the arena... You didn't beat me with power. You beat me with will.
Arkyria:  The fire in your eyes... it doesn't lie. That's why I believe you'll see it through.
Arkyria:  So live... With pride, head held high. Free and unbound. Live for us... and prove to fate that it can be defied...
Chimera:  Curious creatures, humans. Always resisting fate. Entrusting all their hopes to a single soul, just to prove they will not bow to destiny.
Chimera:  Yet her power was corrupted. Back then, she was weak, as powerless as a little lamb to be slaughtered. Each step forward was a gamble with death.
Rover:  But she still escaped. How?
Chimera:  She was born through death.
Chimera:  Come. Let us walk on.

metadata.subsection: (Perceive the Memory Shard found inside the Dark Tide)

title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
content:
[Objective: (Continue forward)]
Rover:  The traces end here. There's no path forward.
Chimera:  Leviathan hides Its message in another dimension.
Chimera:  The Sentinel's power you bear. Its hour has come, little lamb.
Chimera:  Use it to sever the worlds. Reshape what is. Follow the road.

title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
subsection: (Use the lantern from Napoli the Second to separate and alter the Dark Tide's "world")
content:
[Objective: (Use the lantern from Napoli the Second to separate and alter the Dark Tide's "world")]
Chimera:  Good. If resistance comes, let that power be your blade.
Chimera:  A journey into the Abyss allows no return. It is a path ordained.
Chimera:  To rise, one must first learn to fall. So it was for her.

metadata.subsection: (Use the lantern from Napoli the Second to separate and alter the Dark Tide's "world")

title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
subsection: (Perceive the Memory Shard left within the Dark Tide)
content:
[Objective: (Perceive the Memory Shard left within the Dark Tide)]
Chimera:  Ah, I remember. When her Resonance Ability was corrupted by the Dark Tide, she fought with nothing but instinct and flesh.
Chimera:  She clawed through monstrosities until she stood before me. Her frequency was nearly consumed...
Chimera:  How rare... a mortal, here.
Chimera:  It shall gnaw upon thee. Slow, ceaseless, until thou bend the knee. Thy fate... is to be made one with it.
Young Galbrena:  I know... the Dark Tide devours everything. Assimilates everything. If I can't escape it... then I'll use it...
Chimera:  To claim a divinity's power is to invite divine wrath. Know this, more Tidespawn lie in wait before thee...
Young Galbrena:  It's already flowing inside of me... So why can't I turn it against them? Why can't I... be the one who devours them?
Young Galbrena:  These "false frequencies" need me to "survive." If this power... doesn't want to listen to me...
Young Galbrena:  Then I'll show it who's the real boss.
Chimera:  Thy own kind wished for thy survival... yet thou wouldst risk it all?
Young Galbrena:  So I can truly live.
Chimera:  To seek a "life true" while death surrounds thee? Absurd.
Young Galbrena:  Then I'll show you... by living. No matter the pain, humanity can live through it... With pride, heads held high.
Young Galbrena:  Fate... It may be loud, but I don't think it's that strong. I... don't believe in it.
Chimera:  To wield the Dark Tide against its spawns... fascinating. Perhaps...
The Dark Tide's "Whispers":  Within the Dark Tide lies fate itself... None can escape the net it casts!
Young Galbrena:  It hurts... but I already see the light...
Voices of the Departed:  Carry our strength... and our final hopes...
Voices of the Departed:  Live. With pride, head held high. Free and unbound...
Young Galbrena:  ... I'm almost there. I won't give up...
Chimera:  Hmmm... Human flesh remaineth ever feeble. This broken vessel's frequency is sundered and shattered.
Chimera:  Yet this... this is indeed a chance of an eon.
Chimera:  ...I shall give one final push.
Rover:  You... You helped her escape the Dark Tide.
Chimera:  Hahahaha. You are free to see it that way. But I made no vow that my "boon" came without a price.
Chimera:  Still, I never did grasp what she meant by "truly living."
Rover:  If you can't tame the power you carry, you'll only be dragged along by it. That's not living. And it's not the future those who helped her wished for her.
Rover:  She carried the same will they did. Even if she failed in that wish... she'd pass that flame on.
Chimera:  Hmph. Beyond my understanding. But mark this, without my boon, she'd never have come this far.
Chimera:  Her defiance has drawn divine attention. Though she escaped, the Tidespawn still hunt her. Her fate will (To be devoured and merged)  catch her eventually.
Chimera:  To spare Rinascita further calamity, she fled to distant lands. Corrupted by the Dark Tide and losing all her power... At first, she could do naught but run.
Chimera:  But she was clever. Learned to track the movements of Tacet Discords through the Dark Tide's fluctuations. Even when barely holding herself together, she roamed the wilds, warning others of the doom to come.
Chimera:  But men seldom listen to a girl who bears a cursed flame.
Chimera:  'Twas easier to believe she brought disaster. Some even said her flames were from Galbrena, the legendary Tacet Discord.
Rover:  So... Galbrena was originally a Tacet Discord's name?
Chimera:  A fiend of ever-burning flame. A monster who spread fear and hatred across the land, luring humans into the fire for her own cruel delight.
Chimera:  She borrowed that name and saved many in its guise. But her one mistake... was her weakness. And that name became a fate she could no longer escape from.
Chimera:  The Dark Tide saw no more after she escaped. So... I will tell you the rest.

metadata.subsection: (Perceive the Memory Shard left within the Dark Tide)

title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
content:
Is now mine

To wield this cursed fire with sanity
You will suffer considerable pain
Is it worth it?

Let's go
The hunt continues.



Chimera:  To consume that Flame Demon, she surrendered more of her frequency to me. Thus our pact was sealed. All that I consume, she inherits as strength.
Rover:  So, she became what she is by endlessly feeding on Tacet Discords.
Chimera:  Hehehe, a pact always has a price. Should she fail to feed me fresh frequencies, I shall feast on her soul  (frequency), piece by piece, till naught remains. So she hunts. Without end.
Chimera:  Weak Tacet Discords are but tasty morsels. Only the strong may stand beside me. If she would grow, she must hunt true danger.
Chimera:  To crave unorthodox power, yet cling to her humanity... 'Tis a savage clash of wills between her soul and theirs. And should her will falter...
Rover:  You'll devour her frequency. Be reborn through her.
Chimera:  I "helped" her once broken vessel with my own frequency. Enough to survive the Dark Tide. This is a long-overdue... repayment.
Rover:  No. It was the souls of those humans who saved her. You just saw an opening in her broken frequency and slipped in.
Rover:  Admit it. You just wanted to escape the Dark Tide, didn't you?
Chimera:  I do not deny it. After centuries, a door opened at last. And she bore a soul unshaken, even at the border of life and death. The most perfect vessel I have ever known.
Chimera:  Besides, suffering is a gift. Through it, she learned the true meaning of strength.
[Dialogue Option]  Don't glorify suffering.
[Dialogue Option]  To endure and overcome suffering is what's worthy of praise.
Chimera:  "Fate" showed her countless tragedies, stirring her compassion but robbing her of the power to save.
Chimera:  "They" gave her a second life, but what I offered was a path to wrest her strength back from "Fate." And that is what she chose.
Chimera:  She walks this path with zeal. Never resting, as if every misery in the world were born of her own weakness.
Chimera:  Oh, and there are four more like me in her now. Ah... I almost forgot, of course, one must not forget the Flame Demon herself, Galbrena.
Rover:  At this point, Galbrena feels like her true name. But what was her real name?
Chimera:  That, you must ask her yourself.

title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
content:
Rover:  At this point, Galbrena feels like her true name. But what was her real name?
Chimera:  That, you must ask her yourself.



Galbrena:  ... Heh.
Galbrena:  You came.
[Dialogue Option]  Yup.
[Dialogue Option]  Chimera showed me the way.
[Dialogue Option]  Not a bad shot, am I?
Rover:  Hope I'm not too late?
Galbrena:  Not too late, not too early. Right on time.
Galbrena:  One side each?

title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
content:
[Objective: (Defeat the Tidespawn)]
Galbrena:  The Guardian of the Dark Tide, a Mortarch... We meet again.
Galbrena:  I tried to clear the path for you, but that thing got in my way.
Rover:  You handled all the monsters along the way by yourself?
Galbrena:  More or less. Too many roads led here, and I couldn't be sure which one you'd take.
Galbrena:  So I wanted to make it easier, whichever way you chose.
Rover:  You've already helped more than enough.
Galbrena:  So have you. There were things I couldn't have done alone.
Galbrena:  As for the rest... Let's deal with what's in front of us first.

title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
content:
[Objective: (After defeating the Tidespawn)]
Galbrena:  One last thing...
Incomplete Tacet Discord:  You didn't have to go so far, Discord Slayer. Take what's left of me... This flicker of a soul won't last much longer anyway.
Galbrena:  ...Just hang in there. I'll find a way to save your frequency.
Rover:  You don't have to carry it all yourself. Sometimes... it's okay to lean on someone else.
Incomplete Tacet Discord:  Thank you...
Chimera:  Human frequencies dull the pain of absorption. Why not let them serve a purpose? Burn them before they turn?
Galbrena:  I did it because I wanted to. Not everything needs a reason.
[Dialogue Option]  That's what separates us from the Tacet Discords.
[Dialogue Option]  Dignity for the dead. Hope for the living.
Chimera:  Pah... I gave you power, not so you would squander it on sentiment. Unleash your true nature. Terror... slaughter... that is what you are made for!
Galbrena:  Your time's up. Crawl back to where you belong.
Rover:  Looks like... you've got him on a leash?
Galbrena:  Taming him isn't the hard part, becoming stronger than him is. Oh, and keeping him hungry enough to feed on my terms.
Chimera:  Do not mistake this for triumph, Galbrena. This battle... will not end until one of us is dead.
[Dialogue Option]  He's kind of like Abby.
Galbrena:  Really? I think Abby is a lot cuter.
[Dialogue Option]  He's quite... moody.
Galbrena:  Let him howl. Humans don't kneel to beasts.
Galbrena:  That power you used... Was it the Sentinel's power of separation? And that incredible little one (Abby)... No wonder Cartethyia had the nerve to propose such a mad plan.
[Dialogue Option]  Mind sharing that plan now?
Galbrena:  Even here, the Paradise's frequency isn't stable, which means Leviathan hasn't completely seized control. So, looks like part one of the plan worked.

title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
content:
Cartethyia:  You bear the Dark Tide's power, but you are no Harbinger.
Galbrena:  Good, we can avoid the lengthy explanation. If you're looking for the Harbinger too, you must've seen it. The apocalypse Leviathan will bring forth.
Galbrena:  It was meant to remain restrained by the Sentinel. But I feel It stirring again. I followed Its frequency... and found you.
Cartethyia:  Most of Leviathan's power resides in me. But a fragment escaped. I've been tracking the one who carriesthat power. (Threnodian's Gem)
Galbrena:  That Gem was cast into the Dark Tide. If this is where things are at, that leads to only one conclusion...
Cartethyia & Galbrena:  Leviathan is about to resurrect.
Galbrena:  Freed from the Sentinel's hold, It's returned to Its primal state in the Dark Tide, like water returning to the sea. We must trap Its frequency before we can destroy It.
Cartethyia:  Or... we can use "me."
Cartethyia:  Leviathan's instinct will draw It to reclaim what was once part of Itself. The godhood inside me.
Galbrena:  But that godhood has fused with your humanity. Their frequencies are nearly identical now.
Cartethyia:  That's exactly how we trap It. When Leviathan awakens, It won't distinguish. It will devour all frequencies blindly.
Cartethyia:  If I offer my humanity, I'll become an Anchor. Give form to formlessness, and trap Its frequency in one place.
Cartethyia:  And if It's now hiding in the Dark Tide... I know you have a way of sending my humanity into it, right?
Galbrena:  ...And I suppose you know the cost.
Cartethyia:  I do. But I have faith in those who strive to protect this land, in him (Rover)... and in you.
Cartethyia:  The Dark Tide can't read either one of our minds. Only we can do this.
Cartethyia:  Discord Slayer, let me be your first bullet. Fire me into Leviathan's heart.
Galbrena:  ...When the time comes, I'll "kill" you in front of them. To convince Leviathan of your "necessary death."
Cartethyia:  Then I shall leave the rest to you. Thank you for choosing to be misunderstood, hated, and for putting your life at risk. Thank you for your resolve, Discord Slayer.

title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
content:
Galbrena:  With the Sentinel's Sword of Divinity, we split her godhood from her "humanity," leaving the divine within her. Then I fired a Dark Tide bullet to consume her frequency and send her "humanity" into the Dark Tide.
[Dialogue Option]  An insane plan.
[Dialogue Option]  I really panicked back there...
Galbrena:  Leviathan can't truly distinguish the signals It receives. It's blinded by what people believe. By tricking the one closest to the Blessed Maiden into accepting her death, we lowered Its guard.
Galbrena:  Now that Cartethyia has trapped Its frequency, all that's left is to gather strength, reach the Paradise, and finish Leviathan.
[Dialogue Option]  How confident are you in hunting the Threnodian?
[Dialogue Option]  Don't tell me you were planning to kill the Threnodian alone...
Galbrena:  Heh, even I'm not arrogant enough to think I can take the Threnodian by myself.
Galbrena:  No apocalypse is ever stopped by a lone hero. It's always a difficult struggle, fought by countless lives.
Galbrena:  In this hunt, my part is to clear the way while the others prepare, set the aim, and fire the first shot.
[Dialogue Option]  You believe everyone will follow us into the Dark Tide?
[Dialogue Option]  But what if...

title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
subsection: Galbrena:  Maybe I'm gambling. People freeze up facing the end. Fear takes hold. Even those brave enough don't always get that blessing of fate (Resonance Ability).
content:
[Objective: Galbrena:  Maybe I'm gambling. People freeze up facing the end. Fear takes hold. Even those brave enough don't always get that blessing of fate (Resonance Ability).]
Galbrena:  But if there's even the slightest chance to stop a disaster, I'll take it. Even if I stand alone.
Galbrena:  All I need to know is that when I drain the last drop from my glass, I had the guts to pull the trigger.
Galbrena:  Worst case? I stay trapped in the Dark Tide, holding Leviathan back a little longer. That's a price I'll pay.
Galbrena:  But... I think I bet on the right people.
Rover:  Some of us might use the word "trust."
Galbrena:  I can sense Augusta's Anchor Stone. It lies beyond this well in the deeper realm of the Dark Tide.
Galbrena:  But the deeper we go, the stronger Leviathan's mental interference will be. Here, wear this.
Galbrena:  This "casette tape" is a rare find from Lahai-Roi. It preserves your most innate frequency. Perfect for what's ahead.
Galbrena:  I don't know how it works, but it's a good time for music, wouldn't you say?
Rover:  Does the song have a name?
Galbrena:  They're usually named after the one who recorded them.
Rover:  So, your real name is...?
Galbrena:  I'll tell you when this is all over. Call it a promise. A promise that we both make it back in one piece.
Galbrena:  If you're ready, let's go.

metadata.subsection: Galbrena:  Maybe I'm gambling. People freeze up facing the end. Fear takes hold. Even those brave enough don't always get that blessing of fate (Resonance Ability).

title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
subsection: Galbrena:  Maybe I'm gambling. People freeze up facing the end. Fear takes hold. Even those brave enough don't always get that blessing of fate (Resonance Ability).
content:
Galbrena:  If you're ready, let's go.



Galbrena:  You know how to use the Sentinel's original power, don't you?
Galbrena:  Then change the world if something gets in your way.

metadata.subsection: Galbrena:  Maybe I'm gambling. People freeze up facing the end. Fear takes hold. Even those brave enough don't always get that blessing of fate (Resonance Ability).

title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
content:
[Objective: (Defeat the Tidespawn)]
Rover:  Why are there so many enemies here?
Galbrena:  Leviathan's kindred. It created them Itself. Nothing more than empty husks.
Rover:  What should we do? Should we avoid them?
Galbrena:  No, we slay them all.
Rover:  Knew you'd say that.
Galbrena:  They need no mercy. Their rest awaits.

Galbrena:   Another Mortarch thrown at us?
Galbrena:   Bring it on. This song is about to hit the chorus.

title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
content:
[Objective: (After defeating the Tidespawns)]
Rover:  It's over.
Galbrena:  Some faint melodies disrupted the rhythm… Try "switching worlds."
Galbrena:  ...Finally, we've arrived. The true gateway to Hell.

title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
content:
Galbrena:  Some faint melodies disrupted the rhythm… Try "switching worlds."
Galbrena:  ...Finally, we've arrived. The true gateway to Hell.



Devotees:  "Shining with your love... We stand united in devotion... "
Devotees:  "With hearts full of joyous loyalty... we rise from the sea... guided by your light... "
Galbrena:  The dead grow tongues and sing praise day and night. That's what becomes of those consumed by the Dark Tide.
Galbrena:  If the Journeying Paradise reaches our world, everyone in Rinascita... will suffer the same fate.
Chimera:  Heh... Look at them. Lining up to flatter their Divinity, groveling for Its grace.
Chimera:  Without Leviathan's "wisdom," feeble minds like theirs are fit only to be devoured.
Galbrena:  Ceaseless worship, stripped of meaning or soul. From this shore to the next, from Paradise back to our world...
Chimera:  All to gather more "believers," to be drawn into the Paradise's maw. Then they'll go claim their due from Leviathan.
Galbrena:  Even with the tape's help, we can't stay exposed to these "hymns" for too long... Chimera.
Chimera:  I don't take your orders.
Chimera:  Silence, wretched souls! There is no place for you in Paradise. Burn in your ruin and rot in Hell.
Rover:  Seems Chimera still commands some authority here.
Chimera:  Hmph, coming back here feels like coming home. By blood, they ought to call me... Forefather.
Chimera:  Leviathan was right about one thing. Fear is the most ancient and enduring truth in all living things.

title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
content:
[Objective: (Arrive at the familiar lake)]
Rover:  We're here again...
Galbrena:  The Styx Lake. A myth once whispered in Septimont, now carved into reality by Leviathan.
Galbrena:  Those touched by the Tidespawn often begin to see things. Hallucinations...and this lake is usually the first they find.
Galbrena:  Anger, sorrow, pain... Leviathan reads the depths of our hearts. And from them, It births this river of memory.
Galbrena:  What you see here is a part of you. The river mirrors what you fear most.
Rover:  That's why I saw those terrible visions. But why were you there too?
Galbrena:  My mind can walk between reality and the Dark Tide. I've crossed this lake many times, trying to guide the lost home.
Galbrena:  Oftentimes it isn't Hell that people fear. They fear fear itself, and that creates Hell.

title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
content:
[Objective: (Examine the Weathered Stele)]
Galbrena:  There, do you see it? At the edge of this underworld... That's the Journeying Paradise.
Inscribed Words:  Through me, walk the Path of Glorious Ascension... Through me, enter the City of Eternal Bliss...
Galbrena:  No matter how Leviathan dresses it up, it can't hide the truth. It is a liar, twisting souls and selling a Paradise of lies.
Rover:  This lake... It's not quite like how I remembered it.
Galbrena:  The Styx Lake. A place where all souls meet. Some call it by another name—Manes Deep.
Galbrena:  Leviathan reshaped it through the Dark Tide, turning it into a furnace wheresouls  (frequencies) are melted down and reforged.
Chimera:  A crude imitation of the Sentinel's way of giving form to Remnant Creatures. But Leviathan takes the souls devoured by the Dark Tide and forges them into Its obedient kindreds.
[Dialogue Option] You seem... nostalgic.
Chimera:  Nostalgic? No. What I carry is rage. A rage... for vengeance.
[Dialogue Option]  Are you angry for those lost souls?
Chimera:  Perhaps... What I carry is rage. A rage... for vengeance.
Galbrena:  This is where Chimera was born.
Chimera:  Hehe... Do you mean "me"? Or... "us"?
Chimera:  Born from the fury that courses through the earth, rage cast my spine, and slaughter forged my chest...
Chimera:  I've torn through countless souls, rained fire on fields, slept to the wails of a thousand dying cries... They remember me as "Nemean," the name of the land I reduced to ruins. A name forever seared into their hearts with terror.
Chimera:  But Leviathan... Its treachery dragged me into the Dark Tide. It twisted my frequency and forced me into an abominable union with the frail Goat and pathetic Serpent. We were merged into one...
Chimera:  Since then, our frequencies gnaw and rend at one another. Torment without end! The agony wrought by Its will, I shall repay tenfold, carving bone, feasting on marrow, until nothing remains!
[Dialogue Option]  Sounds like you were powerful.
[Dialogue Option]  Sounds like you were a villain.
[Dialogue Option]  That's a lot of big words. Speak plainly.
Galbrena:  Chimera was Leviathan's first Tidespawn, created by fusing the frequencies of three powerful Tacet Discords. The first of Its kindred.
Galbrena:  Don't expect nobility from him. He has the gift of wisdom, but at his core, he's still a Tacet Discord driven by instinct. A destroyer "in life," a prisoner of vengeance "in death."
Galbrena:  That vengeance is what broke Leviathan's leash. For now, our goals align... and that's likely why he's willing to listen this time.
Galbrena:  These human frequencies... They're trapped in the Dark Tide's corruption, still clinging to their last shreds of will.
Galbrena:  Leviathan can do nothing but trap them here and torture them with the pain It's harvested. That alone is reason enough to slay It.
Rover:  We end Leviathan, we set them free.
Galbrena:  Exactly. Look, the Anchor Stone Augusta placed is just across the lake.
[Dialogue Option]  Can we just swim across?
[Dialogue Option]  Can we fly across?
Galbrena:  No. The waters are dark with corruption. Trying to cross would only rouse the Dark Tide.
???:  Wretched souls... Abandon all yearning for the light of Paradise. I come not to save, but to ferry thee to the far shore, into the underworld of hell, into frost and flame.
???:  As for you... The living have no place upon this river. Turn back. Seek another crossing. Leave this place, and be not consorts of the dead.
[Dialogue Option]  Do you see anyone else around us?
[Dialogue Option]  Can you sense anything strange from him?
[Dialogue Option]  Is he one of Leviathan's creations?
Galbrena:  Beholder finds no anomaly. Long staff, eyes like burning coals...
Galbrena:  If Leviathan based this underworld on the old tales of Septimont, then this must be Kharon, the ferryman of the dead.
Galbrena:  Its made-up characters only mechanically follow their scripted roles. Hand me that lantern-shaped Terminal. I'll handle this.
Kharon:  Whence comes your pride, that you would defy my word?
Galbrena:  We come by the Highest Will's command. By divine pardon, we shall cross to honor the dead and to return hope to the living.
[Dialogue Option] ...Please ferry us.
[Dialogue Option] ...Do you think it'll actually work?
[Dialogue Option] ...You're really getting into this.
Kharon:  A vessel for the dead bears not the weight of the living. If you would cross, cast off the riches and honors of your former days.
Galbrena:  The old stories say Kharon favors gold and jewels. If the living seek passage, they must offer a fortune deemed worthy.
Kharon:  The accursed shore awaits all who fear not Divinity. If your heart harbors unfinished desires, and you fear not death... then come. Step aboard.

title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
content:
Kharon:  We have arrived.
Rover:  That was... surprisingly smooth.
Galbrena:  Hmm. I had the Beholder on him the whole time.
Galbrena:  My instincts keep telling me something's off. We'd better stay sharp.
Galbrena:  The Anchor Stone is just ahead. Let's go activate it.
Galbrena:  Its energy has been reshaped by the Dark Tide. We'll need the Sentinel's power to purify it before activation.

title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
content:
[Objective: (Purify the Anchor Stone)]
Galbrena:  It's done. The Terminal's comms should be restored. Let's contact Augusta.

title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
content:
Iuno:  Yes, we saw it. The Anchor Stone has been activated. Sooner than expected...
Cantarella:  My family's potions are ready, but please, a word...
Cantarella:  It's been crafted from the Threnodian's (frequency) venom. Outside the corruption's reach, it induces hallucinations—warping your senses and clouding judgment.
Cantarella:  If you aren't immediately entering the Dark Tide, I advise you all not to drink it.
Augusta:  Ground defenses are holding and no major fluctuations in the Dark Tide for now...
Augusta:  Everyone...
Iuno:  Wait... An intense frequency suddenly... It's moving toward the western front!
Scar:  ...Is this the best the mighty Gladiators of Septimont can offer?
Scar:  A grand finale deserves grandeur! How can such a dull act satisfy the audience?
Scar:  Hahaha! Yes! Now this is a scene fit for the final act!
Qiuyuan:  Blades do not discriminate. Leave. This one's mine.
Scar:  Oh? Has Huanglong fallen so low, they now send a blind man to die?
Qiuyuan:  Prisoner Scar of Jinzhou. Surrender now. One strike is all it would take to end you. Surrender, and you may be spared pain.
Scar:  In an epic play such as this, I refuse an early exit.
Qiuyuan:  My orders were to bring you back. Dead or alive.
Qiuyuan:  I never planned on bringing you back alive.
Qiuyuan:  Your head belongs to me.

title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
content:
[Objective: (Defeat Scar)]
Scar:  You're too late, defender of Huanglong.
Scar:  Beneath the Dark Tide, It stirs once more...
Scar:  ALL HOPE WILL BE SWEPT AWAY!
Qiuyuan:  You talk too much.
Rover:  The connection was cut off...
Galbrena:  The Fractsidus really sent two Overseers at once...
[Dialogue Option]  They definitely had a plan.
[Dialogue Option]  Did they know about our plan?
Rover:  (Phrolova and Scar... Their appearance was too well-timed, like they knew our strategy all along. Meanwhile, Cristoforo's just biding his time in the shadows. This must be just the beginning.)
Rover:  (No matter. The Dark Tide was just unleashed because of the Fractsidus's interference. And everyone there... they didn't even take the potion before it swallowed them... )
Galbrena:  Trust them. Their will is stronger than the corruption.
Rover:  The Anchor Stone has been activated. It will guide them through the Dark Tide...
Galbrena:  Watch out!
Kharon:  Fret not. Soon, you and your companions shall reunite... in the boundless embrace of eternal night.
Kharon:  Your journey ends here. What is writ by fate shall not be swayed. To resist is to invite naught but deeper woe.
Galbrena:  Huh. The Fractsidus must think highly of us. Even you are here.
Galbrena:  No wonder the Beholder couldn't read your frequency. It can't pierce something as ancient as the concept of death.
[Dialogue Option]  Who is he, really?
Galbrena:  I've seen many who can use their Forte to mimic or create, but to perfectly replicate another's frequency and even forge an entirely new body...
Galbrena:  There's only one person who can do that-the thousand-faced survivor, the Grand Architect of the Fractsidus, Schwarzloch. But I doubt that's your real name, huh?
Kharon (Schwarzloch):  The children have toiled to script this grand spectacle and penned a part for me. How could I deny their goodwill?
Kharon (Schwarzloch):  I have slumbered in shadow for too long. This old vessel... yearns to stir.
[Dialogue Option]  So the leader of the Fractsidus himself decides to show up...
Kharon (Schwarzloch):  You are our honored guest. And so, you shall be received with all the reverence your presence commands.
[Dialogue Option]  You're not really him, are you?
Kharon (Schwarzloch):  Perceptive indeed. But this vessel, wrought from ancient tales, sufficeth to welcome you.
[Dialogue Option]  You must've spent ages memorizing those lines.
Kharon (Schwarzloch):  Time hath long since lost all meaning. I have dwelt in this world... for far, far too long.
Kharon (Schwarzloch):  The path of return is barred by the Styx Lake. The Waystone (Anchor Stone) was shattered by my own hand. Stay here, and I shall see you unharmed.
Galbrena:  You ferried us across only to bar the return. Well played.
Galbrena:  The answer is plain to see.
[Dialogue Option]  We must forge ahead.
[Dialogue Option]  There's no retreat.
[Dialogue Option]  We will be the Waystones.
Galbrena:  No one is going to stand in our way.
Kharon (Schwarzloch):  A regrettable choice.
Kharon (Schwarzloch):  Violence is not mine to seek... yet the role I am given is clear: to halt the one who would end Leviathan here.
Galbrena:  Leave him to me.
Galbrena:  Go. Knock upon the gates of Paradise and let its bells toll through the dark to guide their way.
[Dialogue Option]  Be careful.
[Dialogue Option]  And you?
Galbrena:  I'll find a way. Once it's done, I'll catch up. Remember our promise?
Galbrena:  So long as one of us reaches Paradise, hope lives on. GO!
Kharon (Schwarzloch):  Very well. Galbrena, let us see how far you have come since that day.

title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
content:
Kharon (Schwarzloch):  Very well. Galbrena, let us see how far you have come since that day.



Abby:  Looks like it's just the two of us now, Rover.
Rover:   We can't give up. Not as long as there is hope.
Abby:  Right! I'll fight by your side till the end!
Abby:  Look! The path to the Paradise is just ahead! If we push through them, we're almost there! We'll make it!

title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
content:
[Objective: (Defeat the enemies)]
Rover:  The Dark Tide's influence is getting stronger... Are you alright, Abby?
Abby:  Yeah... no worries!
Rover:  ... Okay, I'll make it quick.

Rover:  More enemies...
Abby:  Rover... the "Journeying Paradise" is just ahead...

title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
content:
[Objective: (Defeat the enemies)]
Rover:  Abby's frequency is weakening... I can barely sense it.
Abby:  Ugh... Stop yapping... So dizzy...
Rover:  ...Leviathan's whispers?

title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
content:
[Objective: (Go down the hallway)]
??? Swim up... I can't... why...
??? So dark... It's scary here... Pero... Where are you...

Rover:  These voices...

??? Nothing left... All buried in ruins... The Montellis...
??? I tried to protect... but... I failed them...

??? Maybe this is how it ends for the Fisalias... We all become Its puppets...

??? No one answered my prayers... But my faith was always true... Please... don't punish me...

??? My songs... I can't hear them... where did they go...

Abby:  My head... it hurts. I can't take it...
Abby:  I'm sorry, Rover... I...
Rover:  ...Abby!

??? A Gladiator... should die on the battlefield...

??? My warriors... A ruler who stands alone... is meaningless...

??? To disappear again... But this time... for nothing...
Rover:  ENOUGH!

title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
content:
??? My warriors... A ruler who stands alone... is meaningless...

??? To disappear again... But this time... for nothing...
Rover:  ENOUGH!



Cristoforo:  Welcome, Rover. A pleasure to see you again.
Cristoforo:  No need to rush toward the abyss in such haste. Please, take your time to enjoy this interlude before the story meets its climax.
[Dialogue Option]  I don't care about your theatrics.
Cristoforo:  Did Avidius's story stir sorrow and anger in your heart?
[Dialogue Option]  What are you really after?
Cristoforo:  Avidius's story stirred sorrow and anger in your heart, I presume?
Cristoforo:  By now, you must have realized that Rinascita's fate was forged by the Sentinel.
Cristoforo:  With that truth exposed, have you ever suspected that "humanity's fate" could also be the design of a higher being?
Cristoforo:  A girl born into a land ravaged by war... Tell me, why was she fated to stand against the divine and endure a "Second Suffering"? And that one, born of Sonoro itself, designed to serve as the "core of a hollow system"...
Cristoforo:  Who scripts such destinies? Who appoints such suffering? If fate cannot grant equal grace to all... If it cannot offer each soul a just and rightful end...
Cristoforo:  Then perhaps it is wewho must tear the old script and become the authors of a new one.
[Dialogue Option]  You want to play god.
[Dialogue Option]  You want to rewrite humanity's fate.
Rover:  No matter how noble your reason may sound, the crimes you've committed in Rinascita are far too great to ever be forgiven.
Cristoforo:  I care little for my own fate. I am but a small footnote in this "grand repertoire."
Cristoforo:  One day, my role will, too, end. And if that finale serves to bring the curtain down with perfection and grandeur, I'd gladly add it to the "script."
Cristoforo:  However, my moment on stage has yet to come. The spotlight now belongs to the people of Rinascita.
Rover:  You wrote Avidius and all of Rinascita into a tragedy, just to prove a point.
Rover:  You speak of divinities with disdain, but the moment you took up that "quill," you became no different. I don't trust you, or the "quill" in your hands.
Cristoforo:  Certainly. I do believe there is someone more worthy than I to wield it.
Cristoforo:  We've invited you before, many times. Should you choose to accept... you would be the one to hold that quill.
[Dialogue Option]  Fate should be written by all of humanity.
[Dialogue Option]  No one has the right to dictate another's fate.
[Dialogue Option]  That quill belongs to no one. Not you. Not me.
Cristoforo:  Unbound by Rinascita's fate, and still, you descend into the abyss alone... to aid in their defiance of fate. Aren't you merely playing the role of savior?
Cristoforo:  I know you bear a "power not of this world." It grants you a courage that borders on folly. But even so...
Cristoforo:  Ovathrax's power lies dormant within Abby. A Threnodian's essence is one and the same. Should two such frequencies ever collide...
Cristoforo:  Leviathan could use the Dark Tide to possess Abby, merge with Ovathrax, and eventually, complete Its rebirth.
Abby:  (I'm alright, Rover.)
Cristoforo:  You've never questioned what Abby is, have you?
Cristoforo:  Never paused to wonder why it grows dizzy each time it absorbs the Dark Tide? You do already know what the Dark Tide really is...
Cristoforo:  Perhaps, once Abby merges with Leviathan, it will recall what it once was and find its "true self." If that's the risk you're prepared to take, I suppose I can revise my script accordingly.
[Dialogue Option]  So I was your target all along?
[Dialogue Option]  How long have you been setting this up?
[Dialogue Option]  Making me the Harbinger... was that part of your design too?
Cristoforo:  Leviathan has long sought Its Harbinger, but you weren't Its first choice. That role was meant for Augusta, Septimont's current Ephor.
Cristoforo:  The Paradise should have descended as I had written. Yet the Priestess's arrow, fired at the cost of her very existence, sent the story veering off-script.
Cristoforo:  Still, any script worth its ink must be able to adapt. Just a few careful strokes, and we found the perfect protagonist to bear the mantle of despair.
Cristoforo:  We knew your plan from the beginning. Now your companions are lost to the Dark Tide, adrift with no Anchor in sight, fated to sink endlessly into the depths.
Cristoforo:  As for Cartethyia... The Divinity that granted her a second life is dead. Do you truly believe her Humanity alone can stand against Leviathan?
[Dialogue Option]  I believe in all of them...
[Dialogue Option] ...Just as they believe in me.
Cristoforo:  Yes. Hope amid hardship makes a finer tale than one of aimless doubt. The audience always favors stories steeped in distress, struggle, and ruin.
Cristoforo:  Alas, this interlude must end here. Leviathan stirs from Its slumber, and with Its wrath comes Its gospel.
Cristoforo:  Now then, show me... Show me that humanity can rise against the divine. Prove your will is your own. Prove you are worthy to pen your own fate.
Cristoforo:  But if humanity cannot cross the threshold of the divine... then we shall be the ones to write its fate instead.

title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
content:
Cristoforo:  But if humanity cannot cross the threshold of the divine... then we shall be the ones to write its fate instead.



Cristoforo:  Life is but a walking shadow, a poor player that struts and frets their hour upon the stage...
Cristoforo:  And then, in the blink of a moment, is heard no more...
Rover:  I believe in them... just as they believe in me...
Cristoforo:  Hehe... of course. You've always been the protagonist of our play.
Cristoforo:  But what if, the one we speak of, "the one meant to end Leviathan"... is not you?
Rover:  What...? So your true target is...
Cristoforo:  The special scene between her and our Grand Architect must not be disturbed.
Cristoforo:  For now, take a brief rest. The stage is nearly set for your finale.

title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
content:
Cristoforo:  For now, take a brief rest. The stage is nearly set for your finale.



Not long ago, by the Styx Lake...
Galbrena:  So… I was your true target all along.
Kharon (Schwarzloch):  Indeed. Another stalemate awaiteth him. And you, the revenant returned from the Dark Tide... You are the one chosen to end Leviathan in our script.
Kharon (Schwarzloch):  I know the power you wield. Left unchecked, it unravels the fabric of our play. And so, I must still your steps here.
Kharon (Schwarzloch): Yet I confess, Galbrena... Your growth hath far outstripped what I foresaw.
How many Tacet Discords have you devoured to stand here now?
Galbrena:  ...Heh. Do you count how many gemberries you've eaten in your life?
Galbrena:  For one with a lifespan like yours, surely you know more than most. So go on. Take a guess.
Kharon (Schwarzloch):  You risked all to save those who share no bond with you.
Kharon (Schwarzloch):  To choose to protect is one thing, but to do so wielding power not born of mankind... That, you should never have done.
Kharon (Schwarzloch):  You must have felt it. The cold stares of those you saved. No gratitude, only fear for that which they cannot understand.
Galbrena:  So what? I chose this path, and I'll follow it.
Kharon (Schwarzloch):  Your frequency now intertwines with the Tacet Discords. The moment you crossed that threshold, the mortal world... ceased to be your home.
Kharon (Schwarzloch):  My offer still stands. Join the Fractsidus. You, too, have crossed the veil that parts life and death. Among us, you shall find haven and purpose.
Galbrena:  Ever since I got these wings, I've found freedom in the open sky...
Galbrena:  I don't need a haven or titles to cage me. I am what I choose to be.
Kharon (Schwarzloch):  Shoulds you crave power, we shall grant it, even that of the Threnodian. Should you seek to help, we shall guide mankind toward a future beyond all comprehension.
Galbrena:  Sounds like something a hypocrite would say.
Kharon (Schwarzloch):  Mortal sight is too narrow to fathom our path.
Galbrena:  So you think you stand above humanity, huh? Whatever, I don't give a damn about you or your grand ideals.
Galbrena:  I only need one reason to take you down. You're in my way.
Kharon (Schwarzloch):  The Tacet Discords within you are gone. Now, tell me. What remains of you?
Galbrena:  I've heard enough of this crap.
Galbrena:  You hide behind borrowed faces. But me? I've never once doubted who I am.
Galbrena:  I've risen from blood and inferno a thousand times, faced the monsters that lined up to devour me, and fought back, without mercy...
Galbrena:  I broke Harpyia's razor wings and tore out Balor's demon eye. Not even Dullahan's iron hooves could bring me to my knees. The Dark Tide cursed me long ago. I should have been dead, but here I stand.
Galbrena:  And you think one of your clones can stop me?
Kharon (Schwarzloch):  Still clinging to hope? A sharp tongue may spark your courage, but it shall not change your end.
Kharon (Schwarzloch):  Then so be it. Forsake all hope of ever beholding Paradise. I shall guide you to the other shore, into eternal darkness... into hell.
Galbrena:  We're already there, Schwarzloch.

title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
content:
[Objective: (Cutscene plays)]
Galbrena: ...This blood. It should be enough.
Galbrena: My flames could never reach you before.
Galbrena: But now... it's time you paid for your arrogance.
Galbrena: The hunt begins.
Kharon (Schwarzloch): Your flames... they purified the corrupted frequencies?
Galbrena: Bullseye.
Galbrena: May the flames light your way home.

Galbrena: Bullseye.

Chimera:  You never cease to surprise...
Galbrena:  And here I thought you knew me well. A good hunter turns nature to her advantage.
Galbrena:  Or did you misunderstand? I didn't become strong because of any of you... I was strong. That's how I broke you.
Chimera:  I wasn't referring to that. I was surprised to see the spirits rise at your command, forming as Cetus the Tidebreaker...
Galbrena:  I didn't command them. They chose it of their own will. When disaster strikes, humans unite.
Galbrena:  A hollow being like you wouldn't understand.
Chimera:  ...Even if you absorbed the corruption in their frequencies, it will not last. That Kharon is but one mask the Grand Architect wears. The spirits will not restrain him for long.
Galbrena:  I know. That's why we have to move and find him.
Chimera:  There was a battle near the Journeying Paradise. Its aftershock blocked the main path. Which way do we go?
Galbrena:  Left. It's a shortcut.
Chimera:  There is no path on the left.
Galbrena:  Then I'll carve one out myself.

Galbrena:  Leviathan's presence is growing stronger. Flamewing won't last much longer in the air... Heh...
Galbrena:  (The Beholder's mark is set. With Shadow Fiend's power, I can throw the Feather Blade to move to the target location.)
Galbrena:  Prey marked. Time to end it in one shot.
Galbrena:  (I'll use the Feather Blade to weave through 'em while shooting. That'll speed things up.)
Galbrena:  Chimera! Tear the space apart!
Galbrena:  Those I slay... stay dead forever.

Chimera:  Sweet, sweet slaughter... I shall feast to my heart's content!
Galbrena:  Stay sharp.
Galbrena:  All set to die?

Chimera:  Slow down. I must savor the exquisite taste of their agony...
Galbrena:  Through here.

Galbrena:  Almost there...

Galbrena:  Through here.

Galbrena:  Almost there...



Galbrena:  ...Rover!
Chimera:  You are too late. The purest Dark Tide has swallowed him, and the stairway to the Paradise lies in ruins.
Chimera:  Run all you like, your chance to save him is already lost. Such is the nature of fate.
Galbrena:  If I believed in fate, I wouldn't have made it this far.
Chimera:  You think that little flame can burn this Dark Tide? You drown in delusion.
Galbrena:  I know it's not enough. What if... I add some of this?
Chimera:  ...You intend to unleash the Tacet Discords within you.
Chimera:  Those savage frequencies alone will destroy you before the Dark Tide even gets a chance.
Galbrena:  I tamed them once. I can do it again. It's just a matter of... what I'm willing to lose.
Galbrena:  If saving him means we still have a shot at taking down Leviathan...
Galbrena:  I'll risk it all. My will, my everything.
Chimera:  ...Lunatic.
Galbrena:  Let's see whose fire burns hotter. Don't tell me you're getting cold feet now.
Chimera:  Everything you have fought to keep will burn to ash.
Galbrena:  Then let it burn!
Galbrena:  Time to make a choice again. Hunt with me, or die with me. If you still want to see Leviathan destroyed with your own eyes... this is your final chance.
Galbrena:  Either way, I've already made my choice.
Chimera:  ...I called on you time and again to unleash your true power... And now, of all things, this is what gets through to you?
Chimera:  You would risk everything for a sliver of hope?
Galbrena:  I would. No matter the cost.

Cristoforo:  Just as I foresaw, she arrives to save you from the abyss.
Cristoforo:  A fleeting spark, kindled by all she once had... burning for a hopeless stand against the furious tide.
Cristoforo:  What awaits you is your end.
Cristoforo:  Now, roving outlander, don that exquisite mantle once more...
Cristoforo:  And step onto the deserted stage you are destined to face.

Rover:  How much time has passed...
Rover:  No path to take... No way to go...
Rover:  Wait... what's that ahead...

[Objective: (Examine A gravestone shimmering with faint gemlight)]
Before you, countless pale lights converge into an ancient stele, standing in austere silence.
You reach out, fingers brushing the surface. A faint line of script emerges at its base.
"Here lies Carlotta Montelli."
Rover:  ...
Cristoforo:  Death is a divine gift bestowed upon humanity.
Cristoforo:  Those you cherish now... a lucky few had their names carved into this ancient stone.
Cristoforo:  But far more, those who once stood by your side, you've already let slip away. Like raindrops into the sea... lost to the depths.
Cristoforo:  One day, even this stele will follow. Swallowed by the tide of your fading memory. Just like the rest.
Rover:  I will not forget them.

title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
subsection: (Optional - Examine A gravestone surrounded by wolf howls
content:
Cristoforo:  When the bustling stage quiets, all who played a part in your fate will take their leave. Only you remain for the final bow.
Cristoforo:  From beginning to end, you've always walked alone.
Cristoforo:  That... is the "truth" you cannot escape.
Cristoforo:  Abby's condition was written into our script long ago. Even if you strike Leviathan down, Abby can no longer serve as the vessel to seal Leviathan's essence.
Cristoforo:  Only one variable slipped past our design. Her, the revenant returned from the Dark Tide. She could have bridged your failing forces and brought Leviathan to Its end.
Cristoforo:  But the moment she gave up, your downfall was written. Hope, scattered like ash.
Cristoforo:  Oh, Harbinger of the Dark Tide... you can save no one. What follows in your wake is ruin, and ruin alone.
[Dialogue Option]  No... this is not the end...
Cristoforo:  Hmm... Not fond of how the story ends, are we?
Cristoforo:  Well, fortunately, you are not like the rest. Your fate rises above the masses. You... you still hold the power to choose.
Cristoforo:  You've always wanted to be the savior. Now, that chance lies before you. The one... you've known was coming all along.
???:  Shut up, you noisy pest.
Galbrena:  You don't buy his nonsense, do you?
[Dialogue Option]  Galbrena... Is that you?
Galbrena:  In the flesh. Took a few tricks, but I made it in.
[Dialogue Option]  What is this place?
[Dialogue Option]  That voice said this is the "truth" I cannot escape.
Galbrena:  This is your Mindscape. Leviathan drew it from the deepest layers of your mind using the purest frequency of the Dark Tide.
Galbrena:  Everyone has a Mindscape. Some say when countless seas of consciousness flow together, they make the essence of Solaris.
Galbrena:  I've seen many places, but nothing quite like this... It must mean a lot to you.
[Dialogue Option] ... I think so.
[Dialogue Option]  Is this... where it all began for me?
Rover:  But I saw Carlotta, Brant, everyone... and you. You were all just like in that illusion I had before...
Galbrena:  Leviathan preyed on your deepest fear of losing the ones you care about and turned it into these gravestones.
Galbrena:  The ones who seem the strongest often fear loss the most. That's how Leviathan slips in, by exposing our pain to the light.
Galbrena:  If you let it take hold, you'll never break free. In the end, your mind and body will be devoured, dismantled, reshaped, and assimilated. It's no better than death.
Galbrena:  So, you could say this place hangs between life and death. Your friends are here too, each of them fighting their own demons. But...
Galbrena:  Can you feel this?
Rover:  Yes... it's warm. And real.
Galbrena:  There. Look up.
Galbrena:  When I hunt, I often travel through the night.
Galbrena:  The darkness is thick, but faint stars hang above to guide me.
Galbrena:  But those stars don't shine for me. Long before I even looked up, they'd already been watching over the sky.
Galbrena:  Leviathan has underestimated human resolve. To me, these gravestones... they're signposts left by the "living" for those still fighting.
Galbrena:  Like stars destined to burn out, they refuse to stop shining until the very end. There's always someone in the dark, giving their life to light the way and pass hope to those who follow.
Galbrena:  That's why... you and I, we don't stop moving forward.
Galbrena:  Sometimes, all it takes... is the first step. That's enough to light the way for others. And maybe one day... they'll be the ones lighting the way for you.
[Dialogue Option]  This story was never mine alone.
[Dialogue Option]  My fate is bound to others.
[Dialogue Option]  That's what this journey has always been about.
Galbrena:  I don't know your past, but I do know the future you want isn't one of death.
Galbrena:  Being scared of losing someone just means you're human. But the people you love, the ones who love you back... They'd never let you face the end alone.
Galbrena:  This isn't where it ends. If you want a path to open... Remember all the people you helped Anchor to a future. Now, it's time to Anchor yourself.
Galbrena:  But before that... take a look behind you.
Galbrena:  You've come a long way. Changed a lot of lives. That's your past, but it's also your strength. So use it. Hope... is still out there, waiting for you.
[Dialogue Option]  This path lies right before me.
[Dialogue Option]  No more fear. No more doubt.
[Dialogue Option]  Just keep going, right?
Galbrena:  Take this spark with you...
Galbrena:  Take the step... through darkness into the light.

Voice: Ah, new allies born from the perils of the high seas! What better way to begin an epic
story?

Voice: Good people have their wishes fulfilled, heroes appear in a time of crisis, justice
triumphs over evil, and united friends are undefeatable.

Voice: The Codex reminds us, "It is not the lighthouse that guides us through the storm to
safety, but our own eyes fixed on the shore."
The difference, though, is that you are a blade. A weapon that can break the cycle.

Voice: The difference, though, is that you are a blade. A weapon that can break the cycle.

Voice: Like I said, we seize control.

subsection: (Optional - Examine A gravestone surrounded by wolf howls
content:
Voice: The difference, though, is that you are a blade. A weapon that can break the cycle.

Voice: Like I said, we seize control.



Voice: Music itself holds no emotion. It's the heart that grants it meaning.

Voice: A person of true character should never be defined by an inanimate blade.

Voice: Even if one day you meet defeat, remember this. Those you've helped will never let you face it alone.

Voice: I've been thinking... our final fate might already be written, but how we walk that path is up to us. We, as humans, are meant to carve our own way forward!

Voice: A civilization's glory is forged by generations of brave souls. It was never meant to be one person's medal of honor.
The waves of resistance shall never cease. Mankind will not be oppressed by the Threnodian...
