Rover:  Sigrika?
[Dialogue Option]  Yes, I’m here.
Sigrika:  I failed… I couldn't do it… I'm sorry, I'm so, so sorry…
Rover:  It's not your fault, Sigrika. What did you see in the Dark Side?
Sigrika:  I don't know. It's all wrong... Why... Why is this happening...?
Sigrika:  It felt like a nightmare... No, not a nightmare. It was all real.
Sigrika:  It's all my fault. The Tacet Discords, the riddles… all the disturbances in the Dark Side are coming from me.
Sigrika:  I'm not brave enough to face failure, so I tell myself I can handle everything. I'm terrified of letting everyone down… of not living up to expectations.
Sigrika:  I'm so scared. What do I do now…?
[Dialogue Option]
[Dialogue Option]  (Let her calm down.)
Rover:  It was just a nightmare. We got out with those students, remember? You did everything you could, and you did well.
Sigrika:  Was it… really just a nightmare?
Sigrika:  That voice, the one telling us to stay… I know who it is now.
Sigrika:  It's me...
Sigrika:  I was the one who made it. That's why I could solve the riddles and see those Tacet Discords. It told me... I would always end up back there.
Sigrika:  What should I do to stop it from getting worse?
Rover:  There's no "right" answer I can give you.
Rover:  But whatever you decide to do, I'll be there to help you.
Sigrika:  ...But isn't that just relying on someone else?
Rover:  No. The fight is yours to finish. But you won't be fighting it alone.
Rover:  You once told me that you hear so many voices when you close your eyes.
Rover:  The things you heard in the Dark Side aren't so different from what I'm telling you now. They're all just... voices.
Rover:  What matters isn't how they make you feel, but what you choose to do after hearing them.
Sigrika:  Even if what I choose ends up making things worse?
Rover:  Even then, it'll be okay. At least we've tried our best till the end and have no regrets.
Rover:  I know someone who saw her own end coming from a mile away. Someone very dear to me. But she walked right toward it, towards her own sacrifice.
Rover:  She wanted to save the world. In the end, she kept her promise.
Rover:  What she did... I couldn't judge. Still, I saw her resolve and courage. Those could never be wrong.
Rover:  And I... I'm far from perfect. There are things I can't do, either.
Rover:  But no matter what happens, I won't regret the choices I've made.
Sigrika:  ...
Sigrika:  So I should try? Even if I might fail?
Sigrika:  Senior, I... need some time to think about this.

content:
[Objective: Investigate the diary]
Sigrika:  Everyone says, "She's a future Heliodic Six successor. She has to be the best."
Sigrika:  So I made sure every rune calculation and deciphering was perfect, and my grades were always at the top of every class.
Sigrika:  I didn't miss a single course.
Sigrika:  I paid attention in every lecture, studied for every exam.
Sigrika:  I worked so hard to keep up, but… there's just so much to learn. It feels endless...
Sigrika:  Sometimes I can't help wondering, how is anyone supposed to learn it all?
Sigrika:  …Ugh. That's not the answer, is it? Let's look somewhere else.

title: Gold Suspended in Shadows
content:
[Objective: Investigate the photo]
Sigrika:  Don't look at that.
Sigrika:  I... I don't need photos like that.
Sigrika:  Nivora always told me I could do anything because I'm a future Heliodic Six successor.
Sigrika:  And Denia always says I should ease up a little.
Sigrika:  No matter what I do, they're always there to support and comfort me.
Sigrika:  Their trust means so much to me. But the more they give it...
Sigrika:  The more terrified I am of messing up. Of seeing disappointment in their eyes.
Sigrika:  It's that fear that kept me pushing forward…
Sigrika:  If… if I were all alone from the start, I wouldn't need to worry so much. Wouldn't it be easier?

title: Gold Suspended in Shadows
content:
[Objective: Talk to Sigrika]
Sigrika:  Still nothing here...
Sigrika:  Maybe we should just rest and wait for the professors to find us.
Rover:  Do you think this riddle has an answer, Sigrika?
Sigrika:  …I don't know. Think about it, should finding an answer really be so important?
Rover:  The Sigrika I know would still look for it.
Rover:  She might lose her way, or feel nervous, but she'd never turn away from a riddle.
Rover:  So…
[Dialogue Option]  Who are you?
Sigrika?:  …How strange.
Sigrika?:  I'm only saying what she already thinks.
Rover:  Those fears are a part of her, but she'll push her way through them to find an answer.
Rover:  She wouldn't wish this all away.
Rover:  The Sigrika I know always chooses to move forward.
Rover:  And I promised her, if the nightmare ever came for her again…
[Dialogue Option]  I’d be there to wake her up.

title: Gold Suspended in Shadows
content:
[Objective: Catch up with the rabbit]
Rover:  These words are haunting Sigrika.
Rover:  She's lost in a nightmare now. I have to wake her up.

title: Gold Suspended in Shadows
content:
Sigrika?:  See? You've failed. For real this time.
Sigrika?:  You let everyone down. Again and again, they trusted you. They believed you were destined for greatness.
Sigrika?:  What a shame. You were always going to disappoint them. Your gifts were only going to lead you this far.
Sigrika?:  So why not just give up?
[Dialogue Option]  (Call for Sigrika.)
Rover:  Don't listen to her, Sigrika! It's just a nightmare!
Sigrika?:  Admit it… doesn't that sound better?
Sigrika?:  No more crushing expectations from family or friends.
Rover:  Stand by your choice.
Sigrika?:  No more endless questions from professors. No more pressure to be more.
Rover:  You move forward on your own terms!
Sigrika?:  Oh, and your dear Senior... you don't need to bother with his expectations either.
[Dialogue Option]  Wake up!
[Dialogue Option]  Sigrika!

title: Gold Suspended in Shadows
content:
Sigrika?:  Oh, and your dear Senior... you don't need to bother with his expectations either.
[Dialogue Option]  Wake up!
[Dialogue Option]  Sigrika!



A few minutes ago...
Sigrika: Huh…? Am I… back in reality? But why...
Sigrika: Is the celebration over? What is...

title: Gold Suspended in Shadows
content:
[Objective: Talk to Lynae]
Lynae: How could this happen...?
Sigrika: What happened, Lynae?
Lynae: What happened?! You destroyed the Academy!
Lynae: Why did you insist on going back into the Dark Side? Why did you have to solve those riddles?!
Lynae: It's all gone... everything's gone!
Sigrika: No... please, no...

title: Gold Suspended in Shadows
content:
[Objective: Talk to Lynae again]
No matter what you say, she only looks at you with disappointment.

title: Gold Suspended in Shadows
content:
[Objective: Talk to the student]
Isla: It's all because of you, Sigrika!
Isla: You failed to solve those riddles! You let the Dark Side tear through the Academy! Everyone... everyone's like this because of you!
Isla: Why?! You're a future Heliodic Six successor! Why didn't you stop it?!

title: Gold Suspended in Shadows
content:
[Objective: (Talk to Isla again)]
No matter what you say, she only looks at you with disappointment.

Denia: I didn't realize the runes could explode...
Denia: All this time, Sigrika, and you never told me the runes could explode.
Denia: How stupid I was to think we'd be best friends for life... I told you to stop chasing those riddles.
Sigrika: No, Denia! Please, listen to me—
Denia: Did you ever listen to me? I'm so disappointed in you, Sigrika.

title: Gold Suspended in Shadows
content:
[Objective: Check on the student ahead]
Sigrika: Senior, w-what happened? Did I...
Sigrika?: It's your fault, of course!
Sigrika: You again... So I'm still in the Dark Side. None of this is real.
Sigrika?: Wrong. This is reality.
Sigrika?: You failed. The Dark Side swallowed the Academy whole. And now—look around! I'm everywhere!
Sigrika?: What do you say, Sigrika? See? You failed again. And this time, it's real.
Sigrika?: You knew it all along.
Sigrika: Give up...
Sigrika: Those voices...
Sigrika?: See those pictures? Look familiar?
Sigrika?: The you in those frames worked so hard…
Sigrika?: But what did it get her?
Sigrika?: Why keep pushing when you're this exhausted? Why not just walk away from it all from the very beginning?
Sigrika?: See for yourself.
Sigrika?: You would no longer be haunted by their cheering.
Sigrika?: The duties and expectations they placed on you would never become chains.
Sigrika?: And all those tears you cried studying through the night... they'd be gone.
Denia: Or is this really about proving yourself after all?
Lynae: You need to take a "bad" rest.
Lucilla: No matter what happens, you, me, Rover, Dr. Luuk... we won't let the Dark Side ruin the Academy.
Rover: The Sigrika I know would always choose to keep going.
Sigrika: ...Enough.
Sigrika: Maybe you were right about some things. I have asked myself—
Sigrika: Why do I have to live up to everyone's expectations?
Sigrika: People say I'm gifted, but it's not like I can just solve everything effortlessly.
Sigrika: Their expectations are like gold. Bright, warm... yet heavy.
Sigrika: I've never dared to imagine myself failing, scared of seeing the disappointment on everyone's faces. But now I understand—
Sigrika: As long as I keep moving forward, I'm the one holding that gold (expectation).
Sigrika: A friend once told me to "try our best till the end and have no regrets."
Sigrika: "Even if there are things I can't do"—Well, I'm going to do them anyway!
Sigrika: Because then I'll get to see my friends smiling and cheering.

title: Gold Suspended in Shadows
content:
Sigrika: Because then I'll get to see my friends smiling and cheering.



(Cutscene plays)
Sigrika: So stop trying to twist what I feel.
Sigrika: You don't get to tell me what I think, or discredit my hard work!
Sigrika: My friends would never blame me for coming up short.
Sigrika: All this time... I was the one holding myself back!
Sigrika: So from now on, I only do what I want to do!
Sigrika?: Why? What can you possibly do?
Sigrika: I can erase you.
Rover: And she's not alone.
Denia: Hmph, really?
Denia: Her life would've been a lot easier if she had just run away.
Denia: But... I guess finding her own answer works, too.
Denia: Hey! They promised not to use that!
Denia: Meh, never mind. They should be fine.
(Cutscene ends)

title: Gold Suspended in Shadows
content:
[Objective: Defeat the Vortex's Eye]
Vortex's Eye: Strange, strange... how utterly strange!
Vortex's Eye: So weary, yet still so determined to press on... Why is that?
Sigrika: Because there's something I want to do.
Vortex's Eye: But why… why... why not just leave it all behind…?
Sigrika: Because running away won't make those problems go away.
Sigrika: I will defeat you.

title: Gold Suspended in Shadows
content:
Sigrika: Because running away won't make those problems go away.
Sigrika: I will defeat you.



[Dialogue Option]  Are you alright?
[Dialogue Option]  How do you feel now?
Sigrika: Thank you, Senior.
Sigrika: When I close my eyes now, I still hear everyone's hopes for me. But I hear something else, too. Their laughter and cheers.
Sigrika: It's like gold flecked with starlight. It tells me...
Sigrika: ...That everyone loved the celebration.
Sigrika: I think that's the answer to the final riddle.
Luuk Herssen: I'd say this calls for the special candy.
Sigrika: Are these... Rainbow Bean Pop Rocks?
Luuk Herssen: With an improved formula. Not on the market yet.
Sigrika: So the one who makes these is—?
Luuk Herssen: Shhh... Our little secret.
Lucilla: Again with the candy, Dr. Luuk? I'll be confiscating the extras.
Lucilla: Well done, both of you. The vortex in the Dark Side is almost gone, and we've already reclaimed our access control from that Tacet Discord.
Rover: (Not completely...?)
Lucilla: For now, just enjoy the celebration.
Lynae: Sigrika! Over here! Chisa's getting a new top record!
Sigrika: Coming! You need to try this, Lynae—it's the new Rainbow Bean Pop Rocks!
Lucilla: Rover.
Rover: The Grand Architect's game isn't over yet.
Lucilla: Yes. There are still more shadows to deal with.
Sigrika: Senior, we're over here!
Lucilla: Go now.
Sigrika: There's a white bird here! I've spotted it several times, but there's no record of it. It's definitely a new species!
Sigrika: Hey, Senior... look over here.
Sigrika: In three... two... one...
(Obtained Trophy: The Azure Echoes)

title: Gold Suspended in Shadows
content:
Sigrika: Hey, Senior... look over here.
Sigrika: In three... two... one...
(Obtained Trophy: The Azure Echoes)



Things have finally begun to settle. Time to actually enjoy the celebration while you can.

title: Gold Suspended in Shadows
subsection: See the end of the Celebration
content:
[Objective: See the end of the Celebration]
Sigrika: Almost done over here! Good thing you two came to help.
Lynae: Easy-peasy! If anything comes up, just gimme a shout.
Chisa: And me.
[Dialogue Option]  What are you all doing?
Lynae: Rover! Perfect timing! Here, take this.
[Dialogue Option]  What's this?
Chisa: It's a souvenir ticket for the New Solar Celebration.
Sigrika: Means the celebration is officially over. We didn't have the "Minerva's Treasure" wishing ceremony this year, so the Student Council made these instead. Isla wanted everyone to have something to remember the event by.
Sigrika: Denia was supposed to hand them out, but she's taken a few days off. Odd that Nivora's on leave, too. I wonder if they planned it...
Sigrika: There's so much to do, even with these simple tasks. I'm just glad to have your help.
Chisa: It's nothing. I actually came here hoping to find a location to rebuild that polymorphic thermocyclic composite roasting device.
Chisa: Too bad there isn't one. If there's ever another event like this, I'll make a wish to test some new devices in the Academy.
Sigrika: A wish, huh… I've got one too!
[Dialogue Option]  You have a new wish?
[Dialogue Option]  Is it to capture a certain bird's face?
Sigrika: My wish is—
Sigrika: Heh, I'm keeping it a secret for now! You'll find out what it is once it comes true.
Lynae: Since when did you learn to tease people like that, Sigrika?
Sigrika: Consider it a riddle! Some wishes are better kept to yourself... don't you think?
Lynae: I'd rather find out right now. Chisa, get her!
Chisa: On it!
Sigrika: Hey! No cheating!

subsection: See the end of the Celebration

subsection: 08:00-11:00  - Synthesis Armament Crafting Bay (One time interaction)
content:
[Objective: 08:00-11:00  - Synthesis Armament Crafting Bay (One time interaction)]
Sigrika: Huh? How do you even use this thing...?
[Dialogue Option]  Sigrika, need some help?
Sigrika: Good morning, Senior! This is the Academy’s newest camera model! I've been waiting forever to rent it.
Sigrika: But now that I have, I see it's nothing like the cameras I've used before!
Sigrika: The Academy's electronics update so fast, and it always takes me ages to catch up. I still haven't figured this one out... Could you take a look?
[Dialogue Option]  (Take the camera.)
Sigrika: Oh... The flash goes here... Ah, I see. Now I can adjust the aperture...
You help Sigrika figure out how to operate the camera. Sharing this moment is a slice of warmth in your day...
Sigrika: Hey, little birdies. Don't gobble your food...
[Dialogue Option]  Why are there so many birds here?
[Dialogue Option]  Why are you eating lunch by yourself?
Sigrika: Oh, Senior... Birds flock to the rooftop at noon every day. I like feeding them, so I usually eat up here.
Sigrika: I still have some Fruit Crackle. Would you like to try feeding them too?
[Dialogue Option]  (Feed the birds around you.)
Nearby Birds: Chirp, chirp!
Sigrika: I think the birds like you too. My mother used to say that only very, very good people get loved by animals.
[Dialogue Option]  (Take a few bites yourself.)
Bearby Birds: Cheep, cheep!
Sigrika: I've got a lot more, so don't steal from the birds... I didn't know you liked Fruit Crackle though. I'll bring back extra next time I go home...
Surrounded by birds, you and Sigrika share a moment that is a slice of warmth in your day...

metadata.subsection: 08:00-11:00  - Synthesis Armament Crafting Bay (One time interaction)

title: Gold Suspended in Shadows
content:
[Objective: 16:00-18:00  - Dorm Room (First time Interaction)]
Sigrika: es, yes... No, I promised I wouldn't overdo it this time. Really!
Sigrika: I've been trying to say no to requests I can't handle. I'm fine. Don't worry, okay?
Sigrika: Yes, I'll keep in touch—Ah, my friend is here. I'll talk to you later, Mother. Okay, bye-bye.
[Dialogue Option]  Sorry to interrupt you.
Sigrika: That's alright. I told Mother I'd call back later.
Sigrika: We'd already been talking for a while before you showed up.
Sigrika: I told her all about our adventure in the Dark Side, and what life's been like at the Academy...
Sigrika: We talked so much I completely lost track of time...
Sigrika: ...Oh, Senior. It's been so long since we talked like that with her.
Sigrika: Whenever she called back then, I'd just say "I'm good," or "Everything's fine."
Sigrika: I thought I was protecting her, you know? But the more I did that, the less I actually had to say. Isn't that strange?
[Dialogue Option]  You needed to make a change.
Sigrika: That's exactly what I thought!
[Dialogue Option]  But it's better now, isn't it?
Sigrika: It is. We talk a lot now.
Sigrika: All the things I used to keep to myself... I actually let them out now.
Sigrika: Like how difficult my coursework feels, how tired I get, and how many things I still can't get right...
Sigrika: I never used to tell her any of that. But the moment I finally did, it felt like a shadow lifted.
Rover: Sounds like everything's moving in the right direction.
Sigrika: Yeah! And I haven't slowed down either.
Sigrika: There's so much I still want to do. And I'm gonna do it. One thing at a time.
Sigrika: I think this is the answer I've found for myself!

title: Gold Suspended in Shadows
content:
[Objective: Talk to Sigrika again]
Sigrika: Senior, if you're free sometime, would you like to visit my home?
Sigrika: I told Crackle all about you, and it's been so excited to meet you!
[Dialogue Option]  Who's Crackle?
Sigrika: Oh, that's my pet bird. A Kronapuff.
Sigrika: You have to be careful when you hold it, though.
[Dialogue Option]  Why?
Sigrika: Because it's gotten a little fat!

title: Gold Suspended in Shadows
subsection: 22:00-03:00  - One floor below the rooftop of Spacetrek Archive
content:
[Objective: 22:00-03:00  - One floor below the rooftop of Spacetrek Archive]
Sigrika: Alright, alright. Be good now, okay?
[Dialogue Option]  Sigrika?
Sigrika: Ah! Senior, it's you. You scared me...
Sigrika: Look! I found this incredibly rare bird! It's a "Night Parrot"!
Sigrika: They say anyone who spots one gets blessed with good luck. I want to take a photo and share that luck with everyone.
Sigrika: But it doesn't seem as shy as the rumors say... I can't take a photo because it just refuses to get off me...
[Dialogue Option]  It's because animals love you
Sigrika: Hehe... Could you please take a photo of us?
[Dialogue Option]  Want me to take a photo of you two?
Sigrika: Okay! Thank you so much!
Sigrika: I hope everyone can get a bit of this luck! Including you!
Even though it takes a little time to get the lively bird to stay still, you manage to snap a perfect photo. Sharing this moment is a slice of warmth in your day...

Sigrika: Senior! That's my diary!

title: Gold Suspended in Shadows
content:
[Objective: Read again]
Sigrika: There's... not much in there. But you can look, if you want.
The diary is filled with dense, overlapping schedules. Looking at them is enough to steal your breath. But on the most recent pages, many tasks are crossed out.
[Dialogue Option]  What about these ones you crossed out...?
Sigrika: Oh, those? Just stuff that wasn't super urgent.
Sigrika: I turned them all into... rest time!

title: Gold Suspended in Shadows
content:
[Objective: Rabelle College Photo Corner]
You spot a few familiar photos on the Academy bulletin board—photos you helped take of Sigrika with various wondrous little animals.
They were originally posted on the Academy Forum, but the Academy unexpectedly selected them for a special award.
The judges offered all kinds of interpretations, from composition and lighting to the philosophical "connection between humans and nature…"
In your opinion, it feels like they're reading a little too much into it.
After all, the photos came from a girl's simple wish to share luck and happiness with everyone. And as the photographer, you just tried to make the pictures look as good as possible
But... No harm done. If this means more people get to receive that luck, then it's worth it.

title: Gold Suspended in Shadows
content:
[Objective: 16:00-18:00  Recreational Zone of Spacetrek Archive]
Chisa: For my thesis acknowledgements, I'll include my advisor, my parents, and Rover
[Dialogue Option]  Good afternoon.
[Dialogue Option]  What are you up to?
Chisa: Oh, Rover. Good afternoon. What a coincidence, I was just about to message you.
Chisa: I finally finished my thesis for Synth Armament Studies. Thought I'd rest my eyes for a bit while figuring out the acknowledgments section.
Chisa: It's the only part of the paper with no format to follow. It requires emotional honesty, not methodology or logic. And somehow, that's the part I have to think about the longest...
Chisa: There are so many people I want to thank. My advisor, my classmates, my parents. And... you.
Chisa: So I was wondering, if I included our experiences in Honami, would that be okay with you?
[Dialogue Option]  It would be my honor.
Chisa: I'm glad you think so. I'd be happy to write about it. And I really do owe you a formal thank-you.
[Dialogue Option]  Wouldn't that be a bit too much?
Chisa: Hmm... I don't think so.
Chisa: Without your help, I never would have made it back to the Academy. So... yes. I owe you a formal thank-you.
Chisa: Life at Startorch is good. Demanding, but fulfilling. I don't have to wear a mask here. Every day, something new fills me. I never felt this before. Not in my hometown, not in Honami.
Chisa: And... when I come home now, my parents are there.
[Dialogue Option]  They're not too busy with work anymore?
Chisa: Mm-hmm. During the years I was missing, they moved to Lahai-Roi and took up Academy positions offered by President Lucilla.
Chisa: I think they wanted to stay. To keep searching for me. For twenty years, they never gave up.
Chisa: Remember that radio broadcast in Honami? The new Academy uniforms? My mother designed them. The inspiration... was a pattern I cut out when I was little.
Chisa: They were here, waiting for me all that time. And now, I finally get to be there for them, too.
[Dialogue Option]  I'm really happy for you.
Chisa: By the way, after I told them about you, they've been insisting on thanking you in person.
Chisa: I did say you're probably very busy... But please, let me know when you have a free moment.
Chisa: My father makes the best Ashinohara dishes.
Chisa: If we ever end up in the same class, come find me. That'll be nice.
Chisa: Once my classmates found out my father makes my bento, they started asking for a bite during lunch. Ever since, he's packed extra portions.
Chisa: We could share a meal together sometime. Just the two of us, like in Honami. Or with more people. Both are great.
Chisa: I think... this is it. This is what "being young" is supposed to feel like.

content:
[Objective: *This interaction is only available during the Celebration]
The New Solar Celebration transform the Academy. Lights and banners go up, and the grounds come alive with music, laughter, and youthful spirit.
...Invite a friend to celebrate with you?
[Dialogue Option]  (Invite Lynae.)
Lynae joins you to celebrate, and you are swept away in the celebration's joyful whirl...
Lynae: Whoa, back where we started already? Time sure flies when you're having fun!
Lynae: Scored some wild trinkets, saw some crazy colors, ate my body weight in snacks... A girl could die happy.
Lynae: Ugh, but my bike upgrade fund just went up in smoke... Guess I'm back to square one in the saving thing.
[Dialogue Option]  Hard for plans to keep up with reality.
[Dialogue Option]  You don't get celebrations like this every day.
Lynae: You're right! Screw it, it's a special occasion. The budget can wait.
Lynae: Heh, hanging with you was a blast, but duty calls! Gotta get back to my volunteering!
Lynae: Gotta earn back all those Credits I just blew... Catch you later!
[Dialogue Option]  (Invite Mornye.)
Mornye joins you to celebrate...
Mornye: Facility readings are stable and within safety parameters. No abnormalities detected. Very good...
[Dialogue Option]  Feels like you're here on the clock.
[Dialogue Option]  I spied a few new records already.
Mornye: I did assist in designing several attractions. Monitoring their operational integrity is a logical extension of my responsibility for student safety.
Mornye: Once you understand the mechanics, getting a high score is a breeze. But when it comes to games that test your rhythm or reflexes... I'm not so good at those...
Mornye: Could that be a bit unfair to the students? Maybe I should delete my high scores from the server...
Mornye: I always used to watch the students celebrate from my lab in the Research Institute. Being here with you, Mentor, actually participating... I think... I like it.
Mornye: Returning to work with this "emotional parameter" boost should correlate to higher efficiency. Thank you, Mentor.
[Dialogue Option]  (Invite Luuk Herssen.)
Luuk Herssen joins you to celebrate...
Luuk Herssen: We've had campus-wide events before, but this New Solar Celebration energy is on another level...
Luuk Herssen: Is it because it's the inaugural event? The students poured everything into this. Their passion is great to see, but a little more caution wouldn't hurt.
Luuk Herssen: Patched up a handful of scrapes and bruises just getting here. Ah, the passionate, painful privilege of youth.
[Dialogue Option]  Thanks, Doctor...
[Dialogue Option]  So much for a day off...
Luuk Herssen: Heh, not at all. Time flies when you're having fun, and this was... memorable.
Luuk Herssen: I should head back to the infirmary. Enjoy the rest of the celebration, and watch your step.
Luuk Herssen: I've only been gone a moment, but I'm sure there's already a line forming at my door...
[Dialogue Option]  (Invite Lucilla.)
Lucilla joins you to celebrate...
Lucilla: Phew! It's been so long since I've had this much fun!
Lucilla: Students rarely invite me, you know. Most scatter the second they spot me. I stopped showing up to keep from spoiling their fun, hmph...
[Dialogue Option]  Aren't you exaggerating?
[Dialogue Option]  You're not that type of President. Or are you?
Lucilla: I'm teasing, of course. Only the ones with overdue essays have anything to fear. And on a day like today? I wouldn't dream of rushing them.
Lucilla: Alright, I should get back to work. I did play hooky to be here, after all. Now it's your turn to shine.
Lucilla: Go set some records, Rover. I have high expectations.
Lucilla: Oh, and feel free to compete under the name "Lucilla." Hehe, I won't mind a bit!
[Dialogue Option]  I've got more important things to do...

title: Gold Suspended in Shadows
content:
[Objective: (Outside Rabelle College during Celebration)]
Why the silent treatment? You're a Hearthbear. You're literally built for hugs!
Unless... you've developed hug-ophobia?
Oh, you poor thing. Let me give you a hug...

Dr. Herssen gave me this.
Candy? Did he say anything?
He said I should get some extra rest and stop trying so hard to solve riddles.
And if I'm ever feeling down, I should go see him.

Why not ask one of Heliodic Six successors?
You mean Sigrika? Right, she'd be able to...

Should I give up on my research project? What do you think?
But haven't you been working on it for ages?
Yeah, and I haven't gotten a single useful thing out of it! I keep thinking about just calling it quits...

title: Gold Suspended in Shadows
content:
Yeah, and I haven't gotten a single useful thing out of it! I keep thinking about just calling it quits...



What kind of wishes did previous "Minerva's Treasure" winners make
One year, the winner made a wish to graduate immediately.
And it worked. He was taken away by men in black and brought to the Research Institute, where he became a teaching assistant, landing himself right back at the Academy...

I heard that at night, you'll suddenly see rabbits all over the Academy.

Phew! Break time, finally!
A burst of joyful singing*
...I'll leave the rest to Sigrika. She'll be here soon.
A burst of joyful singing*
OKAY, OKAY, I'M GOING! Stop rushing me!

title: Gold Suspended in Shadows

title: Gold Suspended in Shadows
content:
New Solar Celebration - The Exostrider poured forth light and heat from its Reactor Drive, sheltering life from the killing frost. Grateful for this gift, the Roya revered the Reactor Drive as their sun. They took it upon themselves to gather the Exostrider's "cells," making this quiet labor the duty of their tribe. Now, their ancient vow is complete. As the new sun rises, they hold the New Solar Celebration, both to mark the renewal and to remind their kin of the purpose that set them on this path.

Minerva's Treasure - Each year, a treasure hunt organized by a mysterious host takes place at Startorch Academy. Participants take home a wide range of rewards, and a single wish is granted for the biggest winner. Though those wishes are always granted in delightfully peculiar ways, this eccentricity only fuels the students' rivalry as they strive to outwit their invisible mastermind.

title: Gold Suspended in Shadows
content:
Academy's Dark Side - A Sonoro born of nature. Now a shadowy reflection of the Academy, shifting with the collective psyche of its students and teachers.

Reflection - Shadows of students' emotions in the Dark Side, which mirror the hidden feelings within the students' hearts.

Vortex’s Eye - If the Dark Side is a vortex of anxiety and sorrow. At the heart of the raging storm is the force that sets it all in motion—the vortex's eye.

title: Gold Suspended in Shadows
content:
[Objective: Obtained from Loading Screen]
New Solar Celebration Every year, the break after final exams marks the season for Startorch Academy's club exhibitions—the perfect outlet for students to burn off their pent-up energy. With the Reactor Core restored and the New Solar Ceremony a success, the Academy's Executive Committee has announced that this year's showcase will be co-hosted with the Roya. Under the theme "New Solar Celebration," the event aims to deepen the bonds between both peoples.

New Solar Celebration Due to the special nature of this celebration and the Roya Culture Exhibition joining this year's festivities, the Student Council secured the first two floors of Rabelle College with the help of certain talented coordinators. Once tightly restricted classrooms have been transformed into vibrant club showcase spaces.

title: Gold Suspended in Shadows
content:
Academy's Dark Side A collective Sonoro that manifested naturally in Lahai-Roi. The exact cause of its formation remains unconfirmed. Influenced by the subconscious minds and residual frequencies of the Resonators at Startorch Academy, it gradually evolved into a mirrored projection of the Academy, becoming a unique phenomenon existing within its grounds.

Academy's Dark Side - Classroom Ambition, passion, anxiety, sorrow… the Academy’s Dark Side absorbs them all without distinction, reflecting the student’s rawest and most unguarded thoughts. If left unchanneled, these accumulated negative emotions gather within the domain, eventually spilling into reality.

title: Gold Suspended in Shadows
content:
Academy's Dark Side - Dormitory The Research Institute sealed the Dark Side within riddles, rendering it harmless and turning it into an annual game students eagerly await. By solving these riddles, students confront their doubts directly, releasing and dispelling the negative energy accumulated in the Dark Side.

Academy's Dark Side - Vortex's Eye If the Dark Side is a vortex, then anxiety and sorrow form its very eye. Interfered with by the Fractsidus, these negative emotions are now manifesting as aggressive Tacet Discords.

[Objective: 16:00-18:00  - Dorm Room (First time Interaction)]
Sigrika: Yes, yes... No, I promised I wouldn't overdo it this time. Really!
Sigrika: I've been trying to say no to requests I can't handle. I'm fine. Don't worry, okay?
Sigrika: Yes, I'll keep in touch—Ah, my friend is here. I'll talk to you later, Mother. Okay, bye-bye.
[Dialogue Option]  Sorry to interrupt you.
Sigrika: That's alright. I told Mother I'd call back later.
Sigrika: We'd already been talking for a while before you showed up.
Sigrika: I told her all about our adventure in the Dark Side, and what life's been like at the Academy...
Sigrika: We talked so much I completely lost track of time...
Sigrika: ...Oh, Senior. It's been so long since we talked like that with her.
Sigrika: Whenever she called back then, I'd just say "I'm good," or "Everything's fine."
Sigrika: I thought I was protecting her, you know? But the more I did that, the less I actually had to say. Isn't that strange?
[Dialogue Option]  You needed to make a change.
Sigrika: That's exactly what I thought!
[Dialogue Option]  But it's better now, isn't it?
Sigrika: It is. We talk a lot now.
Sigrika: All the things I used to keep to myself... I actually let them out now.
Sigrika: Like how difficult my coursework feels, how tired I get, and how many things I still can't get right...
Sigrika: I never used to tell her any of that. But the moment I finally did, it felt like a shadow lifted.
Rover: Sounds like everything's moving in the right direction.
Sigrika: Yeah! And I haven't slowed down either.
Sigrika: There's so much I still want to do. And I'm gonna do it. One thing at a time.
Sigrika: I think this is the answer I've found for myself!

content:
[Objective: 16:00-18:00  Recreational Zone of Spacetrek Archive]
Chisa: For my thesis acknowledgements, I'll include my advisor, my parents, and Rover
[Dialogue Option]  Good afternoon.
[Dialogue Option]  What are you up to?
Chisa: Oh, Rover. Good afternoon. What a coincidence, I was just about to message you.
Chisa: I finally finished my thesis for Synth Armament Studies. Thought I'd rest my eyes for a bit while figuring out the acknowledgments section.
Chisa: It's the only part of the paper with no format to follow. It requires emotional honesty, not methodology or logic. And somehow, that's the part I have to think about the longest...
Chisa: There are so many people I want to thank. My advisor, my classmates, my parents. And... you.
Chisa: So I was wondering, if I included our experiences in Honami, would that be okay with you?
[Dialogue Option]  It would be my honor.
Chisa: I'm glad you think so. I'd be happy to write about it. And I really do owe you a formal thank-you.
[Dialogue Option]  Wouldn't that be a bit too much?
Chisa: Hmm... I don't think so.
Chisa: Without your help, I never would have made it back to the Academy. So... yes. I owe you a formal thank-you.
Chisa: Life at Startorch is good. Demanding, but fulfilling. I don't have to wear a mask here. Every day, something new fills me. I never felt this before. Not in my hometown, not in Honami.
Chisa: And... when I come home now, my parents are there.
[Dialogue Option]  They're not too busy with work anymore?
Chisa: Mm-hmm. During the years I was missing, they moved to Lahai-Roi and took up Academy positions offered by President Lucilla.
Chisa: I think they wanted to stay. To keep searching for me. For twenty years, they never gave up.
Chisa: Remember that radio broadcast in Honami? The new Academy uniforms? My mother designed them. The inspiration... was a pattern I cut out when I was little.
Chisa: They were here, waiting for me all that time. And now, I finally get to be there for them, too.
[Dialogue Option]  I'm really happy for you.
Chisa: By the way, after I told them about you, they've been insisting on thanking you in person.
Chisa: I did say you're probably very busy... But please, let me know when you have a free moment.
Chisa: My father makes the best Ashinohara dishes.
Chisa: If we ever end up in the same class, come find me. That'll be nice.
Chisa: Once my classmates found out my father makes my bento, they started asking for a bite during lunch. Ever since, he's packed extra portions.
Chisa: We could share a meal together sometime. Just the two of us, like in Honami. Or with more people. Both are great.
Chisa: I think... this is it. This is what "being young" is supposed to feel like.

The New Solar Celebration transform the Academy. Lights and banners go up, and the grounds come alive with music, laughter, and youthful spirit.
...Invite a friend to celebrate with you?
[Dialogue Option]  (Invite Lynae.)
Lynae joins you to celebrate, and you are swept away in the celebration's joyful whirl...

Lynae: Scored some wild trinkets, saw some crazy colors, ate my body weight in snacks... A girl could die happy.

[Dialogue Option]  Feels like you're here on the clock.

Mornye: Once you understand the mechanics, getting a high score is a breeze. But when it comes to games that test your rhythm or reflexes... I'm not so good at those...
Mornye: Could that be a bit unfair to the students? Maybe I should delete my high scores from the server...
Mornye: I always used to watch the students celebrate from my lab in the Research Institute. Being here with you, Mentor, actually participating... I think... I like it.
Mornye: Returning to work with this "emotional parameter" boost should correlate to higher efficiency. Thank you, Mentor.
[Dialogue Option]  (Invite Luuk Herssen.)
Luuk Herssen joins you to celebrate...
Luuk Herssen: We've had campus-wide events before, but this New Solar Celebration energy is on another level...
Luuk Herssen: Is it because it's the inaugural event? The students poured everything into this. Their passion is great to see, but a little more caution wouldn't hurt.
Luuk Herssen: Patched up a handful of scrapes and bruises just getting here. Ah, the passionate, painful privilege of youth.
[Dialogue Option]  Thanks, Doctor...
[Dialogue Option]  So much for a day off...
Luuk Herssen: Heh, not at all. Time flies when you're having fun, and this was... memorable.
Luuk Herssen: I should head back to the infirmary. Enjoy the rest of the celebration, and watch your step.
Luuk Herssen: I've only been gone a moment, but I'm sure there's already a line forming at my door...
[Dialogue Option]  (Invite Lucilla.)
Lucilla joins you to celebrate...
Lucilla: Phew! It's been so long since I've had this much fun!
Lucilla: Students rarely invite me, you know. Most scatter the second they spot me. I stopped showing up to keep from spoiling their fun, hmph...
[Dialogue Option]  Aren't you exaggerating?
[Dialogue Option]  You're not that type of President. Or are you?
Lucilla: I'm teasing, of course. Only the ones with overdue essays have anything to fear. And on a day like today? I wouldn't dream of rushing them.
Lucilla: Alright, I should get back to work. I did play hooky to be here, after all. Now it's your turn to shine.
Lucilla: Go set some records, Rover. I have high expectations.
Lucilla: Oh, and feel free to compete under the name "Lucilla." Hehe, I won't mind a bit!
[Dialogue Option]  I've got more important things to do...

title: Rabbit Reflected in Shades
content:
[Objective: Find Lucilla]
Lucilla: "When the Bird Glides Across the Sky"... that song I listened to during my insomnia last night. The Rinascitans do have an exquisite taste in art.
Lucilla: But this melody just keeps my mind going. Not suitable for sleeping. Erase.
Lucilla: Next... today's breakfast. Hmm, Royan-style.
Lucilla: All trivial. Erase it too. It was delicious, though.
Lucilla: Alright, looks like my guest has arrived. Gotta handle the rest later.
Lucilla: What? Do I look like some murmuring android to you?
Rover: Sorry, President. Were you...
Lucilla: Tuning memories. Curious about my Forte?
[Dialogue Option]  About your Forte...
Lucilla: Everyone leaves behind frequencies on the objects they carry. My Forte allows me to read and analyze that information.
Lucilla: Those frequencies, in a sense, are their memories.
Lucilla: I can read, analyze, and store them in my mind, erasing or adding memories at will. That's what I call "memory tuning."
[Dialogue Option]  Mind giving me a quick explanation?
Lucilla: I can extract frequency information from an object, use it as an anchor to draw out related memories, and store them in my mind.
Lucilla: But the brain has limits, so I have to decide which memories to keep... and which to discard. Just like you saw earlier.
[Dialogue Option]  Like intermittent amnesia?
Lucilla: It's different from amnesia. With amnesia, memories might still return.
Lucilla: But when I "erase" something through memory tuning, I erase the frequency entirely. There's no recovering it.
[Dialogue Option]  Doesn't that affect your daily life?
Lucilla: Don't worry. I've set clear rules for what I erase. It's part of my daily life now.
Lucilla: Alright, back to the point. I told you all that because it ties into what I mentioned in the message earlier.
[Dialogue Option]  You mean the Dark Side?
[Dialogue Option]  Are you planning to use your Forte on me?
Lucilla: Correct. I need your help to confirm something. May I borrow an item you always carry?
[Dialogue Option]  (You hand her your student card.)
Lucilla: Oh? You still have it. Perfect. Objects with personal meaning carry stronger frequencies.
Lucilla: Rover, I'll need to ask you a few questions. Let's begin.
Lucilla: I have a general picture now. At the end of the Celebration, you and Sigrika entered the Dark Side to solve the final riddle, and encountered another "Sigrika."
Lucilla: And you realized she was a fake when she said, "Should finding an answer really be so important?"
Rover: You got it all right... Amazing how much you learned just from that single card.
Lucilla: To me, your memories play like a film. I can pause and study them frame by frame.
Lucilla: So, what happened after the fake Sigrika revealed herself?
Rover: Then... there was a rabbit. I remember chasing it, the same one I saw right after entering the Dark Side.
Lucilla: I see. Thank you, Rover. I think I've found what I needed.
Lucilla: Remember when I said Mornye compared the frequencies and found that the rabbit was likely the root cause of the Dark Side anomaly?
Lucilla: The rabbit leads those who enter the Dark Side to face what they fear and try to avoid. Just like Sigrika meeting her alter ego.
Lucilla: Since then, the anomaly has persisted. Some students and professors have faced the same situation.

title: Rabbit Reflected in Shades
content:
Lucilla: Since then, the anomaly has persisted. Some students and professors have faced the same situation.



Lucilla: Given the Grand Architect's teaser for you and Dr. Luuk, that rabbit should be one of the Fractsidus's little tricks in this game of theirs.
Lucilla: They harmed my students and colleagues with such despicable means... As the President, I'll make sure they get a taste of their own medicine.
[Dialogue Option]  What are you planning to do?
Lucilla: That rabbit is their pawn, which means, I can turn it against them.
Lucilla: We'll lure it out, capture it, and remove the anomaly at its source. Then, using my Forte, I can extract information about the Fractsidus from it.
Lucilla: But mobilizing the Academy's resources might alert our enemies. I need some more personal aid—someone I trust, who knows the Dark Side well... and that's you.
[Dialogue Option]  So... does that count as my holiday assignment?
Lucilla: Hehe, let's call it a field project. A joint study between a professor and her dear student.
[Dialogue Option]  Even if you didn't ask, I'd help anyway.
Lucilla: Wonderful. Hearing that puts me at ease.

content:
[Dialogue Option]  Even if you didn't ask, I'd help anyway.
Lucilla: Wonderful. Hearing that puts me at ease.



Lucilla: It's worth noting that while many have entered the Dark Side, only a few were chosen by the rabbit.
Lucilla: While the Celebration incident was a Fractsidus scheme targeting you and Sigrika, the other victims might have followed a pattern that drew the rabbit.
[Dialogue Option]  And that pattern lies hidden among the victims themselves.
Lucilla: Exactly. We need to find out what each of them did in the Dark Side and make comparisons.
Lucilla: The common threads might be what attracted the rabbit. The Academy has already investigated the victims.
Lucilla: Based on what we've found, a few possible factors stand out.
Lucilla: Like how long they stayed in the Dark Side, whether they entered with a strong purpose or desire, and whether they brought anything back.
Lucilla: Our next lead is a professor with a pretty strong opinion against the Academy's management. That's why... you, as a student, are a better choice to approach him.
[Dialogue Option]  You two don't get along?
Lucilla: Not exactly. Some of his beliefs just don't align with the executives' ideas.
Lucilla: Setting that aside, I'll support your investigation from the Dark Side. My Forte will be essential to uncover what they experienced.
[Dialogue Option]  What about you?
Lucilla: Don't worry. I'll be assisting from the Dark Side. My Forte will be essential to uncover what they experienced.
Lucilla: Once you speak with him, try to obtain one of his personal items. That'll let me relive his memories in the Dark Side.
[Dialogue Option]  So I'm on the bright side, and you're on the dark...
[Dialogue Option]  Take care of yourself in there.
Lucilla: Hm. Now, I've texted (WavesLine) you the basic info on that victim... And take this.
[Dialogue Option]  A makeup mirror?
[Dialogue Option]  President Lucilla...?
Lucilla: Don't underestimate this  little  mirror. It's actually a communicator. It's only natural for partners to have a private line, right?
Lucilla: It's getting late. I'm already on my way to the Dark Side. The on-campus investigation is in your hands now.
Lucilla: Oh, and check your phone. I've sent you a new message.

title: Rabbit Reflected in Shades
subsection: Inquire about the situation from the students
content:
[Objective: Inquire about the situation from the students]
Lazy Student: Ugh, law of conservation... Then tell me, is the time between holidays and weekdays physically symmetric?
Lazy Student: Fridays turn into weekends, but when weekends pass, it takes four whole days for Friday to come again. Time clearly isn't evenly divided, is it?
Sorrowful Student: Maybe when they invented weekdays and weekends, they didn't think about that law... You know, science is rarely accepted by the masses at first.
Sorrowful Student: Anyway, we should probably focus on the back-to-school exam. I heard President Lucilla wrote the questions. Now just imagine our pass rate... Freshman, you'd better be ready.
[Dialogue Option]  Got any last-minute exam guides?
Lazy Student: Exam guides? You mean like notes, previous tests, or lecture reviews? Forget it. None of that works on President Lucilla's exams.
Lazy Student: According to her, "Don't think of it as a test of knowledge, but an assessment of your life skills."
Lazy Student: "After all, here at Startorch, knowledge isn't just for show. It's what lets you breathe and move forward."
Sorrowful Student: Yeah, she really doesn't like those old scholars who keep talking about theories all day.Speaking of our Professors... is there anyone who might go easy on students? Maybe Professor Sevi?
Rover: Speaking of our Professors... is there anyone who might go easy on students? Maybe Professor Sevi?
Lazy Student: Professor Sevi... Maybe? People say he treats students like his own kids. We just saw him earlier.
Sorrowful Student: But isn't he one of those "old scholars" the President dislikes?"
Sorrowful Student: I heard they had a dispute once. He refused to compromise his academic pursuits, and it all ended on a sour note.
Lazy Student: Ugh, adult drama... Let's not dwell on it. Oh, and why are you asking about Professor Sevi?
[Dialogue Option]  I need to discuss something with him.
Lazy Student: Say no more. He's nearby. You can find him up ahead.

[Dialogue Option]  I see you are giving us students a hard time.
Lucilla: Oh, no panic. I simply put together the professors' finest ideas for the exam questions... and added a little extra depth.
[Dialogue Option]  So... the dispute with Professor Sevi was academic?
Lucilla: Of course not. If we are having ugly disputes simply over academic issues, Startorch Academy wouldn't even need to exist.

Prepatory Student: Professor, about my paper—
Another Resident: You've got a lot of nerve bringing that up.

title: Rabbit Reflected in Shades

content:
[Objective: Inquire about the situation from the other professors]
Professor Karl: I read it. Aside from the title, the rest was mind-numbingly long and irritating, like a damned Voidworm!
Professor Karl: And don't you dare include my name in your acknowledgements. That'd be pure slander! That's all.
Professor Karl: ...Hmm? A freshman? What is it?
[Dialogue Option]  N-nothing.
Professor Karl: If you've got something to say, spit it out. Hesitation doesn't suit a Startorch student.
Professor Karl: Kids like you are always tentative. You even drag that habit into research... Honestly, I'm starting to wonder what Lucilla was thinking when she admitted you lot.
Lucilla: That voice... must be Professor Karl. You'd better answer him candidly. He's upright, and blunt.
Rover: I saw you were upset with your student earlier, so I didn't want to bother you. Professor, have you seen Professor Sevi?
[Dialogue Option]  Excuse me, Professor. Have you seen Professor Sevi?
Lucilla: Well done. That voice... It's Professor Karl. You'd better answer him candidly.
Lucilla: He's one of the tough nuts, just like Professor Sevi.
Professor Karl: Sevi? He's probably prepping instruments. The man seems to be trapped in his research lately.
Professor Karl: Ever since he got back from the Dark Side, he's been calling for its shutdown, saying no one should go in. Caused another big argument with the top brass.
[Dialogue Option]  Why's that?
Professor Karl: Why... Hmph. Probably because of Lucilla and her merry band. They must've botched something, and Sevi caught wind of it.
Professor Karl: You're new, so you probably wouldn't know. Sevi and I don't really see eye to eye with Lucilla.
Professor Karl: She's a fine teacher. But as the Academy's leader? Hardly!
Professor Karl: If it's about scholarship, we have geniuses like Professor Mornye. If it's about leadership, we have investors with far more experience.
Professor Karl: And yet she—an average Resonator with no special expertise—is now carrying the Academy's future. Really?
[Dialogue Option]  Well...
Professor Karl: Ugh, forget it. I don't even know why I'm bringing this up with a student. Guess I've been bottling that up for too long.

[Dialogue Option]  I...

content:

Sevi: You're late. Did you bring all the materials I asked for?
Sevi: Hand me the recalibrator... Hm? What—
Sevi: Ah, my mistake. I thought you were my assistant. You are... Have we met before?
Sevi: ...Ah, the Academy newspaper! You must be the student behind the success of the New Solar Ceremony, right?
[Dialogue Option]  Pleasure to meet you. I'm Rover.

title: Rabbit Reflected in Shades
content:
[Dialogue Option]  Pleasure to meet you. I'm Rover.



Sevi: So, when the launch program for Helios bugged out, how did you manage to recalibrate the parameters? And what about the live Drive data...
[Dialogue Option]  Please, one question at a time, Professor.
Sevi: Ahem... Watching a project come to life always gets me a little overexcited. I helped with part of the launch mechanism myself.
Sevi: Oh, I haven't even introduced myself properly. I'm Sevi, Professor from the Department of Engineering, and a past recipient of the Spacetrek Collective's Startorch Prize.
Sevi: This prize hasn't been awarded in years due to the difficult situation. Oh, don't get me wrong. I'm not showing off.
Sevi: I keep it... to remind myself that our science did make headway before, though now...
Sevi: ...Anyway, Rover, what brings you here?
Rover: (Lucilla mentioned that he's not on good terms with the management. I can't let him know I was sent here by her.)
Rover: (Still, we're both victims of the Dark Side. Maybe approaching from that angle won't raise suspicion.)
Rover: I'm here to talk about the Dark Side. Sigrika and I had an accident there, and I heard other students and professors experienced something similar.
Rover: There are so many conflicting stories about it. As someone who had been there, I want to know if everyone saw the same thing. You've entered it too, haven't you, Professor?
Sevi: I... Before that, tell me, what did you see in there?
[Dialogue Option]  A rabbit.
[Dialogue Option]  The other selves of people who feared facing their problems.
Sevi: ...Unfortunately, although I did enter the Dark Side once, I didn't see any of that.
Sevi: Still, with all these incidents, the place should be completely sealed, especially from students.
Sevi: Now, I have to prepare for an experiment. We can have more discussion next time. Oh, and...
[Dialogue Option]  This is...
Sevi: That medal's yours now. The Startorch Prize may have been discontinued, but your contribution to the New Solar Ceremony deserves recognition.
Sevi: What we need now is another breakthrough in technology. So take it... as my personal acknowledgment.

title: Rabbit Reflected in Shades
content:

[Dialogue Option]  Professor Lucilla?
Lucilla: Yes, I've heard everything.
Rover: Looks like Professor Sevi didn't want to open up about what he saw in the Dark Side.
Lucilla: Even so, that medal's a valuable lead. It's deeply connected to him.
Lucilla: Please place the medal in front of the makeup mirror. I can't touch it myself, so I'll read and tune its frequency remotely.
[Dialogue Option]  Do as Lucilla says.
[Dialogue Option]  I need more time.
[Dialogue Option]  Do as Lucilla says.

[Dialogue Option]  I need more time.

title: Rabbit Reflected in Shades
content:
[Objective: Find clues ahead]
Rover: President, can you hear me?
Lucilla: Yes... The comms are stable. Let's begin.
Sevi: This is strange... I was setting up the room according to the riddle the Academy gave me, but now it's...
Sevi: Who changed the riddle? Who altered the scene? Could it be that rabbit the students keep mentioning?
Sevi: Either way, I should focus on restoring the room through memory projection. If a student gets misled and causes another accident, it'll be a real headache.
Lucilla: Mmm. So this is Professor Sevi's memory when he first entered the Dark Side. He stayed here quite a while and used his Forte.
Lucilla: From what we just saw, he was one of the staff involved in the New Solar Celebration. He came here to restore the scene that had been tampered with.
Lucilla: But...
Rover: Something wrong?
Lucilla: Not exactly. Maybe because I'm a memory-type Resonator too. Something caught my attention.
Lucilla: People think memory-type Resonators like us are masters of memories and emotions, unshaken by illusions or insults.
Lucilla: But no Forte is perfect. When we pour all focus into manipulating memories, information floods the mind.
Lucilla: That's when we're most vulnerable. The anomaly in the Dark Side preys on the mind. If I were a Fractsidus member, I'd strike then...

title: Rabbit Reflected in Shades
content:
[Objective: Look for Professor Sevi's projection]
Lucilla: This projection won't hold for long. Let's move forward.

title: Rabbit Reflected in Shades

Sevi: ...I can't even feel time passing here. Half an hour's gone already?
Sevi: This one... should go here. Wait, the rabbit—
Sevi: You again! Are you the one who changed the riddle and warped this place? Get back here!
Lucilla: This memory records the moment he met the rabbit. Before that, he mentioned time. Could that be another key factor?
Rover: Did the other victims have similar behaviors?
Lucilla: Let's not jump to conclusions yet. Keep going."

title: Rabbit Reflected in Shades
content:
[Objective: Follow Professor Sevi's projection]
Sevi: Gone again? No matter how good you are at hide-and-seek, your traces stay in my memory.
Sevi: I'll just need to use my Forte again.
Sevi: No use hiding. I know you're there.
Sevi (Dark Side): Surprised? Staring at yourself.
Sevi: Y-you are... No, I know what this is. The Dark Side's a mirror. You're just my shadow.
Sevi (Dark Side): Hah. Even if I'm a shadow, so what? I'm still part of you. Afraid your shadow might know a few of your secrets?
Sevi (Dark Side): Secrets you've been running from...
Sevi (Dark Side): You're trapped, desperate for progress, like that Huanglong researcher, who eventually threw everything away for the truth.
Sevi (Dark Side): Pascar Spectrum... That name rings a bell?
Sevi: ...I'm nothing like Pascar.
Sevi (Dark Side): Oh, you're right about that. You don't even have his courage to give it all up. That's why you're stuck here, like a lab rat running in circles.
Sevi (Dark Side): But what if I told you... the answer you've been seeking is right here? Something about your current project. Go on, take a look.
Sevi: The data model... was wrong from the start? Is this where the error lies? If I fix it, my second hypothesis could actually work.
Sevi: Then, based on the corrected model, the result should be... Wait, there's a formula missing? The first half matches my derivation perfectly...
Sevi: Where's the rest? Where's the other half of the formula?

title: Rabbit Reflected in Shades
content:
Sevi: Where's the rest? Where's the other half of the formula?



Sevi (Dark Side): I never said the answer was free. Let's make a fair trade.
Sevi (Dark Side): Offer something of equal value, and the answer's yours. Look, I've even prepared the stakes for you, everything tied to your research.
Sevi (Dark Side): Thesis, data... It's all here. So, which one's worth the truth?
Sevi (Dark Side): See? No weight at all. Your report's worthless.
Sevi (Dark Side): Try again?
Sevi (Dark Side): Ah, no, no, no. Far from enough. Is that the extent of your pride in knowledge? Why not wager everything?
Sevi: That... that can't be...
Sevi (Dark Side): But it can. You've spent all your chips. What else do you have left to trade?
Sevi (Dark Side): Ah, right. Almost forgot about that. Your greatest honor, wasn't it? Let's see if it's worth anything.
Sevi (Dark Side): Look at that. You've given everything, and yet, you still can't trade for a single answer.
Sevi (Dark Side): Or maybe... the scale  is  the answer. The so-called scientific pursuit at Lahai-Roi contributes nothing to the advance of human civilization.
Sevi (Dark Side): And of course, it can't change what sleeps beneath Lahai-Roi. You know exactly what I mean.
Sevi: Enough! You don't understand anything!
Sevi (Dark Side): Oh? Don't I? You've got nothing left. Oh... but there's still one last thing you can trade.
Sevi (Dark Side): Your life. Go on! This is the part you idealists always love, isn't it?

title: Rabbit Reflected in Shades
content:
Sevi (Dark Side): Your life. Go on! This is the part you idealists always love, isn't it?



Sevi: ...I told you. You don't understand! You're just preying on desperate seekers of truth!
Sevi: I won't let anyone else enter this room!

title: Rabbit Reflected in Shades
content:

Sevi: I won't let anyone else enter this room!



Rover: So that's why Professor Sevi was so determined to keep everyone out of the Dark Side...
Lucilla: He was protecting them in his own way. He feared that eager students or passionate teachers might trade their lives for an illusion of truth.
Lucilla: Greatness isn't just about achievement. Sometimes, it's about facing reality and still choosing to live with dignity.
Lucilla: At Startorch Academy, we pursue truth, yes, but we value the journey more than the destination. Weighing our worth on a scale? That's true ignorance.
Lucilla: Now then, if we cross-check the clues from Sevi with the Academy's earlier findings...
[Dialogue Option]  The rabbit's appearance is linked to time?
Lucilla: Spending more time in the Dark Sie does raise the chance of seeing the rabbit, but that's not the root cause.
[Dialogue Option]  The rabbit's appearance is linked to the victim?
Lucilla: You're saying it's drawn to one's vulnerability.
Lucilla: But everyone has weaknesses. Some hide them deeper, some don't. That alone isn't special enough.
[Dialogue Option]  The rabbit's appearance is linked to using Forte?
Lucilla: You're half right. The key isn't the Forte itself. It's what it acts upon.
Lucilla: Remember? Professor Sevi used his Forte to restore the scene, and other student victims used theirs to take something from the Dark Side...
Lucilla: In both cases, they influenced the space itself. That's the real link.

title: Rabbit Reflected in Shades
content:

Lucilla: They were all memory-type Resonators. And there aren't many of us in the Academy...
Lucilla: Only one remains. You understand what that means now, don't you?
Lucilla: Focus my mind. Loosen my thoughts. Just a little. Give the threat an opening.
Lucilla: A small price to draw it out. In that false professor's words, a fair trade it is.
Lucilla: Since the Fractsidus went to such lengths to invite me, well, as the President, how could I turn down the feast?
???: That student... You seem to trust him quite a lot.

???: Just as planned. No one else remains in the Dark Side.

Lucilla: And remember, if anything unexpected happens, you know what to do.

Inside the Startorch Academy A moment ago, on the other side...
