title: The Wind Before the Storm
content:
[Objective: (;(Cutscene plays) plays)]
Rover: You're all here...
Lucilla: Ah, Rover. I knew everyone would want to see you off, so I rounded up whoever I could.
Lynae: You weren't gonna just shoot us a WavesLine and dip, were ya? That'd be cold!
Sigrika: Oh, Senior! Come back and visit us when you get the chance, okay?
Chisa: Even though your "time" at the Academy has ended, Rover, ours will keep moving forward.
Chisa: I believe that there will be a day when we'll share time together again.
Aemeath: Which means! This isn't some sad, teary "goodbye forever" moment—
Aemeath: It's another brand new "beginning" that belongs to us.
Lucilla: The Academy is just a stop along the way. A cradle for dreams.
Lucilla: The way I see it, everyone here already knows the path they should take and just needs a little more time to sprout.
Lynae: So, Rover! You have a good time here at the Academy with us, yeah?
Rover: It was short, but yeah. I'm glad.
Rover: If there's one thing I'll take away from my time here, it's all of you.
Lucilla: Rover, you are the most unique "student" Startorch Academy has ever had. And as a place for learning, I hope the time you spent here becomes a source of strength for the path ahead of you—
Lucilla: And yada, yada, yada... I'll spare you the speech. Ready, everybody?
Sigrika: President Lucilla, d-do we have to?
Sigrika: Happy graduation, Senior!
Lynae: Happy graduation, Rover!
Chisa: Congratulations on your graduation. I'll do my best to catch up to you as soon as I can.
Aemeath: Goodbye. And it is a "good" "bye" cuz we'll definitely be seeing you again soon!
Aemeath: So don't act all shocked when we just show up one day, 'kay?
Rover: Everyone, thank you.
Rover: Well then... See you, Startorch Academy.

title: The Wind Before the Storm
content:
|label2=Sigrika
|content2=:Sigrika:  Senior, happy graduation!
Sigrika:  I never expected you'd graduate so soon! As your "senior," I'd better step it up, huh?
Sigrika:  Before you go, have any graduation tidbits you'd like to share?
Sigrika:  You know... like, "So long, Startorch cafeteria food," or "Goodbye, student life"...things like that? Sometimes when I'm drowning in assignments, I daydream about moments like this...
[Choice]  I wish I could stay longer here at the Academy...
(Rover):  I wish I could stay longer here at the Academy...
Sigrika:  You'll get your chance! Besides, I heard President Lucilla say she wants to invite you back as a teaching assistant.
[Choice]  It's time to meet what's ahead of me.
(Rover):  It's time to meet what's ahead of me.
Sigrika:  Oh, you haven't changed a bit, Senior. Always got something you want to do.
Sigrika:  And that's a good thing!
Sigrika:  By the way, what's it like in Jinzhou?
[Choice]  (Describe the views of Jinzhou.)
(Rover):  Breakfast stalls open up at first light. Teahouses are always full of people chatting away...
Sigrika:  Sounds like an exciting place. Completely different from the frostlands.
Sigrika:  It feels like a very warm place to be.
Sigrika:  After hearing all that, I really want to visit Jinzhou myself now.
[Choice]  You want to go for a visit?
[Choice]  (Introduce your friends from Jinzhou.)
(Rover):  There's Yangyang. She's kind, and very pleasant to be around. Chixia. Loyal, strong sense of justice. She goes by another name too.
(Rover):  And Jinhsi, the Magistrate of Jinzhou. Everyone in Jinzhou places great trust in her...
Sigrika:  They all sound wonderful! Hearing you talk about them makes me feel like I've known them for a long time myself.
Sigrika:  You must cherish those friendships a lot.
Sigrika:  If there's ever a chance, I'd like to meet Magistrate Jinhsi. Sounds to me like she's under a lot of pressure, but she's handling it very well.
[Choice]  If the chance comes up, I'll introduce you to each other.
[Choice]  (Share your adventures in Jizhou.)
(Rover):  Well, it all started back at the Gorges of Spirits...
Sigrika:  I didn't realize you already did so many amazing things, Senior! You're incredible.
Sigrika:  I wonder what kind of adventures await you next? Be sure to tell me all about them!
Sigrika:  After hearing all that, I really want to visit Jinzhou myself now.
[Choice]  You want to go for a visit?
(Rover):  If the chance comes up, I'll introduce you to each other.
(Rover):  You wanna go for a visit?
Sigrika:  I do! I want to start doing more of what I want to do. See more places, learn new things. Things that don't have to do with the Roya. Maybe it'll even help with my rune deciphering...
Sigrika:  But maybe in the future.
[Choice]  Goodbye for now, then.
(Rover):  Goodbye for now, then.}}
|label3=Chisa
|content3=:Chisa:  This... reminds me of the party we had with everyone at Shashou Cafe.
[Choice]  How so?
(Rover):  How so?
Chisa:  Back then, all I wanted was to finish what I needed to do in Honami. No regrets. Then go home to see my parents.
[Choice]  I see.
(Rover):  I see.
[Choice]  Yeah, I remember you telling me.
(Rover):  Yeah, I remember you telling me.
Chisa:  Yes. I'd even prepared myself for a final goodbye. But then we ended up coming here together... In a way.
Chisa:  It's not like we saw each other all the time at the Academy. But between classes, I'd sometimes think of you studying in some other corner of campus. Or maybe... saving Lahai-Roi.
Chisa:  When I did, I'd feel relieved. But this time... you really are leaving.
[Choice]  ...Chisa?
(Rover):  ...Chisa?
Chisa:  Rover, is there anything you wanted to do at Startorch Academy, but didn't get to?
[Choice]  I can't think of anything.
(Rover):  I can't think of anything.
Chisa:  That's good. I hope you got everything out of your student life.
Chisa:  Last break, I made time to go back to Honami. Brought Namipon some Roya snacks. And Namipon said.. it really hopes you'll go back to visit.
Chisa:  I know. You always have to keep moving forward. But that's okay. One day, I'll catch up.
[Choice]  ...?
[Choice]  There are some things I wish I did.
(Rover):  There are some things I wish I did.
Chisa:  I see...
[Choice]  This isn't goodbye for good.
(Rover):  This isn't goodbye for good. Sure, there are still things I didn't get to do, but there'll be other chances. I know it.
(Rover):  ...?
Chisa:  There's still a promise to keep. Once I complete my studies, I'll definitely come find you.
Chisa:  No matter where in Solaris you are, I'll come find you. With confidence. Head held high.
Chisa:  And by then, you'll see a brilliant Kuchiba Chisa who lived her campus life with no regrets.
[Choice]  I've always believed in you.
(Rover):  I've always believed in you.
[Choice]  Nothing can hold you back, Chisa.
(Rover):  Nothing can hold you back, Chisa.
Chisa:  Mm, yes. No matter if it's the Black Shores or somewhere else, our paths are bound to cross.
Chisa:  I'm sorry. I've said too much. Since we're saying goodbye, how would you like me to address you?
[Choice]  You don't need to get all fancy.
(Rover):  You don't need to get all fancy.
Chisa:  Farewell... Rover!
[Choice]  I didn't mind that Senpai thing.
(Rover):  I didn't mind that Senpai thing.
Chisa:  Farewell... Senpai!}}
|label4=Lucilla
|content4=:Lucilla:  Some students who graduate are like kites. No matter how high they fly, one end of the string is always tied to this place.
Lucilla:  Others are like dandelions. They grow fast, just so they can take root in some faraway land that calls to them.
Lucilla:  So, Rover... which one are you?
[Choice]  You can bet I'll be back.
(Rover):  You can bet I'll be back.
Lucilla:  Heh, I knew you'd say that.
[Choice]  What do you think?
(Rover):  What do you think?
Lucilla:  You've always been a tricky one to read, but I think that for you, the answer doesn't even matter.
Lucilla:  That's because you're definitely coming back.
Lucilla:  Huanglong, the New Federation, even the frontiers of civilization I myself have never set foot in...
Lucilla:  No matter when or where you are, when you look up at the sky, I know you'll think of this place.
Lucilla:  You'll think of the people here, marching toward the stars.
[Choice]  Yeah.
(Rover):  Yeah.
Lucilla:  Haha. Well, in any case, happy graduation, Rover.}}
|label5=Aemeath
|content5=:Aemeath:  Grad-ulations!
Aemeath:  Huh, never thought I'd ever say that to you. You might legit be the fastest person to ever graduate from Startorch Academy.
Aemeath:  Meanwhile, I'm still stuck here grinding for my degree...
[Choice]  Where's the first place you want to go after you graduate?
(Rover):  Where's the first place you want to go after you graduate?
Aemeath:  Let's see... Maybe I'll do a road trip. Hit up all the spots you've been. Check out Ragunna and Septimont in Rinascita, then skip over to Jinzhou for that border view.
Aemeath:  You spoke about the great people you met there before. I want to see the people and places that meant so much to you, y'know?
Aemeath:  After that, I think I'll make the trip to the Black Shores.
Aemeath:  I wanna meet THE Shorkeeper who's been watching over you this whole time! Oh, and I definitely gotta go another round with Camellya!
Aemeath:  The Black Shores tracks the Lament everywhere, so I bet they can find the best place for my skills there, don't you think?
[Choice]  Aemeath, are you still set on walking the "savior's" path?
(Rover):  Aemeath, are you still set on walking the "savior's" path?
Aemeath:  Duh. That's my dream and the path I chose.
Aemeath:  Even if we're not always together, just knowing that you and I are doing the same thing somewhere in Solaris... That makes me happy.
Aemeath:  'Cause think about it, the more I pull my weight, the less you gotta carry, right? It's kind of messed up if all that pressure was just on one person!
Aemeath:  Who knows, you might even start hearing legends about "the one and only Aemeath" before we see each other again.
[Choice]  I'll be looking forward to it.
(Rover):  I'll be looking forward to it.
Aemeath:  All right! Get ready to be blown away!
[Choice]  Have no fear, Aemeath's here!
(Rover):  Have no fear, Aemeath's here!
Aemeath:  Hehe, just hearing you say that already makes me all giddy!
Aemeath:  Anyway, if anything comes up, I'll just find you in WavesLine real quick. As a digital ghost, my ping is kinda off the charts.
Aemeath:  Sooo... I guess I'll look forward to next time, then.
Aemeath:  Journey well.}}
|label6=Lynae
|content6=:Lynae:  Congrats on the finish! So, is this, like, your "graduation trip"? Wait, guess this can't count since you've been traveling this whole time anyway.
Lynae:  Huanglong, huh... If I ever get to planning my own graduation trip, that'd actually be a solid pick.
Lynae:  One capital and six cities. Sounds like I could burn a lotta time there!
[Choice]  You're still a ways from graduation, right?
(Rover):  You're still a ways from graduation, right?
Lynae:  Hehe... A girl can dream!
Lynae:  But for real though... graduation means saying goodbye to who you used to be, doesn't it? Starting fresh.
Lynae:  Originally, I thought "this place" was gonna be my fresh start. But nothing lasts forever, right?
Lynae:  What kind of person will future "Lynae" turn out to be...? Well, seems like I gotta think on that a little more.
Lynae:  Never thought having too many options would actually become a problem for me...
Lynae:  But I'm sure I'll find the answer here. I'll let you know once I get there!
[Choice]  Looking forward to it.
(Rover):  Looking forward to it.
Lynae:  By the way, since you've already been to so many places...
Lynae:  That means... you'll end up in the New Federation sooner or later, right?
[Choice]  Yeah, probably.
(Rover):  Yeah, probably.
[Choice]  If I need to.
(Rover):  If I need to.
Lynae:  Well... if you do, watch your back, alright?
Lynae:  I know you can handle yourself, but the New Fed... It isn't a place where slick moves alone are going to solve every problem.
Lynae:  ...If it really comes down to it, just gimme a holler and I'll be your tour guide!
Lynae:  What's one semester off... Hell, I'll retake the whole damn semester if I have to!
[Choice]  I appreciate it, Lynae.
(Rover):  I appreciate it, Lynae.
(Rover):  I'll let you know if I need a hand.
Lynae:  Well, happy trails.
Lynae:  Don't be a stranger, okay? I'll be posting updates on my Wavesline all the time!}}
|label7=Luuk Herssen
|content7=:Luuk Herssen:  Happy graduation! Hmm, I never thought I'd be saying that to you so soon.
[Choice]  Is that regret I'm getting from you?
(Rover):  Is that regret I'm getting from you?
Luuk Herssen:  Saying goodbye to an old friend again will always be cause for regret. But in itself, graduation is a good thing. It's the start of something new.
Luuk Herssen:  I've seen off plenty of graduates over the years. Each time, including this one, I'm struck by the same sentiment. All that bright hope and energy... that's what has kept me here in Lahai-Roi all this time.
Luuk Herssen:  If I remember correctly, you're heading back to Jinzhou, yes? That city over in Huanglong.
[Choice]  That's right.
(Rover):  That's right.
Luuk Herssen:  Hmm... I've been to many places, but Jinzhou never quite made the list. It intrigues me more every time you mention it, though.
Luuk Herssen:  Morning stalls, teahouse chatter, streets full of life. A far cry from this place sleeping beneath the frostlands.
Luuk Herssen:  You've made it sound rather tempting, you know… I wonder if fate will ever point me in that direction.
[Choice]  Why not ask for a long vacation?
(Rover):  Why not ask for a long vacation?
[Choice]  Want to come with me?
(Rover):  Want to come with me?
Luuk Herssen:  Haha. Well, that depends on whether the Academy is willing to let me go. Somehow I doubt President Lucilla would say yes. She's already filled our schedules.
Luuk Herssen:  But hey, it's not all grind. Whenever I visit the frostlands and watch the snow dance across the sky, I think back to that moment... Remember what you told me? "Bright, passionate students, beautiful snow."
Luuk Herssen:  I came here with nothing but a "let's just see where this goes" kind of mindset. And before I knew it, years had slipped by here in Lahai-Roi.
Luuk Herssen:  You know, trying something new like that wasn't such a bad thing. You were right. I've lived a completely different life here. But of course, I'll speak with the President for some time off sooner or later.
Luuk Herssen:  When work finally slows down, and the timing feels right... maybe I'll take a long leave to go see Huanglong?
Luuk Herssen:  I hear their medical practices are fairly ancient, completely different from what I grew up learning. Would be fascinating to see it firsthand.
Luuk Herssen:  If you happen to know someone in that field, you might introduce me.
[Choice]  Actually, I do know a doctor...
(Rover):  Actually, I do know a doctor...
(Rover):  Though he's not practicing anymore.
Luuk Herssen:  Oh? That's even better.
Luuk Herssen:  People who change professions tend to be far more interesting than the ones who stay put. If I ever get the chance, I'd love to meet him.
Luuk Herssen:  Well, I should let you go now. Our graduate has a packed schedule, I presume?
[Choice]  Yeah, I'm almost done packing up.
(Rover):  Yeah, I'm almost done here.
Luuk Herssen:  Travel safe, then. When you return to Lahai-Roi someday... or when I visit Huanglong, remember to tell me all about your journey.
Luuk Herssen:  Once again, happy graduation.
Luuk Herssen:  It's a long road ahead—but you'll walk it beautifully.}}
|label8=Mornye
|content8=:Mornye:  I never thought there'd come a day when I'd be congratulating you on your graduation as the "teacher."
Mornye:  Happy graduation, Mentor. I'm so glad I get to witness this moment.
Mornye:  It's just... this is the second time I'm seeing you off from Lahai-Roi.
[Choice]  I'm sorry I've forgotten our past time together.
(Rover):  I'm sorry I've forgotten our past time together.
Mornye:  Don't be. I know you had your reasons, and I don't feel disappointed.
Mornye:  But last time you left, you said that Lahai-Roi will continue forward on its own feet. I've carried those words with me ever since.
Mornye:  So this time... may I be the one to offer a proper farewell?
[Choice]  By all means.
(Rover):  By all means.
[Choice]  And I'll be the one to remember it this time.
(Rover):  And I'll be the one to remember it this time.
Mornye:  Mentor, I—You have always been the brightest star in my heart!
Mornye:  And as long as this star exists... whether it's a pitch black night or a bottomless abyss, I'll find the courage to overcome it.
Mornye:  I wish I could draw closer to this star. To touch it. To let its light linger on me... just a little longer.
Mornye:  But—there's nothing more important than for that star to shine forever in the night sky.
Mornye:  So please, go on with your journey. I hope the road ahead is kind to you. I hope your wishes come true. I hope you're always surrounded by people you can trust.
Mornye:  And I hope you remember... no matter where you are, Lahai-Roi and I will always be here to support you.
[Choice]  There's something I want to say too.
(Rover):  There's something I want to say too.
(Rover):  Thank you for everything you've done for me, Mornye.
Mornye:  Mentor...
Mornye:  If that's how you feel, then let me make one request. Think of it as... a little reward I'd like from you.
Mornye:  I'd like you to come back to Lahai-Roi. Often. So you can see how far we've come. Because we will have come far.
Mornye:  I'll always be looking forward to your return.}}
}}

title: The Wind Before the Storm
content:
;Have you heard? About Uncle Dong? It's been days now...
;Did you hear? I think it was YangYang...
;And the Patrol Station isn't saying anything...
Abby: Yep—Same old Jinzhou, alright. Smells just like I remember it.
Rover: But looking around... The city looks like it's on edge. Yangyang did mention trouble brewing in her letter. Is this it?
Abby: Yeah... What's with all the long faces? It's a beautiful day out and everything.
Rover: Anyway, let's go find Yangyang and the others first.
Zhezhi: Rover? Is that really you? You're back?
[Dialogue Option]  Zhezhi?
[Dialogue Option]  Long time no see, Zhezhi.
Zhezhi: Oh, thank goodness. Now that you're here, Rover, everything is going to be all right. You must've come back because you heard what happened to Yangyang and Chixia!
[Dialogue Option]  Yangyang and Chixia...
[Dialogue Option]  What happened?
Zhezhi: Huh? You haven't heard? Chixia's still unconscious, and Yangyang... she's gone missing. And now...
Rover: ...Can you be more specific, Zhezhi?
Zhezhi: O-okay. I-I only found out recently myself. There was a commission that passed its deadline, but nobody came to follow up on it...
Zhezhi: So I went out to look for my client, but I couldn't find him anywhere. And it wasn't just him. People all over Jinzhou have been disappearing.
Zhezhi: Chixia and Yangyang were the ones on this case, but two days after they left the city, Chixia was brought back by the Midnight Rangers due to serious injuries. And Yangyang... she wasn't with her.
Zhezhi: That's all I know! I went to the Patrol Station to ask for more information, but they won't tell me anything.
Abby: C'mon, y-you don't gotta assume the worst, alright?
Abby: Yangyang, she... she's gonna be all right!
Rover: Don't beat yourself up, Zhezhi. You've already been a big help.
Rover: From here on out, leave it to me. I'll be on my way now.
Zhezhi: Rover... Please, just...

title: The Wind Before the Storm
content:
[Objective: Head to the City Hall]
Abby: So, Rover... Whadda we do next...?
Rover: ...Let's go talk to Jinhsi first.
Rover: ...

title: The Wind Before the Storm
content:
[Objective: Listen to the residents' conversations]
Qinggong: Hey... I haven't seen Xiaofang patrolling the streets lately.
Fuyue: Huh? Didn't you hear? I heard she got injured...
Qinggong: What?! By who...? Was it the TDs?
Fuyue: No idea... The Patrol Station's been keeping really quiet...

Kangjiu: I heard Yangyang went somewhere called the Land of Xuanfang... What kind of place is that, really?
Uncle Li: That place is no ordinary land, I tell you. Natural barriers, treacherous terrain... Sits right at the throat between Jinzhou and Mengzhou.
Uncle Li: Deep within the land lies Xuanfang Hold. Word is, the Sentinel of Mengzhou built it herself to cage the Tacet Discords. Cage them, kill them!
Kangjiu: But... will Yangyang be alright? I heard she went with Chixia, but Miss Panhua said Chixia came back with terrible...
Uncle Li: Well now... I wish I knew.

title: The Wind Before the Storm
content:
Uncle Li: Well now... I wish I knew.



Shuncai: Try not to fret too much, Miss Panhua... I'm sure Xiaofang will be just fine...
Panhua: Ha... Easy for you to say. What if something does happen to her and Yangyang...?
Shuncai: It'll be alright, trust me. I checked at Huaxu Academy. They said Chixia's stable now.
Panhua: What about Yangyang? Still nothing?
Shuncai: Well... Hmm..

title: The Wind Before the Storm
subsection: (Optional) Get more info from the locals
content:
[Objective: (Optional) Get more info from the locals]
Qinyou: The situation is getting worse. Ten people have gone missing, and we've lost contact with the Midnight Rangers sent to investigate. This is beyond the Patrol Station's capability now...
Yingda: I know. Xuanfang shares a border with Jinzhou. If anything goes wrong there... Is the Magistrate aware of this?
Qinyou: She is. But if things truly go south in Xuanfang, her hands are tied. Politics, you know how it is...
Qinyou: If only Counselor Changli were here. She left for Mingting a few days ago. No telling when she'll be back.
Yingda: All we can do is have faith in our Magistrate. She won't turn a blind eye to the Jinzhou civilians in harm's way.

metadata.subsection: (Optional) Get more info from the locals

title: The Wind Before the Storm
content:
[Objective: Continue forward]
???: Madam Sanhua, I do believe it's been two whole hours. Will you be taking me to see the Magistrate or not?
Sanhua: As I have already stated, the Magistrate is not presently at City Hall... so that won't be possible.
???: Very well, then. Tell me where she is, and I'll go find her myself.
Sanhua: I'm afraid... I cannot grant your request.
Rover: It's been a while, Sanhua.
Sanhua: Rover!? You... you've returned?
???: (And who might you be?)
Rover: Can you take me to Jinhsi?
???: Hold on, I hope you don't mind waiting your turn. Not to mention this concerns my younger sister—
Rover: I'm sorry, but I'm also here for someone important to me—
??? & Rover: I need to know what trouble Yangyang—
???: —Got herself into? Hmm?
Rover: Wait... Are you...?
Jinhsi: Please forgive Sanhua. I truly did not share my whereabouts with her.
[Dialogue Option]  Jinhsi! Are you hurt?
Jinhsi: It's nothing. Just some scratches. Compared to what I've gained from this trip, this is merely a small jest from  That One .
Jinhsi: My deepest apologies for not welcoming you properly, Miss Suisui. And apologies that your first visit to Jinzhou is under such circumstances.
Suisui: ...Well. Since Ms. Sanhua was telling the truth, I suppose I should apologize for my earlier rudeness. I came all the way to Jinzhou to see my sister, only to be told she's gone missing. I hope you can understand how that feels.
Jinhsi: I do. And I understand the urgency of the matter. Now that Rover is here, I'll brief you both directly.
Jinhsi: Recently, multiple people have gone missing across Jinzhou. All leads point to Xuanfang. Yangyang and Chixia were tasked to investigate Xuanfang Hold together. Chixia returned gravely wounded, and we've heard nothing from Yangyang.
Jinhsi: The moment I learned of this, I dispatched messengers via alternate routes to the Mengzhou City Hall, but they have yet to report back. I also tried sending elite Midnight Rangers to scout Xuanfang Hold once more, but their gates are sealed shut. No one knows what is happening inside those walls.
Suisui: Xuanfang Hold... Of all places.
Rover: But you must have a way in.
Jinhsi: Yes. Magistrate I may be, but I am also Resonator to Sentinel Jué.
Jinhsi: Xuanfang Hold's creator is none other than Mengzhou's Moon Fox Sentinel—Hsin. As Mengzhou and Jinzhou share borders, the two Sentinels laid down certain rules. One of which concerns an agreement regarding Xuanfang Hold.
Jinhsi: Should an emergency arise in Xuanfang Hold, the Resonators of each Sentinel may go to a designated location and retrieve the token they left.
Jinhsi: Regarding the specifics of that retrieval... it's not important. The act is done. And what I ultimately obtained, put simply, is a "spare key."
Suisui: I can tell the journey was not an easy one.
Jinhsi: It is, after all, something that can only be invoked in an "emergency." However, what constitutes as an emergency is for me to decide.
Jinhsi: Rover, given your deep connection with Jué, you should be able to use any of its artifacts freely as well.
Jinhsi: There is no time to waste, Rover. We should go. Forgive me, Miss Suisui. I beg your patience just a little longer.
Jinhsi: The Land of Xuanfang falls under Mengzhou's jurisdiction. Xuanfang Hold itself is a military stronghold. Generally speaking, as a neighboring state, we are not permitted to interfere in its affairs without due cause.
Jinhsi: While I cannot dispatch any personnel, as Jué's Resonator, I may enter on a personal basis.
[Dialogue Option]  You need to stay in Jinzhou, Jinhsi.
[Dialogue Option]  Ovathrax might make a return. Jinzhou can't be without you.
Jinhsi: But...
Rover: Trust me.
Suisui: He's right. If this involves more factions than we think, Jinzhou will need its Magistrate at the helm.
Suisui: Besides, you didn't think I'd just sit here and do nothing, did you?
Jinhsi: Very well, then. Rover, Miss Suisui. As Magistrate, I give you my word. I will bear all responsibility for your actions in Xuanfang Hold.
Jinhsi: Please, bring Yangyang... bring the people of Jinzhou home safely.
Jinhsi: Rover, Chixia is currently recovering at Huaxu Academy. Do pay her a visit before you depart. If you wish to learn more about Xuanfang Hold, you may also speak with Principal Investigator Xiangli and Baizhi there.
Jinhsi: As for you, Miss Suisui...
Suisui: Might I have a moment of your time? There's a matter I'd like to discuss with you, Madam Magistrate.
Jinhsi: As you wish. I'll answer as best I can.
Suisui: Rover, I will meet you at Huaxu Academy shortly.
Sanhua: ...We're counting on you, Rover.

title: The Wind Before the Storm
content:
[Objective: (Optional) Listen to the residents' conversations]
Lizhu: Ah... I sure hope Yangyang's all right...
Zhanghua: I know. She only just became an Outrider...

title: The Wind Before the Storm
subsection: Head to Huaxu Academy and check on Chixia
content:
[Objective: Head to Huaxu Academy and check on Chixia]

Baizhi: Rover, you have arrived.
Rover: Baizhi, how's Chixia...
Baizhi: She's right here. Still undergoing treatment.
Chixia: Yang... Yang...
Rover: ...Don't worry, Chixia. I'll bring Yangyang back.
Baizhi: We should step outside. She needs rest.

metadata.subsection: Head to Huaxu Academy and check on Chixia

title: The Wind Before the Storm
subsection: Head to Huaxu Academy and check on Chixia
content:
Chixia: Yang... Yang...
Rover: ...Don't worry, Chixia. I'll bring Yangyang back.
Baizhi: We should step outside. She needs rest.



Baizhi: Zhezhi came to visit Chixia earlier and spoke about you. Judging from your look, you've already met with the Magistrate.
Baizhi: Chixia... the Midnight Rangers who brought her back said she was gravely injured, but she still made it across the Dreaming Cavern by herself. She stayed conscious long enough to tell them what happened to Yangyang before finally collapsing.
Rover: Chixia...
Baizhi: No need to worry. She is no longer in critical condition. Her readings from late last night show she's slowly regaining awareness. However, she's still disoriented at the moment.
Baizhi: Forgive me, Rover. After I heard, I also wanted to search for Yangyang immediately. But with Chixia in this condition, I had no choice but to...
[Dialogue Option]  Thank you for taking care of her.
[Dialogue Option]  No need to apologize.
Xiangli Yao: That's right, Baizhi. Without you, Chixia's condition wouldn't have stabilized so quickly. And frankly, she might've been left with permanent damage.
Xiangli Yao: Rover, Sanhua told me about your situation. I take it you'll be heading to Xuanfang Hold soon?
Baizhi: Do be extra cautious, Rover. Xuanfang Hold isn't just any military stronghold. It's the pinnacle of what Automata Mechanics as a field can achieve today, and for the foreseeable future.
[Dialogue Option]  Automata Mechanics...
[Dialogue Option]  Advanced technologies beyond current knowledge...
Xiangli Yao: It's the masterpiece of Mengzhou's Sentinel, Hsin. A mechanical city built for the sole purpose of trapping and eliminating Tacet Discords to keep wider Mengzhou safe.
Xiangli Yao: Xuanfang Hold has stood at the border between our two states for over two hundred years now. Not a single incident in all that time. It's a "living" city in its own way that doesn't rely on people to run things. Instead, it uses creations called "Autopuppets" to fight off TDs.
Xiangli Yao: In theory, Xuanfang Hold is Mengzhou's most impenetrable fortress. And because of that exact reason, if something has gone wrong? The cause and the fallout are almost unimaginable.
Baizhi: According to Chixia, while Yangyang was being surrounded by Tacet Discords, Xuanfang Hold's gates opened for reasons unknown. And to ensure Chixia's escape, Yangyang went through that gate alone.
Baizhi: Meaning... Yangyang should still be inside.
Xiangli Yao: After I joined Huaxu Academy, I submitted several requests to Mengzhou to research the technological principles underlying Xuanfang Hold, but they were all rejected. So I'm afraid I don't know much more about what's actually in there. Sorry I can't be of more help in that regard.
Xiangli Yao: That said... while digging through old archives here at the Academy, I did stumble upon a report about Xuanfang.
Xiangli Yao: The contents were vague, frustratingly so. But there was a clue. Not sure if it'll help, but...
Xiangli Yao: Over two hundred years ago, when Xuanfang Hold was first being built, aside from Hsin and the forces of Mengzhou, there was another group that left their mark there.
[Dialogue Option]  And they were...
Xiangli Yao: The Court of Savantae.
Xiangli Yao: Xuanfang Hold has a long, long history. And that comes with a tangled web of events, each one tied to the next. I could elaborate, but I suspect you'd rather be on your way.
[Dialogue Option]  This is good enough for now.
[Dialogue Option]  Yes, finding Yangyang is the priority.
Xiangli Yao: Leave Chixia to us. Huaxu Academy will take good care of her.

metadata.subsection: Head to Huaxu Academy and check on Chixia

title: The Wind Before the Storm
content:
[Objective: (Optional) Listen in on the researchers’]
Liuqin: Chixia's finally stable now...
Zhixiu: Yes, and it's all thanks to that researcher, Baizhi. I've never seen her look so worried before.
Liuqin: It's only natural she'd react that way. Even I broke out in cold sweat just looking at her vital signs.
Zhixiu: Thank goodness she pulled through. Let's take turns watching her so Baizhi can finally get some rest.

title: The Wind Before the Storm
content:
[Objective: Talk to Suisui]
Suisui: Oh, alright... settle down, Dumpling.
Rover: Dumpling?
Suisui: Ah, there you are. Pay no mind, I've had this silly bird for years. Dumpling's her name.
Suisui: She's... in a bit of a mood right now. Probably because she didn't get to see Yangyang.
Suisui: They were thick as thieves back home. There was this one time when Yangyang—
Suisui: ...Sorry. This isn't really the best time to reminisce.
Rover: What were you thinking just now?
Suisui: Oh, nothing. Just an old memory.
Suisui: I was thinking about the day Yangyang told Mother and me she was leaving for Jinzhou. I told her that if she'd found her path, then she needn't worry about anything else. Just take that step and go.
Suisui: Only I wasn't being entirely honest with her.
[Dialogue Option]  That shows how much you love her.
[Dialogue Option]  It's only natural to feel this way.
Suisui: Before coming to Jinzhou, I'll admit I was a little nervous. After so many years apart, I wasn't sure we'd still be the same people we remembered. I never imagined...
Rover: Yangyang said the same thing to me.
Suisui: Oh? Did she now...
Rover: You two are a lot alike, you know.
Suisui: Are we? In some ways, perhaps. In others, not so much.
Rover: She's determined. She's never wavered or doubted her own choices.
Suisui: My, my. You seem to know Yangyang rather well.
Rover: My journey didn't really start until I met Yangyang.
Rover: No matter how far I've come, no matter how many places I've traveled, meeting her will always be my starting line.
Rover: So whether it's for everyone who cares about her, or for myself, I will find her. And I'll bring her back.

title: The Wind Before the Storm
content:
[Objective: Head to the Dreaming Cavern]
Suisui: Well, then. Shall we be on our way?
Suisui: To reach Xuanfang from Jinzhou, we'll need to cross through the Dreaming Cavern, north of the Gorges of Spirits. Since you've never been, I'll lead the way.

title: The Wind Before the Storm
content:
[Objective: Continue forward]
Rover: So... you and Jinhsi. What was that about?
Suisui: Oh, just a little exchange of intelligence. It took some persuading, but she did eventually agree to grant me access.
Suisui: Other than that, we talked about you.
Rover: Me?
Suisui: Well, we may share the same goal, but I still need to know whether the person I'm traveling with is someone I can trust.
Suisui: And besides, Yangyang mentions your name so often in her letters. I couldn't help but be curious. Who is this person my dear sister is so utterly hung up on?
Rover: And? Did you get the answer you were looking for?
Suisui: ...That, my dear, remains to be seen.

title: The Wind Before the Storm
content:
[Objective: Examine "Dried Blood Marks"]
Dried Blood Marks: A trail of dried blood marks where a body was dragged... It seems to lead all the way to the entrance of the Dreaming Carvern.

title: The Wind Before the Storm
content:
[Objective: Examine "Trace Frequency"]
Trace Frequency: Familiar trace frequencies linger in the air...

title: The Wind Before the Storm
content:
[Objective: Investigate the traces of Combat]
Rover: These traces... Yangyang and Chixia must've left them when they fought.
Suisui: Yes, but no signs of TDs now...
Rover: The mountain gate is just ahead.

title: The Wind Before the Storm
content:
[Objective: Cross the Gate of Xuanfang]
Rover: Let's press on.
Rover: So that's Xuanfang Hold...
Suisui: It does look rather magnificent from here.

title: The Wind Before the Storm
content:
[Objective: (;(Cutscene plays) plays)]
Suisui: Only it's hard to tell if anything's wrong from this distance.
Rover: Which means we need to be even more careful.

title: The Wind Before the Storm
content:
[Objective: Continue forward]
Suisui: So far, so good.
Rover: Yeah... we haven't run into any of those  Autopuppets  Xiangli Yao mentioned yet.
Suisui: In any case, let's make for Shaftpost Yard first. It's not far. That's where Xuanfang's Ministry of Foreign Affairs is located. There ought to be some clues there.
Rover: You seem to know your way around here.
Suisui: Not really. I've made a few visits on business, but never ventured far.
Suisui: Xuanfang Hold keeps the tightest security. Every visitor must pass through layers of screening. Not even a fly could get through without proper I.D.
Suisui: What if this incident wasn't an act of nature, but a human one...?
Rover: ...Then we watch our step.

title: The Wind Before the Storm
content:
Suisui: What if this incident wasn't an act of nature, but a human one...?
Rover: ...Then we watch our step.



Current Day: Morning - Rover and Suisui Point of View
Suisui: There's no one here, either.
[Dialogue Option]  So much for that plan.
[Dialogue Option]  Looks like it's up to us to find the leads.
Suisui: Just as I thought. Our Terminal comms went down the moment we entered Xuanfang.
Suisui: Here, take this, Rover.
[Dialogue Option]  What's this?
Suisui: A pair of locators. Simple little things, really. They'll show us each other's position and vital signs. The downside is that they have no communication functions.
Suisui: The situation here is unpredictable. We're together now, but there's no guarantee it'll stay that way. Think of it as a safeguard.
Suisui: To help us make the right call when it matters most.
[Dialogue Option]  You thought of everything.
Suisui: Just an old habit from my trading days. I always prepare for the worst.
[Dialogue Option]  You sound so sure we're getting separated...
Suisui: Besides, our priority is finding Yangyang. We wouldn't want to be distracted by anything else, would we?
Suisui: Still, think of it as a gift from me. Don't lose it, alright?
Rover: (For a gift, it sure feels like a heavy one...)
Suisui: There should still be clues around Shaftpost Yard. Let's investigate.

title: The Wind Before the Storm
subsection: Search for clues near the Shaftpost Yard
content:
[Objective: Search for clues near the Shaftpost Yard]
Rover: So this is a Xuanfang Autopuppet...
Rover: Structurally, it's nothing like the Twin Nova units at Startorch. But the technical complexity is every bit their equal. Maybe more.
Rover: And this blade mark...

content:
[Objective: Notice on the Wall]

Suisui: Is this...?
Suisui: This handwriting... Could it be...
Rover: Find anything?
Suisui: Take a look at this, Rover—
Suisui: Where did this fog come from?
Rover: This is no ordinary fog.

title: The Wind Before the Storm
subsection: Defeat the Autopuppets emerging from the fog
content:
[Objective: Defeat the Autopuppets emerging from the fog]

Suisui: Autopuppets! Is this an ambush...?!
Rover: (These must be the "rogue Autopuppets" Chixia's report mentioned...)
Rover: Stay sharp. Let's take them out together.

subsection: Defeat the enemies in the fog
content:
[Objective: Defeat the enemies in the fog]
Rover: The fog is getting thicker...
Rover: Tch—it's numbing my senses...
Rover: Suisui, we need to stay close—
Rover: Suisui? Damn it...

[Objective: Find a way out of the fog]

title: The Wind Before the Storm
content:
[Objective: Follow the Rafter Kite]
Rover: Is that... the mechanical bird from earlier?
Rover: Looks like it's trying to show me the way.
Rover: Let's see where it takes me.
??: Tch. The Disorienting Fog is here, too.
??: Every road back to Jinzhou is blocked. With only a city garrison, we won't last long...
??: What do we do...? Why now, of all times, would the Sentinel—

title: The Wind Before the Storm
content:
[Objective: Talk to the stranger]
??: —Who's there?!
Rover: Easy. I don't mean you any harm.
??: You... you don't look like you're from Xuanfang. Who are you? Why are you here?
Rover: I came to find someone from Jinzhou.
??: Jinzhou? So you came through the south mountain gate? Does this mean... Jinzhou knows what's happening here? Are you the reinforcements they sent?!
[Dialogue Option]  My name is Rover. You can think of me as the reinforcements.
??: That name... I've heard it somewhere. Golden eyes, black hair, and a Tacet Mark on the back of your hand.
??: Could it be—you're the one from the Battle of Norfall Barrens? The one who fought alongside General Jiyan and drove back the Threnodian Ovathrax... Rover?
Rover: I'm here on behalf of Jinzhou's Magistrate. Can you tell me what's happening in Xuanfang?
Liangyu: Yes. My name is Liangyu, and I serve under Mengzhou's Ministry of War, as part of the . But now, I'm the only one left...
Liangyu: Three days ago, one of Xuanfang's  detected Tacet Discord activity of unusual scale. An elite squad of  was sent to purge any remaining TDs.
Liangyu: Standard procedure for the Ministry of War. But that day...
Liangyu: The moment we stepped foot in the Censure Court, the Autopuppets stationed there suddenly attacked us—
Liangyu: No one saw it coming. The people of Xuanfang Hold... especially the Wardens, we all trust the Autopuppets completely. They're our main tool against Tacet Discords, and one of the Sentinel's creations no less.
Liangyu: By the time we realized what was happening, so many had already... My two fellow Triad squadmates didn't even have time to draw their weapons.
Liangyu: Only a handful of us made it out alive. And now...
Rover: All the Autopuppets are going rogue?
Liangyu: Yes. Censure Courts are meant to trap Tacet Discords, but they're useless now. Now they pour into our lands, and the Ministry of War cannot keep up.
Liangyu: And that's not all. The Warden Commander has sent countless requests to Mengzhou for reinforcements, but neither City Hall nor the Sentinel has answered.
Liangyu: And with every road out of Xuanfang blocked by Disorienting Fog, the Wardens have no choice but to retreat to the Hold. But that is no solution, not even a poor one.
Rover: (No one can leave the Hold... Which means Yangyang might still be inside.)
Rover: Have you run into anyone else from Jinzhou? Besides me?
Liangyu: You don't mean...
Liangyu: There was a girl. Yangyang. Said she was an Outrider for Jinzhou's Midnight Rangers. Two days ago, during the civilian evacuation, she traveled with us.
Rover: That's her. Do you know where she is now?
Liangyu: No. She volunteered to draw a large group of Autopuppets away so we could get the civilians into the Hold. We lost her after that.
Liangyu: I sent a few scouts to search the Eastern Xuan Peaks area, but we failed to locate her trail.
Rover: I see. Another dead lead...
Liangyu: ...Do you have anything on you that's connected to her?
Rover: (Now that she mentions it, Suisui did give me... one of her letters?)
Liangyu: This is...
Liangyu: I'm sure you have a Terminal on you. One moment, I'll share the access.
Liangyu: Xuanfang Hold has deployed "Skywatch Rings" everywhere to monitor Tacet Discord activity. They can track frequency fluctuations left behind in different areas. As of this moment... we're lucky they're still working.
Liangyu: This letter carries her frequency. With that, we should be able to track some of her previous movements. I'll take you to the Four Chime Shaftpost. It has equipment that's connected to the Skywatch Rings.

title: The Wind Before the Storm
subsection: Head to the Four Chime Shaftpost and gain access using your authority
content:
[Objective: Head to the Four Chime Shaftpost and gain access using your authority]
Rover: (Locator readings are normal. Suisui's safe for now...)
Rover: (Like she said, the priority right now is finding Yangyang.)
Rover: You said you traveled with Yangyang?
Liangyu: That's right. She... I hope she's safe.

Liangyu: Oh. While I'm at it, I'll unlock access to a Cloud Ride for you as well.
[Dialogue Option]  Cloud Ride...?
Liangyu: It's a type of transport vehicle developed by Mengzhou's Huaxu Academy. Very useful for quickly navigating rough terrain.
[Dialogue Option]  Is it similar to Lahai-Roi's expedition motorbike?
Liangyu: Expedition motorbike...? Are there similar technologies in other places?
Liangyu: Hmm... since you already have a means of transportation, I'll just share the functions with you.

title: The Wind Before the Storm
content:
[Objective: View Yangyang's frequency projection]
A projection of Yangyang...
Looks like she's fighting something...

title: The Wind Before the Storm
content:
[Objective: Defeat the Autopuppets]
Yangyang: Father, Mother, Sister... Rover...
Yangyang: I don't expect any of you to read these words. If anything, I'd rather say them to your faces.
Yangyang: What I've been through here, and what I still have yet to face...

title: The Wind Before the Storm
content:
[Objective: Escape the Autopuppets' encirclement]

Yangyang: Should be... far enough now...
Yangyang: This way... Chixia will be safe...
Yangyang: Ngh...
??: Liangyu, these Autopuppets... They seem...
??: Watch out! Khh—aghhh—!
??: What is this?! Why are the Autopuppets—Ngh—
??: Duzhong?! Qingzhi?!
??: ...Go. I will hold the rear.
??: Paragon Qingxiao—you—
??: ...I will go back for the others. Do not worry.
??: But—!
??: ...Anyone still standing, with me! Push through!
??: We have to get word back... to Xuanfang Hold...
Yangyang: These... voices... what are...?
???: A Rafter Kite? Why'd it fly here? Ah! That's—
???: Watcher Liangyu! Someone's fighting the Autopuppets over there!
??: At a time like this... How is that—
??: Everyone, get in formation! Keep them away from the village!
??: Hey! Are you alright?!
Yangyang: I...

Two Days Ago: Noon - Yangyang Point of View

title: The Wind Before the Storm
content:
[Objective: Enter the old house]
??: But... in all these years, nothing like this has ever happened. Many still refuse to leave their homes.
??: They're emergency orders from the Commander. Everyone outside the Hold falls back inside.
??: Xuanfang has always stood under the Sentinel's protection. How could this possibly...
??: I told you. We cannot reach the Sentinel right now.
Yangyang: Where am I...
Yangyang: This place... is...
Yangyang: And you are...?

title: The Wind Before the Storm
content:
[Objective: Inquire about the current situation]
Yangyang: Excuse me...
??: Oh, you're awake. You almost Overclocked and have been unconscious for hours. How do you feel? Anything hurt?
Yangyang: I'm fine... I just don't understand what's happening...
Liangyu: ...Name's Liangyu. I'm a  under the Ministry of War, stationed at Xuanfang Hold. This is Xianling Village, at the foot of the Eastern Xuan Peaks. Most folks here are locals.
Yangyang: Liangyu... Xuan Watcher... Xianling Village...
Liangyu: Now answer my questions. Who are you? Why are you here? And why were you fighting the Autopuppets?
Yangyang: ...I am Yangyang. Outrider under Jinzhou's Midnight Rangers. I came to Xuanfang to help the Patrollers investigate the recent disappearances in Jinzhou.
Yangyang: My partner and I followed the trail through the Dreaming Cavern, but we ran into a large swarm of Tacet Discords outside the mountain gate... But then it suddenly opened. To buy my partner time to escape, I went in alone to draw them off.
Yangyang: What came after that... you already know.
Liangyu: Jinzhou... Folks going missing... Tacet Discords running wild... The gate opening by itself...
Liangyu: Jinzhou hasn't been informed... Mengzhou won't answer... What is all this...? Tch—!
Yangyang: I thought the Autopuppets of Xuanfang Hold were meant to aid soldiers against Tacet Discords. Why did they turn on the people?
Liangyu: I don't know... Nobody does...
Liangyu gives Yangyang a brief account of events.
Yangyang: The Autopuppets... rebelled?
Liangyu: ...No one is willing to believe it. The Autopuppets are creations of Mengzhou's Sentinel. Under no rightful circumstance should they ever spill the blood of innocents.
Liangyu: And even if someone was pulling their strings, using them to throw Xuanfang into chaos... it's unthinkable! It would mean someone has the means to breach, maybe even unravel, the Sentinel's own intelligence.
Yangyang: If this was all orchestrated from the shadows... then the only force I know that might be capable of such a thing is...
Yangyang: ...Could this be the work of the Fractsidus?
Liangyu: The Fractsidus... that infamous terrorist organization? I can't say. At the very least, we have seen no one in red robes within these lands for a very long time.
Liangyu: If only Zhuojun Atelier could send one or two Helmsmasters right now... No. Wishful thinking.
Yangyang: Zhuojun Atelier? Who are they?
Liangyu: A Mengzhou organization devoted to mechanist art. Nearly half the craftsmen in Mengzhou have ties to Zhuojun Atelier. When it comes to mechanisms, they're second only to Sentinel Hsin and the Ministry of Development.
Liangyu: But unlike the Minstry of Development or Huaxu Academy, they don't answer to City Hall. Their leadership rarely shows itself. And now that Xuanfang has lost contact with Mengzhou...
Liangyu: ...Whatever the truth may be, the safety of the people comes first.
Liangyu: As for the missing travelers from Jinzhou... I'm sorry. The Ministry of War never received word of them, and in our current situation, I fear we cannot spare the manpower to assist your investigation.
Yangyang: Please don't apologize. I have no proof, but I can't shake the feeling that all of this... is connected somehow.
Yangyang: Besides, as comrades-in-arms, we should stand by one another. If there's any way I can help, you need only say the word.
Liangyu: ...Thank you. We are short of hands.
Liangyu: Many of our soldiers were wounded in the clash with the Autopuppets. They need time to recover.
Liangyu: Once our scouts have mapped a safe route back to the Hold, we'll escort everyone out of here.
Yangyang: Until then, I'll go check on the villagers.
Liangyu: ...Mmm. Much appreciated.

title: The Wind Before the Storm
content:
[Objective: (Optional) Listen to Residents' conversation]
Liangyu: The men are still resting. We're counting who's left in the village...
Liangyu: Once preparations are complete, we move out, Gra—Chief.
Qiankun: Ah... how did it come to this...?
Qiankun: Has the Sentinel... has our Lady Hsin truly forsaken us...?

title: The Wind Before the Storm
content:
[Objective: Listen to the residents' conversations]
Xuan Watcher: Gather the villagers in the square. And check everyone household. We don't want to miss anyone...
Another Xuan Watcher: Understood. Moving out now.

Xuan Watcher: I can't believe it... Watcher Duzhong, Watcher Qingzhi... They actually...
Another Xuan Watcher: ...Don't think about that right now. Focus on the mission.

Digeng: Hah... Haha... HAHAHA—I knew it... I KNEW IT!
Xinyuan: Not this delusional nonsense again, Digeng...

Qinyan: Ming...! You're hurt?!
Jingming: Ugh, I'm fine... Just a scratch. Nothing serious, Yan...

Tian: The Autopuppets are malfunctioning? How... how is that possible? Could it be false intel?
Baiyou: Liangyu said it herself. It has to be true...

Zaochun: What about those from the Ministry of Foreign Affairs?
Qilu: With the lockdown lately, there was only a small crew left...

title: The Wind Before the Storm
content:
Zaochun: What about those from the Ministry of Foreign Affairs?
Qilu: With the lockdown lately, there was only a small crew left...



Wenxi: Excuse me, any word about my husband? He left the village yesterday morning...
Anran: I'm sorry...

Villager: A-are you alright?
Another Villager: Ah... aaah—No... everyone...
Another Villager: Everyone is... The Autopuppets... they—
Villager: Just... just try to calm down. I'll get you some water, okay?

Villager: Wait... I think I left something at home. I'll go back to get it—
Another Villager: This isn't a picnic! Get to the rally point. NOW!

title: The Wind Before the Storm
content:
[Objective: Check on the villagers]
Yangyang: The Autopuppets could strike again at any moment...
Yangyang: We need to get everyone to a safe rally point...
Yangyang: And I should talk to the Wardens to learn more about Xuanfang.
[Dialogue Option]  Knock
Huamei: You mean... Zhong... he's...
Xuanfang Warden Fighting Back the Grief: I'm sorry, Auntie. We couldn't bring him home. Please... stay strong.
Yangyang: ...
[Dialogue Option]  Knock
Qiuyan: ...Who is it?
Yangyang: ...Please hurry. The Wardens want everyone gathered in the village square.
Qiuyan: All right... I understand.
Qiuyan: Xiaoyi, pack your things. We're going to Xuanfang Hold.
Xiaoyi: We're going inside the big walls? Then can I go see Uncle Qiu?
Qiuyan: We will not trouble Uncle Qiu. He's very busy.
speakers: Xuanfang Warden Fighting Back the Grief
Xuanfang Warden Fighting Back the Grief

title: The Wind Before the Storm
content:
[Objective: (Optional) Talk to the villagers]
Gaoyun: Well now, young maiden... is this  yours? So lively, and such fine craftsmanship too. A master's hand, no doubt.
Yangyang: (Rafter Kite... is that your name?)
Yangyang: No, sir. It's just that... for reasons I don't understand, it seems intent on guiding me to various places.
Gaoyun: Oh? Curious, very curious... I see feathers in your hair and a Tacet Mark upon your brow. You are a Resonator, yes? Ha... perhaps this Rafter Kite has grown a mind of its own and taken you for a  of old.
Yangyang: A Xuanling Bird... Forgive me, sir. I'm not from here. Might you tell me what that is?
Gaoyun: Ahh... never mind you outsiders. Unfortunately, plenty of young folk from these parts no longer care for the legend of the Xuanling either.
Gaoyun: Long before these lands were claimed under Mengzhou, a flock of spirit birds dwelt here. Azure of body, black of plume. People called them "Xuanling" (Numinous Plume).
Gaoyun: They did not think as we do, but they could see into the heart and bear its voice to another. In those days, the land was cruel and the roads few. People entrusted the Xuanling with their joys, sorrows, and longings, trusting the bird to carry them across the wilds.
Gaoyun: Such a pity... That war two hundred years ago laid waste to Xuanfang's land and people, driving the Xuanling to extinction as well.
Yangyang: (Two hundred years ago... he must mean the  that led to Jinzhou's founding.)
Gaoyun: Later, after Xuanfang Hold was built, Mengzhou's mechanist arts found their way here. In memory of those birds, local craftsmen fashioned the Rafter Kite in their image, to carry letters and messages in their stead.
Gaoyun: You've been favored by this one. Treat it kindly... For when people cease to speak of the Xuanling, the hands that know how to craft a Rafter Kite will grow fewer and fewer.
Yangyang: (Come to think of it, it was this little thing that led Liangyu and the Wardens to my aid before.)

title: The Wind Before the Storm
content:
[Objective: (Optional) Talk to the villagers]
Qiaochai: Hey, you! You're from Jinzhou, aren't you? Do you know Uncle Dong?
Yangyang: (Uncle Dong... he's on the missing persons list!)
Yangyang: I do. Have you seen him?
Qiaochai: I have! He was headed to Mengzhou and passed through our village. He told the most amazing opera stories!
Qiaochai: Pity he only stayed one night. Come morning, he hurried off at first light. No telling when he will return…
Qiaochai: Oh... With Xuanfang in such a state, he likely won't be back anytime soon. I still wanted to hear the rest of his tale.
Yangyang: (She still doesn't know what became of him...)
Yangyang: (But this confirms it. The people from Jinzhou all vanished somewhere in the Land of Xuanfang.)

title: The Wind Before the Storm
content:
[Objective: Check on the villagers]
[Dialogue Option]  Knock
Yangyang: (Looks like this house is already empty...)

title: The Wind Before the Storm
subsection: Obtain details of the situation from Qingdai
content:
[Objective: Obtain details of the situation from Qingdai]
Resident: Uncle Gao! H-have you seen Qingyan...?
Qingdai: He... he's been missing ever since Liangyu came back...
Qingdai: I've asked the other children, but none of them know where he went...
Gaoyun: Yan... I haven't seen him. Was it because... Ah...
Yangyang: Excuse me. Has a child from the village gone missing?
Qingdai: Yes! He's about eight or nine. Not very tall, thin as a twig. Scruffy mop of hair.
Yangyang: I'll help look for him. I'm quite good at finding people.
Qingdai: Thank you, thank you...

title: The Wind Before the Storm
subsection: Talk to the Xuanfang Warden in the village
content:
[Objective: Talk to the Xuanfang Warden in the village]
Yangyang: I've checked out most of the village by now...
Yangyang: Time to speak with a Warden and see how things stand.
Yanlang: So you're the one who held off more than a dozen Autopuppets on your own... that is no small feat.
Yanlang: Liangyu said you're an Outrider from Jinzhou? I should have guessed. The front lines against Tacet Discords do not breed ordinary soldiers. Only the finest make it there.
Yangyang: I... I wouldn't go that far. But those Tacet Discords I fought here... they were nothing like the ones I've fought before. They were fast, vicious, like veterans tempered by countless battles.
Yanlang: For two centuries, Xuanfang's Censure Courts have purged TDs within its borders. Anything that survived the Autopuppets and generations of Wardens would have to be brutal and cunning.
Yanlang: Though to be fair, the Autopuppets do the heavy lifting. We Wardens mostly support them in combat.
Yanlang: Back then, only a few people could face powerful Tacet Discords alone: the Warden Commander, the Xuan Triad Watchers... and that elusive Xuan Paragon.
Yanlang: But now the Autopuppets have turned on us, the Paragon is trapped in a Censure Court, and of the Triad, only Liangyu remains... Even if we retreat to the Hold, we still will not be able to stop what's coming.
Yangyang: Well...
Yanlang: It's okay, I don't need comforting. After decades in uniform, you learn to make peace with whatever may come. It is only...
Yanlang: If you are willing, comrade, do us one favor. Look after Liangyu.
Yanlang: She has talent, but she is still young. Most days, the other two Watchers kept her under their wing, like an older brother and sister. She saw them the same way.
Yanlang: The battlefield has no place for tears. But any eye can see their deaths have left their mark.
Yanlang: A leader cannot afford to show weakness before the ranks. Liangyu is too proud for that. She will only bury it inside.
Yanlang: You look to be about her age, and you are not of the Xuanfang Wardens. So... she might open up to you.
Yangyang: I see... Understood. I'll do what I can to help lighten her burden.
Yangyang: It's clear she means a great deal to all of you.
Yanlang: Of course she does. She lost her parents young and was raised by the whole village. For us, it's hard not to think of her as our little sister.
Yanlang: In any case, I leave it to you.
Yangyang: By the way, have you seen a child named Qingyan?
Yanlang: Qingyan... Ah, Qingzhi's little brother. Yes, I saw him.
Yanlang: He tried to sneak into the tents a little while ago, but the men on duty drove him out. After that... I think he headed toward the shrine.
Yangyang: I see... Thank you. That's all for now.

metadata.subsection: Talk to the Xuanfang Warden in the village

title: The Wind Before the Storm
content:
[Objective: Follow the Rafter Kite]
Yangyang: (It's... trying to lead me somewhere?)
Yangyang: (Let's see where it goes.)

content:

Qingyan: I was just going to the shrine. I remember there's a sword there.
Qingyan: If I take that sword... then maybe I can...

Yangyang: (His sister must've been in Liangyu's unit...)
Yangyang: (I'd better keep following him for now.)

title: The Wind Before the Storm
content:

title: The Wind Before the Storm
content:
Yangyang: Careful! That blade is sharp!
Qingyan: Leave me alone! I will slay those Autopuppets and Tacet Discords! I will avenge my sister!



???: Ling, why must you put yourself through this. Your little girl is only three. If you go to war...
???: Forgive me, Grandmother. But my mind is made. My husband never came home. A Xuanling brought word that he was slain by Tacet Discords in the Gorges of Spirits...
???: If I do not answer that blood with blood, then every vow we swore means nothing... Just think, he spent half his life painting Xuanfang's landscapes. How could I watch them be destroyed by Tacet Discords?
???: Take this liuqin (stringed instrument) to Mengzhou and pawn it. It should fetch enough to see you both through for a time.
???: Once this war is over, I... will return to Mengzhou for you.

title: The Wind Before the Storm
content:
???: Once this war is over, I... will return to Mengzhou for you.



???: Xuanling... So you birds already know what will happen, don't you?
???: If you do, then go. Take nothing with you. Let it all be buried here.
???: You are the solace people cling to. The bridge between hearts.
???: Do not become an ill omen in their eyes. Do not be messengers of death.
???: Fly! Leave this place!
???: Leave... before it turns into hell.
Qingdai: Yan! You foolish child! What are you doing here?!
Qingyan: B-Big Sister?! I...
Yangyang: What was that just now...?
Qiankun: Are you well, young maiden? You look a bit dazed.
Yangyang: You... you were the one speaking with Liangyu earlier.
Qiankun: Yes. I am Qiankun, the village chief. I have watched over Liangyu since she was just a child.
Yangyang: Chief, if I may ask, what is this sword enshrined here?
Qiankun: A nameless sword. And because it bears no name, it belongs to every soul who fought in that battle.
Qiankun: Two hundred years ago, the Fortress and Gorges War tore through Xuanfang. Not only did Mengzhou send its great armies, but most of Xuanfang's own sons and daughters also took up arms to defend their home.
Qiankun: I was not yet born in those days. I know only what the elders told me. They spoke of a battle so ghastly that the sky itself ran red. For every ten who went to war, scarcely one returned alive.
Qiankun: This sword was found among the ruins of that battle. Its owner is unknown. But this much is certain, the one who wielded it died protecting this land.
Qiankun: When the war ended, those who had taken refuge in Mengzhou slowly made their way home. This shrine was raised in memory of the heroes who fell.
Yangyang: (That woman I saw... was she going to join the Fortress and Gorges War?)
Yangyang: (Was that the sword's memory... Or...)

title: The Wind Before the Storm
content:
[Objective: (Optional) Talk to the siblings]
Qingdai: You must listen, Yan! Come back with me!
Qingyan: I... I'm not leaving! If I leave... who will avenge our sister?!
Yangyang: Tell me. Have you trained with a weapon? Do you know how to fight an enemy many times stronger than yourself? Do you think you can really avenge her?
Qingyan: I... I've watched the Xuanfang Wardens train.
Yangyang: Your sister was a Warden, and she was strong. But even she could not walk away from that battlefield alive.
Qingyan: Then what... what am I supposed to do?! She... she's never coming back.
Yangyang: What about your other sister? Don't you mean to protect her?
Qingyan: I...
Yangyang: Stay by her side. Go with the others to the rally point.
Qingyan: Young miss... are you a soldier too? Like my sister?
Yangyang: Yes. I became a soldier so I could protect those who can't protect themselves.
Yangyang: That is not a vow you fulfill in a single day, nor a single year.
Qingyan: Then... will you teach me? Swordwork, I mean. The kind that can beat those Tacet Discords!
Yangyang: I will. That is my promise. But you have to promise me in return: until that day, keep your sister safe.
Qingyan: ...Promise!

title: The Wind Before the Storm
content:
[Objective: Talk to the village chief]
Qiankun: Little Yan... I understand his heart. He and Qingzhi were always so close.
Qiankun: We thought those days belonged to the ashes of history. And yet... this land must suffer a new calamity. I wonder what our ancestors would make of this, were they watching.
Yangyang: ...Even so, we cannot simply sit and wait.
Yangyang: It all comes down to what we do. At least for now, there are still things within our power.
Yangyang: Chief, I believe this sword isn't just a monument to the fallen. It may also give people the courage to... walk forward even in the face of death.
Qiankun: Well spoken. Now you make me sound like a bitter old fool.
Qiankun: Would you do an old man a favor? Take this sword and pass it to Liangyu. Let the Wardens carry it back to the Hold.
Qiankun: Tacet Discords scour the land bare. A sword is but iron and steel, but it is still part of Xuanfang's legacy. I would see it kept safe.
Yangyang: Of course, Chief. Let me speak with Liangyu.
Qiankun: You had the right of it, Yangyang. The Autopuppets were a gift from the Sentinel, and for two hundred quiet years, we have leaned upon that gift.
Qiankun: And yet... it comes down to what we do. What we do.

title: The Wind Before the Storm
content:
[Objective: Take the sword]
Yangyang: (The Chief was right... I should go talk to Liangyu.)
Yangyang: (Now where did she go...?)
???: Fly on, Xuanling, fly over rivers... Rivers flow, mountains loom...

title: The Wind Before the Storm
content:
[Objective: Follow the singing]
Liangyu: ...
Liangyu: Who—oh, it's you...
Liangyu: Do you need something? The scouts have not yet returned, but we cannot wait much longer.
Liangyu: Once everyone is gathered, we move.
Yangyang: I met the village chief just now. He wishes for this sword to be kept with the Xuanfang Wardens.
Liangyu: A sword? At a time like this? Retreat will be dangerous enough. I'd ask everyone only to protect themselves and those beside them, not cold steel.
Yangyang: Then I will carry it myself, for now.
Liangyu: You... Fine. Do as you see fit.
Yangyang: I also never properly thanked you for saving me. And for giving me a room to rest.
Liangyu: It is nothing. I have not stayed in this village for years. The house was sitting empty.
Yangyang: So it was your home...
Liangyu: Just an old house... Soon enough, this village may be flattened by Tacet Discords. Nothing left but rubble.
Liangyu: Houses can always be rebuilt. But the dead do not come back...
Yangyang: Then let's focus on those who are still alive.
Liangyu: ...
Liangyu: ...Is there something else?
Yangyang: Let's talk.
Liangyu: I... There is nothing to say.
Yangyang: Any other time, I wouldn't press you.
Yangyang: But Liangyu, we're soldiers. We have our duties. This is no time to indulge ourselves.
Yangyang: My Forte allows me to catch the messages the wind carries from far away.
Yangyang: It's useful. Convenient. It lets me notice, in places no one looks, that someone is waiting for a hand to reach out to them.
Yangyang: But sometimes... I hate it.
Yangyang: The echoes of tragedy. The aftershocks of disaster... Everything is already over and done with. There's nothing left I can change... and yet it forces me to listen.
Yangyang: Even now, those sounds make my heart clench.
Liangyu: You...
Yangyang: It's all right. I know. Because I've already... heard it.
Liangyu: ...I am afraid to look them in the eyes.
Liangyu: I know what they are all waiting for. Because I am waiting too. Waiting for someone to step forward.
Liangyu: Duzhong and Qingzhi were that kind of person. Xuan Watchers or not, they would have made great commanders. And yet they died. And I was the one who lived.
Liangyu: If only I had seen it, just few seconds sooner. If my life could buy back theirs... I would...
Yangyang: Better? It helps a little, saying it out loud, doesn't it?
Yangyang: I think... you don't need anyone to tell you what to do. You already know.
Yangyang: You're only afraid you won't do it well enough. Because some mistakes cannot be undone.
Yangyang: But even so, sometimes we just have to go through with it, don't we?
Liangyu: Was that how you all felt, too? During the Battle of Norfall Barrens?
Yangyang: I can't speak for anyone else. But by the end, my mind was blank. I fought on instinct. On the will to stay alive.
Yangyang: We only won that battle because so many stood with us. And back then, there really was someone who stood in front of me, in front of all of us.
Yangyang: But I also know, he won't always be there.
Yangyang: If I only ever chase someone else's shadow, I'll never truly move forward.
Yangyang: I hope next time he and I meet, I'll be able to stand beside him. Not behind.
Yangyang: The situation in Xuanfang Hold is still uncertain. But as I said before, the Streams brought me here. So the only thing I can do is...
Liangyu: ...You are right. Whatever comes, I have a duty to fulfill.
Yangyang: By the way, that song earlier...
Liangyu: Song? Oh, did I hum it aloud?
Liangyu: It's a little tune. My mother taught it to me when I was little.
Liangyu: I never learned all of it. They say the written score was lost two hundred years ago. Now all people remember is a half-forgotten tune.
Yangyang: I see.
Liangyu: You... knew this tune before? Or did you memorize it just from listening once?
Yangyang: I just thought that it might help everyone breathe a little easier.
Liangyu: Maybe it did. You certainly sing it better than I do.

title: The Wind Before the Storm
content:
Yangyang: I just thought that it might help everyone breathe a little easier.
Liangyu: Maybe it did. You certainly sing it better than I do.



Mingyu: Watcher Liangyu, a Skywatch Ring has detected Autopuppets moving this way. They will reach Xianling Village in about two hours.
Liangyu: Then we have no time to waste. If the scouts still haven't reported back, we'll have to move and scout as we go.
Yangyang: I'll go. Scouting is part of an Outrider's duties, and my Forte can help me avoid danger.
Liangyu: Okay. Here are the coordinates for the garrison camp outside the city. There will be people waiting there to receive you. Once you arrive, have the guards send the route by a . We'll move out as soon as we have it.
Liangyu: I will have the officer in charge unlock the Cloud Ride for you. Should save you quite a bit of time.

title: The Wind Before the Storm
subsection: Talk to Mingyu and gain access to a Cloud Ride
content:
[Objective: Talk to Mingyu and gain access to a Cloud Ride]
Mingyu: I was expecting you. Hand me your Terminal. I'll grant you access to the Cloud Ride.
Mingyu: It's a joint project of Mengzhou's Huaxu Academy and the Ministry of Development. Leaves any glider in the dust.
Mingyu: If you're heading to the camp, there's a side path nearby.
Mingyu: The Eastern Xuan Peaks are treacherous, and the Disorienting Fog hangs thick through much of it. Be careful.

Two Days Ago: Afternoon - Yangyang Point of View

subsection: Observe the situation in Fogveil Pagoda
content:
[Objective: Observe the situation in Fogveil Pagoda]
Yangyang: First... I need to get a sense of the terrain.
Yangyang: Better find a vantage point.
Yangyang: That path over there... should avoid most of the Autopuppets.
Yangyang: Worth taking a look.
Yangyang: (Over there... rogue Autopuppets.)
Yangyang: (They are really closing in... I have to move faster.)
Yangyang: (This... this must be the Disorienting Fog that Warden mentioned.)
Yangyang: (Visibility's too low... I'll have to find a way around.)
Yangyang: (That's...)
Yangyang: (That must be the garrison camp Liangyu mentioned.)
Yangyang: (Looks like there are still soliders there. I need to make haste.)

content:
[Objective: (Optional) Use the Cloud Ride]
Yangyang: (The Cloud Ride... It's easier to handle than I expected.)
Yangyang: (Chixia would love this. I wonder if she made it out safely...)
Yangyang: (...I'd best hurry.)

title: The Wind Before the Storm
content:
[Objective: Quickly take out the Autopuppets]
Yangyang: Autopuppets... not many of them.
Yangyang: I might be able to end this quickly!

title: The Wind Before the Storm
content:
[Objective: Check on the scout]
Yangyang: Those are... Xuanfang Wardens.
Yangyang: Liangyu's scouts... This must be them.
Yangyang: No sign of life.

title: The Wind Before the Storm
content:
[Objective: Continue forward]
Yangyang: Too many... Engaging them would cause too much noise.
Yangyang: Need to find another way.

title: The Wind Before the Storm
content:
[Objective: Further investigate]
Linnian: Halt! Who goes there?! Identify yourself!
Yangyang gives the guards a quick briefing.
Linnian: So Watcher Liangyu sent you to map a route. Good! We've been waiting a long time.
Yangyang: Also, I found scouts along the way. They're already...
Linnian: I see... Thank you for telling me. They were long overdue, so I... I feared as much.
Linnian: No time to lose. We must send word to Liangyu immediately.
Linnian: Good work. The camp is just ahead. I'll find you a place to rest.

Two Days Ago: Dusk - Yangyang Point of View

title: The Wind Before the Storm
subsection: Rest up in the garrison camp
content:
[Objective: Rest up in the garrison camp]
Yangyang: (I hope everyone makes it through safely...)
Yuanzhi: Excuse me, miss... do you have a Rafter Kite with you?
Yuanzhi: If it's not too much to ask, could you let it carry a letter for me? A letter home, to Mengzhou.
Yangyang: You mean to...
Yuanzhi: Ah... I've been away from home for many years now. Now Xuanfang has fallen into chaos. I may never see my wife and children again. This letter is my last wish.
Yuanzhi: I asked every soldier in the Hold, but they all say that under these cirsumstances every Rafter Kite must be reserved for military reports. Please...
Yangyang: It's alright. Give me the letter.
Yuanzhi: Thank you... Thank you, oh, thank you!
Yangyang: (I hope the first thing his family sees is not this letter, but the man himself returning home.)
Yangyang: (Father, Mother, Rover...)
Yangyang: (Sister said she'd come visit Jinzhou soon. If she can't find me, will she worry?)
Yangyang: (Maybe I should... write down what I've seen here.)
Yangyang: (If nothing else, I can put the clues in order. Perhaps it will help whoever reads it.)

metadata.subsection: Rest up in the garrison camp

title: The Wind Before the Storm
subsection: Write down your encounters up until today
content:
[Objective: Write down your encounters up until today]
[Dialogue Option]  (Write about Xianling Village and the Rafter Kite.)
Yangyang: Since entering the Land of Xuanfang, I have been set upon by both Autopuppets and Tacet Discords. For what cause I was targeted, I cannot say. But the Xuanfang Wardens pulled me from the brink, and that is how I came to Xianling Village.
Yangyang: Somewhere along the way, a mechanical bird began to follow me. The locals call it a "Rafter Kite." They say it was modeled after a spirit bird that once dwelt in Xuanfang. It is remarkably clever. Now and then, it seems to lead me to places. Almost like a real, living bird.
[Dialogue Option]  (Write about Liangyu.)
Yangyang: In Xianling Village, I met Liangyu. She is young, yet she already holds the title of Xuan Watcher. She told me of the chaos that has swept across Xuanfang. Her squadmates were slaughtered in a Censure Court.
Yangyang: Something in her reminds me of who I once was. If I can, I will lift some of the weight off her shoulders.
[Dialogue Option]  (Write about the rogue Autopuppets.)
Yangyang: The Autopuppets meant to purge Tacet Discords... have gone rogue. They now attack the people. I can't prove it yet, but something tells me this isn't just a malfunction. It's deliberate. Someone's behind it. But Xuanfang Hold's comms have been cut. The Wardens are barely holding the line against both Autopuppets and Tacet Discords. No one has the time or strength to find out what's really going on.
Yangyang: If only I could gather some clues through the Streams...

metadata.subsection: Write down your encounters up until today

title: The Wind Before the Storm
subsection: Write down your encounters up until today
content:
Yangyang: If only I could gather some clues through the Streams...



Two Days Ago: Night - Yangyang Point of View
Liangyu: Really? None of them managed to？
Liangyu: Yangyang. Thanks to you, we slipped past the Autopuppets and TDs. We were blessed to make it with no losses.
Yangyang: As long as everyone is safe.
Liangyu: The Hold is just ahead. Once we catch our breath, I'll have the guards clear passage and escort everyone inside.
Liangyu: As for your case, the Commander has been collecting intelligence by Rafter Kite. Once we reach him, we can decide our next steps together.
Yangyang: Understood. And with any luck, Mengzhou may already have reinforcements on the way.
Liangyu: Hah... I hope that is the case.
Liangyu: Next—
Liangyu: How—? We should've avoided all of them—
Liangyu: Fire the signal! Rally the Hold's support!
Liangyu: Tch—they're too fast... There's no time—Battle lines! Cover the civilians! Buy them time to fall back!
Yangyang: That won't hold! We're outnumbered three to one. The line will break!
Yanlang: Liangyu, one of us has to stay behind to hold them off...
Liangyu: Then let me stay—
Yangyang: Liangyu, you are our captain now. Don't lose sight of that.
Yangyang: I'll play decoy and draw them away. Trust me. I've done this before.
Mingyu: There are too many for one. If you ask me, we need three. At least three.
Liangyu: You—
Linnian: Watcher Liangyu! The Hold is answering our signal!
Liangyu: I—
Liangyu: ...Yanlang. Mingyu. Go to help Yangyang.
Liangyu: Everyone else—fall back! Stay in formation! Fall back as fast as you can!
Xuanfang Wardens: Yes!

title: The Wind Before the Storm
subsection: Hold off as long as you can
content:
[Objective: Hold off as long as you can]
Yangyang: I need to lead these Autopuppets another way...
Yanlang: No one can hold that many alone. Don't let them surround you!
Mingyu: We Wardens know these Autopuppets better than anyone. There's no way we let a Jinzhou Midnight Ranger bait them off by herself.
Yangyang: You...
Yangyang: ...Thank you. Both of you!

Mingyu: Ngh—!
Yanlang: Mingyu! Damn you—DIE!
Yanlang: It's finally over...
Yangyang: I'm sorry. If I'd only gotten here a little sooner...
Yanlang: Heh... Now you sound... just like... little Liangyu.
Yanlang: I'm all right... Just need... to rest... some rest and I'll be fine.
Yanlang: A pity... that boy Mingyu.
Yanlang: Quite a few girls... had taken a shining to him.
Yanlang: ...
Yangyang: ...

Yangyang: A Sonoro? But how did I...

Bruise-Covered Xuanfang Warden: Xuanling... tell me... Yuan Fortress... did it stand?

Injured Xuanfang Warden: Don't know. Not many left, I'd guess...
Injured Xuanfang Warden: We held off the first wave, but the next one...
Gravely Injured Xuanfang Warden: Hey... Xuanling. Do you think... we'll win this?
Injured Xuanfang Warden: Heh... Either way... I'm afraid neither of us... will live to find out...

content:
[Objective: Investigate the battlefield]
Dying Village Chief: Xuanling... are those Xuanling Birds...
Dying Village Chief: Thank heavens... You didn't all...
Dying Village Chief: Go... Go now... The village is already...
Dying Village Chief: Pro-promise me... Go and see... if there's still... anyone...
Dying Village Chief: Take them away... Away from here...

title: The Wind Before the Storm
content:
[Objective: Investigate the battlefield]

Voice of Reverberation: I don't want to die... I can't die!
Voice of Reverberation: My brothers and sisters... my parents... my wife and children... They're all waiting.
Voice of Reverberation: Tacet Discords...! Tacet Discords! Those cursed, wretched Tacet Discords!
Voice of Reverberation: KILLING YOU A HUNDRED TIMES, NO, A THOUSAND TIMES... WOULD NEVER BE ENOUGH!

title: The Wind Before the Storm
content:
[Objective: Navigate the battlefield]
Yangyang: (How many battles have been fought in this place...)
Yangyang: (And how many more are still to come?)
Yangyang: (These sounds... They just keep flooding in.)
Yangyang: (I...)

???: Skies boundless... land wide...
