(Cutscene end)
Young Artisan: Another wave of Tacet Discords will be here any moment...
Young Artisan: Good. Then we have arrived at the right time.
Young Artisan: Our orders are to reinforce the western second front. Fellow Artisans, ready the Bladepuppets.
Young Artisan: Zhuojun Atelier has poured years into this generation of Bladepuppets. There is no better test than real combat.
Young Artisan:  was built by the Ministry of Development and Zhuojun Atelier. It is the pinnacle of human intellect. Mindless Tacet Discords cannot be allowed to undo that.
Artisans: Yes, sir!
Yangyang: Zhuojun Atelier... Liangyu mentioned them... a Mengzhou organization devoted to the mechanist arts.
???: Excuse me...

A Day Ago: Afternoon - Yangyang Point of View

title: The Wind Before the Storm
content:
[Objective: Talk to the stranger]
Yangyang: I'm... back?
???: Xuanfang is not exactly peaceful these days, young lady. This ground is dangerous. It would be wiser not to linger here.
Yangyang: Sir, that advice applies just as well to yourself, wouldn't you agree?
???: Oh? My apologies. I misjudged you. You carry a military blade, so you are a soldier, I take it? It's only that your face is new, and you do not dress like one of the Wardens.
Yangyang: I'm with the Jinzhou Midnight Rangers. Why I've come to Xuanfang... it's a long story. Not for this place.
Yangyang: Since you've questioned me, perhaps you can offer your own name and identity in return. As you said, this place is not exactly peaceful. A civilian wandering alone through these mountains is unusual, to say the least.
Muyu: Of course. My name is Muyu. I am an Artisan under the Xuanfang Ministry of Development. If you do not trust me, I have my badge with me.
Muyu: Yesterday, on orders from the Ministry of War, I went to a nearby Censure Court for routine maintenance.
Muyu: But before I even made it inside, I watched the Autopuppets go rogue. They attacked the Wardens escorting me.
Muyu: I was fortunate. I lived. But I had to retreat deep into the cliffs. Only once I was certain the Autopuppets had moved on did I dare come back out.
Muyu: Then I found you here, looking rather shaken. Judging by the area around us, you must have endured quite a battle. Did you fight all these Autopuppets yourself? Remarkable...
Yangyang: (There's something about this man...)
Yangyang: Since you're a Ministry of Development Artisan, let me escort you back to the Hold.
Muyu: This is no time to return to the Hold. I must get to the Western Fang Peaks, now. I must not dally.
Yangyang: The Western Fang Peaks... Why? What's there?
Muyu: The Western Fang Peaks houses the , Xuanfang's largest Autopuppet production plant and Tacet Discord disposal facility. If that place falls, rogue Autopuppets and Tacet Discords will spill into every corner of Xuanfang. The consequences are unthinkable.
Muyu: In truth, when I reviewed the patrol routes of the Autopuppets days ago, I noticed a few had deviated from their assigned paths.
Muyu: Autopuppets are self-operating machines. At first, I assumed a few units had suffered minor faults in their circuits after fighting Tacet Discords. But now it seems the "rebellion" may have started from there.
Muyu: And the point where all those rogue units' paths converged... was the Skyworks.
Yangyang: So you suspect... the answer to why the Autopuppets went rogue might be there?
Muyu: Precisely.
Yangyang: We still don't know why the Autopuppets malfunctioned. If, as you say, Autopuppets and Tacet Discords have gathered at the Skyworks, then how do you stay safe if you go there alone?
Muyu: Heh. The Xuanfang Artisans spent generations crossing mountains and valleys. That is how the Hold was built. I have inherited a measure of that nerve.
Muyu: Besides, Xuanfang is now on a knife's edge. Everyone thinking only of their own survival is hardly a wise strategy.
Muyu: But still, young lady from the Midnight Rangers, your skills are extraordinary. Were you to come with me, perhaps my safety would be much less of a concern?
Yangyang: (The disappearances in Jinzhou also began around that same time. I can't ignore this lead.)
Yangyang: (And... whether he's telling the truth or not, I can't just leave this man on his own.)
Yangyang: ...All right. I'll go with you.
Muyu: Excellent. Then let's not waste another second.

title: The Wind Before the Storm
content:
Yangyang: ...All right. I'll go with you.
Muyu: Excellent. Then let's not waste another second.



A Day Ago: Afternoon - Yangyang Point of View

title: The Wind Before the Storm
subsection: Follow Muyu towards the Western Fang Peaks
content:
[Objective: Follow Muyu towards the Western Fang Peaks]
Yangyang: But the ruins of Yuan Fortress lie between the Eastern and Western Fang Peaks. How do you plan to get there?
Muyu: That is no problem. We Artisans know every mechanical structure in the Land of Xuanfang, and that includes Yuan Fortress.
Muyu: There's an old passage through the ruins that connects to the Western Fang Peaks. Rarely used now, but I know of it.
Muyu: This is the entrance. The Fortress has been abandoned. No Autopuppets to concern us. I will lead the way.
Yangyang: ...Yes. Thank you.

metadata.subsection: Follow Muyu towards the Western Fang Peaks

title: The Wind Before the Storm
content:
[Objective: Follow Muyu]
Yangyang: These... are traces of the Fortress and Gorges War...
Muyu: Correct. When that war erupted, Tacet Discords swept into Xuanfang. The main battlefield was this Fortress, built by Mengzhou in earlier days against these monsters.
Yangyang: Those symbols on the mechanisms...
Muyu: The construction was overseen by both the Ministry of Development and Zhuojun Atelier's Grand Helm. It would be strange if the Atelier's marks were not here.
Yangyang: The Yuan Fortress battlefield... Even after all these years, it still feels so...

title: The Wind Before the Storm
subsection: Clear Tacet Discords along the way
content:
[Objective: Clear Tacet Discords along the way]

title: The Wind Before the Storm
content:
[Objective: Continue forward]
Muyu: So She turned to powers beyond mortal understanding. With the authority of Her station, she raised Xuanfang Hold atop the ruins of Yuan Fortress.
Muyu: It was meant to be the apex of Automata Mechanics. Once complete, as the Sentinel envisioned, its very architecture would redirect and eliminate Tacet Discords.
Muyu: A mechanism so vast, so intricate, so perfectly ordered... that no mortal hand could ever hope to build it.
Muyu: Unfortunately, Ovathrax launched its surprise attack just days before completion.

title: The Wind Before the Storm
subsection: Head down from the cliff's edge, deep into Yuan Fortress
content:
[Objective: Head down from the cliff's edge, deep into Yuan Fortress]
Yangyang: They were... using themselves as bait. Luring Tacet Discords into the Censure Cages.
Muyu: Against a Tacet Discord Outbreak, the forces stationed in the Fortress and the Atelier's Bladepuppets were little more than... straw and mud.
Yangyang: ...And yet, because of them, so many others were spared.

title: The Wind Before the Storm
content:
[Objective: Check the detonation platform]
Yangyang: This damage... it isn't just from Tacet Discords. It looks more like... some kind of explosion.
Muyu: ...Then it seems you do not know how the Fortress and Gorges War truly ended.
Muyu: That is to be expected. Even now, to most of Mengzhou, it is little more than a memory of suffering.
Muyu: When they realized that no amount of human effort could ever drive back the Tacet Discords...
Muyu: When every hope was exhausted, every option spent... Mengzhou's last defenders detonated the entire Yuan Fortress.
After that, a Higher Will descended upon Xuanfang and brought that... gruesome war to an end.

title: The Wind Before the Storm
content:
[Objective: View the past scenes]
(Cutscene plays)
Young Artisan: No... no, this isn't right...
Young Artisan: What went wrong? Weapons? Mobility? Or is it...
Young Artisan: Argh—?!
Tenacious Xuanfang Warden: Damn you... Tacet Discord—!
Young Artisan: Is this...?
Young Artisan: How fascinating...
Young Artisan: The most uncontrollable part of a person... remade into the stepping stone toward perfection.
Young Artisan: ...Is that not putting it to its best use?

title: The Wind Before the Storm
content:
Current Day: Dawn - Yangyang Point of View
Muyu: What is it, young lady? The Skyworks lies just ahead. We may soon learn the reason for the Autopuppets' rebellion.
Yangyang: Your... right eye.
Muyu: Hmm? This eye? Pay it no mind. An old wound left by a Tacet Discord years ago, nothing more.
Yangyang: This encounter... was it during the Fortress and Gorges War?
Muyu: ...
Muyu: ...Interesting. You couldn't have known me before. And no one alive in Xuanfang knows the particulars of my past.
Yangyang: When people speak, they always try, without knowing, to hide what they leave unsaid.
Yangyang: Unfortunately, I'm very good at seeing it.
Muyu: Oh? You possess that ability?
Muyu: So then, I assume you saw something in that Sonoro, didn't you?
Yangyang: ...Two hundred years ago, you were with Zhuojun Atelier.
Muyu: Zhuojun Atelier... Even now, the name elicits a certain fondness.
Muyu: A so-called gathering of "geniuses," "eccentrics," and "madmen"... A sophisticated nursery.
Muyu: In the eyes of a Higher Will, what difference is there between the wisest human beings and the cleverest colony of ants?
Muyu: The "destination" lies plainly within sight, and yet the Sentinel... only watches from her lofty perch as the ants line up and march in circles. Meaningless circles.
Muyu: Fire has burned in this world so long, the world has forgotten how the fire began. The first flame was stolen from the gods by none other than human hands.
Yangyang: You... You're the one behind all of this.
Muyu: I'm not "behind" anything. Please do not demote me into one of those dull schemers. The sort you've likely heard of... the Fractsidus?
Muyu: I am simply finishing a "research project." To do that, one requires "experiments" for supporting evidence.
Yangyang: You can save that speech for the Ministry of War.
Muyu: I am a man who values efficiency. To waste even one second on anyone or anything unrelated to my purpose would already be excessive.
Muyu: I only revealed myself to you here because I determined it was necessary.
Yangyang: ...
Muyu: ...You lavish so much attention on others, and so remain stubbornly blind to your own nature.
Muyu: Pitiful. The way you live is no different from burning a  for kindling and boiling a crane for broth.
Muyu: I can sense it. The Reverberations formed from your frequency are the perfect medium. The one I have long sought.
Muyu: A hundred... No, a thousand ordinary Reverberations could not compare to you.
Yangyang: From the moment we met, you've done nothing but talk at yourself...
Yangyang: I don't understand what you're saying, and I don't care to.
Yangyang: But I do know this... the wind will not carry these words anywhere.
Yangyang: Your madness ends here!

title: The Wind Before the Storm
content:
The Streams - Since Yangyang Awakened her Forte at a young age, she became capable of sensing and interpreting a unique form of "streams," which carry various kinds of information, including voices and emotions.

Xuan Triad - A special unit formed by the Xuanfang Wardens, composed of three elite Wardens. Members of this unit are also known as Xuan Watchers. The Xuan Triad is tasked with handling incidents beyond the capabilities of standard Xuanfang Wardens.

Censure Court - In the wake of the Tacet Discord Outbreak in Norfall Barrens, hordes of Tacet Discords were diverted and imprisoned in Censure Courts of varying sizes across the Land of Xuanfang. They now serve as sites for the regular purging of Tacet Discords. Each Tacet Discord is held in its own Censure Cage, and these Cages also serve to transport newly forged Autopuppets from the Skyworks to where they are needed.

title: The Wind Before the Storm
content:
Xuanfang Wardens - The soldiers responsible for guarding Xuanfang Hold are known as Xuanfang Wardens.

Rafter Kite - After Xuanling Birds went extinct, the people of Xuanfang crafted mechanical birds in their image and named them Rafter Kites. In the past, Rafter Kites served as the primary means of communication across the Land of Xuanfang, carrying messages where their living predecessors once did. But with the widespread adoption of Terminals, their role as messengers has faded, becoming more ceremonial than essential.

title: The Wind Before the Storm
content:
Fortress and Gorges War - A large-scale war that broke out simultaneously in the Gorges of Spirits and Yuan Fortress, aimed at preventing the spread of the Tacet Discord Outbreak from the Norfall Barrens into Huanglong via the Land of Xuanfang. Following this war, Jinzhou was formally established. Yuan Fortress was ultimately destroyed during the war, and Xuanfang Hold was later constructed upon its ruins.

Skyworks - A factory in the Land of Xuanfang's Western Fang Peaks. It comprises the Thousandfold Foundry, which produces Autopuppets ceaselessly, and the Myriad Snare, which suppresses and exterminates powerful Tacet Discords. The Skyworks runs day and night in service to  Xuanfang Hold.

content:
[Objective: Discuss with Liangyu your next moves]
Liangyu: The frequency trace ends northwest of the Eastern Xuan Peaks. Either it's heading somewhere a Skywatch Ring cannot monitor, or...
Rover: Wait. There's something on the back of this letter.
Rover: These marks... Were they left by the Streams?
Rover: "Sky... works?"
Liangyu: Skyworks? Yangyang actually mentioned that place?
[Dialogue Option]  What is it?
Liangyu: A factory in the Western Fang Peaks. It is where Xuanfang Hold produces its Autopuppets and "disposes" of Tacet Discords.
Liangyu: The Ministry of War just flagged it. They say the Skyworks has become a hive for rogue Autopuppets. Even the Xuanfang Wardens and the Ministry of Development can't get close anymore.
Liangyu: You think... Yangyang went there?
Rover: She went out of her way to leave us this message. I can't ignore it.
Rover: What about you? What's your move?
Liangyu: The Hold is under siege from all sides. My Commander's order was to reach Jinzhou through Shaftpost Yard's mountain gate. To call for reinforcements.
Liangyu: But the gate is sealed. There is no other way out... If I do nothing, I'll just be waiting for death.
Liangyu: I'm coming with you. If Yangyang went to the Skyworks, she must have sensed something important.
Liangyu: Besides... I owe her a great debt.
Liangyu: Only the Skyworks has become a den of horrors. Two souls alone... may not be enough.
Rover: We'll just have to find out.
Liangyu: ...Right.

Rover: Abby.

[Dialogue Option]  Want some snacks?
[Dialogue Option]  Don't you think it looks like a gaint piece of candy?
Abby: Nooooo—! Absolutely not! It looks nasty!
Abby: My stomach isn't a trash can!
[Dialogue Option]  This may help us locate Yangyang.
[Dialogue Option]  You can analyze its frequency.
Abby: Ugh, fine, if you say so... I'll do it.
Abby: It's all for Yangyang, okay? Even if I get a stomachache, I'll still do it—!
Abby: Bleh... That tasted awful.
Rover: What did you "taste"?
Abby: Well, I'm not sure how to put it... The frequency was messy, like a billion math formulas all tangled together. Looking at it makes my head hurt.
[Dialogue Option]  What if it's the core programming driving the Autopuppets?
[Dialogue Option]  Yeah, and?
Abby: It's weird... On top of that string of numbers, there's a ton of... emotions.
Abby: Rage, regret, disappointment...
Rover: A machine... isn't supposed to have emotions.
Rover: Could that be what's causing them to go rogue?
Abby: Blegh... Too much bad juju... My stomach's feeling all kinds of wrong.
Abby: I'm out. Gotta crash for a bit... Wake me if something goes down.
Rover: (Were those emotions implanted? Or...)
Liangyu: Sorry, but... What was that thing back there?
Rover: Hm? You mean Abby? That's my Echo. It has a big appetite.
Liangyu: (I guess I'd better not pry...)

Yangyang: After all, a certain "role model" of mine likes to rove the world and send back stories of his own reckless adventures.
Yangyang: Breaking that habit now... might be difficult.
[Dialogue Option]  Hey, now...
Yangyang: But you're right. I owe everyone an apology when we get back.
Yangyang: And... I'm sorry, Rover. For making you worry.
Rover: Don't lose it again, okay?
Liangyu: You two...
Yangyang: Liang-Liangyu—?! You're here too—
Liangyu: (I've been standing here for a while...)
Liangyu: Are you okay, Yangyang?
Yangyang: I'm... I'm alright. Liangyu, the civilians... did everyone make it back to the city?
Liangyu: They did. Thanks to you.
Liangyu: (I didn't see Yanlang and Mingyu. I fear they have...)
Yangyang: I'm sorry, Liangyu. I couldn't—
Liangyu: Say no more, Yangyang. Apologize to anyone you wish, but not to me. This burden is mine. This failure is mine. Let me bear it alone.
Liangyu: The architect of the rebellion has fled. Now we must decide what comes next.
Yangyang: Rover, the bird that delivered the token just now... could it be...
[Dialogue Option]  Suisui is also in the Land of Xuanfang.
[Dialogue Option]  I came here with your sister.
Yangyang: My sister...
Liangyu: I see. It seems your other companion has made some progress elsewhere as well.
[Dialogue Option]  (Check the locator.)
[Dialogue Option]  She's on her way to Xuanfang Hold.
Liangyu: Then that is where we go first.
Liangyu: I need to report the situation at the Skyworks to the Warden Commander. And the rescued civilians need to be settled.
Yangyang: I agree. We should pool what we have learned.
[Dialogue Option]  That sounds like a solid plan.
[Dialogue Option]  To Xuanfang Hold, then.

title: Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled
content:
Suisui: Really, now—
???: Hey! Over here!
???: This trick won't hold them for long. If you don't wanna die, get into the fog!
Suisui: Tch—



???: Here, take this. It'll stop the fog from messing with your head.
???: Picked it up from a fortune-teller in Mengzhou. S'posed to calm the mind. Thought she was full of it, you know those Jianghu types. But wouldn't ya know, it actually works.
???: Hmph... 'bout time. This job's becoming a real pain. If I'd known Xuanfang would turn into this kind of circus, I'd have listened to my master's old lady. Saved up a little nest egg and quit while I still could...
Suisui: You...
???: Hey, hey... don't tell me you don't recognize the man you hired.
???: What, trust issues? Come on, look at my gourd. That'll prove it.
Suisui: ...Preloaded frequency data. The Terminals were set to alert each other when we drew close.
Suisui: Ahem... Then you... Ugh—Cat of the Nether Lamp, I presume?
"Cat of the Nether Lamp": The one and only. S'pose that makes you the Chongming Pruner herself.
"Cat of the Nether Lamp": You've been hiding your identity this whole time. Not the sort of thing you share with any Tom, Dick, and wandering rogue, I imagine. So what changed? Why come to Xuanfang at all?
Suisui: With all that is happening here, I should think you'd already possess certain insights, no?
"Cat of the Nether Lamp": ...You mean the sudden Autopuppet rebellion. Think Zhuojun Atelier's got their hands in it, do you?
"Cat of the Nether Lamp": Hmm... In Mengzhou, their "Flowerveil Puppet" Grand Helm hasn't made any moves. She doesn't seem to give a crap about Xuanfang, far as I can tell.
"Cat of the Nether Lamp": Ten years I've been at this. Tracked every operative Zhuojun Atelier sent to the Ministry of Development. Every single one, except...
"Cat of the Nether Lamp": ...Sorry. Say any more and I'd be out of a job. And I happen to enjoy eating.
"Cat of the Nether Lamp": Anyway, I did what you asked. Mapped the whole Fogveil Pagoda top to bottom, just like you asked in your letter.
"Cat of the Nether Lamp": Right then. If that's everything, I'll be off. Believe it or not, I do have honest work from time to time.
Suisui: Wait. One last question.
Suisui: Did you happen to come across a girl with a blue hat? Hair with feathered tips?
"Cat of the Nether Lamp": Those features are hard to miss... If I'd seen her, I'd remember. Sorry, doesn't ring a bell.
Suisui: I see...
"Cat of the Nether Lamp": What, is she important to you?
Suisui: She's my sister. She... shouldn't have come here.
Suisui: And I... shouldn't have come here either.
"Cat of the Nether Lamp": What's that saying again? Ah, right: "The fairest judge fails family feuds." Let alone a street rat like me.
"Cat of the Nether Lamp": Looks like my work here's done. Well, Chongming Pruner, I'll be on my way.
"Cat of the Nether Lamp": If you're aiming to get into that Fogveil Pagoda, head north. The Elseway Shroud's your ticket in.
"Cat of the Nether Lamp": Look, I don't know if you're hunting a person or a prize, but you've put a lot of work into this. Don't choke at the finish line.
"Cat of the Nether Lamp": The more you waver, the more you waste what was hard to win—Huh. That was pretty good. I should write that down...
Suisui: I really am a terrible older sister...
Suisui: ...I'll go where he said.

title: Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled
subsection: Try to strike the correct pose
content:
[Objective: Try to strike the correct pose]
???: You have arrived at last, my ally.
Suisui: This... this isn't your true self, is it? Am I right, Sentinel of Mengzhou—Hsin?
???: That's right. What remains here is merely a thread of my frequency.
???: You have reached the agreed place. Good. That completes the first step of our pact.
???: The second step is the pivot upon which everything turns. Listen carefully, my ally—
Suisui: Hold on. Before we proceed, I have something to say.
Suisui: Our agreement did not cover how our transaction would proceed in the event of a "force majeure."
Suisui: And with the chaos sweeping through Xuanfang... as its Sentinel, do you not have a duty to act?
Suisui: Why the silence, Hsin? As a Sentinel, isn't protecting the people your foremost duty?
Suisui: ...This . It's a piece of you, isn't it?
Suisui: You had me come to Xuanfang to retrieve it and deliver it to the "true" you, the one hiding somewhere.
Suisui: Does that mean... you cannot move freely now?
???: It seems I have fallen victim to my own cleverness. I should have chosen a less perceptive ally.
Suisui: This Prism of Fate... can only you wield it? If I were to—
???: Absolutely not. Do not mistake my patience for permission. That particular desire has no claim here.
???: You...
Suisui: I'm so very sorry, but I prepared a "backup key."
Jinhsi: ...Miss Suisui, you are claiming you entered into a direct deal with Sentinel Hsin the Moon Fox?
Suisui: Yes. By chance, I once entered into a contract with that elusive Lady Sentinel.
Suisui: She requested I meet Her at a certain place in Xuanfang. To that end, She gave me an encrypted frequency.
Suisui: This was meant to be a private matter, but the situation has spiraled. I will not walk into Xuanfang Hold blind.
Suisui: Magistrate, may I ask if this frequency is the same as the one you gave to Rover?
Jinhsi: Mm... Yes, the spectral pattern matches exactly.
Suisui: Then, about the Sentinel of Mengzhou... do you have anything more to share?
Jinhsi: I am afraid I have little to offer. In recent years, Jué has shared very few updates regarding Hsin, and I can't confirm that what I do know is even true.
Jinhsi: However, if She summoned you to the Land of Xuanfang, then that soil must hold a deep significance for Her.
Jinhsi: Jué once mentioned that Hsin separated Her tail to create multiple '. Each one contains a fragment of the Sentinel's power. If one is hidden in the Hold, it's no coincidence...
Jinhsi: Only... I cannot say why Hsin's intentions are so veiled. I suspect you will only learn more once you are there.
Jinhsi: Miss Suisui, you're wondering if that Prism of Fate can be used to find Yangyang, aren't you?
Suisui: Is that not possible?
Jinhsi: Naturally, a vessel for a Sentinel's power would be heavily restricted. Likely, only Hsin or Her Resonator could wield it.
Jinhsi: No... There is one more exception.
???: Jué... and the young girl it rescued...
Suisui: Our prior agreement is forfeit. I did break faith first. But now, Sentinel Hsin, I would propose a new contract. Will you hear it?
???: How sly... you sought out Jué and its Resonator to cheat the terms. You wear the fox's skin better than I.
Suisui: Forgive me. I am backed into a corner. But I truly believe this serves us both. If only you would—
???: ...No. Even if I cannot cast you out, do not think I will bend so easily.
???: You do not know what weight of "duty" lies beneath your own words.
Suisui: Looks like convincing Her will take some effort...

[Objective: Defeat the Exiles]
???: Fatal malice... It strikes the moment when you are least on guard.
???: When you cannot count the blades hidden in the dark, there is no single answer to this test.
???: Someone must stand in this position, whether it's you or that soldier. Someone... must be sacrificed. This Prism of Fate represents that burden.
???: If... one life could settle this, I would not ask for two. Surely you understand.
Suisui: No, I don't.
???: Child... Are you feigning ignorance?
Suisui: How can I possibly understand if you don't explain it to me from the beginning?
Suisui: Besides, I'm still here, alive and kicking.
???: If I had not intervened just now, you would have already "died."
Suisui: Yes. I have you. I have you, therefore I can take the risk. I can try to overturn an outcome that's already been decided.
???: ...Reality is not like the questions I set. It has no gaps for you to slip through.
???: What you're attempting is nothing more than a desperate gamble.
???: The greedy lose everything in the end. Always.
Suisui: Yes. Unless of course—
Suisui: We happen to have...
Suisui: A "trump card" powerful enough to flip the table entirely.

content:

Suisui: The Magistrate of Jinzhou told me what happened on Mt. Firmament. If it weren't for him, things would have ended exactly as you said.
Suisui: You're right. I am greedy. Greedy enough to want to keep everyone safe. Greedy enough to dream of an ending where no one bleeds.
Suisui: And I believe that person... Rover, can carry the weight of that greed. You should know that better than anyone, Sentinel Hsin.
Suisui: I understand that perhaps under your current circumstances, you can't tell me the truth. But I want you to take a chance with me. One bet. A bet on a future... you've never dared to imagine.
???: Honeyed words, sweet promises... How many souls have you sold such pretty illusions to?
Suisui: Well, I admit I've never tried them on a Sentinel before.
???: Heh... Silver-tongued little thing, indeed. I find I do not entirely dislike it.
???: I see... So the Arbiter has come here as well...
???: But at this moment, the one standing before me to make this deal is not him... it is you.
???: If you wish to convince me, then... let us place our bets.
???: One round. Winner takes all.
???: So be it...
???: A bet is a bet. I yield.
???: My ally... No, Suisui—
???: For now, I place my "hope" in your hands.

title: Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled
subsection: Meet with Suisui in the Hold
content:
[Objective: Meet with Suisui in the Hold]
Liangyu: Yangyang, Rover, I need to report to the Commander. Why don't you two find your companion first?
Yangyang: Alright. We'll meet you later.
Yangyang: My sister... I wonder if she made it here safely.
Yangyang: Actually, Rover... when she gets here, there's something I need to discuss with her in private. Would you mind—
[Dialogue Option]  A bit late for that.
[Dialogue Option]  Yangyang, look behind you...
Suisui: YANGYANG—!
Yangyang: S-sister...?!

metadata.subsection: Meet with Suisui in the Hold

title: Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled
subsection: Meet with Suisui in the Hold
content:
[Dialogue Option]  A bit late for that.
[Dialogue Option]  Yangyang, look behind you...
Suisui: YANGYANG—!
Yangyang: S-sister...?!



Suisui: Oh, my poor Yangyang! You've gotten so thin! Is no one in Jinzhou looking after you? Do you not eat properly?
Suisui: This will not do. This will not do at all. You need to eat more, darling. How else am I supposed to enjoy hugging you?
Yangyang: Sister, please! I'm not a child anymore. And I've been eating perfectly fine...
Suisui: Oh? Since when has my little Yangyang been so shy?
Yangyang: Sui—sui—
Suisui: Mm... All these years, and you don't hang on to me anymore. I find that rather crushing...
Yangyang: That is not how it was! You were the one who dragged me everywhere. I missed so many of my vocal lessons...
Suisui: Oh Really? Hmm... it all gets quite blurry, doesn't it? But I seem to recall a certain someone begging me to sneak her out to see the festival boats, pestering for me to keep it from Mother.
Yangyang: That was... But you were always sneaking out at night to watch the opera...
Suisui: Excuse me? I recall a certain little critter who stole my box of osmanthus cakes. Hint: mice don't usually wipe their mouths with napkins after they eat.
[Dialogue Option]  How did this turn into a roast session...?
[Dialogue Option]  (Well, no wonder they're sisters...)
Rover: Somehow... it feels like you're a completely different person now.
Suisui: Well, things were urgent back then. Now that the weight on my mind has lifted, of course I'm more at ease.
Suisui: Though the little sister I went through so much to see seems to have forgotten how to be nice to her older sister.
Yangyang: Ahem... Thank you for taking the time to come see me, but let's focus on the issues at hand first.
Rover: This thing you sent... What exactly is it?
Suisui: Just as I thought. You are qualified to wield it. My efforts to persuade that stubborn fox weren't in vain after all.
Yangyang: Fox... Suisui, you don't mean—
Suisui: ...My apologies, Rover, Yangyang. There is something I've been keeping from you.
Suisui: Well, let me start from the moment Rover and I got separated.

metadata.subsection: Meet with Suisui in the Hold

title: Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled
subsection: Meet with Suisui in the Hold
content:
Suisui: Well, let me start from the moment Rover and I got separated.



Yangyang: I had no idea... You and the Sentinel of Mengzhou shared such a complicated history.
Suisui: I'm sorry, Rover, for keeping this from you. My deal with Hsin was meant to stay between us. Until I stood before Her, I wasn't sure if revealing the truth would help or just make things worse.
Suisui: Thank you for finding Yangyang. In the end, I wasn't much help in that department.
Yangyang: Don't say that, Suisui. It's over now. You've carried that burden alone for far too long.
[Dialogue Option]  We wouldn't have made it out of the Skyworks without your help.
Suisui: In any case, the Sentinel's token has passed into your hands. That means your fate is now woven with Hsin the Moon Fox. When those threads will come undone, I cannot say.
Suisui: I can feel it, though... She's hiding something. A truth She cannot, or will not, speak. You will have to find that answer yourself.
[Dialogue Option]  Would not be the first time.
[Dialogue Option]  If She's in trouble, I won't just stand by.
Yangyang: Before that, we have to stop the Autopuppet rebellion.
Yangyang: Sister, you mentioned Zhuojun Atelier. Did you find something specific about them back in Mengzhou?
Suisui: They are a unique organization renowned for their mastery of mechanist art. Their roots run deep in Mengzhou, and their expertise rivals that of Huaxu Academy.
Suisui: But they lack discipline and have no unified code of conduct. Their leader, the Grand Helm "Flowerveil Puppet," is especially elusive, with questionable morals.
Suisui: You both know of the , yes? Though it has since disbanded, their leader, the , was originally from Zhuojun Atelier.
[Dialogue Option]  (The Séance Society...)
[Dialogue Option]  (Yinlin...)
Yangyang: That man, Muyu... he was a member of the Atelier two hundred years ago. But it seems he's long since cut ties with them.
Suisui: Two hundred years ago... Even for a Resonator, that is an exceptionally long life. He might've had multiple identities in that time. Tracing his origins will prove difficult.
Rover: There's something else. He knew me. The way he spoke... he knows my history.
Rover: And he mentioned a "woman in red"...
Yangyang: Could it be the woman we encountered in Jinzhou? Scar's companion?
Rover: No, I don't think it's her... It sounds like an Overseer we haven't met yet. Someone still lurking in Huanglong.
Yangyang: Zhuojun Atelier and the Fractsidus... If he has ties to both...
Yangyang: With a Forte we don't yet understand, infiltrating the Autopuppet system and causing the chaos in Xuanfang would be well within his reach.
Yangyang: But... why? He kept mentioning his "experiment." What could it mean?
[Dialogue Option]  It might be related to what he took from the Skyworks.
[Dialogue Option]  He's probably using the Reverberation for something.
Yangyang: At least now we know who we need to stop.
Yangyang: Let's find Liangyu and the Warden Commander. Maybe they can help us make sense of these leads.

metadata.subsection: Meet with Suisui in the Hold

subsection: Meet with Suisui in the Hold
content:
Yangyang: Let's find Liangyu and the Warden Commander. Maybe they can help us make sense of these leads.

content:
[Objective: Meet up with Liangyu and the Warden Commander]
Rover: By the way, earlier, I asked Abby to "analyze" the abnormal Autopuppet's kernel.
Rover: It was packed with negative emotions. If those were somehow implanted from the outside...
Yangyang: That could be how Muyu is controlling them...
Yangyang: (But the source of those emotions... Could it be...)

title: Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled
content:
[Objective: Listen to conversation around]
Digeng Urgh... I can feel them...
Changluan: Haah... There you go again, Digeng. Talking nonsense...

Resident: Hey, did you see that lady who just passed by? She's so beautiful...
Other Resident: Wait, I think I know her. Isn't she... the head of the Zhaoming Commerce Guild?
Other Resident: What's someone like her doing here at a time like this?

Xuanfang Warden: His left arm was cut by an Autopuppet. All we could do was a simple patch-up at the time...
Xuanfang Medic: Don't worry, we'll take good care of him. It's just...
Xuanfang Medic: It's a deep wound, and it wasn't treated in time. We might need to amputate it...

Resident: What was that noise just now? Did it come from the Western Fang Peaks?
Other Resident: Did something happen to the Skyworks...?

title: Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled
content:
Resident: What was that noise just now? Did it come from the Western Fang Peaks?
Other Resident: Did something happen to the Skyworks...?



Resident: I still can't believe it... That Autopuppets would attack humans...
Other Resident: Yeah... they were all acting normal up until then...
Resident: You suppose... even after we get through this, can we still trust them?

Elder Resident: Sentinel Hsin... please save Xuanfang...
Elder Resident: Two hundred years... Have you forgotten Xuanfang after two hundred years?

Artisan: Without the Autopuppets, how are we supposed to stop the Tacet Discords?
Other Artisan:We have to trust the Wardens.

title: Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled
content:
Artisan: Without the Autopuppets, how are we supposed to stop the Tacet Discords?
Other Artisan:We have to trust the Wardens.



Qiuhong: ...Check the Ministry of War, the Ministry of Development, and Huaxu Academy. If there's any space left, get the elderly and children in first.
Qiuhong: When the last civilian is inside the Hold, recall the remainder of our forces. Leave only a handful of scouts. The Autopuppets within the city remain operational, but watch them closely. Do not let them fight. Not until we know why this is happening.
Liangyu: Understood. I will send someone at once—Oh, you're here.
[Dialogue Option]  I assume this is the Warden Commander?
[Dialogue Option]  (He's not quite what I expected...)
Qiuhong: ...You three must be the ones Liangyu spoke of. In these desperate hours, your willingness to stand with us is a comfort beyond words. I, Qiuhong, owe you a debt!
Yangyang: Commander Qiuhong, there are things we need to discuss with you and Liangyu.
Qiuhong: I have just finished our next deployment schedule. We can talk at the Ministry of War.

title: Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled
subsection: (Optional) Talk to the Artisans of the Ministry of Development
content:
[Objective: (Optional) Talk to the Artisans of the Ministry of Development]
Huihuan: These Autopuppets... What in the heavens could have caused this?
Huihuan: With our current skills, we can inspect their mechanical structures and make simple repairs, but we cannot begin to understand their control kernels...
Huihuan: Hm? You...
[Dialogue Option]  (Tell him about Muyu)
Huihuan: Muyu? No one by that name works here. But the man you're describing... that sounds exactly like Master Shenyuan.
Huihuan: He came to us twenty years ago. One of our most senior Artisans.
Huihuan: He keeps to himself, but his skills are exceptional. We all trust him. A few days ago, he stopped showing up. We thought he had fallen victim to the rogue Autopuppets...
Huihuan: You think... he's been plotting this for the past twenty years? No, that cannot be...
Huihuan: He never said a word about Zhuojun Atelier. We used to discuss techniques together. I thought I knew him well...
Huihuan: Why... why would he do this...?

metadata.subsection: (Optional) Talk to the Artisans of the Ministry of Development

title: Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled
content:
[Objective: Listen to conversation around]
Shuoyan: Wait—hey! Could you be—
Shuoyan: H-hello! I mean... sorry, I-I...
Rover: Are you talking to me?
Shuoyan: Yes! I mean—no offense—but is it true you fought in the Norfall Barrens alongside General Jiyan?
Rover: I did.
Shuoyan: Amazing! My friends in the Midnight Rangers have told me about your remarkable deeds. You do have an incredible aura.
Shuoyan: I'm a new recruit here in the Xuanfang Warden, and to be honest... I'm still pretty nervous. Do you have any advice for me?
Rover: Trust your companions and trust yourself. Trust the hard work that brought you this far.
Shuoyan: Trust... I see. I'll try my best! Thank you so much!

title: Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled
content:
Shuoyan: Trust... I see. I'll try my best! Thank you so much!



Huaiqian: Have all the recovered Autopuppet remains been transported?
Qiansu: All accounted for... I still cannot wrap my head around it. I saw my own work—the transmission lever I just fixed.
Huaiqian: Keep a close watch on them. We will need to give an account for this later.
Qiansu: To others... and to ourselves.

Artisan: Are the signal nodes ready? We can't afford to waste any more time.
Other Artisan: All done. Just confirming where to place them...
Artisan: Good. Get the Hold's communications back online as soon as possible.

title: Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled
content:
Other Artisan: All done. Just confirming where to place them...
Artisan: Good. Get the Hold's communications back online as soon as possible.



Xuanfang Warden: Do we have a number on the rogue Autopuppets outside the city? What about an estimate?
Other Xuanfang Warden: According to the data from Skywatch Rings, it's anywhere from several hundred to a thousand...
Xuanfang Warden: Damn it! We got so used to having them around that we never realized just how many there were...

Xuanfang Warden: Supplies, personnel... have they all been allocated? Can't leave a single thing behind!
Xuanfang Warden: Got a huge battle head. Must throw everything we have into supporting the front lines. Duty of the logistics, huh?

title: Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled
content:
Xuanfang Warden: Got a huge battle head. Must throw everything we have into supporting the front lines. Duty of the logistics, huh?



Xuanfang Warden: You mean... someone saved you from a rogue Autopuppet?
Resident: Yes... but I couldn't see their face. They wore a hat.
Xuanfang Warden: In times like these... who could it have been?

Xuanfang Warden: I saw Watcher Liangyu bringing in another group of civilians, including some from Jinzhou.
Xuanfang Watcher: Do we even have enough space for all these people?
Xuanfang Warden: Let's see what the Commander says. Either way, we can't just leave them out there.

Xuanfang Warden: All units! Man your posts. Orders from the Warden Commander will be here any moment!
Xuanfang Warden: Remember, Xuanfang Hold stands behind you. There's no retreat. We fight to the bitter end!

title: Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled
subsection: Head to the Ministry of War and discuss your next course of action
content:
[Objective: Head to the Ministry of War and discuss your next course of action]
The group arrives at the Ministry of War to exchange the intelligence they have gathered.
Qiuhong: So, this Muyu... spent years disguised as a Ministry Artisan, all to lay hands on the Sentinel's technology... That was a grave oversight on our part.
Qiuhong: And since Zhuojun Atelier never discloses its members' identities, I fear tracing his origins will lead nowhere...
Qiuhong: However, if one digs deeper, the Atelier's connection to Xuanfang Hold runs deeper than most realize.
Yangyang: What do you mean?
Qiuhong: I discovered the connection in a dossier collected by the Commanders who came before me. Everyone knows when the Threnodian stirred at Norfall Barrens and Tacet Discords swelled beyond control, Sentinel Hsin looked ahead. She chose to build this Hold.
Qiuhong: But She did not build it alone. No. She needed hands and sought out a council of helpers.
Qiuhong: Back then, Zhuojun Atelier had already stood in Mengzhou for generations. Masters of the mechanist arts. Architects of Yuan (Abyssal) Fortress. So when the call went out, they answered. They wished to take on the commission for Xuanfang.
Qiuhong: Yet for some unknown reason... the Sentinel passed them over.
Yangyang: Who did Hsin choose to assist in the construction instead?
Rover: I remember Xiangli Yao telling me that a group from the Court of Savantae once came to Mengzhou...
Qiuhong: Exactly. They were the ones who helped build the Hold, but no records of their whereabouts were found afterward.
Liangyu: Could it be... that the Atelier has held a grudge against the Sentinel and Xuanfang Hold after being turned down?
Suisui: To wait two hundred years for revenge? That Muyu is certainly patient, if nothing else.
Yangyang: No... While I can't say for sure, I believe his motives run deeper than a simple grudge.
Yangyang: Manipulating the Autopuppets to cause chaos may only be one step in his plan. So far, only one place in Xuanfang remains untouched by rogue Autopuppets and Tacet Discords...
Qiuhong: ...The Hold itself.
Suisui: Given the sheer value this Hold represents to this land, it's only natural that he would set his sights on it.
Qiuhong: Regardless, we must stand ready to fight. Perhaps... without hope of aid. A fight to the death against rogue Autopuppets and Tacet Discords.
Rover: Count me in the fight.
Yangyang: We stand together, no matter what.
Qiuhong: Our people have guarded this Hold for over two centuries...
Qiuhong: I hope that its history does not end with us.
Liangyu: Communication across Xuanfang has been severed by unknown interference. Fortunately, the Ministry of Development has just finished a batch of signal nodes. Once we place them around the Hold, they will restore our internal comms and link directly to the defense systems.
Qiuhong: This will aid our defense. But we are short on hands... Rover, would you help set up some of the nodes?
[Dialogue Option]  No problem.
[Dialogue Option]  Consider it done.
Yangyang: I'll go with you, Rover.

metadata.subsection: Head to the Ministry of War and discuss your next course of action

title: Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled
content:
[Objective: Talk to Suisui]
Suisui: While you set up the nodes, how about I stay here at the Hold to keep an eye on things?
Suisui: The people you rescued from the Skyworks were brought here as well, weren't they? I'll go check on their condition.
[Dialogue Option]  Thank you.

title: Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled
content:
[Objective: Listen to Lingyu and Qiuhong]
Liangyu: Commander, have you heard anything from Paragon Qingxiao?
Qiuhong: No... Not yet.
Liangyu: Paragon Qingxiao... I hope she's alright.
Qiuhong: Her strength is beyond question. But for now, we play it by ear...

title: Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled
content:
[Objective: Listen to conversation around you]

Xuanfang Warden: Those two over there... who are they?
Other Xuanfang Warden: I heard they are reinforcements from Jinzhou. The Ministry of War has been greatly aided by them.
Xuanfang Warden: But there's... only two of them...

Wanmeng: Excuse me. About my brother...
Zhuhua: He... he was trapped in a Censure Court with a group of others when the Autopuppets rebelled. We don't know if he's still alive...
Wanmeng: H-How could this happen...?
Zhuhua: Hey... it's going to be alright. Paragon Qingxiao was there when it happened. She... she will definitely keep them safe.

title: Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled
content:
Zhuhua: Hey... it's going to be alright. Paragon Qingxiao was there when it happened. She... she will definitely keep them safe.



Muxuan: With everything that's happened lately, why hasn't Paragon Qingxiao shown herself yet?
Zihan: Strange, right? I even raised it with the Ministry of War. I got a lot of hemming and hawing, but no straight answers.
Muxuan: Every other time the Land of Xuanfang was in need, Qingxiao the Perfected would descend from the mountain. But this time... could something have happened...?

title: Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled
content:
[Objective: Listen to Storyteller]
Storyteller: Hear me, good people! Do not lose heart.
Storyteller: For many years, I have wandered these lands, bearing witness to all the rise and fall of this world.
Storyteller: Through the long annals of the six cities of Huanglong, the pages are steeped in calamities sown by the Threnodian...
Storyteller: Yet even when the world lay ravaged by disaster, there have always been brave souls who rose to defend it.
Storyteller: When I set foot in Jinzhou, I heard tales of the Midnight Rangers, standing shoulder to shoulder to break a surging tide of Tacet Discords.
Storyteller: And how, when Mt. Firmament returned to the world, the frozen realm thawed, and the land itself was reborn.
Storyteller: Now, a new storm brews over Xuanfang Hold, and peril beats fiercely at our very gates.
Storyteller: But the Xuanfang Wardens have formed their ranks and marched forth, standing as an unbroken shield to protect the peace of this land.
Storyteller: So long as our hearts beat as one, we shall surely weather this storm!

title: Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled
content:
[Objective: Fix the first node]
Yangyang: I just remembered... I need to return this sword to the villagers...
Rover: That so?
Yangyang: It's a long story. A local I met earlier asked me to keep it for them.
Yangyang: It's just... I don't know why, but I feel a strange familiarity with it.
Yangyang: Looking at its edges, I've even started to see things. Flashes of the past.
Rover: Like the visions I had when I saw Jué's statue?
Yangyang: But that was because of the history you shared with Jué.
Yangyang: I have never set foot in the Land of Xuanfang before...
Rover: What if you've lost your memories too, like I did?
Yangyang: Rover... Really now? How could that be...?
Rover: (Yeah. That... probably couldn't be true.)

title: Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled
content:
[Objective: Fix the second node]
Yangyang: There. The two nodes we were assigned are in place...
Yangyang: We still have a bit of time. Let's go find the village chief.

title: Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled
content:
[Objective: Listen to conversation around you]
Resident: There must be thousands of Autopuppets serving Hsin in the Sanctum
Other Resident: No, I heard the inside is like a mirage realm. A painting you can walk into.
Another Resident: Knowing Hsin's tastes, it is probably a garden of water pavillions and winding corridors.

Jinling: Sob... Sob... I-I'm scared...
Jinling: I-if the fog never goes away, does that mean I'm never gonna go home...
Linfu: Don't worry. Those amazing Xuanfang Wardens are already on their way.

title: Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled
content:
[Objective: Talk to Xianling Villagers]
Resident: Huh? Where's Granny Yanshu? I haven't seen her since we entered the Hold.
Other Resident: Me neither... Maybe she went to see Liangyu?

Zhenshu: How's that boy Qingyan doing?
Gaoyun: The Huaxu researchers say his condition is stable now. He just needs rest. That sudden Resonance Awakening took a lot out of him.
Zhenshu: Thank goodness... If not for that power, he and his sister would have fallen from the cliff.

Resident: Lady Hsin... Why has She not appeared...
Other Resident: It's been too long since we last saw Her...
Resident: But... but...
Resident: I refuse to believe She would simply abandon us...

title: Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled
content:
Other Resident: It's been too long since we last saw Her...
Resident: But... but...
Resident: I refuse to believe She would simply abandon us...



Dingjun: Is here fine for the altar, sir?
Chizhen: Yes, that's perfect. Thank you so much...
Dingjun: Don't mention it. It's just been sitting in the warehouse gathering dust anyway. So, what do you need it for...?
Chizhen: That old Qiankun asked for it. As for what it's for... Hehe. Let's just say it's for some peace of mind...

Xiran: Step right up! Come take a look... Top-quality goods—
Xiran: Tasty... Big portions... Sweet as can be...
Xiran: Ugh, when is this road gonna come back...

title: Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled
subsection: Head to the location where the Xianling villagers are sheltered
content:
[Objective: Head to the location where the Xianling villagers are sheltered]
Qiankun: If it isn't Yangyang! You returned unharmed!
Yangyang: Yes, I'm fine. Thank you for your concern.
Qiankun: Your safe return... your safe return is all that matters...
Yangyang: I brought back the blade you entrusted to Liangyu. There was... some trouble along the way, but I managed to keep it safe.
Qiankun: This is... ah, thank you. Thank you.
Yangyang: No thanks are needed, Chief. As I said, this blade gives the courage to walk forward even in the face of death.
Yangyang: It... will bear witness as we weather this storm together.
Rover: What was that...
Yangyang: Rover...?
[Dialogue Option]  I heard someone singing...
[Dialogue Option]  Is this what you spoke about before...
Yangyang: Did you hear it too, Rover?
Yangyang: Xuanfang Hold... It's like... we're in the past again.
Yangyang: This song...
Yangyang: Let's find out where it's coming from, Rover.

subsection: Return to the Xuanfang Hold of the past
content:
[Objective: Return to the Xuanfang Hold of the past]
Yangyang: Could these be... Xuanling Birds?
Yangyang: I didn't think I'd ever get to see them...
Yangyang: (...Why... when I see them... do I have this feeling like...?)
