title: Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled
content:
[Objective: Talk to Zhuqing]

;Zhuqing: Ah... a miscalculation.
Zhuqing: A miscalculation... a miscalculation.
Shutong: Only a single lost piece. What settles the game lies not on the board, but with us.
Zhuqing: A lifetime of playing the board. And now, it seems... I am a piece on it myself.
Shutong: You old hack. That last move was the finest of your sorry life.

title: Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled
content:
[Objective: Listen to conversation around you]

Xuanfang Warden: Promise me you will eat well. Sleep well...
Resident: Snff... Snff...
Xuanfang Warden: What else... Ah, yes. Just stay safe, okay?
Xuanfang Warden: Wait for my return. But if I do not... wait for the Ministry's letter.

title: Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled
content:
[Objective: Talk to Gaolan]
Gaolan: Oh, Xuanling... Why haven't you returned yet...
Gaolan: Lianqing said she'd ask you to bring her message back...
Gaolan: Please... please come back...
Gaolan: Just let me know that she's alright...

title: Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled
content:
[Objective: Listen to conversation around you]

Xuanfang Warden: Oh, Xuanling... Will the Sword Transcendent finally descend from the mountain this time?
Xuanfang Warden: ...
Xuanfang Warden: Could you tell her how my greatest wish has always been to become her disciple?

title: Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled
content:
[Objective: Talk to Tired Xuanfang Warden]
Veteran Xuanfang Warden: Hah... you're too soft for the military. What are you even doing here?
Young Xuanfang Warden: My parents... they were both killed. I want to avenge them!
Veteran Xuanfang Warden: Avenge them? That's the last thing you should be thinking about! You living a long, peaceful life is what your parents would have wanted!
Veteran Xuanfang Warden: But you're already in this uniform. There's no room for regrets now.
Veteran Xuanfang Warden: Listen up, lad. Once we're on the battlefield, you stick close to me and the rest of the squad, got it?
Veteran Xuanfang Warden: That way... you might just make it out alive.

title: Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled
content:
[Objective: Listen to conversation around you]
Xuanfang Warden: Years of training have all led to this moment! Remember, soldiers—behind your line of defense is Mengzhou!
Xuanfang Warden: If we retreat, our homeland is doomed. If we march, we may die, but we die bringing hope!

title: Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled
content:
[Objective: Talk to Young Artisan]
Young Artisan: I heard Zhuojun Atelier sent some of their people as well...
Experienced Artisan: Makes sense. They're the ones who designed Yuan Fortress. Besides... now that our homeland is in danger, it's their duty to step up.
Young Artisan: Let's hope they can find a way out of this mess...
Experienced Artisan: Hmm... Hard to say. Real hard to say...

title: Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled
content:
[Objective: Listen to conversation around you]
Xuanfang Warden: Those Court of Savantae Artisans also went to Yuan Fortress...
Other Xuanfang Warden: There's a girl named Ruoyun, right? I remember she's also from Xianling Village...

title: Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled
subsection: Head toward where the singing is coming from
content:
[Objective: Head toward where the singing is coming from]
???: I'll be leaving soon, Xuanling.
???: Now now, don't be so stubborn. Beyond Xuanfang, there are oh so many melodies waiting for you...
???: Hm?
Yangyang: You are... Liangyu?
???: Liangyu? Liang... Yu... Hmm. A beautiful name, but it is not mine.
???: My name is Lingfang. Are you new recruits as well? Heh, the Ministry must truly be in dire straits if they cannot even give you proper uniforms.
Yangyang: (She's the one I saw in those memories. She and Liangyu... Could it be...)
Yangyang: If I remember correctly, you were once... a musician?
Lingfang: Oh? I did not expect to be recognized so far from Mengzhou.
Lingfang: A shame I cannot play for you now. I have already sold my liuqin (stringed instrument). No place for music on a battlefield.
Lingfang: The only thing I kept was this xiao (bamboo flute). My husband made it for me. I could not bear to part with it.
Lingfang: It never made a single note, but I never told him. That lumbering man was never good with his hands...
Rover: Why did you join the army...
Lingfang: No grand reason. Tacet Discords killed my beloved. So I took up a blade to avenge him. It is as simple as that.
Lingfang: My father served in Mengzhou's Ministry of War. He taught me how to fight when I was young, but I grew bored after a few years and ran away to study music. It was during those wandering years that I met him.
Lingfang: Others might have seen only an ordinary painter, but I saw the colors within him. He walked away from a chance to study at the Mingting Institute of Art, all to stay in the hometown he loved so dearly.
Lingfang: He loved painting the Xuanling Birds. They were his voice. They helped him confess what he was too shy to say to me himself.
Lingfang: But it's all gone now. Tacet Discords took everything.
Lingfang: The thought of those monsters coming here to trample the land he held so dear...
Lingfang: Makes me... tremble with rage.
Lingfang: So I took up the sword again, just like my father had always wished. He used to say a sword is wielded for one's country and people. I still don't think I understand what that means.
Yangyang: ...They're the same thing.
Yangyang: Whether it's for a person, an ideal, or something more profound that's hard to put in words...
Yangyang: We feel for the  things we hold dear . Sorrow. Joy. Fear. Shame. Anger.
Yangyang: That is why we choose to  protect .
Yangyang: And you're protecting more than the memories you made with him. You're protecting the place where countless new memories and feelings will be born.
Lingfang: Protect, you say... We have a baby girl, and I... I only wish I could protect her as she grows.
Yangyang: Don't worry, she will grow up healthy and safe.
Yangyang: She will find her own love, career, and family, and she will protect her child with the same love you gave her. That will pass on, for generations.
Yangyang: To the future and to faraway tomorrows we can't yet see.
Lingfang: I see...
Lingfang: Then... I will hold onto that hope.
Lingfang: I must go. Though I do not know your name, it was a comfort to speak with you before I march onto the battlefield.
Lingfang: I have nothing to offer you in return, so... I give you my song.
海内兮传四方
My voice travels far and wide
唤伊莫相忘
My voice says, forget me not
潮水滔滔
Roaring tides
迷雾遮道
Rolling fog
前路迢迢
Long road ahead
归期遥遥
When will I be home again?
荒山萧萧
Desolate mountains
河无梁
Bridgeless rivers
家酒难尝
Hometown wine, a memory brew
发染雪霜
Did longing paint the hair gray?

metadata.subsection: Head toward where the singing is coming from

title: Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled
subsection: Defend Xuanfang Hold from the rogue Autopuppets and Tacet Discords
content:
[Objective: Defend Xuanfang Hold from the rogue Autopuppets and Tacet Discords]
Liangyu: Rover! Yangyang! Can you hear me?
Liangyu: The last node is in place. Communications around Xuanfang Hold should be fully restored.
Liangyu: We have mobilized all functional heavy siege weapons from the reserves, and Commander Qiuhong has completed the defensive deployment.
Liangyu: However... the enemy moves faster than we anticipated.
Liangyu: No time to explain. Meet me at the front gate!
Yangyang: Let's go, Rover.
Yangyang: It's our turn to protect this land now.

Xiaoyi: Mommy, what is that thing outside the Hold?
Qiuyan: I don't know, Xiaoyi... Come on, lets follow the Wardens to the Ministry of War.
Xiaoyi: Oh, the Ministry of War! Is Uncle Qiu going to be there too?
Qiuyan: No... Just be good and stay close to me, Xiaoyi.
Qiuyan: Brother Qiu... please be careful...

metadata.subsection: Defend Xuanfang Hold from the rogue Autopuppets and Tacet Discords

title: Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled
subsection: Defend Xuanfang Hold from the rogue Autopuppets and Tacet Discords
content:
Qiuyan: No... Just be good and stay close to me, Xiaoyi.
Qiuyan: Brother Qiu... please be careful...



Warden: The Commander is summong us! Let's go!
Other Warden: Everyone! Get indoors right now! Do not come outside, no matter what happens!

Resident: L-Look at what's on the mountain tops in the distance... What are those things?
Other Resident: Not good... I have a sick feeling about this...

Qiankun: It seems... after two hundred years, the Land of Xuanfang must endure yet another catastrophe...
Qiankun: However, I believe that even after two hundred years, our people's will to overcome this hasn't changed.
Qiankun: Just like our ancestors, we will overcome whatever hardships lie before us.
Qiankun: Yangyang, Rover... you're heading to the frontlines, aren't you?
Qiankun: May you return victorious. And... may you return safe.

metadata.subsection: Defend Xuanfang Hold from the rogue Autopuppets and Tacet Discords

title: Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled
content:
[Objective: (If players exit the Instance)]
Linnian: Rogue Autopuppets and Tacet Discords are gathering outside the city...Rover, are you ready?
[Dialogue Option]  Let's do this.
[Dialogue Option]  I still need some time.

title: Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled
content:
[Objective: (Cutscene plays)]
Yangyang: No... We can't let them reach the Hold!
Liangyu: There are too many of them...
Rover: Go reinforce the other units...
Rover: The frontline... leave it to me.

title: Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled
content:
[Objective: (Rover's Point of View)]
Rover: Too many. If they break through here... the Hold falls.
Rover: Hsin the Moon Fox... Lend me your strength now!
Amazed Xuanfang Warden: Incredible...! They actually held back that many Autopuppets and Tacet Discords!
Qiuhong: Soldiers, now is our chance! Press the attack!
Brave Xuanfang Warden: Charge!

title: Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled
content:
[Objective: (Yangyang Point of View)]
Yangyang: (Rover is taking the brunt of it...)
Yangyang: (I will not be another one he has to carry!)
Yangyang: (Need to push harder... Need to be stronger!)
Yangyang: (I will... protect everyone!)

title: Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled
content:
[Objective: (Suisui Point of View)]
Suisui: So this is what they call a battlefield...
Suisui: (Yangyang... she's been fighting in places like this all along...)
Brave Xuanfang Warden: Thank you! That was a great help!

title: Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled
content:
[Objective: (Group up)]
Yangyang: Rover! Are you alright?!
Suisui: These things... Cut down one wave, and another rises to take its place...
Rover: Stay focused! We need to survive this wave!
Liangyu: Damned monsters! Will they never stop?!
Qiuhong: There is no retreat... We fight until the very end!

title: Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled
content:
[Objective: (Cutscene ends)]

Liangyu: Paragon Qingxiao?!
Qingxiao: Forgive me. I should have come sooner.
Rover: The Censure Court... it's growing...
Yangyang: Muyu... he's probably hiding in that one.
Qingxiao: The assault grows fiercer by the moment. My sword formations will not hold long. We must end this quickly.
Qingxiao: If you can find the one pulling the strings... go. Strike the root of this evil.
Liangyu: The Paragon is right. Yangyang, Rover, you two go. We will manage here.
Liangyu: ...This ground will hold while you are gone. That is a promise!
Suisui: Yangyang!
Suisui: ...Be careful.
Yangyang: ...I know. Let's go, Rover!

Fallen Court The innermost depths of Censure Court—where madness and chaos first took root.

title: Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled
subsection: Head deep into the Censure Court and confront Muyu
content:
[Objective: Head deep into the Censure Court and confront Muyu]
Yangyang: (The Streams' Resonance is getting stronger...)
Yangyang: W-what is happening—?
???: ...Votary of the Voice. Do you finally understand?
Yangyang: Who... Who are you?
???: Even if the choice before you is but a single stone cast into a boundless ocean...
???: The "ripples" it creates shall touch the fate of the entire world (planet).
???: Turn back here. Leave what follows to ■■■, and you may remain in ignorant bliss, living only for "yourself."
???: Once this "wind" rises, it will never cease.
Yangyang: ...
Yangyang: I'm sorry. I don't understand what you're saying...
Yangyang: But no matter what, I won't let him face this alone.
???: Is that so...
???: Forgive us.  We never intended for any living soul to hear this Voice .
???:  For in every ending, not one has ever succeeded in saving anything.
???: Will this time be different? We do not know.
???: If this is your will, your wish, and the path you have chosen...
???: Then steel yourself... to leave everything behind.
Rover: What's wrong, Yangyang?
Yangyang: ...No. It's nothing.
Yangyang: Let's go, Rover. Together, we will...
Rover: End it. End it all.

metadata.subsection: Head deep into the Censure Court and confront Muyu

title: Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled
subsection: Venture into the depths of the Censure Court
content:
[Objective: Venture into the depths of the Censure Court]
Muyu: Oh? Having chased me here, did you enjoy this little game of pretend? And you—I wonder where you picked up that sickening habit of playing human.
[Dialogue Option]  I don't know how you've managed to control the Autopuppets...
[Dialogue Option]  But you'd better make them stop right now.
Muyu: No, there's no question that the Autopuppets are functioning exactly as they should. How could a mere mortal like me command the Sentinel's creations?
Yangyang: ...Liar. If not for your interference, how could the Sentinel's constructs ever harm the very people they were built to protect?
Muyu: Heh... Sentinels protecting humans... What an absurd delusion.
Muyu: Is it because they guide civilization? Because the Sentinels of Huanglong reign alongside humans? You're from Jinzhou, aren't you? Did that girl who became the Sentinel's Resonator feed you that pretty fantasy?
Muyu: We know nothing of the Sentinels. Not their design, not their internal structure, not where they obtained knowledge that eclipses all human understanding.
Muyu: Is "protect humanity" written into their core code? Has a single Sentinel ever confirmed it to you?
Muyu: No. That idea is rooted only in shallow experience, in the numbness of those who have grown comfortable under borrowed protection.
Muyu: Sentinels... Why do they guide us? And to what end? No one knows.
Muyu: You cling to this notion that they protect us, because of what? Because they have grown to "feel" for us?
Rover: ...And what if they have?
Rover: Every Sentinel I've met has sacrificed everything for the people under their watch.
Rover: You dragging their names in the dirt won't change that.

metadata.subsection: Venture into the depths of the Censure Court

title: Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled
subsection: Venture into the depths of the Censure Court
content:
Rover: You dragging their names in the dirt won't change that.



Muyu: Hah... "Feeling." If you want to say the world indeed walks on ice this thin...
Muyu: Then my work here is proof of how easily that feeling can curdle into carnage and suffering.
Voice of Reverberation: Kill... Kill all of you... Tacet Discords... Rot in hell...
Voice of Reverberation: Spare no one... Do not let any escape...!
Yangyang: Those voices...?!
Muyu: It took me two centuries to learn how to shape these useless passions into something useful.
Muyu: I have to admit, the process was not without its pleasures.
Muyu: I simply altered the perception (parameters) of these Reverberations. Redirected their rage. Not at the Tacet Discords, but at humanity itself. Then I installed them into the Autopuppets.
Muyu: And just like that, the protectors become the butchers. A single thread of foolish obsession is enough to shatter every line of logic, every careful protocol.
Muyu: Feeling... is this dangerous. The enemy of reason. The wellspring of chaos. Humans must learn to control it... No, to discard it entirely.
Yangyang: ...You're wrong.
Yangyang: When the ones we love are taken, and our homes are trampled... when a parent realizes they will never watch their child grow, or a peaceful soul is forced to pick up a blade just to survive...
Yangyang: Of course we grieve. Of course we resent. Of course we rage.
Yangyang: Humans are not puppets. From the moment we're born, we find our own "voice."
Yangyang: Whether it laughs or weeps, roars or wails... those voices make up the colors of this world.
Yangyang: But you... you twist them. Mock them. Treat them as tools. You will never understand what they truly mean.
Yangyang: You are nothing but a coward covering his ears! A madman worshipping his own delusions as truth!
Rover: You pride yourself on seeing through everything, but you're a greater fool than any you scorn.
Yangyang: And before this is over...
Rover: You will be eaten by the very "rage" you created.

metadata.subsection: Venture into the depths of the Censure Court

title: Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled
content:
[Objective: Defeat the Thousand-Puppet Pavilion]
Muyu: The simple addition of one superfluous thread, and the perfect guardian becomes a fearsome executioner in an instant.
Muyu: If the Sentinels protect humanity only because they "feel," then one day, one moment, one of them could "feel" differently and do the opposite.
Yangyang: You still don't get it, do you? You don't believe, that's all. So you're desperate to be right and lord it above everyone else.
Yangyang: What you have done... is not worth the breath it would take to refute it!

title: Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled
content:
[Objective: Attack the kernel]
Rover: Yangyang!
Muyu: These Reverberations have echoed in the abyss for two hundred years. Even now, their remnants serve my purpose.

title: Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled
subsection: Witness what happened in the past
content:
[Objective: Witness what happened in the past]
Muyu: Isn't it ironic that the very voices you resonate with and mourn for are burying you alive?

metadata.subsection: Witness what happened in the past

title: Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled
content:
[Objective: Navigate through the Reverberations]
Voice of Reverberation: Tacet Discords! Tacet Discords! You damned Tacet Discords...!
Voice of Reverberation: A hundred times... A thoudsand times... I'll keep killing you all!
Voice of Reverberation: Kill... Kill all of you... Tacet Discords... Rot in hell...
Voice of Reverberation: Keep attacking! Don't stop! Leave them no breath!
Voice of Reverberation: Spare no one... Do not let any escape...!
Voice of Reverberation: Damn you... Tacet Discords...
Voice of Reverberation: Must... Kill them... Every last one...
[Dialogue Option]  (Stay your hand.) Dodge the attacks of the Xuanfang Wardens

Muyu: Stopped already? Feeling pity for these Reverberations?
Muyu: Heh... So this is what your so-called "rage" looks like.
[Dialogue Option]  (Draw your sword.)
Bring release to the agonized Reverberations

title: Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled
content:
[Objective: (Cutscene plays)]
Weak Inner Voice: No... don't...
Weak Inner Voice: Please...
Weak Inner Voice: Kill... me...
Lingfang: I have nothing to offer you in return, so... I give you my song.

title: Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled
content:
[Objective: Defeat the Thousand-Puppet Pavilion]
Muyu: This... power...?
Muyu: I knew it. You truly are  special ...
Muyu: I failed to claim your Reverberation at the Skyworks, but it is not too late...
Yangyang: ...In your dreams!
Yangyang: You will never... toy with another soul again!

title: Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled
content:
Yangyang: ...In your dreams!
Yangyang: You will never... toy with another soul again!



Yangyang: Rover!
Rover: Yangyang, you look...
Yangyang: Everyone... entrusted their final voices to me.
Yangyang: Let's... guide them to the end, Rover.
Muyu: It's almost impressive that you two held your own against the Thousand-Puppet Pavilion for this long...
Yangyang: Two hundred years of Xuanfang's history breathes through us—
Rover: You face a will more powerful than you can imagine!
Muyu: ...Pathetic fools. You have guarded this Hold for over two hundred years, yet still you're blind to its fundamental nature.
Muyu: I am but a single step away from my "destination." Anything that stands in my way now is nothing more than a momentary diversion.
Yangyang: ...Everyone knows what this Hold means better than you ever will.
Yangyang: You climbed this high by trampling others beneath you—
Yangyang: You will never reach your "destination." Not today. Not ever.

title: Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled
content:
[Objective: (Cutscene plays)]
Rover: A puppet...?
Yangyang: Rover...
Yangyang: I...

title: Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled
subsection: Go to the Ministry of War and gain information from the Warden Commander
content:
[Objective: Go to the Ministry of War and gain information from the Warden Commander]
Qiuhong: Rover, Yangyang, you're here.
Yangyang: Commander Qiuhong, how's the situation now?
Qiuhong: Stable, mostly. But the list of work never ends. Rescue and recovery. Reorganizing the garrison. Caring for the displaced... All of it takes time.
Qiuhong: Liangyu has the makings of a leader, but she pushed herself to the brink of Overclocking to defend the Hold. She's currently at Huaxu Academy receiving treatment.
Qiuhong: We are simply too few... that is my concern.
[Dialogue Option]  And Paragon Qingxiao?
[Dialogue Option]  Where did that Sword Transcendent go?
Qiuhong: She has already departed for the Censure Court to purge the remaining Tacet Discords. But even she cannot be everywhere at once.
Yangyang: ...
Qiuhong: Still, we won a victory. We should take some comfort in that.
Qiuhong: It would not have been possible without you. I will see that your deeds are reported to the Mengzhou City Hall. Xuanfang and Mengzhou alike will not forget what you have done.
[Dialogue Option]  But Muyu is still out there.
[Dialogue Option]  Muyu remains a threat to us all.
Qiuhong: Mm, yes. The Ministry of War is allocating scouts to track him, but the man has lurked in Xuanfang for years. Between his knowledge of this land and his mastery of puppetry, the hunt will be difficult.
[Dialogue Option]  What about the Autopuppets he corrupted?
Qiuhong: All held at the Ministry of Development for observation. They are no longer hostile, but their state remains abnormal.
Qiuhong: The Artisans do not know how to repair them. They cannot even shut them down.
Yangyang: My new ability only restored the distorted emotions within them to their original state. It didn't purge the Reverberations from their kernels.
Yangyang: The lingering traces of hatred and grief are still jamming their systems. Perhaps only the Sentinel who created them can resolve this for good.
[Dialogue Option]  Then we take it step by step.
[Dialogue Option]  It seems we'll be staying a while longer.
Qiuhong: Now that communications with the outside world are restored, our Terminals should be back online.
[Dialogue Option]  We should let Baizhi and the others know we're safe.
[Dialogue Option]  Everyone must be worried about us.
Yangyang: Yes, I want to know how Chixia's recovery is going.
Qiuhong: Then I will leave you to your business. If any emergency arises, I will contact you immediately.

metadata.subsection: Go to the Ministry of War and gain information from the Warden Commander

title: Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled
subsection: Go to the Ministry of War and gain information from the Warden Commander
content:
Qiuhong: Then I will leave you to your business. If any emergency arises, I will contact you immediately.



Yangyang: Rover, let's find somewhere quiet to call Baizhi.
Yangyang: My voicemail is... wait. Ninety-nine missed calls?! Baizhi, Zhezhi, Taoqi, Suisui, Jianxin... even Magistrate Jinhsi called!
Rover: Everyone seems to be losing sleep over you.
Yangyang: Haha... It's going to take me a long time to call them all back...

metadata.subsection: Go to the Ministry of War and gain information from the Warden Commander

title: Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled
subsection: Call Baizhi from a nearby location
content:
[Objective: Call Baizhi from a nearby location]
Yangyang: Hello? Baizhi—
Chixia's Voice: Baizhi! Is that Yangyang?! Oh, finally! Yangyang! Rover! CAN YOU HEAR ME—
Zhezhi's Voice: CHIXIA, NO—! A-are you alright?! Miss Baizhi, Chixia just fell right out of her bed!
Baizhi: ...You're not fully healed, and you thought jumping out of bed was a good idea?
Chixia's Voice: You're one to talk, Baizhi! Weren't you just—Mmph!
Baizhi: ...Done? Good, back to bed.
Rover: Sounds like quite the scene over there.
Yangyang: Ahaha...
Baizhi: Well, you heard her. No need to worry about Chixia. A few more days, and she'll be bouncing around like nothing happened.
Baizhi: Yangyang, Rover, I don't know what you've faced in Xuanfang Hold these past few days...
Baizhi: But knowing that you are both safe is more than enough.
Yangyang: ...I am sorry. I made everyone worry.
Xiangli Yao: Don't blame yourself. Consider it a blessing to have so many people holding you in their thoughts.
Yangyang: Principal Investigator Xiangli...! You're there too.
Xiangli Yao: Yes, just happened by. Seems you two managed to find each other, Rover. Though... I hear you've stumbled into fresh trouble at Xuanfang Hold.
Rover: Mengzhou's Sentinel, Hsin the Moon Fox, has gone missing.
Xiangli Yao: Really...? I'm sorry that I can't personally assist with the investigation. But if you need help, contact Huaxu Academy at any time. Everyone here will do their utmost to help you.
Xiangli Yao: I should be returning to my lab. I wish you a swift and successful conclusion to this case.
Baizhi: Yangyang, Rover, what are your plans now?
Yangyang: Hmm...
Baizhi: Don't let Jinzhou weigh on you. Just focus on the problem at hand.
Baizhi: As for that... new look of yours, the explanation can wait until you've caught your breath. Best to wait until Chixia has fully recovered. Otherwise, the shock might land her right back in that hospital bed.
Yangyang: I understand. Thank you, Baizhi.

metadata.subsection: Call Baizhi from a nearby location

title: Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled
subsection: Wait until the call is over
content:
[Objective: Wait until the call is over]
Yangyang: Chixia seems to be alright. What a relief.
Rover: You'll give her quite the surprise when you see her next.
Yangyang: ...If I had it my way, I'd go back to the way I was.
Rover: A new look is just proof of a new journey.
Yangyang: Hm... perhaps you're right.
Qiuhong: Rover, Yangyang. When you have a moment, come to the Ministry of War.
Qiuhong: There is a call for you. From someone you both know well.
Rover: (Someone we know well? Could it be...)
Yangyang: I want to visit Liangyu at Huaxu Academy first. If you have things to do, Rover, we can meet at the Ministry afterwards.
Rover: All right, let's finish what's at hand and meet the Commander there later.

metadata.subsection: Wait until the call is over

title: Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled
content:
[Objective: Walk around the Xuanfang Hold]
Suisui: Hehe. Looks like Dumpling has taken a liking to you.
Rover: You seem cheerful.
Suisui: Oh this is nothing. If I really put my mind to it, I could make Xuanfang Hold every bit as lively as Mengzhou.
Suisui: Although I do like the feel of this place. It's less flashy, maybe... but the people are kind. Genuine. Is Jinzhou like that too?
Rover: Next time there's a chance, Yangyang and I will give you a proper tour of Jinzhou.
Suisui: Oh? And when exactly is this "next time?"
Suisui: I don't have my sister's patience. If you don't set a date, I'll have to assume I'm free to hijack your schedule whenever I please.
Suisui: Relax, I'm joking. At least until the dust settles here in Xuanfang.
Rover: Speaking of... why did you convince Hsin to give the token to me?
Suisui: Well... plenty of reasons. The Magistrate of Jinzhou told me a bit about you, so I knew you could handle a Sentinel's token.
Suisui: But you want to know why I "trusted" you so suddenly, don't you? Especially since I was keeping my deal with Hsin a secret from you before.
Suisui: Well, it's either terribly complicated or terribly simple... There's the respectable version, and the clever one. Which would you like to hear, darling?
Rover: I want to know your real thoughts.
Suisui: ...How blunt. But you should know a girl's thoughts aren't something you get to hear just by asking.
Suisui: Fine. The real answer is... I don't know.
[Dialogue Option]  ...You don't know?
Suisui: It's either that you have this terribly dependable sort of air about you. Or maybe it's just that you never try to be anything you're not.
Suisui: Trust can be a connection built over years, or it can be a single note that rings true the moment you hear it.
Suisui: For you, I think it was the latter.
Suisui: In other words, you have a girl's sincere trust. How does that sit with you? If it's too much, I don't mind taking it back, you know.
Rover: ...Thank you for trusting me.
Suisui: ...Oh, no need to thank me. Really, I've just saddled you with a rather enormous headache.
Suisui: But that promise you made? I'm holding you to it.
Rover: Should we draw up a contract?
Suisui: That's not a bad idea! We could even add a few extra clauses. Say, naming you as an honored guest of my Guild?
Suisui: As for what that actually gets you... Well, you'll simply have to visit me in Mengzhou to find out, darling.

title: Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled
subsection: Regroup with Yangyang at the Ministry of War
content:
[Objective: Regroup with Yangyang at the Ministry of War]
Yangyang: Sorry to keep you waiting, Commander. About the call you mentioned...
Qiuhong: No rush. I will patch you through now.
Jinhsi: Rover, Yangyang. Glad to see you both safe...
Rover: I had a feeling it was you.
Jinhsi: Hehe. I had planned to wait until Changli returned from Mingting, but I found myself growing a bit restless.
Jinhsi: I've already spoken with Commander Qiuhong regarding the current situation in Xuanfang Hold. Rover, I assume you intend to stay in the region to search for Sentinel Hsin?
Jinhsi: And you, Yangyang? What is your plan?
Yangyang: Now that the case is closed, as a member of the Midnight Rangers, I should follow military regulation and return to Jinzhou...
Yangyang: But, Madam Magistrate... would you allow me to stay here with Rover for a while longer? I know this isn't what a soldier should ask for...
Yangyang: But the Land of Xuanfang is still in turmoil. Many people here need help.
Yangyang: I know I'm only an Outrider, but there must be more I can do.
Jinhsi: Please don't sell yourself short, Yangyang. The power you now carry... Well, as my teacher Changli would say, "You are certainly a pivotal piece on the board."
Jinhsi: The bond you have formed with Xuanfang will eventually find its way back to this land in some shape or form.
Jinhsi: Therefore, I respect your decision. Commander Qiuhong, what are your thoughts?
Qiuhong: I could ask for nothing more. There are still countless Tacet Discords loose from the Censure Court. We are desperate for capable soldiers. Yangyang's abilities would be a great help.
Qiuhong: Yangyang, would you be willing to serve as a Xuan Watcher during this time? I believe Liangyu would be happy to hear it.
Yangyang: ...If it means I can help everyone, then yes.
Jinhsi: Then it is settled. I will speak with General Jiyan and arrange for your temporary transfer to the Xuanfang Ministry of War.
Jinhsi: Rover, I trust you to look after Yangyang on behalf of us here in Jinzhou.
[Dialogue Option]  We'll look after each other.
[Dialogue Option]  Wait for our good news.
Yangyang: Yes. And when that time comes, we'll bring everyone together for a celebration.
Jinhsi: A wonderful idea. We'll be waiting for you to come home.
Yangyang: Ah, it's you...
Rover: This little thing was a great help along the way.
Qiuhong: This Rafter Kite... I have never seen one quite like it.
[Dialogue Option]  You seem to know a lot about Rafter Kites.
[Dialogue Option]  It feels as though this one has a mind of its own.
Qiuhong: Rafter Kites were first crafted by local Artisans to honor the Xuanling Birds. Over the centuries, the designs have changed so much that many no longer resemble the original.
Qiuhong: But this one... by my estimate, was made at least two hundred years ago.
Qiuhong: The Artisan who made this must have seen a true Xuanling soaring through the skies.
Qiuhong: I can feel it. A deep, lingering... longing.
[Dialogue Option]  I could say the same of you, Commander.
[Dialogue Option]  Maybe it was made by someone who shared a deep bond with the Xuanling.
Yangyang: Or maybe it's more than just a simple Rafter Kite...
Yangyang: Either way, thank you... Your wishes are safe in my heart now.
Yangyang: Fly, little one. Fly to wherever your heart desires.

???: I have burdened you, old friend.
???: ...Is that so? It has been an age since we last witnessed a will and spirit as radiant as theirs.
???: If you find them worthy of your trust...
???: Then let this spark continue to burn. Just a while longer.

title: Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled
content:
Prism of Fate - A token created from Hsin the Moon Fox's own frequency. It contains part of the Sentinel's authority.
The Séance Society - A criminal organization that was once active in Jinzhou. It recruited a large number of members by promising the ability to reunite them with their deceased loved ones. With the intervention of you and Yinlin, the organization has since been dismantled.
Dollmaker - The leader of the Séance Society, formerly a disciple under Yinlin's parents.

title: Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled
subsection: Watch Yangyang and Chengmi duel at Xianling Village at
content:
[Objective: Watch Yangyang and Chengmi duel at Xianling Village at]

Yangyang: My steel can be unforgiving. Stay sharp!
Chengmi: Waaah... S-Slow down...
Yangyang: Oh...! Okay.
Chengmi: Err... I still can't see it...
Yangyang: You did well. Shall we call it here?
Chengmi: You're incredible. I couldn't land a single hit on you...
Yangyang: It's just luck, really... I still have much to learn myself. I don't have any special talent for swordsmanship. I've just spent a ton of time training. I guess I've at least picked up the basics.

metadata.subsection: Watch Yangyang and Chengmi duel at Xianling Village at

title: Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled
content:
[Objective: Watch again]
Chengmi: But... you knocked out most of the people from the Ministry of War all by yourself... Even Liangyu knows about it. She said once she's back on her feet, she absolutely wants to have a round with you!
Yangyang: Haha... Really? Well, I truly hope she has a speedy recovery.
Chengmi: Hehe, it'll definitely be a fun one to watch! You could even hold a tournament! Who knows, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs might already be getting tickets ready!
Yangyang: Hmm... I'm sure it won't be that big of an event... Right?

title: Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled
subsection: Talk to Yangyang at Xianling Village at
content:
[Objective: Talk to Yangyang at Xianling Village at]
Yangyang: Rover, you made it. Oh, have you had a chance to look around Xianling Village yet?
[Dialogue Option]  Already been around.
[Dialogue Option]  Not yet.
Yangyang: Liangyu offered us her house. She said we could stay as long as we need… I tried to turn her down, but she wouldn't hear it. So I ended up taking the keys.
Yangyang: Rover, I imagine you still need a place to stay. We don't know how long we'll be in Xuanfang, so whenever you need rest, the village is always open to you.
Yangyang: Everyone here is eager to meet you. They're already planning a welcoming feast for when Liangyu gets out of the hospital.
[Dialogue Option]  You seem to have really settled in here.
Yangyang: Think so... I'm not sure why, but maybe it has something to do with the Xuanling Birds. Everything here feels oddly familiar.
Yangyang: Everyone has been so warm to me. It reminds me of when I first arrived in Jinzhou.
Yangyang: Since I have taken on the role of a Xuan Watcher, I cannot afford to let Commander Qiuhong and the others down.
Yangyang: Wherever I am, what I need to do does not change.
Yangyang: Rover, it's the same for you, isn't it?
[Dialogue Option]  Yeah.
[Dialogue Option]  We'll be seeing each other all the time now.
Yangyang: ...That reminds me. I know it's a little strange, since we're in the same place now—
Yangyang: But could I still write to you? Some things only seem to find their way out when I put pen to paper...
[Dialogue Option]  Of course.
[Dialogue Option]  I would miss it if you stopped.
Yangyang: Mm. This time, I won't have to rely on Lollo Logistics. I can hand them to you myself.

metadata.subsection: Talk to Yangyang at Xianling Village at

title: Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled
content:
[Objective: Talk to Yangyang again]
Yangyang: Rover, what a coincidence. How has your day been? If you're tired, make sure you rest, alright?
[Dialogue Option]  (Talk about Muyu.)
Yangyang: Muyu… I have thought a lot about what he said. About the Sentinels. About emotion.
Yangyang: But no matter how long I turn it over in my mind, I still… cannot agree with a single word he said.
[Dialogue Option]  Following your heart is what matters most.
Yangyang: Mm. I hope you never lose sight of yours, either. That wish you have always carried, the one that matters most.
Yangyang: It must be something so precious that even losing your memory could not erase it. Your  truest self .
[Dialogue Option]  (Talk about the Xuanling Birds.)
Yangyang: Actually, a lot of people have come to me lately, hoping to see what the Xuanling Birds looked like before they disappeared.
[Dialogue Option]  You can summon them now, right?
Yangyang: Yes… and no. The Xuanling Birds you see now are formed from my Resonance power. Sometimes the Streams take that form as well, probably because of that power, too.
Yangyang: But if I leave, they fade away quickly.
Yangyang: The Xuanling must've lived alongside the people here for a very, very long time.
Yangyang: I hope one day, they can truly return to Xuanfang.

title: Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled
subsection: Talk to Suisui at Xuanfang Hold, Yuan's Flavors at
content:
[Objective: Talk to Suisui at Xuanfang Hold, Yuan's Flavors at]
Suisui: Oh? Rover? Well, hello there.
Suisui: I just wrapped up a deal with the local merchants and thought I'd finally get a breather. And then I spot you... What a lovely coincidence.
[Dialogue Option]  You've been busy.
[Dialogue Option]  I was hoping to run into you.
Suisui: Heh, I'm always happy to oblige.
Suisui: You know, after spending time here, I've realized Xuanfang Hold's got a whole different rhythm from the other market towns.
Suisui: Back in Mengzhou, trade routes snake through mountains and rivers. If something happens out there, having someone who can lend a hand is everything.
Suisui: So the folks back home don't simply trade in goods. They trade in "goodwill."
Suisui: Here, though... Efficiency's the name of the game. People want to know if a trade's solid. I've been chewing on it for a few days, and I think it comes down to what this place really is.
Suisui: This city holds and purges a staggering number of Tacet Discords, all to keep Huanglong safe. With that kind of responsibility, you can't exactly afford "good enough," or "we'll deal with it later."
Suisui: Freight, scheduling, supply chains... everything's got to be grounded and carried out practically.
Suisui: ...Oh, would you listen to me? Here I am, finally with you, and I'm still running my mouth about work...
Suisui: Rover, darling, will you sit with me? Have a bite?
Suisui: The fish soup here is divine. And I just so happen to have ordered an extra portion.

metadata.subsection: Talk to Suisui at Xuanfang Hold, Yuan's Flavors at

title: Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled
content:
[Objective: Talk to Suisui again]
Suisui: Supplies have been moving a lot smoother through the Hold lately. I was looking over the books a couple of days ago, and even the water routes are turning around faster.
Happy Merchant: That's right. Routes and timetables have gotten a lot more reliable. My shipment even arrived half a day early. Never thought I'd see the day.
Happy Merchant: And we've got more traders from other regions trickling in as well. Yuan's Flavors is busier than ever. Hard to get a seat these days.
Suisui: And is that such a bad thing?
Suisui: More people make a place livelier. And when the trade routes flow, the city's hearth burns all the warmer, don't you think?

title: Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled
content:
[Objective: Xianling Village]
Chutang: Don't worry, Liangyu is fine. She's just recovering at the Huaxu Academy.
Chutang: As for Yangyang, I hear she'll join the Xuan Watchers of Xuanfang Hold.
Miyu: Knowing that both of my benefactors are safe is a relief to my heart.
Miyu: It's just... The way Yangyang changed on the battlefield...
Geman: If you ask me, Yangyang is an envoy of the legendary Xuanling Bird!
Geman: Just look at her hair! There's no mistaking it!

Lilin: Is the person behind the incident still out there?
Ouliang: Yeah... The Ministry of War even put out a notice, asking anyone with information to come forward...
Lilin: An Artisan from Zhuojun Atelier... Wait, didn't your nephew land a spot there a few years back?
Ouliang: Ugh, don't even get me started... He hasn't been home once since then. He's basically cut himself off from the family...

title: Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled
content:
Ouliang: Ugh, don't even get me started... He hasn't been home once since then. He's basically cut himself off from the family...



Qingdai: Qingzhi... Don't worry, I'll take care of Qingyan...
Qingyan: Rest in peace, sis... Sobs...

title: Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled
content:
[Objective: Xuanfang Hold]
Storyteller: Hear me, good people!
Storyteller: Here upon the Land of Xuanfang, dark clouds once choked our Hold, and a heavy fog shrouded the earth.
Storyteller: The once-silent Autopuppets stirred without warning, preying on the innocent and plunging the realm into chaos...
Storyteller: And in that hour of peril, the Wardens stood their ground, and two extraordinary heroes rose to answer the call.
Storyteller: One bore eyes of burning gold and power beyond reckoning. The other, a lady in blue, cut through the fray like a Xuanling Bird riding the wind.
Storyteller: Side by side they fought, and together they brought the Autopuppet rampage to heel.
Storyteller: Yet, the true spark of this madness remains unknown, veiled in a shroud of impenetrable mist.
Storyteller: Whispers in the dark speak of a hidden mastermind... one whose strings may lead right to Zhuojun Atelier...

title: Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled
content:
Storyteller: Whispers in the dark speak of a hidden mastermind... one whose strings may lead right to Zhuojun Atelier...



Yuanxiao: Hmm? You're the hero who fought alongside Watcher Yangyang during the defense of the Hold.
Yuanxiao: If you're not in a hurry, care to chat? So much has happened lately.
[Dialogue Option]  (Chat about recent events.)
Yuanxiao: The Ministry of Development has been swamped lately. So many facilities and mechanisms inside and outside the Hold need repairs. Speaking of which...
Yuanxiao: I ran into Paragon Qingxiao on a job. When she stepped off her flying sword, I thought something was wrong, but she just stopped to ask me for directions.
[Dialogue Option]  What was she doing?
Yuanxiao: Probably wrapping up loose ends. With a "Transcendent" like her working on it, we can all rest easy.
[Dialogue Option]  (Chat about Yangyang and Suisui.)
Yuanxiao:Watcher Yangyang being reassigned to Xuanfang Hold has been one of the few pieces of good news these days. Folks all wanted to thank her in person.
Yuanxiao: One time, I thought I saw a Xuanling, a species of birds thought to be extinct, appear next to her... Or maybe I was seeing things after working too long?
Yuanxiao: As for Miss Suisui, I heard she arranged for the Commerce Guild to send a big shipment of emergency supplies to the Hold. The Ministry of Development also received a hefty stock of raw materials, too.
[Dialogue Option]  (Chat about Hsin the Moon Fox.)
Yuanxiao: When trouble broke out in Xuanfang, both the Ministry of War and the Ministry of Development sent people to the Sanctum. They couldn't even get through the door.
Yuanxiao: I've never seen the Sentinel myself. But my grandmother told me She gave her candy at a Waking Moon Festival when she was a little girl.
[Dialogue Option]  That's it for now.

title: Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled
content:
[Dialogue Option]  That's it for now.



Jiyuan: I hear you're the great hero of Jinzhou? What an outstanding talent. Why don't you sit and have some tea?
Jiyuan: I know a thing or two about the tales and history of the Land of Xuanfang. If there's anything you want to know, ask away.
[Dialogue Option]  (Chat about the origins of Xuanfang Hold.)
Jiyuan: The origins of Xuanfang Hold? Well, that calls for the "Legends of the Celestial" that have been passed down to this day.
Jiyuan: It is said that the Artisans who built Xuanfang Hold are still alive. Never left. They became "Celestials" who live as one with the mechanisms.
Jiyuan: Heh, it's only a story. I was fascinated by such legends when I was younger. Went around trying to prove them, but found nothing in the end.
[Dialogue Option]  (Chat about the history of Yuan Fortress.)
Jiyuan: Yuan Fortress... A mechanical fortress built by human hands over two hundred years ago. The blood, sweat and tears of our forebears went into its construction.
Jiyuan: If not for the Fortress and Gorges War, we'd still be able to see its majestic mountain gate today...
[Dialogue Option] (Chat about Zhuojun Atelier.)
Jiyuan: Zhuojun Atelier has many branches, with members spread across Mengzhou. I even had a disciple who joined them after leaving the Ministry of Development.
Jiyuan: Whenever disaster strikes in Mengzhou and rebuilding is needed, Zhuojun Atelier often sends people to help.
Jiyuan: They also fund water performer training and hold water performances during festivals. Their reputation among the people is quite good.
Jiyuan: That Zhuojun Atelier had anything to do with the turmoil in Xuanfang Hold... truly, I cannot imagine it.
[Dialogue Option]  That's it for now.

title: Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled
content:
[Dialogue Option]  That's it for now.



Shuoyan: Hey, Rover! I'm Shuoyan, remember?
Shuoyan:Your fight against the Thousand-Puppet Pavilion was absolutely breathtaking!
Shuoyan:Honestly, I was still a little confused even after your advice.
Shuoyan:But the moment I stood on that field with my comrades at my back, I finally understood what your words meant.
Shuoyan:The bonds of trust forged in the thick of it... You never forget it.

Hushen: We switched to using only human guards, and the workload has more than doubled.
Hushen: Now I regret not getting enough training. I'm so exhausted...
Tanqi: That's just the way it is now. Nobody knows when the Autopuppets might go haywire again, so we've got to do things ourselves.

Mingzhong: Mingkui. You're home now...
The Xuanfang Warden takes out a helmet covered in scars and slowly places it in front of the house.

title: Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled
content:
Mingzhong: Mingkui. You're home now...
The Xuanfang Warden takes out a helmet covered in scars and slowly places it in front of the house.



Yuanzhu: Ah, you're the young man who was with Watcher Yangyang. Please give her my regards.
Yuanzhu: I thought I wasn't going to make it through the last incident, and had Yangyang send a letter home for me.
Yuanzhu: A few days ago, I requested leave and went back to Mengzhou to see my wife and children. Being busy with work all these years, it was a rare reunion.
Yuanzhu: No matter how many letters you send home, nothing beats seeing your family in person.

Resident: With all that's happened in Xuanfang... Lady Hsin never even made an appearance...
Other Resident: Yeah... You think there's something even bigger going on over in Mengzhou City?

title: Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled
content:
Other Resident: Yeah... You think there's something even bigger going on over in Mengzhou City?



Weiyan: Sentinel above, please bless the Land of Xuanfang. Keep us safe.
Weixu: Grandma... The Xuanfang Wardens are the ones protecting us, not Hsin the Moon Fox.
Weiyan: Oh, my sweet Xu... We must show respect to the Sentinel. If not for Her, there would be no Xuanfang Hold as it is today. The Tacet Discords would have devoured our homeland long ago.
Weixu: But... Father, Mother, and everyone else... They're the ones who gave their lives...
Weixu: Everyone protected Xuanfang Hold with everything they had. Hsin... Why didn't She protect everyone?
Weiyan: The Sentinel... may be facing a problem only She can solve. She would never abandon Mengzhou or the Land of Xuanfang.

title: Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled
content:
Weiyan: The Sentinel... may be facing a problem only She can solve. She would never abandon Mengzhou or the Land of Xuanfang.



Resident: Any word from Mengzhou? After all that mess...
Other Resident: The Ministry of Development found out why communications went down. They're trying to call in reinforcements again.
Another Resident: How loathsome. I knew it was an inside job!

title: Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled
content:
Another Resident: How loathsome. I knew it was an inside job!



Tanjing: This garden of mechanisms... it is indeed captivating.
Dawan: But once the TDs are wiped out, Xuanfang Hold will be no more...
Dawan: Beauty fades from the mirror, blossoms fall from the tree. Nothing in this world can be kept forever. Xuanfang Hold is so exquisite, so wondrous... and yet it marches inevitably toward its own destruction.
Tanjing: Don't be so melancholy. At least Xuanfang Hold will fulfill its purpose first...
Dawan: Tell me, what do you think Hsin the Moon Fox felt when She built this magnificent, mechanized city, knowing it would one day be destroyed?

title: Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled
content:
Dawan: Tell me, what do you think Hsin the Moon Fox felt when She built this magnificent, mechanized city, knowing it would one day be destroyed?

Resident: You have to believe me, Doctor! I really heard a human voice coming from that Autopuppet!
Resident: A machine soul... Must've grown a soul, I tell you!

title: The Chant of Unseen Ties
content:
Wait for 2 Days
Read Huaxu Academy’s WavesLine message
Head to the Huaxu Academy
Explore deeper
Head to where it all began

title: The Chant of Unseen Ties
content: Quest Objective: After the Autopuppet crisis was resolved, the Huaxu Academy invites Yangyang to undergo another Spectrum examination. However, as Yangyang awaited the results, that mysterious voice finds its way to her once more...

title: The Chant of Unseen Ties
content:
[Objective: Read Huaxu Academy's WavesLine message]
Luoqing: Rover, about that data you sent over... I'm afraid the encryption on that Prism of Fate is beyond us. It's too sophisticated for our current tools.
[Choice]  That's alright.
(Rover): That's alright.
(Rover): Guess I'll have to track down the clues myself.
Luoqing: By the way, are you still with Yangyang?
Luoqing: Some personnel bandwidth has finally opened up at Huaxu Academy. Does she have any time to come by?
Luoqing: She seemed to have an Overclocking episode in that Censure Court. Both her physical traits and her Forte have changed significantly. According to the Ministry of War, she'll need to retake her Spectrum Test and Overclock Diagnostic.
Luoqing: Otherwise, we can't trust sending her out into combat.}}

title: The Chant of Unseen Ties
content:
Luoqing: Otherwise, we can't trust sending her out into combat.}}



Rover: Yangyang, Huaxu Institute is asking for you.
Yangyang: Yes, I know. I received their message as well...
Yangyang: Rover, I should go. It's only a routine Spectrum Test. Shouldn't take long.
Rover: ...How have you been feeling the last few days?
Yangyang: Well, nothing out of the ordinary... I'm still trying to get the hang of this new Forte.
Yangyang: I can undo altered frequencies and restore them... But which frequencies it works on, and how much I can actually undo... that, I still don't know.
Rover: (Yangyang's condition... This isn't a normal Second Awakening like Jinhsi's or Cartethyia's.)
Rover: (Should I bring her back to the Black Shores for a proper check?)
Rover: (No... that will have to wait until we settle things here in Xuanfang.)
Yangyang: Well then, Rover. I'll see you later.

title: The Chant of Unseen Ties
content:
[Objective: Head to Huaxu Academy]
Yangyang takes a series of tests under the guidance of Huaxu Academy researchers.
Luoqing: The test is finished. It'll take some time before the results come out. Please wait here for a moment.
Yangyang: Sister?
Suisui: I ran into Rover back in the city. He told me I could find you here, so here I am!
Yangyang: I see. I'm waiting for my Spectrum Test results.
Suisui: You know, when you came back with Rover, you looked so different it actually gave me a bit of a fright...
Yangyang: Haha... I'm not quite sure how it happened either. By the time I came to, the change had already happened.
Yangyang: But I'm still me. You don't need to worry.
Suisui: Well, you're certainly going to give Mother and Father a shock at the New Year's gathering.
Yangyang: ...It really has been a long time since I've been home. How are they doing? I wonder what Mingting is like now.
Suisui: I visited them recently. They're in wonderful form, as spry as ever. I heard they're even planning a little trip to Chongzhou next month.
Suisui: That's right... Mother told me to give you this. I meant to bring it to you in Jinzhou, but things got rather... complicated. It very nearly slipped my mind.
Suisui: This is for you, Yangyang.
Yangyang: This is...
Suisui: Don't you remember our family tradition, darling? When a child comes of age, the parents gift them a musical instrument.
Suisui: Ours chose conches for us. Whether that carried some profound meaning or was just a clever way to check the box, who's to say...
Suisui: Father picked mine out years ago. And this one... Mother spent an entire day walking the shoreline searching for the perfect one for you.
Suisui: Congratulations on becoming an adult, Yangyang.
Yangyang: I...
Yangyang: It doesn't quite feel real...
Yangyang: How much have I really grown since I left home?
Suisui: Enough that I don't think our parents would even recognize the woman standing before them.
Suisui: But in all seriousness, Yangyang, you might not be able to see it yourself...
Suisui: But ever since we reunited, as much as it stings my heart to admit it—
Suisui: My little sister has grown into someone who doesn't need her big sister to protect her anymore.
Yangyang: Suisui...
Yangyang: Suisui, no matter what, I'll always be your little sister. That's the one thing that will never change.
Suisui: Really? Hehe, that's certainly a relief! But I cannot help thinking there are some things you could stand to change, dearest...
Suisui: Say, those heartfelt things you wrote to me in your letters? Perhaps you might try saying them to the person they were actually meant for?
Yangyang: Suisui—!
Suisui: Alright, alright! No more teasing. Delegates from the Commerce Guild will soon be visiting the Four Chime Shaftpost. I need to discuss supply arrangements with them.
Suisui: Just remember to write home when you have a moment, won't you, Yangyang?
Yangyang: That sister of mine...
Yangyang: Mother...
Yangyang: They say a conch carries the sound of the sea within it...
Yangyang: ...
???: ...
???: So... you have finally made your choice...
Yangyang: You... You were in the Censure Court...
???: Come with me. I will take you... to where it all began.
Yangyang: ...

title: The Chant of Unseen Ties
content:
[Objective: Explore deeper]
???: Hurry up! Come on! Yangyang, Baizhi! We're almost at the Gorges of Spirits!
???: Slow down, Chixia. We're here to survey the terrain, not go sightseeing.
???: But Yangyang's Streams said a Tacet Field was forming here! If we don't hurry, what if some poor traveler gets stuck inside?
???: We're in the middle of nowhere. I doubt anyone would be out here—
???: Chixia, Baizhi, the Streams... They just brought back a new message...
???: Just ahead of us... Someone is...

title: The Chant of Unseen Ties
content:
???: Chixia, Baizhi, the Streams... They just brought back a new message...
???: Just ahead of us... Someone is...



Yangyang: Is this... the Gorges of Spirits?
???: He was the first variable. A "chaos system" that broke this world from a determined chain of cause and effect.
???: You could say your encounter with ■■■ was inevitable. Or you could say... it was a  miracle  unlikely to repeat in a billion iterations.
???: The fixed ending may have already collapsed. From here on, even I cannot see where the raindrops may fall.
???: But one wish I still hold—
???: That when this world welcomes its next dawn, hope will be born from that same light.
Yangyang: Who... Who are you?
???: ...The echo of a passing breeze.
???: Though... you have heard this Voice countless times before.
???: I am sorry. "I" cannot tell you more. Not yet.
???: ... No, Yangyang. Your journey (pilgrimage) will start soon. From this day forward, I ask only one thing of you—
???: Listen to the songs of the wind.
Yangyang: My... journey?

title: The Chant of Unseen Ties
subsection: Head to where it all began
content:
[Objective: Head to where it all began]
???: ...Hey, Yangyang, look! Somebody's over there!
???: His vitals are stable. He should be fine.
???: This is no place to linger. I'll go to the survey point to gather the data. Yangyang, Chixia, you two stay here and keep an eye on him.
???: Once he wakes up, meet me at ■■■■.
???: Understood. Leave the rest to us.
Are you... awake?

metadata.subsection: Head to where it all began

title: The Chant of Unseen Ties
content:
[Objective: Talk to Luoqing]
Yangyang: (What was that...)
Yangyang: (Strange... I only have a vague recollection of what I saw...)
[Dialogue Option]  Something wrong, Yangyang?
[Dialogue Option]  Why are you just standing here?
Yangyang: Rover?
Yangyang: ...It's nothing. I just spaced out for a moment.
Yangyang: Do you still remember the first time we met, Rover?
[Dialogue Option]  Of course.
[Dialogue Option]  I don't think I could ever forget that day.
Yangyang: You know, before you woke up...
Luoqing: Yangyang! Your examination reports are finally ready. Do you want to go over them now?
Rover: How do they look?
Luoqing: ...Normal. But very strange.
Yangyang: Compared to previous reports, my Spectrum Pattern looks nearly the same. So does my Rabelle's Curve...
Yangyang: Does that mean... nothing has actually changed?
Rover: But Yangyang Awakened a new Forte.
Rover: Technically, the results should show a resonance with the Xuanling Bird, shouldn't they?
Luoqing: That I don't know. But I do know the reports can't be wrong.
Luoqing: Xuanling Birds are Remnant Creatures that went extinct long ago, so it's simply impossible for us to compare their frequency with yours.
Luoqing: Perhaps the changes in your body are simply beyond what Huaxu's current testing methods can identify.
Yangyang: If even Huaxu Academy can't make sense of it...
Luoqing: Our tech is standard across the world. Even if you went to Mingting, the results would still be the same.
Luoqing: From what I've heard, only the New Federation has deeper research into Resonators than Huanglong. It is possible they would recognize what this is.
Luoqing: But for now, all your indicators are within normal range. The changes won't hinder your daily life or combat effectiveness.
Luoqing: Take these reports. You may report to the Ministry of War. Good luck out there, Watcher Yangyang.

title: The Chant of Unseen Ties
content:
[Objective: Talk to Yangyang]
Yangyang: I suppose we'll have to leave this matter for another day.
Rover: Are you really okay with that?
Yangyang: Yes. After all, we have more urgent problems to solve in Xuanfang Hold first.
Yangyang: Besides... you have your own fair share of mysteries too, don't you, Rover?
[Dialogue Option]  That is true...
[Dialogue Option]  It seems we share the same kind of trouble.
Yangyang: This power... Though I still don't fully understand what it is...
Yangyang: Now that I have it, I feel... like I can protect more people than I ever could before.
Yangyang: Perhaps, one day, I'll be able to...
Yangyang: No. I don't want this to be a "one day" wish. So I'll say it now.
Yangyang: Rover, I want to stand beside you. Sorrow or smile, stillness or storm... Whatever comes, I want to face it standing beside you.
Yangyang: If you're the wind that wanders, then let me be the bird that sails upon it.
Yangyang: My wings might not be strong enough yet. Maybe there's still a long way for me to go before I can truly keep up with you.
Yangyang: But this vow will never change. This feeling will be the beacon that guides me—

Yangyang: —Until the end of the world.

title: The Chant of Unseen Ties
content:
Coming-of-Age is a milestone for when a youth becomes an Adult.
In China, there is a coming of age ceremony called Guan Li (冠礼) for men, and Ji Li (笄礼) for women. Traditionally, it is common that men recieve the ceremony at 20 and women at 15, with 10 being the young and 20 the oldest for either gender. However, in modern times the tradition have changed to 18-20 as both genders now pursue equal education and careers.

content: Quest Objective: With the great battle over, the Land of Xuanfang is slowly returning to how it once was, though plenty of aftershocks have yet to settle. Then one day, a WavesLine message from Yangyang arrives out of the blue: Suisui is about to head back to Mengzhou City...

content:
[Objective: Read Yangyang's WavesLine message]
Yangyang: Rover, are you free right now?
Yangyang:
Yangyang:
Friend sent a nudge
[Choice]  What happened?
(Rover): What's going on? Did something happen?
Yangyang: My sister...
Yangyang: She's about to go back to Mengzhou City!
[Choice]  Isn't that a bit sudden?

title: Song of the Heart Sword
content:
[Objective: Go see Suisui off]
Yangyang: Suisui... are you sure you won't stay a few more days?
Suisui: Come now, don't give me that face, darling. When I'm gone, get plenty of rest, eat on time, and don't push yourself when things get hard. And...
Suisui: There you are at last, Rover.
[Dialogue Option]  Why didn't you leave a message?
[Dialogue Option]  I only just heard you're heading back to Mengzhou.
Suisui: Well, I meant to slip away quietly. I didn't expect Yangyang to catch me halfway.
Suisui: What, going to miss me already?
Rover: It's very sudden, that's all. Has something pressing come up in Mengzhou?
Suisui: Nothing major. It's just now that I've found my little sister, and she's grown strong enough to stand on her own, I can relax and return to minding the Guild's affairs.
Suisui: Moreover, I plan to make full use of the Guild's connections and channels to dig into Zhuojun Atelier. Into Muyu.
Yangyang: Muyu... He fled the last battle inside a puppet vessel. We still don't know where his true body is, or what he's scheming.
Yangyang: For now, I'll join the Ministry of War patrols around Xuanfang Hold to search for any sign of him.
Suisui: To think, that man sowed chaos on such a scale in Xuanfang, yet Mengzhou City Hall shows so little concern... Makes you wonder, doesn't it?
Rover: So you're going back to Mengzhou to try to find answers.
Suisui: I am. That's where I shine. You have bigger fish to fry. Like tracking down a certain Mengzhou Sentinel (Hsin the Moon Fox) I once made a deal with.
Suisui: She never told me where She was, but I've always had the feeling She was close to Xuanfang Hold. And wouldn't you know...
Suisui: The Elseway Shroud I entered before has appeared again.
Rover: The Sentinel is our best chance at understanding what's happening in Xuanfang.
Rover: You obtained Her token and saw her frequency at Fogveil Pagoda. If there are clues anywhere, they'll be there.
Suisui: Yes, you two chase down the leads here. I'll worry about Mengzhou. Divide and conquer.
[Dialogue Option]  Stay safe in Mengzhou City.
[Dialogue Option]  Be careful. This is bigger than it looks.
Suisui: Relax, darling. I am esteemed Chairwoman of the  Zhaoming Commerce Guild . The eldest daughter in a family of musicians. And... Yangyang's big sister!
Rover: I trust you, Suisui. But if anything happens that you can't handle alone, you need to contact us.
Suisui: ...I was really trying not to make a fuss.
Suisui: ...I grew far too fond of the time we all spent together. So before I leave, one last reminder—
Suisui: Take care of Yangyang. If you let her get lost... you'll have to answer to me.
Yangyang: Sister... I can hear you, you know...
Suisui: Well then, let's say goodbye now. One of these days, I'll give you both a proper tour of Mengzhou!
Yangyang: That qin music... I think I've heard it before.
Rover: ...It sounds expectant. Like the person playing is waiting for something.

title: Song of the Heart Sword
content:
[Objective: Enter the Elseway Shroud]
Qingxiao: Be on guard. Tacet Discords have escaped from nearby Censure Cages.
Rover: You must be... Paragon Qingxiao. We've met before.
Rover: But the siege at the Hold's gates didn't give us much time for introductions. What brings you here?
Qingxiao: A Rafter Kite guided me. I am searching for someone of great importance.
Qingxiao: You have come for Hsin the Moon Fox as well?
[Dialogue Option]  How do you know that?
Qingxiao: I know of your deeds in Jinzhou. Alongside  Jué  and the Jinzhou Magistrate, you resolved the Temporal Disruption on Mt. Firmament.
Qingxiao: That someone connected to a Sentinel should be at Fogveil Pagoda, a place tied to  Hsin , is likely no accident.
[Dialogue Option]  You know about Mt. Firmament too?
[Dialogue Option]  Guess I'm more famous than I thought...
Qingxiao: Do not trouble yourself. Few know the details.
Qingxiao: "Bloom Bearer," "Hero of Jinzhou," "Dark Thunderbolt," "Laureate," "Hero of Heroes," "Voidworm Rider"... These are the stories the  recorded in broad strokes.
[Dialogue Option]  ...Sounds like the Ministry of Foreign Affairs knows a little too much.
Qingxiao: I came seeking Her too, only to find many Censure Cages failing, and the fog meant to confuse Tacet Discords has dispersed.
Qingxiao: A nearby secret chamber stores the Sentinel's Relic. It may have been affected as well.
Rover: By "Sentinel's Relic"... do you mean something like this?
Qingxiao: It does resemble an ornament worn by Hsin.
Rover: Not long ago, Suisui met the Moon Fox in that very secret chamber and was given this .
Rover: Paragon Qingxiao, we're here for the same reason. Why don't we travel together? Watch each other's backs?
Qingxiao: I suppose we can.
Qingxiao: ...From now on, please just call me Qingxiao.

title: Song of the Heart Sword
content:
[Objective: Investigate the fallen Autopuppet nearby]
Qingxiao: No external damage. Unlike last time, it has not been corrupted by Reverberations.
Rover: Meaning this isn't one of Muyu's tricks?
Qingxiao: Yes, it seems they have simply shut down.
Rover: This should be the entrance to the secret chamber. Looks like... nothing's stopping us from just walking in.
Qingxiao: It seems whatever ward kept it sealed is no longer in effect.

title: Song of the Heart Sword
content:
[Objective: Head to Hsin's Chamber]
Abby: Hey, do you smell that? Something weird is nearby. Sniff, sniff... Huh?
Qingxiao: ...
Abby: Uuugh... Rover, she's lookin' at me funny!
Qingxiao: In all my travels across Huanglong, I've encountered many Tacet Discords and Echoes. Yet never one quite so curious.
[Dialogue Option]  This is my longtime partner.
Abby: Yessiree! So uh... hi there. Nice meeting ya, I'm Abby.
[Dialogue Option]  This one lives in my Tacet Mark. Big time foodie.
Abby: Big time what now? Anyway... hi there. Nice meeting ya, I'm Abby.
Qingxiao: Hello. Abby... I'll remember that name.
Qingxiao: There is no trace of Hsin nearby. She is not here.
Rover: The Prism of Fate isn't responding either...
Abby: Oh, I found where that smell is coming from. This way!
Rover: What's this...?
Abby: Its frequency is a lot like that weird-smelling Autopuppet kernel from last time.
Rover: Hmm, Suisui did mention an informant who met her outside Fogveil Pagoda before—
Suisui: ...If there were no hiccups, the  Cat of the Nether Lamp  should have made contact with Muyu by now.
Suisui: ...He is one of our people inside Zhuojun Atelier. But our cooperation with him has limits. Mutual limits. We don't even know his true name.
Suisui: ...Identifying traits? The Tacet Mark down his eye, a Qingfu (copper coin) pendant on his belt, and... an odd lamp that's always burning.
Suisui: The Guild's intelligence says a special spirit (Remnant Creature) is sealed within the lamp. That's where his   comes from.
Rover: If the informant wore a similar pendant, this didn't wind up here by accident. He likely left it on purpose.
Qingxiao: Hm, he likely did so because he anticipated that someone would come here soon.
Qingxiao: And those who come to this chamber are either connected to Hsin or seeking Her.
Rover: Then this may be a clue that's meant for us.
Abby: Mm... I don't get it. Why only a pendant? A note or a letter would've been a whole lot more obvious.
Rover: Could've been... that he had no time to leave a message, just something he carried on him.
Qingxiao: I have seen copper coins like this before. In Mengzhou's rural areas, many call them "Yin coins."
[Dialogue Option]  Yin coins?
Qingxiao: I know little beyond that. The people of Xianling Village should be more familiar with them.
Rover: Then let's go ask around Xianling Village. We don't have any other leads.
Rover: Once we understand its significance, we can figure out what this "Cat of the Nether Lamp" was trying to tell us.
Qingxiao: I will go with you.
Qingxiao: These disruptions in the ancient order are not trivial. If more Tacet Discords escape, the people around Shaftpost Yard will suffer first.

With the Tacet Discords eliminated, the villagers quickly gather around you.
Changluan: Whew... Thank you for saving us, Paragon Qingxiao. And... Ah, you're the great hero who helped the Wardens defend Xuanfang Hold.
Changluan: Never thought we'd see Tacet Discords around the village again. Times like these... we could really use those Autopuppets back.
[Dialogue Option]  Is something wrong with the Autopuppets?
Xinyuan: Well... ever since the last incident, there haven't been many working ones left around the village.
Xinyuan: They'll be standing fine one moment, then just drop the next. Even the Ministry folks couldn't fix them.
Rover: (...That sounds exactly like the Autopuppets we encountered back at the Pagoda.)
Changluan: These days, we rely on the Ministry's soldiers to keep us safe. But they're run ragged. Too much to do, not enough hands.
Qingxiao: Do not worry. The Four Chime Shaftpost has sounded. The Xuanfang Wardens will arrive shortly. I will brief them myself.
Xinyuan: With you down from the mountain, Paragon, we can rest easy. My mother, she never forgets your deeds. She even burns incense for you at home.
[Dialogue Option]  Burns incense...?
Xinyuan: Oh, that? She lights incense before the  Sword Transcendent's  spirit tablet. Prays for good luck and health. Some of the older folks believe in such things.
Rover: ...
Qingxiao: There is something I would like to ask you.
Rover: We'd like to know what this pendant means in Mengzhou.
Changluan: Hsss... those are no ordinary copper coins. The  Nethermancers  in Mengzhou carry coins just like that.
[Dialogue Option]  Nethermancers?
Changluan: Not a good place to talk. Too many ears... But word is, they're a lawless bunch. "Thieves," through and through.
Xinyuan: That's not really fair. Some say they are righteous wanderers, too.
Changluan: Hmph, if you want the full telling, go ask Granny Yanshu by the village gate.
Xinyuan: She's not a bad person, it's just... most folks in the village have their reasons for keeping a distance.
Qingxiao: I see. I will go speak with her.

content:
[Objective: (Optional) Listen to the villagers' rumors about Qingxiao]
Qinyan: So beautiful... First time seeing Paragon Qingxiao with my own eyes.
Qinyan: Grandfather and Grandmother were right. She looks exactly like the Sword Transcendent in the paintings.
Xiangwut: That's not the half of it. She's the master of the finest cultivation school in all the land.
Qinyan: Huh? What does the Paragon have to do with a cultivation school?
Xiangwu: Well, she is the master of the Xuanyuan School in the Eastern Xuan Peaks. The only  Perfected One  in all of Xuanfang. She has watched over this land for centuries.
Xiangwu: At the  Martial Arts Championship  a few years back, she was an honored guest. Many sect leaders even greeted her as their "Transcendent Elder."
Xiangwu: Why, even the great Daoist Master Jiufeng, with all his profound knowledge, sent his favorite disciples to her for guidance.
Qinyan: All I know is Paragon Qingxiao has been around since my great-great-grandmother's time.
Qinyan: But I've never heard of this Xuanyuan School... You didn't make that up, did you?

metadata.subsection: (Optional) Listen to the villagers' rumors about Qingxiao

title: Song of the Heart Sword
subsection: (Optional) Listen to the villagers talk about cultivation
content:
[Objective: (Optional) Listen to the villagers talk about cultivation]
Changshu: See that? That's what a true "cultivator" looks like.
Changshu: Growing both body and spirit. Being one with nature. Breathing the same breath as Heaven and Earth...
Yue: Grandfather, what are you even saying?
Changshu: When your grandfather was young, I read a few storybooks. Got it into my head to roam the great mountains, find a famous master, and become a cultivator myself.
Yue: Then why not ask Master Qingxiao to take you as her disciple?
Changshu: Hah. Paragon Qingxiao does not take disciples. In all these years, nobody has proved worthy.
Yue: Why's that?
Changshu: Cultivation takes a bit of talent, yes. But it takes an even steadier mind. To let nothing in this world disturb your inner peace… That, my boy, is a rare and precious skill.

metadata.subsection: (Optional) Listen to the villagers talk about cultivation

title: Song of the Heart Sword
content:
[Objective: Listen in to others conversations]
Storyteller: Ah... I was hoping to set up my stall and tell tales of the Fortress and Gorges War.
Storyteller: Now there's trouble in these parts again...

Resident: The Qing who wrote "Records of Huanglong Tacet Discords"... That's actually Paragon Qingxiao?
Resident: I would die for her autograph...

Resident: Bless me, Paragon Qingxiao. Let me pass the Ministry of Development's selection.
Resident: And Lady Hsin, bless me too, though it has been a long while since anyone laid eyes on You... Please, I beg you both, show your power!
Another Resident: ...I can't tell if you're superstitious or just trying to cover all your bets.

title: Song of the Heart Sword
content:
Another Resident: ...I can't tell if you're superstitious or just trying to cover all your bets.



Resident: Old Qian! I-I want to join the patrol. We all ought to do our part for our home.
Other Resident: Oh, you old fool. You're still nursing a bad leg. Don't go making trouble for everyone.
Qiankun: We should form a patrol team soon to help ease the burden on the Ministry of War.
Gaoyun: Quite a few of the young folks in the village have already brought up the idea. They're just waiting on your word.
Gaoyun: I'll get them together later. At least we'll be ready next time the TDs show up.
Qiankun: I'll join you. Say, remember that heavy downpour years ago?
Gaoyun: Of course. If the Rafter Kite hadn't brought Paragon Qingxiao at the time, us kids would've been swept away in the flood.
Qiankun: The village really owes her for her protection all these years.

Rover: This is...

title: Song of the Heart Sword
content:
Qiankun: The village really owes her for her protection all these years.

Rover: This is...



???: Ah... I thought there would be no need to send a Xuanling to trouble you.
???: But Bladepuppets alone could not hold back this tide of Tacet Discords...
Qingxiao: Evacuate the others. I will handle what remains.

title: Song of the Heart Sword
content:
???: But Bladepuppets alone could not hold back this tide of Tacet Discords...
Qingxiao: Evacuate the others. I will handle what remains.



Rover: ...?
Qingxiao: What troubles you?
Rover: The figure in that old portrait... is that you and a Xuanling Bird?
Qingxiao: Yes. It never could settle. Always pecking at my hair.
Rover: (If I remember right, Xuanling Birds have been extinct since the  two centuries ago...)
[Dialogue Option]  Paragon Qingxiao, may I ask your age?
Qingxiao: No need for formality. A Cultivator seeks to live long and see true. Age holds little meaning to me now.
Qingxiao: Besides... you are not the younger of us.
[Dialogue Option]  ...
[Dialogue Option]  ...How long have you been in the Land of Xuanfang?
Qingxiao: It has not been long. Just over two hundred years.
[Dialogue Option]  ...And that's not long?
Qingxiao: She has come.
Yanshu: Heh heh. An ancestor of mine left that painting a hundred years back. Said it would ward off evil and invite good fortune. Look at those colors, haven't faded a bit after all this time...
Yanshu: Oh, Paragon Qingxiao! You are here too. If I'd known, I would have prepared a pot of good tea.
Qingxiao: Please do not trouble yourself. We came to ask you about a pendant.
Rover: We found this inside Fogveil Pagoda.
Rover: The villagers said the copper coins on it have ties to Mengzhou's Nethermancers.
Yanshu: They do. They are "Yin coins," said to speak between the Yin and Yang (the living and the dead). Nethermancers carry them.
[Dialogue Option]  What exactly do Nethermancers do?
Yanshu: You have likely heard the ugly rumors. But in truth, they are a band of "old-world relics" who do not hold their own lives dear.

title: Song of the Heart Sword
content:
Yanshu: You have likely heard the ugly rumors. But in truth, they are a band of "old-world relics" who do not hold their own lives dear.



Yanshu: Since olden times, Mengzhou has had many places of strange fengshui where Reverberations gather. Left untended, they grow into Mirage Realms (Sonoro Spheres), and from them, Tacet Discords are born.

Yanshu: Nethermancers practice Vein Prospecting, the art of reading the land's hidden golden veins. Their trade is exploring Mirage Realms. It is an old, old craft.

title: Song of the Heart Sword
content:
[Dialogue Option]  Sounds like the Pioneer Association's work.
Yanshu: Hehe... Far less noble than that, I'm afraid. Nethermancers dispel Mirage Realms to stop disasters, yes. But also peddle the ownerless relics they find inside. That is the Jianghu way.
Yanshu: Their rules are loose, their ranks mixed. They walk where the dead walk, so misunderstandings cling to them like flies to honey.
Yanshu: There are fewer Nethermancers each year. Few in that line meet a peaceful end. My late husband, Sandao, was no different... He did not even leave me a keepsake.
Yanshu: Forgive me. I have drifted from the question. The pendant you asked about is a common token they carry.
Yanshu: It is a mark of reverence for gods, spirits, and the dead. In a Mirage Realm, such a token often serves a special purpose.
Qingxiao: Do Nethermancers always bring such pendants when they enter one?
Yanshu: Yes. Rarely do they go without.
Rover: (Then the reason he left it behind likely has to do with a Mirage Realm. The anomalies in Fogveil Pagoda may be linked to whatever he did.)
