Yanshu: Wait. This knotwork... I think I've seen it before...
Yanshu: Could this belong to... Jing? But how...?
Yangyang: Rover, Paragon Qingxiao!
Yangyang: A nearby Censure Court has stopped functioning. We need to evacuate these people to Xuanfang Hold right away.
Qingxiao: The Celestial Ring Formation...?

title: Song of the Heart Sword
content:
Qingxiao: The Celestial Ring Formation...?



(Cutscene starts)
It isn't safe here! Everyone, get to the Sky Pier at Shaftpost Yard!
I will buy us time.
(Cutscene ends)

Qingxiao: A few Tacet Discords slipped past the formation already. I will deal with them swiftly.
Rover: I'll go with you. We need to keep the evacuation route clear.
Qingxiao: Shaftpost Yard needs you more.
Rover: It'll be fine. Yangyang and the Wardens have that side covered.

title: Song of the Heart Sword
subsection: Eliminate the Tacet Discords in the sword formation
content:
[Objective: Eliminate the Tacet Discords in the sword formation]
Qingxiao: The Tacet Discords inside the formation have been mostly cleared.
Rover: To the Sky Pier, then. Yangyang and the others must be ready to set off.

metadata.subsection: Eliminate the Tacet Discords in the sword formation

title: Song of the Heart Sword
subsection: Head to the Sky Pier at Shaftpost Yard
content:
[Objective: Head to the Sky Pier at Shaftpost Yard]
Rover: Signs of evacuation everywhere. Most people have already left.

metadata.subsection: Head to the Sky Pier at Shaftpost Yard

title: Song of the Heart Sword
content:
[Objective: Ride on Motorbike]
Qingxiao: Your Cloud Ride...
Rover: What about it?
Qingxiao: The Ministry of War issued me one. I never could grow used to it.

title: Song of the Heart Sword
subsection: Help the Xuanfang Wardens eliminate the Tacet Discords
content:
[Objective: Help the Xuanfang Wardens eliminate the Tacet Discords]
Qingxiao: The Wardens holding the line need backup.
Rover: Let's go.

Rear Guard Soldier: Our thanks for the assistance. We'll regroup with Watcher Yangyang and the others straightaway.
Evacuating Civilian: Phew, thank you! Lucky for us you were here.

metadata.subsection: Help the Xuanfang Wardens eliminate the Tacet Discords

title: Song of the Heart Sword
subsection: Meet up with Yangyang and the others at the Sky Pier
content:
[Objective: Meet up with Yangyang and the others at the Sky Pier]
Yangyang: You're here! This is the last group of people. You should board the Skybarge too.
Yangyang: There are still plenty of seats inside. Enough for everyone.
Qingxiao: There's no need. I will ride escort from the sky, in case anything goes wrong.
Yangyang: Under the Ministry's contingency plan, Commander Qiuhong has already set up a receiving party for those who left earlier.
Yangyang: No time to waste. Let's go.

Outside the Ministry of War After the evacuation...

metadata.subsection: Meet up with Yangyang and the others at the Sky Pier

title: Song of the Heart Sword
subsection: Head to the Ministry of War
content:
[Objective: Head to the Ministry of War]
Abby: (Pheeew... We finally got everyone to the Ministry of War in one piece.)
Rover: You say that like you did it all yourself.
Abby: (Uh, I did stuff too! That kid's shoe? The old man's bag? Who zoomed into the middle of those TDs to snatch 'em back? Me, that's who!)
Rover: I know, I know. Everyone was quick on their feet this time. Soldiers and civilians both.
Abby: (Yeah, well, the same thing happened not long ago. Everyone has an idea of what to do now.)

metadata.subsection: Head to the Ministry of War

title: Song of the Heart Sword
subsection: Listen to others conversations on the way
content:
[Objective: Listen to others conversations on the way]
Artisan: Strange. The control kernel is completely intact...
Artisan: Looks more like it's been "shut down."

Xuanfang Warden: We really owe you for showing up this time.
Midnight Ranger: Don't mention it, brother. We're all here to defend Xuanfang Hold.

Medic: The warehouse should still have some medicine left. I'll fetch it.
Another Medic: I'll send someone with you. Tacet Discords could show up along the way.

Medic: The wound has been dressed. I'll have someone take you inside the Ministry of War to rest shortly.
Xuanfang Warden: When the Tacet Discords had me surrounded, I swear I saw a light coming off me...
Medic: Maybe you need more examining... you're starting to spout nonsense.

metadata.subsection: Listen to others conversations on the way

title: Song of the Heart Sword
subsection: Listen to others conversations on the way
content:
Medic: Maybe you need more examining... you're starting to spout nonsense.



Xuanfang Warden: Is it true that both the Skywatch Rings and the Mingshen System went down?
Another Xuanfang Warden:Yes, now we can only rely on Rafter Kites to scout the surrounding area.
Another Xuanfang Warden:Look on the bright side. At least this time the Autopuppets aren't our enemies anymore.
Xuanfang Warden: But the Autopuppets can't help us either. Setting up defensive lines is much harder than it used to be.
Another Xuanfang Warden:In any case, we're on our own now. Hop to it.

metadata.subsection: Listen to others conversations on the way

title: Song of the Heart Sword
subsection: Listen to others conversations on the way
content:
Another Xuanfang Warden:In any case, we're on our own now. Hop to it.



Xuanfang Warden: So, what did the Commander mean by "we must fall back, line by line"?
Injured Xuanfang Warden: Basically, we set up several defense lines around the perimeter, and put most of our manpower on the spots that matter most.
Xuanfang Warden: So it means... the area around the Ministry of War is our final stronghold?
Injured Xuanfang Warden:Ugh, if I hadn't gotten careless and let that TD swipe at me, I'd be out there helping build the defenses right now.

metadata.subsection: Listen to others conversations on the way

title: Song of the Heart Sword
subsection: Listen to others conversations on the way
content:
Injured Xuanfang Warden:Ugh, if I hadn't gotten careless and let that TD swipe at me, I'd be out there helping build the defenses right now.



Xuanfang Warden: The TDs were literally by our door back then. What were you doing rummaging through the home?
Xuanfang Warden: What could possibly be worth more than your life? What if you get left behind for missing the evacuation?
Resident: Ah, it's just an old habit I can't shake. Don't worry, I won't do it again.
Xuanfang Warden: Well, I certainly hope there won't be another evacuation...

metadata.subsection: Listen to others conversations on the way

title: Song of the Heart Sword
subsection: Meet up with Qingxiao at the Ministry of War
content:
[Objective: Meet up with Qingxiao at the Ministry of War]
Injured Soldier: Ngh... Mm...
Helpless Girl: He looks like he's really hurting.
Worried Mother: Is the pain from his wound keeping him conscious? What did the Huaxu medic say earlier?
Calm Father: The wound is dressed, and it will not worsen. But... we've no medicine for the pain. He must endure for now.
Worried Mother: A young man barely in his first posting... He threw himself in front of us. Took those strikes so we wouldn't.
Helpless Girl: Lady Transcendent, please help him. Can you?
Qingxiao: I will.
Injured Soldier: Ah... It's... Paragon... Qingxiao...
Injured Soldier: ...How pathetic. I've dragged everyone down again...
Qingxiao: You did well. Now rest easy.
Qingxiao: ...The pain will not trouble him for now.
Helpless Girl: Thank you... Thank you!
Qingxiao: Why do you not speak?
[Dialogue Option]  What did you just do?
[Dialogue Option]  That's a handy skill.
Qingxiao: It is only a simple Quietude Art. It can help induce sleep, nothing more.
Qingxiao: ...It cannot dispel their true pain.
[Dialogue Option]  You still helped him, though.
Qingxiao: Come. The Warden Commander is expecting you up ahead.

metadata.subsection: Meet up with Qingxiao at the Ministry of War

title: Song of the Heart Sword
subsection: Meet up with Qingxiao at the Ministry of War
content:
[Dialogue Option]  You still helped him, though.
Qingxiao: Come. The Warden Commander is expecting you up ahead.



Rover: How are things looking right now?
Qingxiao: The contingency measures have proved effective. Only a few were injured during the evacuation, and most Tacet Discords remain outside the Hold.
Qingxiao: Still, we have taken a heavy blow. Even with aid from other cities, we are short on supplies.
Rover: We can't let this drag on. Our priority should be to find the source of this disturbance.

metadata.subsection: Meet up with Qingxiao at the Ministry of War

title: Song of the Heart Sword
subsection: Meet up with Qingxiao at the Ministry of War
content:
Rover: We can't let this drag on. Our priority should be to find the source of this disturbance.



Qiuhong: ...The Hold's Autopuppets have all shut down. Even our defensive apparatuses, including the , have failed.
Qiuhong: Holding the main gate is no longer viable. We must fall back, line by line, and rally everyone around the Ministry of War. It is the sturdiest ground we have left.
Yangyang: Only a few Tacet Discords have slipped into the Hold so far. We still have time to set up our defenses... Ah, you're here.
Rover: Any word on what caused this incident?
Qiuhong: Our tally shows nearly three in ten Censure Courts have stopped cold. The Ministry of Development has yet to determine why. This is not a simple malfunction.
Yangyang: Earlier, while patrolling near the Skyworks with the others, we ran into a pack of Tacet Discords that had just broken loose.
Yangyang: We fought our way through and found a nearby Censure Court shut down. Autopuppets fallen all around. It was as if every mechanism... gave out at once.
Qiuhong: If anything could trigger anomalies of this magnitude, it would have to be...
Qingxiao: The Sanctum.
Qingxiao: It is Hsin's residence, and the control mainframe of Xuanfang Hold.
Qiuhong: Precisely. There may have been a change inside. Looking back, we overlooked something in our earlier operations—
Qiuhong: Tacet Discords and Autopuppets were not a concern within the Hold, so we assumed the Sanctum was safe. We posted only a handful of guards along the main approaches.
Rover: When the Ministry of War searched for Muyu's true body, did anyone search inside the Sanctum?
Qiuhong: Rover, you mean... Muyu...
[Dialogue Option]  He might be hiding inside the Sanctum.
[Dialogue Option]  He might be hiding in plain sight.
Yangyang: During the fight... Muyu hinted that his attack on Xuanfang Hold had another purpose—

metadata.subsection: Meet up with Qingxiao at the Ministry of War

title: Song of the Heart Sword
subsection: Meet up with Qingxiao at the Ministry of War
content:
Yangyang: During the fight... Muyu hinted that his attack on Xuanfang Hold had another purpose—



Muyu: ...Pathetic fools. You have guarded this Hold for over two hundred years, yet still you're blind to its fundamental nature.
Muyu: I am but a single step away from my  destination . Anything that stands in my way now is nothing more than a momentary diversion.

metadata.subsection: Meet up with Qingxiao at the Ministry of War

title: Song of the Heart Sword
subsection: Meet up with Qingxiao at the Ministry of War
content:
Muyu: I am but a single step away from my  destination . Anything that stands in my way now is nothing more than a momentary diversion.



Yangyang: He sowed such chaos. Threw lives away... just so he could clear a path to the Sanctum.
Qiuhong: During the Siege of Xuanfang Hold, all eyes were on the fierce battle around the main gate... The Sanctum could indeed have been infiltrated.
[Dialogue Option]  In any case, we should inspect the Sanctum.
Rover: We can't be sure yet, but too many signs point to the Sanctum: Muyu's escape. The Censure Courts shutting down. The Sentinel missing.
Rover: It may well be the source of this disturbance. If we're lucky, we might find the truth and some trace of Hsin the Moon Fox there.
Qingxiao: I will go with you. The Sanctum's mechanisms are intricate and ever-shifting. A moment's carelessness could make you lose your way.
Qingxiao: Hsin once received me there as a guest. I can serve, at least, as a guide.
Qiuhong: "None may enter the Sanctum without the Sentinel's leave" has always been the Hold's iron law. But now... we cannot afford to observe it.
Qiuhong: If the Mengzhou City Hall assigns blame afterward, I will bear full responsibility. Let them strip my rank again. It matters not. But...
Qiuhong: The city's fortifications are not yet finished. I must ask you both to stay the night and leave at dawn. We can't be too careful.
Yangyang: I'll see the rest of the preparations through with the Wardens. Come what may, we'll be ready.
Yangyang: Rover, you and Paragon Qingxiao should relax tonight. Prepare for whatever awaits you in the Sanctum.
Qingxiao: Then I will rely on you, Yangyang.
Rover: ...Qingxiao?
Qingxiao: I have preparations to attend to.

metadata.subsection: Meet up with Qingxiao at the Ministry of War

title: Song of the Heart Sword
content:
[Objective: Talk to Yanshu]
Yanshu: We meet again. Xuanfang has been anything but quiet this past while.
[Dialogue Option]  Are you all right?
[Dialogue Option]  I didn't see you when everyone evacuated.
Yanshu: Bless you, child. Paragon Qingxiao looked after me well, and the young lady Yangyang was a great help too.
Yanshu: You came at the right time... I've been thinking about that pendant. The knotwork looked familiar to me, like something my Jing would make.
[Dialogue Option]  Jing...
Yanshu: His full name is Jingran. Sandao and I raised him. He followed at Sandao's heels, learned what he could, and became a Nethermancer himself.
Rover: He's one too? Does the name "Cat of the Nether Lamp" mean anything to you?
Yanshu: Heh... What a strange Jianghu moniker. Jing never spoke of it, but it does sound like something he would dream up.
Yanshu: ...It has been years since I last laid eyes on him. He said he wanted to travel the world alone. But for six months now, pastries and money have been showing up at home every so often.
Yanshu: I told myself it must be one of Sandao's old friends. Now I see that the boy must've been sneaking home all along, just can't bear to let me see him.
[Dialogue Option]  If I run into him, I'll send word.
Yanshu: Thank you. I hope Jing hasn't caused you any trouble. It's late now. You should rest.
[Dialogue Option]  Yes, I will.
[Dialogue Option]  I will after I take another look around.

title: Song of the Heart Sword
content:
[Objective: (Optional) Look around the courtyard]
Yue: Aw... I lost the little picture book the big brother gave me on the road.
[Dialogue Option]  What kind of big brother?
Yue: I met him near the village half a month ago. He wore a hat and had a grin like a bandit.
Yue: But he was so nice to me! He shoved a picture book into my hands before he left. It was about adventurers in some old desert city.

title: Song of the Heart Sword
content:
[Objective: Listen to others conversations]
Resident: Those Tacet Discords would have had me if not for Paragon Qingxiao's sword formation...

Young boy: I wish Paragon Qingxiao could show me a few sword moves, then I wouldn't be afraid of Tacet Discords.
Young girl: I'd rather learn how to play the qin...
Young girl: I've been hearing her music a lot lately.

Elderly Resident: I spoke with Commander Qiuhong. We can start by organizing the villagers ourselves.
ElderlyResident: The Xuanfang Wardens need to focus on the defenses. Let's spare them the trouble where we can.
Another Elderly Resident: The Ministry of War doesn't have enough beds for everyone, so we'll need to set some up in the courtyard.
Elderly Resident: Same as last time. The elderly, the frail, and the wounded get indoors first. I'll be sleeping outside tonight as well.

title: Song of the Heart Sword
subsection: Find a good place to rest and prepare for tomorrow
content:
[Objective: Find a good place to rest and prepare for tomorrow]
[Dialogue Option]  (Open your eyes.)
Rover: (This is... the same music I heard after saying goodbye to Suisui.)
Rover: (No, not quite the same. This time it sounds... sad.)

metadata.subsection: Find a good place to rest and prepare for tomorrow

title: Song of the Heart Sword
subsection: Follow the sound of the guqin
content:
[Objective: Follow the sound of the guqin]
Rover: (Everyone else is asleep. But the qin is still playing...)
Rover: (I'm getting closer. Whoever's playing should be nearby.)

metadata.subsection: Follow the sound of the guqin

title: Song of the Heart Sword
subsection: Keep Qingxiao company in the pavilion until dawn
content:
[Objective: Keep Qingxiao company in the pavilion until dawn]
Rover: (So... it's her.)
Rover: Couldn't sleep either, I see.
Qingxiao: ...
Rover: So this is what you meant by "preparations."
Qingxiao: Yes.
Qingxiao: Through music, I can pass a wisp of my  Sword Intent  to another.
Rover: I saw that same light in Xianling Village.
Qingxiao: It is a sword without form, forged from my will. If danger comes, it will release Sword Energy to keep its bearer alive.
Rover: You're worried something may happen out here while we're in the Sanctum?
Qingxiao: If more Censure Courts fall, it is hard to predict what may happen. A few safety measures put my heart at ease.
Qingxiao: How are the wounded?
Rover: The Ministry of War has people looking after them. There's no need to worry.
Qingxiao: ...
Rover: We go to the Sanctum while the Wardens guard the Hold. Everyone agreed this was the best arrangement for now.
Rover: Just as they trust us to do our part, we should trust them to do theirs.
Qingxiao: ...Xuanfang Hold should never have come to this. As the Xuan Paragon, I cannot shirk my duty here.
Qingxiao: The recent chain of incidents started with an abnormal Tacet Discord reading in one of the Censure Courts. I was on the investigation team.
Rover: I heard... you stayed behind to cover the retreat so they could escape the rogue Autopuppets.
Qingxiao: ...That was exactly what Muyu wanted.
Qingxiao: He laid the trap. He split our ranks. He bet that I would go back for the soldiers dragged deep into the Courts.

metadata.subsection: Keep Qingxiao company in the pavilion until dawn

title: Song of the Heart Sword
subsection: Keep Qingxiao company in the pavilion until dawn
content:
Qingxiao: He laid the trap. He split our ranks. He bet that I would go back for the soldiers dragged deep into the Courts.



Specter of Muyu: Paragon Qingxiao. These Autopuppets cannot stop you. These Tacet Discords cannot defeat you. Even an entire Censure Court cannot bar your way.
Specter of Muyu: But... can the same be said of these Wardens? Frail. Trembling. Mortal.
Specter of Muyu: So, stay to protect the weak and be buried by endless enemies, or walk away and save the next battlefield? Your choice.
Specter of Muyu: Come to think of it, during the  Fortress and Gorges War , did our great Sword Transcendent not choose to send a group of soldiers... to their deaths?

metadata.subsection: Keep Qingxiao company in the pavilion until dawn

title: Song of the Heart Sword
subsection: Keep Qingxiao company in the pavilion until dawn
content:
Qingxiao: ...I know this was the best everyone could do. But... there may have been a better choice...
Rover: We've already made our choice now, haven't we?
Rover: Now we just have to see this choice through. The same way you always have.
Rover: Think of all the people who are still here because you stayed true to that choice.
Rover: Tomorrow, we finish the investigation as fast as we can and rejoin the others. Then no more worrying. Not about Xuanfang, or these impossible choices.
Qingxiao: ...Very well.

[Dialogue Option]  Wait
Rover: Was that... a taste of her Quietude Arts?

metadata.subsection: Keep Qingxiao company in the pavilion until dawn

title: Song of the Heart Sword
subsection: Meet up with Qingxiao at the Ministry of War
content:
[Objective: Meet up with Qingxiao at the Ministry of War]
Rover: (Daybreak already. Time to head for the Sanctum.)
Rover: (...I'll check in at the Ministry of War first.)

metadata.subsection: Meet up with Qingxiao at the Ministry of War

title: Song of the Heart Sword
content:
[Objective: Talk to Qiankun]
Qiankun: Paragon Qingxiao, {PlayerName}, I wish you both a safe journey.
Qiankun: As things stand, even Lady Hsin's residence may not be called safe. Do take the utmost care.
[Dialogue Option]  Take care, sir.
Qiankun: Don't worry. We have Ms. Yangyang and all the soldiers keeping watch. We'll be fine.
Qiankun: The Land of Xuanfang has weathered countless calamities, yet the will of our ancestors endures through the generations. I have faith that things will turn out for the best.

title: Song of the Heart Sword
content:
[Objective: Go meet up with Qingxiao]
Yangyang: Rover, did you get enough rest? Paragon Qingxiao has been waiting for you.
[Dialogue Option]  I did.
Yangyang: That's good. We don't know what awaits in the Sanctum, so conserve your strength.
Rover: Is everything all right here?
Yangyang: The surrounding defenses are complete. Many civilians volunteered to help. And another wave of reinforcements from Jinzhou just arrived.
[Dialogue Option]  So the Midnight Rangers showed up with backup.
Yangyang: Jinzhou answered at once, but recent activity from the Threnodian in the Norfall Barrens has tied down their main force.
Qingxiao: Ovathrax...
Yangyang: Only a small group could come, but they're elite Rangers. They will make a difference.
Yangyang: We can manage the Tacet Discords within the Hold. It's just... some strange mechanism parts have appeared nearby. Look—
Yangyang: It's like they spilled over from somewhere else into the Hold. The Ministry's Artisans examined them, and so far, they don't pose any danger.
Qingxiao: I will complete the Sanctum investigation quickly. Once the situation is clear, I shall return at once.
Rover: If things get bad, don't risk yourself needlessly.
Yangyang: Mm. You too. I'll hold the line with everyone. Xuanfang Hold will remain standing.
Qingxiao: Yangyang.
Qingxiao: This blade is shaped from my Sword Intent. It cannot break an army, but it should be able to protect you.
Yangyang: Paragon Qingxiao... Please come back safe, both of you.

title: Song of the Heart Sword
subsection: Listen to conversation between Qiuhong and the Elite Midnight Rangers'
content:
[Objective: Listen to conversation between Qiuhong and the Elite Midnight Rangers']
Midnight Ranger: By order of General Jiyan, our unit has arrived to provide reinforcements.
Midnight Ranger: We are in position and awaiting your orders.
Qiuhong: Long march. You have my thanks.
Qiuhong: The defensive line is set, but we're spread thin. Your timing could not be better.

Xuanfang Warden: Keep your eyes on the Rafter Kites. If there's a swarm of Tacet Discords headed our way, they will be our first warning.

metadata.subsection: Listen to conversation between Qiuhong and the Elite Midnight Rangers'

title: Song of the Heart Sword
subsection: Head to the Manifold Sanctum with Qingxiao
content:
[Objective: Head to the Manifold Sanctum with Qingxiao]
Qingxiao: These strange parts look as if the mechanism itself fell into a state of disorder.
Qingxiao: A few Tacet Discords are here too.
Rover: Let's make it quick.

metadata.subsection: Head to the Manifold Sanctum with Qingxiao

title: Song of the Heart Sword
subsection: Head to the Manifold Sanctum gate
content:
[Objective: Head to the Manifold Sanctum gate]
Rover: Just as I expected, it's locked tight.
Qingxiao: The Ministry of War has sent several parties here recently, and I came here as well, but there has been no answer from within.
[Dialogue Option]  It wasn't like this before?
Qingxiao: In the past, Hsin would send an attendant to receive those seeking an audience. If She did not wish to see guests, She would say so plainly.
Qingxiao: But now...
Rover:
Qingxiao: In that case—
Qingxiao: We break the gate open.
Rover: ...Wait, what?
Abby: Hey, that coin pendant you picked up is reacting to your Resonance Ability!
Rover: ...That door looks like a Mirage Realm (Sonoro Sphere) entrance.
Qingxiao: It connects to a passage. It may lead directly into the Sanctum.
Abby: ...So this coin pendant is the key?
Qingxiao: The one who left that pendant in the secret chamber must have foreseen that its finder would eventually seek out Hsin at the Sanctum.
Abby: Hmm... So that shady guy left you a side door into this fancy schmancy place on purpose. Where d'ya think he is now?
Rover: Maybe we'll find out once we're inside.
Abby: Bleh... It stinks in there. So, uh, if there's nothing else, I'm headed back. Yell if you need me!
Qingxiao: It appears we have no other path into the Sanctum. Let's go.
[Dialogue Option]  Well, here goes nothing.
[Dialogue Option]  Stay on guard after we enter.

metadata.subsection: Head to the Manifold Sanctum gate

title: Song of the Heart Sword
subsection: Head to the Manifold Sanctum gate
content:
[Dialogue Option]  Well, here goes nothing.
[Dialogue Option]  Stay on guard after we enter.



Manifold Sanctum Within the Sanctum, the mist swirls. The signs were there all along...

metadata.subsection: Head to the Manifold Sanctum gate

title: Song of the Heart Sword
content:
[Objective: Step through the mysterious gateway]
Qingxiao: A compact Mirage Realm created by Resonance Ability. And I see quite a few Reverberations around us...

title: Song of the Heart Sword
content:
[Objective: Head through the passage]
???: Give me a number. How many years of life to crack this passage open?
???: Half a year.
???: Hah... Greedier every time, ain't ya?
???: Take it or leave it. And keep your voice down unless you want him to find us!
???: Cough—
???: Oh, you rotten brat... Four months!
???: Deal.
Rover: Those voices...
Qingxiao: The Reverberations must have captured them not long ago.

title: Song of the Heart Sword
content:
???: Oh, you rotten brat... Four months!
???: Deal.
Rover: Those voices...
Qingxiao: The Reverberations must have captured them not long ago.



Qingxiao: Conceal your presence.
Rover: This fog... has Reverberations mixed in with it.
Qingxiao: ...Someone is here.
???: Well, well. Who dares trespass in the Sanctum?
[Dialogue Option]  You're...
???: Just a lackey on door duty.
???: Whew. No beating you, huh? I surrender.
Qingxiao: ...Muyu.
Muyu: Oh? Seems there's no need to bar your way. Catch me... if you can.
???: That's my cue.
???: Catch ya... in the underworld.
Qingxiao: They escaped.
Qingxiao: That man was testing your skill... Is he the Cat of the Nether Lamp?
Rover: I think so. Probably checking if I was worth working with. But with Muyu watching, he couldn't risk blowing his cover.
Qingxiao: Look ahead, Rover.
Rover: That's...
Qingxiao: The control mainframe. It governs every mechanism in Xuanfang Hold, great and small. Reverberations have already eaten into it.
Rover: Muyu used Reverberations to alter Autopuppet programming before. This looks like a similar trick.
Qingxiao: Then this is where the disturbances we're now facing began.
Rover: ...The Prism of Fate is flickering?

title: Song of the Heart Sword
content:
Qingxiao: Then this is where the disturbances we're now facing began.
Rover: ...The Prism of Fate is flickering?



(Cutscene starts)
...Careful!
Xuanfang Hold... is flying?
(Cutscene ends)

title: Song of the Heart Sword
content:
[Objective: Fall to the valley floor]
Rover: ...
Rover: (Did we fall all the way here from the air...? Why couldn't I fly with my wing?)
Rover: Qingxiao... Are you all right?
Qingxiao: Mm... Rover...
[Dialogue Option]  Are you all right?
Qingxiao: ...I'm fine. It happened so suddenly. The impact stunned me, that is all.
Qingxiao: We were still inside the Sanctum only moments ago. But now...
Rover: Can the Hold's structures transform into what we just saw?
Qingxiao: I have never seen such a thing.
Rover: I wonder if Yangyang and the others in the Hold were affected. We need to find a way back.
Rover: My Terminal won't connect... It looks like the signal got cut off.
Rover: ...Abby. Abby?
Qingxiao: This valley is no ordinary place. It may not even be real.
Rover: The Prism of Fate flickered, and we ended up here... Could this be something Hsin the Moon Fox is doing?
Qingxiao: Hsin's authority can cause all things to proliferate as fractal forms of themselves. It is not impossible.
[Dialogue Option]  You lost me.
Qingxiao: ...That is, she can make mechanisms multiply... or decrease.
Qingxiao: There are signs of fighting all around us, as if a great battle occurred not long ago.
Qingxiao: It shouldn't be like this...
[Dialogue Option]  Qingxiao?
Qingxiao: We should leave the valley and find open ground.

title: Song of the Heart Sword
content:
[Objective: Explore ahead]
Rover: More fallen Autopuppets. Wreckage from the Hold.
Qingxiao: Their condition is fresh... They were damaged in recent combat.

title: Song of the Heart Sword
content:
[Objective: Listen to the conversation]
Resident: Wait... Is that Qingxiao the Transcendent I'm seeing?
Resident: Heard there's always a Xuanling Bird next to her, but I didn't see one just now.
Another Resident: Maybe it wasn't the Xuanling Bird who asked her to come down the mountain this time?

title: Song of the Heart Sword
content:
Another Resident: Maybe it wasn't the Xuanling Bird who asked her to come down the mountain this time?



Scared Soldier: Besides us, did the Gorges of Spirits get hit by the TD Outbreak too?
Experienced Soldier: Yeah. Heard the Threnodian hit hardest there. Even the Crownless showed up.
Scared Soldier: Splitting up to hit both fronts and cut off communication between us. Crafty bastard.
Experienced Soldier: True. As long as the Gorges of Spirits are still in a mess, the Threnodian's gonna keep sending TDs our way.
Scared Soldier: If it weren't for the Cloud Shuttles, this battle would've gone a whole different way...
Experienced Soldier: Don't dwell on it. Truth is, you and I barely set foot out there, and it was nearly over.

title: Song of the Heart Sword
subsection: If players go the opposite direction from the Outgoing Villager greeting you.
content:
[Objective: If players go the opposite direction from the Outgoing Villager greeting you.]
Rover: I see people up ahead. Let's ask them about this place.

Outgoing Villager: Hello! Good morning, Sword Transcendent!

metadata.subsection: If players go the opposite direction from the Outgoing Villager greeting you.

title: Song of the Heart Sword
subsection: Talk to the villager greeting you
content:
[Objective: Talk to the villager greeting you]
Outgoing Villager: Oh, Sword Transcendent, you've come down the mountain! Some time has passed since your last visit.
Qingxiao: You are...
Outgoing Villager: We saw something fall from the sky in the distance, so we came to take a look.
[Dialogue Option]  That something was us, actually.
Outgoing Villager: Is that so... Can't say I've seen you before, sir. Are you from outside Xuanfang?
Outgoing Villager: Ah, I know. The Sword Transcendent brought you down in a  Cloud Shuttle  from the Hold, right?
[Dialogue Option]  What's a Cloud Shuttle?
Outgoing Villager: You've not heard of them? The great airships flying overhead. If they had not fought in the battle a while back, we'd have been done for.
Rover: "The battle a while back"? I don't recall seeing any of these Cloud Shuttles before.
Outgoing Villager: It happened about half a month ago. They said a Threnodian vanguard attacked. Tacet Discords blackened the land as far as the eye could see.
Outgoing Villager: We thought we were doomed. But then the Shuttles came down, all together. In one day and one night, they destroyed every last monster.
Outgoing Villager: That Threnodian was called Ova... uh... something. I can never quite remember the name.
[Dialogue Option]  ...Ovathrax.
Outgoing Villager: Yes, that's the one! Fancy name, sounded fierce enough. But in the end, the Shuttles and the Autopuppets still sent it running.

metadata.subsection: Talk to the villager greeting you

title: Song of the Heart Sword
subsection: Talk to the villager greeting you
content:
Outgoing Villager: Yes, that's the one! Fancy name, sounded fierce enough. But in the end, the Shuttles and the Autopuppets still sent it running.



Cheeerful Villager: If only I'd known sooner! I'd have brought my sister along. How often does one get to meet a Transcendent?

metadata.subsection: Talk to the villager greeting you

title: Song of the Heart Sword
subsection: Ask around among the nearby villagers
content:
[Objective: Ask around among the nearby villagers]
Cheerful Villager: The Sword Transcendent herself! What a surprise to see you here. Are you here to help someone?
Qingxiao: I would ask about "the great battle" that happened not long ago.
Cheerful Villager: Ah, I only know bits and pieces. Grandfather, Grandmother, and I were too frightened to leave the house for those two days.
Cheerful Villager: I heard two moons appeared in the sky above the Gorges of Spirits. And the rain was going up, not down.
[Dialogue Option]  Sounds like "The Day of Twin Moons" and Retroact Rain.
Cheerful Villager: Yes, Retroact Rain! People who came back alive said they saw phantoms of the past. Even family who had long since passed.
Cheerful Villager: The Cloud Shuttles and Autopuppets weren't bothered by that strange rain. After they cleared the Tacet Discords in Xuanfang, they went on to the Gorges of Spirits and destroyed the source of the outbreak.
Qingxiao: ...Is Yuan Fortress still standing?
Cheerful Villager: Sword Transcendent... Why do you ask? Yuan Fortress is fine, of course.
Cheerful Villager: Just follow this mountain road and you'll see it for yourself.

metadata.subsection: Ask around among the nearby villagers

title: Song of the Heart Sword
content:
[Objective: Head to the cave ahead]
Rover: Ovathrax, Retroact Rain, and the Gorges of Spirits... They're talking about the battle that occurred years ago.
Qingxiao: ...The Fortress and Gorges War, two hundred years past.
Rover: If their perception of events is true, then we might be standing in some kind of illusion.

title: Song of the Heart Sword
content:
[Objective: Head to Yuan Fortress]
Rover: That grand structure... Is it the gate to Yuan Fortress?
Qingxiao: A fortress built not with the Sentinel's wisdom or divine might, but by mortal hands.
Rover: Yangyang told me about it. A City of Mechanisms, built long before Xuanfang Hold. The Mengzhou Ministry of Development led it, and Zhuojun Atelier carried out the construction.
Qingxiao: Then you know what became of it...
Rover: Yes. It was destroyed in the Fortress and Gorges War. A last resort to stop the Tacet Discords.

Artisan: I came to Yuan Fortress to learn how Cloud Shuttles are manufactured.
Another Artisan: Well, not down here you won't. You'll need to find a way to go up there.
Artisan: You mean... on a Cloud Shuttle?
Another Artisan: That's right. You can apply for a Cloud Shuttle maintenance team someday.

title: Song of the Heart Sword
subsection: Ask the nearby people what's going on
content:
[Objective: Ask the nearby people what's going on]
Confused Young Man: That's odd... Why is the mountain gate closed?
Kind Old Man: Heh. You're not from around here, are you, lad? The gate is under repair. No one will be allowed through for a while.
Confused Young Man: Oh, I see. I came from Taoyuan Vale to visit my brother. He's an Artisan in the Fortress.
Kind Old Man: Taoyuan Vale? Heard it's about to become part of a new city. Soon enough, you'll all be calling yourselves Jinzhou folk.
Confused Young Man: It is hard not to feel something. We traveled such a long way from Hongzhen to Taoyuan Vale. Now it finally feels like home.
[Dialogue Option]  ...Jinzhou is about to be founded?
[Dialogue Option]  Are you talking about Jinzhou's founding?
Confused Young Man: Yes. The war is over. Mingting's decree has been proclaimed. Huanglong is soon to have its sixth city.
Qingxiao: Excuse me, if I may ask... has Xianling Village fared well?
Kind Old Man: Sword Transcendent, it has been some time since we offered incense to you. Please do not worry. When the Tacet Discords came, the whole village took refuge in Yuan Fortress. Every soul is safe.
Qingxiao: Then all is well.
Kind Old Man: If you wish to reach the Fortress, you will need to find another way. The mountain gate is closed today.

metadata.subsection: Ask the nearby people what's going on

title: Song of the Heart Sword
subsection: Go check out the mountain gate ahead
content:
[Objective: Go check out the mountain gate ahead]
Qingxiao: The elder's words were true. Yuan Fortress's gate remains closed.
[Dialogue Option]  Locked out again. Shocking.
[Dialogue Option]  You'd think doors would get tired of refusing us...
Qingxiao: This resembles Xuanfang from two centuries ago, yet history has taken a different course. The Fortress and Gorges War left no deep wounds, and Yuan Fortress still stands.
Qingxiao: It all appears so real... This is no ordinary Mirage Realm.
Rover: The villagers we met all seemed to know you. They called you "Sword Transcendent"...
Qingxiao: At this point in time, I hadn't yet accepted Hsin's request to serve as the Xuan Paragon. The "Sword Transcendent" title only came from an embellished tale.
Qingxiao: With the gate closed, we either detour, or—
[Dialogue Option]  Wait, you mean to break it?
???: Ahhhh—! That almost killed me!
Rover: Is that... an Autopuppet?
???: Eep...! Mercy! Mercy!
Jadie: I-I'm Jadie! I know I look suspicious, but please believe me! I'm here to help.
Jadie: If you want to uncover the secrets of this place, find a way to get to the sky.
Jadie: Look! The Cloud Shuttles are coming!
Qingxiao: So those are Xuanfang Hold's Cloud Shuttles.
Jadie: Yes! They're heading for the lightway that runs through the  Skyend Barrier , up into the higher sky.
[Dialogue Option]  Skyend Barrier?
Jadie: It may look like regular cloud and mist, but get up close and you'll see what it really is.
Jadie: To catch those Shuttles, you need to head for that lightway... Go through the Barrier to reach the Ren (Human) Realm...
Qingxiao: This one has stopped functioning completely.
[Dialogue Option]  A puppet that talks. That's rare.
[Dialogue Option]  It talks. Too bad it was all riddles.
Qingxiao: It laid out a route for us, at least... A fork nearby leads straight to that lightway.
Rover: As we were falling from the Sanctum, we saw Xuanfang Hold flying on those very Cloud Shuttles.
Rover: It could be lying or telling the truth. Either way, we need to see for ourselves.

metadata.subsection: Go check out the mountain gate ahead

title: Song of the Heart Sword
subsection: Set out for the distant lightway
content:
[Objective: Set out for the distant lightway]
Rover: Flying on a sword. And here I thought I'd seen everything.
Qingxiao: Sword Flight is not as rare as you think. I've seen Magistrate Jinhsi and her counselor both possessing the skill.
Rover: ...You know Jinhsi and Changli?
Qingxiao: Shortly after the Magistrate took office, Counselor Changli visited Xuanfang Hold for a Ministry of War conference on regional defense. That was where I first met her.
Rover: When all this is over, how about a few lessons?
Qingxiao: ...Teaching is not my strength. I once instructed a disciple of the Thunder Spells. She spent most of her time trying to escape.
Rover: Don't worry, I'll be the judge of whether your methods suit me. Plus, I trust you.
Qingxiao: ...As you say.

metadata.subsection: Set out for the distant lightway

title: Song of the Heart Sword
content:
[Objective: Head to the lightway]
Rover: When all this is over, how about a few lessons?
Qingxiao: ...Teaching is not my strength. I once instructed a disciple of the Thunder Spells. She spent most of her time trying to escape.
Rover: Don't worry, I'll be the judge of whether your methods suit me. Plus, I trust you.
Qingxiao: ...As you say.

title: Song of the Heart Sword
content:
[Objective: Charge for the Skyend Barrier]
Rover: The lightway is just ahead. Looks like this mechanism track will take us right up to it.
Qingxiao: This realm does not allow ordinary means of flight. Our fall taught us that.
Qingxiao: What lies ahead demands vigilance.

title: Song of the Heart Sword
content:
[Objective: Charge for the Skyend Barrier]
Qingxiao: There are the Shuttles again. They fly toward the lightway.

title: Song of the Heart Sword
content:
[Objective: Charge for the Skyend Barrier]
Qingxiao: Brace yourself. The lightway is just ahead.

(Cutscene start)
Rover: The power...?
Qingxiao: Here.
Qingxiao: Focus on the sword.
Qingxiao: Remember, will and sword as one, that the edge follows your heart.
(Cutscene end)

(Ren Realm) | (人境） Mountains and rivers unfold like a painting. White clouds drift by like a fleeting dream. The Cloud Shuttles that sail these skies seem destined never to rest.

title: Song of the Heart Sword
content:
[Objective: Explore the Cloud Shuttle]
Qingxiao: I've passed the fundamentals of Sword Flight to you through my Sword Intent. But to master it, you still need to practice.
[Dialogue Option]  Guess I'm a quick study, huh?
Qingxiao: You may credit your unique constitution and disciplined foundation in swordcraft.
Qingxiao: My  Heart Sword  technique is simple: keep an unshaken will, and your Sword Intent will cut through anything.
Rover: So, does that make me your disciple now, Qingxiao?
Qingxiao: ...

title: Song of the Heart Sword
content:
[Objective: Listen to the conversation]
Resident: My stomach just turns every time the Cloud Shuttle takes off...
Another Resident: Oh, I've got my own problem... I'm scared of heights. My legs are shaking already.
Resident: Spend enough time up in the air and we'll get used to it.

title: Song of the Heart Sword
content:
Resident: Spend enough time up in the air and we'll get used to it.



Seasoned Artisan: Pay attention. Stop gawking. You'll get tired of the view soon enough.
Curious Apprentice: Sorry, it's just the mechanisms are beyond anything I've ever seen...
Seasoned Artisan: You've been on this Cloud Shuttle for days now. How are you still acting like a rookie on their first day?
Curious Apprentice: Master, I was just thinking. If these mechanisms can already run themselves... then won't the repair crews be out of a job one day?
Seasoned Artisan: Hmph. "One day" isn't today.
Curious Apprentice: A fleet this massive... and all it takes to keep it running is a handful of people from the Ministry of Development and Zhuojun Atelier.
Curious Apprentice: All we really do is inspect them every day. If something breaks, swap in a spare part. That's it...
Seasoned Artisan: So? If you don't learn this craft, then when one of them does break down, you won't even know where to look.
Curious Apprentice: So we keep studying mechanist arts... and before we know it, the machines will have taken our place.

title: Song of the Heart Sword
content:
Curious Apprentice: So we keep studying mechanist arts... and before we know it, the machines will have taken our place.



Mowen: This large sphere... Is that the control kernel of the Cloud Shuttle?
Qingfang: Right you are. It's also the power source that propels the Cloud Shuttle during its flight.
Mowen: I can hardly imagine how it manages to support the Cloud Shuttle's operations. How does it even work?
Qingfang: I'm not entirely sure either. It must be one of those "miracles" of mechanist arts.
Mowen: What happens if it breaks down one day?
Qingfang: Don't worry. They've been around since forever, and I've never heard of any Cloud Shuttle's kernel having problems.

title: Song of the Heart Sword
subsection: Explore ahead to learn about the current situation
content:
[Objective: Explore ahead to learn about the current situation]
Qingxiao: Those Artisans ahead may know a thing or two.

metadata.subsection: Explore ahead to learn about the current situation

title: Song of the Heart Sword
content:
[Objective: Talk to Qingxiao]
Qingxiao: I would not have believed it if I had not seen it myself. The mechanist craft of these Cloud Shuttles surpasses even that of the Xuanfang Hold we know.
Rover: Still, you can see the Hold's influence in their design.

title: Song of the Heart Sword
subsection: Ask the Artisans what's going on
content:
[Objective: Ask the Artisans what's going on]
Friendly Artisan: Sword Transcendent? Why are you... If we had known you were coming, we would have prepared tea. And the young man at your side is...?
[Dialogue Option]  Just call me Rover.
Friendly Artisan: A pleasure. Welcome to Xuanfang Hold—or rather, to the Cloud Shuttle.
[Dialogue Option]  I'm the Sword Transcendent's very first disciple.
Friendly Artisan: Ah, so you are under her tutelage... That is why she keeps company.
Qingxiao: ...
Qingxiao: I remember you. You are Anyan.
Anyan: Indeed, I am. I was once with the Ministry of Development's Defenseworks. Now, I serve on the Cloud Shuttle's maintenance crew.
Anyan: Had you not held back the Tacet Discords when Yuan Fortress was first built, none of us would have lived to see Xuanfang Hold rise.
Rover: This is the City of Mechanisms built with the aid of Mengzhou's Sentinel, right?
Anyan: Sentinel...? Forgive me, but I don't quite follow.
Qingxiao: Sentinel Hsin, the Moon Fox. Isn't she the reason Xuanfang Hold and these Shuttles exist?
Anyan: Why would you also—Never mind. I shall brief you on the recent tidings.
Anyan: A  Transcendent  excelling in mechanist arts came to Xuanfang and taught us wondrous techniques. It was like learning how to turn stone into gold.
Anyan: Mountains, pebbles, pearls, rough stone—anything could be turned into a mechanism. And those mechanisms could evolve and replicate on their own. With that knowledge, the Ministry and Zhuojun Atelier raised this magnificent city in just a few months.

metadata.subsection: Ask the Artisans what's going on

title: Song of the Heart Sword
subsection: Ask the Artisans what's going on
content:
Anyan: As for the Shuttles, they were first tested in real combat two weeks ago.
Anyan: We were on board, yet we barely had to lift a finger. They hunted and exterminated the Tacet Discords on their own.
Anyan: And for the tight spots they couldn't reach, we deployed Autopuppets. Like soldiers falling from the sky, scouring the earth clean.
Anyan: In a single day and night, from Yuan Fortress to the Gorges of Spirits, the Threnodian of War's vanguard was reduced to nothing.

metadata.subsection: Ask the Artisans what's going on

title: Song of the Heart Sword
subsection: Ask the Artisans what's going on
content:
Anyan: In a single day and night, from Yuan Fortress to the Gorges of Spirits, the Threnodian of War's vanguard was reduced to nothing.



Anyan: Now, our Shuttles provide reinforcement across all of Huanglong. One fleet has already left for the Norfall Barrens, to protect the newly founded Jinzhou City.
Rover: ...I'd like to know more about this Transcendent.
Anyan: Strange thing is, none of us can remember his face. Or his voice. Probably another one of his mystical tricks.
Anyan: If you want answers, board the Shuttle at the head of the fleet. The Transcendent is staying there.

Qingxiao: A Xuanfang Hold with no Sentinel, but a Transcendent who preaches mechanist arts...
Rover: Whoever he is, he's probably connected to Muyu.
Rover: To the lead Shuttle, then. Let's see who's really pulling the strings in this shadow play.

metadata.subsection: Ask the Artisans what's going on

title: Song of the Heart Sword
content:
[Objective: Listen to the conversations]
Baijun: Never expected we'd meet on a Cloud Shuttle. How are things over at Zhuojun Atelier?
Huaihua: Can't complain. Lot more freedom than back at the Ministry of Development. Fewer hoops to jump through when you're doing research.
Huaihua: So what's this about, old friend? Here to check up on me for the Ministry?
Baijun: Don't be ridiculous. Up here on the Cloud Shuttle, we're all just maintenance crew. Nobody's keeping tabs on anybody.
Huaihua: Fair enough. Looking forward to working together again.

title: Song of the Heart Sword
content:
Huaihua: Fair enough. Looking forward to working together again.



Resident: Come on, spit it out. How did you get on board the Cloud Shuttle?
Another Resident: Well... I hide inside a cargo crate when the Cloud Shutter was refueling. Haha...
Resident: All right, I think you've seen enough. I'll have the Ministry of War take care of you once we land.
Another Resident: Wait, wait, please, ma'am. Can't you just let this one slide? I'll be gone before you even know it.

title: Song of the Heart Sword
content:
Another Resident: Wait, wait, please, ma'am. Can't you just let this one slide? I'll be gone before you even know it.



Yanwu: Back during the Fortress and Gorges War, these Autopuppets were like heavenly soldiers from the legends.
Yanwu: But the truth is, we know nothing about their internal structure or how they function. Is this technology we were ever meant to possess?
Yanwu: What would happen if one day they stopped helping us and instead became accomplices to some person or purpose instead?
Yanwu: Even the Cloud Shuttles themselves might... Ugh. Maybe all these sleepless nights are making me paranoid.

Resident: The scenery here is really breathtaking. And the breeze is so nice...

title: Song of the Heart Sword
content:
Resident: The scenery here is really breathtaking. And the breeze is so nice...



Xinzhi: I miss the braised pork from  Yuan's Flavors .
He'an: Sounds like you're just homesick.
Xinzhi: Homesick? Once the Cloud Shuttles dock at Yuan Fortress to restock, I'll be able to go home anyway.
He'an: Then why bring up braised pork all of a sudden? Are the rations finally getting to you?
Xinzhi: You know, I can barely taste a thing nowadays. Whatever I eat or drink... nothing.
Xinzhi: So... just thought the food at Yuan's Flavors might make a difference.
He'an: ...Truth is, I'm the same. For some reason, I feel like... I've just stopped feeling much of anything lately.

title: Song of the Heart Sword
content:
He'an: ...Truth is, I'm the same. For some reason, I feel like... I've just stopped feeling much of anything lately.



Resident: Say, which do you think is faster? The Sword Transcendent's flying sword? Or the Cloud Shuttle?
Another Resident: Probably the flying sword. The last time I saw the Sword Transcendent, she whizzed past like a beam of light.
Resident: Wait, wasn't that the Sword Transcendent just now?

Resident: The mechanisms run on their own anyway. A little extra rest won't hurt...

title: Song of the Heart Sword
content:
[Objective: Explore ahead]
Rover: Those Autopuppets over there... They look like they're guarding the Shuttle.

title: Song of the Heart Sword
content:
[Objective: Defeat the rogue Autopuppets]
Qingxiao: ...It seems we've been flagged as hostiles.
Rover: Then we'll just have to cool their systems down.

title: Song of the Heart Sword
content:
[Objective: Talk things over with Qingxiao]
Qingxiao: These Autopuppets show no signs of malfunction, yet they attacked us without hesitation.
Rover: We'll know if this was just an isolated glitch at the next Shuttle.
Qingxiao: The airflows between the Shuttles are remarkably stable. Perfect for Sword Flight.
Rover: You mean...
Qingxiao: Let's fly to the next one. Manifest a blade from your Sword Intent, then guide it at your will.

title: Song of the Heart Sword
content:
[Objective: Talk to Qingxiao]
Qingxiao: Your form is steady. You learn quickly. All you need now is more practice.

title: Song of the Heart Sword
content:
[Objective: Keep exploring ahead]
Qingxiao: As we suspected. The first attack was no isolated incident.
Rover: Does this mean... the entire fleet is turning against us?

title: Song of the Heart Sword
subsection: Talk over the situation with Qingxiao
content:
[Objective: Talk over the situation with Qingxiao]
Rover: This mechanism looks like your sword formation.
Qingxiao: Years ago, a Court of Savantae Artisan had me test a similar device designed to snare Tacet Discords.
Qingxiao: I do not know its inner workings, but I know how to break it. Strike the "core," the eye of the formation, with a flying sword.
Qingxiao: I will handle this side. You take the other.

metadata.subsection: Talk over the situation with Qingxiao

title: Song of the Heart Sword
subsection: Use the flying sword to undo the mechanism
content:
[Objective: Use the flying sword to undo the mechanism]
Qingxiao: All change in this world is but a shift in frequency. When you face an obstacle, find its pivot. Strike true and your blade will do the rest.
Rover: The way you describe martial arts is always a bit... quaint.
Qingxiao: ...What I mean to say is, these mechanisms can be dismantled with flying swords.

metadata.subsection: Use the flying sword to undo the mechanism

title: Song of the Heart Sword
subsection: Use Sword Flight to reach the next Cloud Shuttle
content:
[Objective: Use Sword Flight to reach the next Cloud Shuttle]
Qingxiao: Focus on the sword. I'm with you.

metadata.subsection: Use Sword Flight to reach the next Cloud Shuttle

title: Song of the Heart Sword
content:
[Objective: Explore ahead]
Qingxiao: This one is more intricate. You must locate all the cores.

title: Song of the Heart Sword
subsection: Examine the Swordlight standing on the ground
content:
[Objective: Examine the Swordlight standing on the ground]
Rover: This sword has a unique frequency.
Sense the Sword Intent

metadata.subsection: Examine the Swordlight standing on the ground

title: Song of the Heart Sword
subsection: Check the frequency on the nearby Swordlight
content:
[Objective: Check the frequency on the nearby Swordlight]

???: ...Are you the legendary Sword Transcendent from the mountain?
???: I am not the one you seek.
???: If not you, then who else could it be?
???: Please, Sword Transcendent. The Tacet Discords are coming! Can you help us? They roam the Clouded Cliffs and are almost at our village!
???: Lead the way. And your name is...?
Ruoyun: Ruoyun. Ruo as in "if," Yun as in "cloud."
Rover: What I saw just now, was it a memory from your past?
Qingxiao: Yes... that girl was the Court of Savantae Artisan I mentioned. She grew up in Xianling Village.
Qingxiao: When I first came to the Land of Xuanfang, the Xuanling Birds guided her up the mountain to seek my help. She returned often after that, though usually on behalf of others.
Qingxiao: But... why would I see Ruoyun here?

metadata.subsection: Check the frequency on the nearby Swordlight

title: Song of the Heart Sword
subsection: Use the flying sword to undo all the mechanisms at once
content:
[Objective: Use the flying sword to undo all the mechanisms at once]
Rover: (Looks like I'll need to form more blades with my Sword Intent to break it.)

Qingxiao: Well done. Leave the final core to me.

metadata.subsection: Use the flying sword to undo all the mechanisms at once

title: Song of the Heart Sword
subsection: Wait for Qingxiao to undo the last mechanism
content:
[Objective: Wait for Qingxiao to undo the last mechanism]
Rover: Qingxiao, you've been trying to teach me this whole time, haven't you?
Qingxiao: Was it that obvious? I told you, I'm not good at this.
Rover: Quite the opposite, actually. Come on, let's keep moving.

metadata.subsection: Wait for Qingxiao to undo the last mechanism

title: Song of the Heart Sword
subsection: Head to the next Cloud Shuttle
content:
[Objective: Head to the next Cloud Shuttle]
Qingxiao: The Artisans here seem completely blind to the rogue Autopuppets.

metadata.subsection: Head to the next Cloud Shuttle

title: Song of the Heart Sword
content:
[Objective: Defeat the incoming Autopuppets]
Artisan: Why did the barrier activate all of a sudden?
Autopuppet: No path found. Route, blocked.

title: Song of the Heart Sword
subsection: Use sword intent to break the mechanism
content:
[Objective: Use sword intent to break the mechanism]
Artisan: Thank you. I'll find someone to fix it later.
Artisan: Sigh, these Cloud Shuttle mechanisms have been glitching out constantly lately.
Autopuppet: Route unlocked. Begin patrolling soon.

???: Sword Transcendent? We didn't expect to see you here. This way, please!

metadata.subsection: Use sword intent to break the mechanism

title: Song of the Heart Sword
content:
[Objective: Talk to the rescued Artisans]
Shitang: That sudden rampage from the Autopuppets caught us off guard. It's like their alert systems just triggered for no reason.
Qingxiao: ...It seems only you two noticed what was happening.
Chigong: It's working hours. We can't just abandon our posts.
[Dialogue Option]  Is your job really that important?
Shitang: It's more like a habit. When we are assigned to a Shuttle, we tend to lose ourselves in the work.
Shitang: Though now that you mention it, more and more of us have been working around the clock. Some don't even know when to stop anymore.
Chigong: It is strange... My mind has been hazy for a while. I don't feel much of anything lately.
Shitang: That happened to me as well. I can't even enjoy a good novel like I used to.
Qingxiao: Have you met a certain Transcendent who teaches mechanist arts? Does the name "Muyu" sound familiar?
Chigong: Hmm... haven't seen anyone by that name, no. But we did host a Transcendent recently. Helped us solve a few technical hurdles.
Shitang: I can't remember much else about him... Only that he had an answer for everything. No airs about him at all.
[Dialogue Option]  We've been looking for him.
Shitang: I heard he's on the lead Shuttle now.
Shitang: If you are heading that way, could you check on a friend of mine? She's sitting at the bow, watching the scenery.
Shitang: She's been acting very strange lately. It's like she's lost interest in everything and everyone.

title: Song of the Heart Sword
content:
Shitang: She's been acting very strange lately. It's like she's lost interest in everything and everyone.



Rover: So... this Xuanfang Hold isn't as perfect as it seems.

title: Song of the Heart Sword
content:
[Objective: Talk to the other Artisans]
Artisan with a Headache: ...
Artisan with a Headache: ...Someone must've altered my memories.
Artisan with a Headache: Who exactly is controlling me to stay on the Cloud Shuttle?

Yixing: There's some bad news. You should probably brace yourself.
Jianghang: Just say it.
Yixing: Your sister's condition worsened not long ago. She's gone.
Jianghang: I always knew this day would come.
Yixing: Are you okay? It wasn't just anyone who died. It was the little sister you cared so much about!
Jianghang: ...I know. But right now, all I feel is emptiness.
Jianghang: Once the maintenance work is done, I'll return to Yuan Fortress for the customary funeral.

Artisan: Listen up, everyone, we're well ahead of the maintenance schedule for the day.
Another Artisan: Why's he talking to empty space...?

title: Song of the Heart Sword
content:
Artisan: Listen up, everyone, we're well ahead of the maintenance schedule for the day.
Another Artisan: Why's he talking to empty space...?



Resident: One hundred and thirteenth routine inspection...
Resident: Mechanisms functioning normally.
Resident: One hundred and fourteenth routine inspection... One hundred and fifteenth routine inspection...

Chiheng: Did I just... doze off?
Chiheng: ...I think I dreamed of a different Fortress and Gorges War.
Chiheng: In it, Tacet Discords swarmed toward Yuan Fortress without end, but there were no Cloud Shuttles or Autopuppets to save us.
Chiheng: All we had were Bladepuppets, city walls, and trenches. The defenses were shattered. So many people fell...
Chiheng: Guess I've gone too long without sleep. That must be why my mind conjures up such nonsense.

title: Song of the Heart Sword
content:
Chiheng: Guess I've gone too long without sleep. That must be why my mind conjures up such nonsense.



Kanghong: That lightway in the distance connects to a higher region beyond.
Shengxin: How do you know? Have you been there?
Kanghong: I don't quite remember, but yeah, I have been there.
Kanghong: The place's gloomy. The sky is nowhere near as clear as it is here. And they have so many Cloud Shuttles running as well...

title: Song of the Heart Sword
subsection: Go talk to the Artisan who's acting strangely
content:
[Objective: Go talk to the Artisan who's acting strangely]
Lianqing: ...
[Dialogue Option]  Are you alright?
Lianqing: I watched the sunrise earlier. My memory told me it was beautiful, but I felt nothing. Just emptiness.
Lianqing: I can no longer feel as a human should. It is as if I've become just another gear in this Shuttle's mechanisms.
Lianqing: What if... I jumped?
Lianqing: ...I will not, of course. But the thought does not trouble me. Nothing does.
Lianqing: ...
[You try to press for more, but she falls into a heavy, dead silence.]

metadata.subsection: Go talk to the Artisan who's acting strangely

title: Song of the Heart Sword
subsection: Go talk to the Artisan who's acting strangely
content:
Lianqing: ...
[You try to press for more, but she falls into a heavy, dead silence.]



Qingxiao: ...
Rover: What's wrong?
Qingxiao: I remember these people. Most of the Artisans on these Shuttles died when Yuan Fortress was destroyed during the war.
Rover: And they are only alive here because this Xuanfang survived it?
Qingxiao: Yes. In the world we know, the soldiers and Artisans defending the Fortress detonated it themselves. A final sacrifice to stop the Tacet Discords from overrunning Mengzhou.
[Dialogue Option]  Were you there when it happened?
Qingxiao: No. I was... with the defending troops in the Gorges of Spirits.
Qingxiao: By the time I returned to Xuanfang, the Fortress was already in ruins.
Qingxiao: If only I had been faster. If only this version of Xuanfang were real... everything could have been different.
[Dialogue Option]  What is done is done.
[Dialogue Option]  Don't lose yourself in a past that never was.
Rover: This can't be called a better world. Everyone we've met here isn't in a normal state of mind.
Qingxiao: Something is suppressing their feelings.
Rover: That "Transcendent" isn't just handing out lessons. I think he's done something to them.
Qingxiao: Mm. Onward, then.

metadata.subsection: Go talk to the Artisan who's acting strangely

title: Song of the Heart Sword
subsection: Head to the next Cloud Shuttle
content:
[Objective: Head to the next Cloud Shuttle]
Qingxiao: We can use this Shuttle.

metadata.subsection: Head to the next Cloud Shuttle

title: Song of the Heart Sword
subsection: Try using the mechanism to pilot the Cloud Shuttle forward
content:
[Objective: Try using the mechanism to pilot the Cloud Shuttle forward]
Rover: So this is how that Transcendent treats his guests, hm?

Qingxiao: Careful!

Rover: ...Nearly lost my footing there.
Qingxiao: Follow the airflows ahead. Navigate your sword to get closer.

Qingxiao: Keep your stance steady. These attacks cannot touch you.

metadata.subsection: Try using the mechanism to pilot the Cloud Shuttle forward

title: Song of the Heart Sword
subsection: Try using the mechanism to pilot the Cloud Shuttle forward
content:
Qingxiao: Follow the airflows ahead. Navigate your sword to get closer.

Qingxiao: Keep your stance steady. These attacks cannot touch you.



Muyu: At last, you arrive. I hope my little "roadblocks" weren't too much trouble for you.
Muyu: And where is that ignorant, chattering little girl? The strike she landed last time... It left an impression.
Qingxiao: I will grant you a swifter end this time.
Muyu: Easy now, Sword Transcendent. Surely you realize I am but a phantom.
Muyu: Why not stay for a chat? You must have questions. I would be disappointed if you didn't.
Rover: What have you done to the minds of the Artisans in this Mirage Realm?
Muyu: This is Xuanfang as I have shaped it. A better version of what stood here two hundred years ago.
Muyu: Those Artisans are shadows of the past. I offered them a kindness— adjusted their perception, excised their emotional flaws. Now they are on their way to becoming perfect.
Muyu: You should understand, Qingxiao. A heart unsullied by desire or feeling, is that not the ideal state you Cultivators chase?
Qingxiao: Cultivation is not about making oneself an unfeeling lump of wood.
Muyu: Lump of wood...? No, no. This is perfection. Xuanfang Hold as it was always meant to be.
Muyu: Everything you see runs itself. Perfect order. Perfect efficiency. With mechanisms like these, we could fight another Fortress and Gorges War and lose no one.
Muyu: I am sick to death of those "Hero Plays" about devotion and sacrifice.
Muyu: They stir the heart, yes. But that is all they do. The weak swallow them because the truth is too bitter to bear.
Qingxiao: You have no right to judge them, Muyu.
Muyu: Heh... I built Yuan Fortress. I understand the limits of humanity far better than powerful Resonators like you.
Muyu: When the Fortress fell, when our struggle meant nothing against the Lament, the one meant to "guide civilization" just stood there. Watching.
Muyu: The Xuanfang Hold you see now? This is what it was supposed to be. I just restored it from the blueprints in the database. Which is to say—
Muyu: It could have changed the course of the war. So what do you think? Did our Sentinel Hsin lack the power? Or... did She lack the will?
Rover: Suspect the Sentinel all you want. Your fall from grace is your own doing.
Rover: All I see is a coward hiding in a Mirage Realm, running experiments that are only fooling himself.
Qingxiao: Wherever your true body is hiding, I will find it. And I will end you.
Muyu: I look forward to it. There's just one thing...
Muyu: Where did you get the idea that this place couldn't affect reality?

metadata.subsection: Try using the mechanism to pilot the Cloud Shuttle forward

title: Song of the Heart Sword
content:
[Objective: Defeat the incoming Autopuppets]
Qingxiao: The fog disrupts the stability of our Resonance Abilities.
Qingxiao: Skywatch Lancers... Another Autopuppet series that never made it past the prototype stage.

Rover: You've seen these before?
Qingxiao: They were Ruoyun's work, too. She asked me to test them once, and I ended up shattering the prototype.

title: Song of the Heart Sword
subsection: Go check on the mysterious Autopuppet
content:
[Objective: Go check on the mysterious Autopuppet]
Jadie: Aaagghh! Those traitors are such big bullies! Lucky for me you showed up again! Thanks for saving me!
[Dialogue Option]  You're the one from Yuan Fortress...
Jadie: Yep. You two are so fast. Took me forever just to catch up to you.
[Dialogue Option]  Hello again, little riddle-box.
Jadie: Call me Jadie. That's my name now. You two are too fast. Took me forever just to catch up to you.
Qingxiao: The Fortress gate is indeed far from here. We thought you had gone offline when we left.
Jadie: Ah! I just ran out of juice. Lucky me, I woke up and found some spare power cells from the others. Then I flew all the way here!
Jadie: The sky here is split into levels. Right now, we're in the Ren (Human) Realm. Up there will be the Di (Earth) Realm.
Jadie: If you're after that creepy one‑eyed jerk, just keep heading up, up, up!
Qingxiao: Why is this Mirage structured in such levels?
Jadie: Because it's extra special! Don't worry, you're super close to the source of it all now.
Rover: You know things we don't, and it's clear you've been keeping them from us this entire time.
Jadie: ...If I could help it, I wouldn't want to be like this either.
Jadie: But I do have some bad news. Things are getting messy in the Hold outside.
[Dialogue Option]  You mean the real Xuanfang Hold?
Jadie: Mm-hmm. A lot of evil things are swarming toward it as we speak. If you take too long, things might get really bad.
Qingxiao: ...

metadata.subsection: Go check on the mysterious Autopuppet

title: Song of the Heart Sword
subsection: Go check on the mysterious Autopuppet
content:
Jadie: Mm-hmm. A lot of evil things are swarming toward it as we speak. If you take too long, things might get really bad.
Qingxiao: ...



Xuanfang Hold: Present At this very moment, things within the real Xuanfang Hold seem to have changed...

metadata.subsection: Go check on the mysterious Autopuppet

title: Song of the Heart Sword
subsection: Go check on the mysterious Autopuppet
content:
Qingxiao: ...



Xuanfang Hold: Present At this very moment, things within the real Xuanfang Hold seem to have changed...



Yangyang: Commander Qiuhong's Rafter Kites have detected a large Tacet Discord swarm approaching from the eastern peaks. All units, prepare to engage!
Yangyang: I will intercept the biggest threats. Vanguards, stick to the formation we practiced. Do not break ranks.
Soldiers: Yes, Watcher Yangyang!
Yangyang: Rover, Paragon Qingxiao... It's been so long...
Yangyang: Please, please come back safely.
???: Think I'd let you fight without me, Yangyang?
Liangyu: Watcher Liangyu, reporting for duty.
Yangyang: Liangyu? But your injuries...
Liangyu: Do not worry. My injuries have mostly healed. I was only staying at the Ministry of War because the medics insisted on quiet rest.
Liangyu: Word is, those roaming Tacet Discords have begun to close in on the Hold. I will not let you face this alone.
Liangyu: We will fight together. The new Xuan Triad... Well, duo, for now. I will not let Qingzhi and Duzhong down.
Yangyang: Yes. Shoulder to shoulder, once more.
Liangyu: The villagers... are they safe?
Yangyang: Don't worry. Even the final stragglers have been evacuated behind the defensive line.
Yangyang: Huh? What is that...
Messenger Soldier: Watcher—
Messenger Soldier: An urgent report from the Ministry of Development. Another Censure Court has just gone offline.
Yangyang: I see... Thank you.

metadata.subsection: Go check on the mysterious Autopuppet

title: Song of the Heart Sword
subsection: Go check on the mysterious Autopuppet
content:
Messenger Soldier: An urgent report from the Ministry of Development. Another Censure Court has just gone offline.
Yangyang: I see... Thank you.



Jadie: I know you're here to save the Hold. You don't need to trust me, but I'm trusting you.
Qingxiao: It is true your words have not been false.
Jadie: Please, Qingxiao. You both have to keep going.
Qingxiao: I never told you my name.
Jadie: I, uh—I heard that one‑eyed jerk say it. Ahem... anyway! Once you enter the Di (Earth) Realm, watch out for the .
[Dialogue Option]  The Reeling Fog?
Jadie: It makes your head all spinny. You ran into a bit of it earlier.
Qingxiao: Are you not coming with us?
Jadie: I'd just slow you down. But don't you worry! I'll catch up as soon as I'm ready!

metadata.subsection: Go check on the mysterious Autopuppet

title: Song of the Heart Sword
subsection: Head to the entrance of the Skyend Barrier
content:
[Objective: Head to the entrance of the Skyend Barrier]
Qingxiao: That's Cloud Shuttle wreckage scattered among the cliffs.
Rover: So, not as perfect as Muyu made it out to be. The next level is probably going to be a mess.

metadata.subsection: Head to the entrance of the Skyend Barrier

title: Song of the Heart Sword
content:
[Objective: Fly through the Skyend Barrier]
Rover: By the way, still no sign of that Cat of the Nether Lamp. But since he was at the Sanctum with us, he must've been pulled into this Mirage Realm too.
Qingxiao: If he has not blown his cover, he should be with Muyu.

title: Song of the Heart Sword
content:
[Objective: Continue forward]
"Cat of the Nether Lamp": (...Guess I'll just leave it here.)

title: Song of the Heart Sword
subsection: Leave a clue for that person
content:
[Objective: Leave a clue for that person]
"Cat of the Nether Lamp": (That's about all I can do for now. Time to go play nice with the crazy man.)
???: Are you sure they will find that little breadcrumb you left?
"Cat of the Nether Lamp": Sure? Nah. But you don't win bets by not playing. And so far, I'm on a roll.

metadata.subsection: Leave a clue for that person

title: Song of the Heart Sword
content:
[Objective: Pass through the Spirit Portal]
"Cat of the Nether Lamp": Yin Yang converge, Nether Qi surge. Spirits, stay hidden.

title: Song of the Heart Sword
content:
[Objective: Go meet up with Muyu]
Muyu: You've been gone for quite a while.
"Cat of the Nether Lamp": Not every day I get to hitch a ride on a fancy airship like this. Had to do a little sightseeing.
Muyu: Hmph. I'm interested to know what the Reverberations of the dead mean to a Nethermancer like yourself?
"Cat of the Nether Lamp": Still hung up on that? They're just lingering obsessions.
Muyu: To me, they are the raw materials of transcendence.  Resources  to be shaped as I see fit.
Autopuppet?: Where... am I...
Muyu: You are on a Xuanfang Hold Cloud Shuttle. Get acquainted with your new body. Go on.
Muyu: Before, I proved that Reverberations could influence an Autopuppet's behavioral logic. Now, I have gone a step further...
Muyu: Reverberations can drive a shell entirely on their own. Granting it new life.
"Cat of the Nether Lamp": Waking the dead from their nap? You sure they won't have a bone to pick with you?
Muyu: I have adjusted their perceptions. Scrubbed away the redundant emotions and petty desires.
Muyu: Trifles no longer trouble them, so they have no reason to care about things like that.
"Cat of the Nether Lamp": Not quite alive, and not quite dead. This really what you wanted?
Muyu: Progress takes time. For now, they are just the "intermediate products" of my experiment.
Muyu: Which is why I need a small favor... Dispose of that sample for me.
"Cat of the Nether Lamp": I agreed to help you out, Grand Helm's orders. I didn't agree to being your trash man.
"Cat of the Nether Lamp": ...How dull.
Muyu: Impressive. A necessary cost, nothing more. One must discard the defects to make room for perfection.
"Cat of the Nether Lamp": I guess you know that Rover and the Paragon have entered this Mirage Realm. Doesn't that concern you?
Muyu: ...That "fox" actually did us a favor.
"Cat of the Nether Lamp": Hah. Well, you'd better pray when they find you. I'm not sticking around to fight them.
Muyu: Guardians always suffer from the same delusion. They think that if they strike down the mastermind, the problem vanishes.
Muyu: But the end was decided long ago. Until the time is right, I shall let them play their little game.
???: (Boy. Why have me save the Reverberation from that broken puppet? Keeping it as a souvenir?)
"Cat of the Nether Lamp": (Just let it go. Same as always.)

title: Song of the Heart Sword
content:
"Cat of the Nether Lamp": (Just let it go. Same as always.)



(Cutscene starts)
(Di Realm) | （地境）
(Cutscene ends)

title: Song of the Heart Sword
content:
[Objective: Investigate the anomaly nearby]
Qingxiao: This must be the Reeling Fog Jadie warned us about. We shouldn't stay in it for long.
Rover: Do you hear that? The Autopuppets nearby are speaking.
Qingxiao: They are not hostile.

title: Song of the Heart Sword
content:
[Objective: Listen to the conversation]
Resident: Watch out. Something's not right. The fog... it's getting thicker.
Resident: Rogue Autopuppets... too many. Tacet Discords... attack.
Resident: Village ahead... No entry...
Resident: I... protect... village...

title: Song of the Heart Sword
content:
[Objective: Explore the area]
Qingxiao: These mechanisms have been corrupted by the fog, but our flying swords can still dismantle them.

title: Song of the Heart Sword
content:
[Objective: Examine the Autopuppet wreckage nearby]
Qingxiao: The cut on this Autopuppet is clean. It has not been down for long.
Rover: The frequency left on it feels like the Cat of the Nether Lamp's Resonance Ability. Probably his work.

title: Song of the Heart Sword
content:
[Objective: Look around]
Qingxiao: It is as if... they live here as people do.

title: Song of the Heart Sword
content:
Friendly Village Chief?: Thank you... breaking seal. Here... our village. I... Chief.
[Dialogue Option]  ...Well, I think I'm fluent.
[Dialogue Option]  Why is there a village in a place like this?
Friendly Village Chief?: We... have no home. We... gather here.
Qingxiao: It carries Reverberations, just like the Autopuppets Muyu controlled during the Siege of Xuanfang Hold.
Friendly Village Chief?: ...Seems I can speak normally now.
Friendly Village Chief?: Much has faded from my mind. But I remember being human. I lived in Xianling Village long ago.
Rover: Do you remember what happened back then?
Friendly Village Chief?: We fled back to the village during the chaos. Not long after, we were trapped by these strange mechanisms.
Friendly Village Chief?: Many villagers were left out there... If you leave, could you help them?
Friendly Village Chief?: Thank you. I just remembered... a young lass I did not recognize left a sword here. She said to give it to the outsiders who would come.
Qingxiao: Did she have any distinguishing features?
Friendly Village Chief?: Forgive me, I can no longer recall her face. Let me fetch the blade for you.
Qingxiao: ...Muyu implants the Reverberations of the deceased and binds them to these shells. Forces them to "live" like this.
Rover: Another one of his sick experiments. What he did in the Ren Realm... this goes much further.
Qingxiao: ...Huff.
Qingxiao: We should examine that sword. It is likely the one we have seen before.
Rover: You don't... look well.
Qingxiao: I'm fine. It will not hinder our mission.

title: Song of the Heart Sword
content:
[Objective: Explore your surroundings]
Qingxiao: The fog thickens. The anomalies here are worsening.

title: Song of the Heart Sword
subsection: (Optional) Use Sensor to check your surroundings
content:
[Objective: (Optional) Use Sensor to check your surroundings]
Rover: (They all have a flame‑like frequency, same as before. I'll use the pendant to reveal their true forms.)

Resident: Beloved. Cannot move. Waiting.

metadata.subsection: (Optional) Use Sensor to check your surroundings

title: Song of the Heart Sword
content:
[Objective: Talk to Waiting Villager?]
Waiting Villager?: The one inside it is my wife. While we were fleeing, she protected me.
Waiting Villager?: She can't seem to move anymore. But if I stay here beside her...
Waiting Villager?: Maybe one day she'll stand up again, right?

Resident: Nowhere to go. Village. Home.

title: Song of the Heart Sword
content:
[Objective: Talk to Gathered Villager?]
Gathered Villager?: We "woke up" one by one. None of us could remember where we were supposed to go.
Gathered Villager?: But we knew one thing: we were different from those Autopuppets that only follow orders.
Gathered Villager?: Slowly, we gathered here... hoping to live normal lives again, like before.
Gathered Villager?: This place is our base, our village, and our new home. We won't let it be taken from us.

Resident: Everyone's safety. Must protect.

title: Song of the Heart Sword
content:
[Objective: Talk to Comtemplating Villager?]
Comtemplating Villager?: The village chief did not tell you, but... it was me. I am the one who set off the seal to close off our village.
Comtemplating Villager?: I only meant to keep those Autopuppets out. But the fog corrupted the mechanism. Now it will never shut off.
Comtemplating Villager?: We live again... but so many were left outside. Did I do the wrong thing?
[Dialogue Option]  This isn't a simple matter of right or wrong.
Comtemplating Villager?: I have been thinking about it all this time. I have not found an answer. If none of this had happened, maybe we could have gone on living in these bodies. Peacefully.
[Dialogue Option]  The one at fault is the man who sent the Autopuppets.
Comtemplating Villager?: ...Thank you. I understand now. No matter what, I should apologize to the dead.
[Dialogue Option]  You were wrong.
