Comtemplating Villager?: Thank you. An answer, even a hard one, is better than being stuck ruminating forever. I will go apologize to the dead.

title: Song of the Heart Sword
subsection: Feel the Sword Intent in the sword
content:
[Objective: Feel the Sword Intent in the sword]
Qingxiao: Its frequency resembled my own Sword Intent...

Swordlight Projection

metadata.subsection: Feel the Sword Intent in the sword

title: Song of the Heart Sword
subsection: Feel the Sword Intent in the sword
content:
[Objective: Feel the Sword Intent in the sword]
Ruoyun of the Past: Sword Transcendent, I have come to bid you farewell. It was Lingfang who finally convinced me to do this.
Qingxiao of the Past: Where are you going?
Ruoyun of the Past: I am staying in Xuanfang Hold. The construction is nearing completion. I just... wanted you to know.
Ruoyun of the Past: I love this land. I love the people here. I want to use my mechanisms to give everyone the strength to protect themselves.
Ruoyun of the Past: That way... I will not have to keep sending Xuanling Birds to beg for your help.
Ruoyun of the Past: I have a question. If you spend your life chasing a goal so difficult that it has already cost you dearly, is it still worth it?
Qingxiao of the Past: ...I cannot answer that for you.
Ruoyun of the Past: That's alright. I have plenty of time ahead of me to think about it.
Ruoyun of the Past: Farewell... Qingxiao.
Qingxiao: What you saw just now was the day Ruoyun came to say goodbye.
Rover: Where did she go after that?
Qingxiao: The Fortress and Gorges War broke out soon after. She was in the squad tasked with the Fortress's self-destruction.
Qingxiao: Later, I returned to the ruins to search for her... I found nothing.

metadata.subsection: Feel the Sword Intent in the sword

title: Song of the Heart Sword
content:
[Objective: Leave the "Autopuppet village"]
Qingxiao: ...Onward. We should be able to break this seal together.
Qingxiao: Well done.

title: Song of the Heart Sword
subsection: Eliminate the rogue Autopuppets and rescue the "villagers"
content:
[Objective: Eliminate the rogue Autopuppets and rescue the "villagers"]
Rover: Autopuppets are attacking those "villagers." We should help them.

title: Song of the Heart Sword
subsection: Talk to the "villagers" in the Netherworld Domain
content:
[Objective: Talk to the "villagers" in the Netherworld Domain]
Composed Soldier?: Thank you. Some friends... they are trapped on the Shuttle ahead.
Composed Soldier?: Something went wrong with the Shuttle's mechanisms. It sent the Autopuppets into a blind rampage... we couldn't stop them.
[Dialogue Option]  We'll handle things there.
Composed Soldier?: You are from the world outside, aren't you? How is Yuan Fortress now?
Qingxiao: ...What do you mean?
Composed Soldier?: I... I remember defending that Fortress. So many of us... we did our best. But the Tacet Discords were endless. Tell me... did we lose?
Qingxiao: You did not. It was your sacrifice that ensured two centuries of peace for Xuanfang.
Composed Soldier?: That's good... Somehow, my chest does not feel quite so empty.

metadata.subsection: Talk to the "villagers" in the Netherworld Domain

title: Song of the Heart Sword
content:
[Objective: (Optional) Rescue the trapped "villagers"]
Trapped Kid?: Why... why did you save me?
Trapped Kid?: I can move now. But... I don't know where I should go...

title: Song of the Heart Sword
content:
[Objective: Keep going]
Rover: There are no Reverberations bound to the Autopuppets that attacked the villagers.
Qingxiao: Muyu must have been controlling them directly, just as he did back in the Ren Realm.

title: Song of the Heart Sword
subsection: Examine the book someone appears to have left behind
content:
[Objective: Examine the book someone appears to have left behind]

This appears to be a novel titled  Mirage Seeker's Tales , with a cover illustrated of a lamp that seems oddly familiar.

The cover is rather clean, suggesting this book was left here not long ago. The author's name reads... Cat of the Nether Lamp.

There is a cutout in the upper right corner of the cover. Judging by its size and shape, it appears to have been designed to fit exactly one Yin coin.

On the back of the novel are two columns of small text. The first reads: "Into the depths and beyond the mirage."
The second reads: "This is an advance copy. Please return after proofreading."

The novel is written in remarkably realistic prose, recounting the sinister and mysterious events a Nethermancer encounters while exploring the Mirage Realms.

metadata.subsection: Examine the book someone appears to have left behind

title: Song of the Heart Sword
subsection: Examine the book someone appears to have left behind
content:
Rover: This is... a note left by the Cat of the Nether Lamp.
Rover: He's been through here. He made sure to leave this intelligence for us.

content:

title: Song of the Heart Sword
subsection: Talk to the Autopuppet beside the mechanism
content:
[Objective: Talk to the Autopuppet beside the mechanism]
Artisan Repairing Mechanisms?: I must restore the Xuan Bombards before the next wave of rogue Autopuppets arrives.
[Dialogue Option]  Xuan Bombards?
Artisan Repairing Mechanisms?: A Cloud Shuttle's most advanced defense system. It can track and fire on multiple hostile targets at once.
Artisan Repairing Mechanisms?: Think of it as a very powerful automated cannon.
Artisan Repairing Mechanisms?: Almost there... I will fix them.

metadata.subsection: Talk to the Autopuppet beside the mechanism

title: Song of the Heart Sword
content:
[Objective: Defeat the incoming rogue Autopuppets]
Rover: So, Qingxiao. Between that cannon and your flying swords...?
Qingxiao: ...Within a hundred paces, the sword is faster.

Resident Autopuppet: Thank you. I... continue the repairs.

subsection: (Optional) Talk to the Artisan by the Xuan Bombards
content:

title: Song of the Heart Sword
content:
[Objective: Keep exploring ahead]
Qingxiao: Ugh...
Rover: Let's stop and find somewhere to rest.
Qingxiao: Okay. Let us board that looming Shuttle.

title: Song of the Heart Sword
content:
[Objective: Talk to Qingxiao]
Rover: You said the Sword Intent you shared could only release one burst of Sword Energy. But now...
Qingxiao: It is alright. As long as I maintain the link to my Sword Intent, the power I shared to protect the people will not run dry.
Rover: No, what I want to know is who's paying the price for all that power?
Qingxiao: ...

title: Song of the Heart Sword
content:
[Objective: Keep exploring ahead]
Muyu: Welcome aboard this Cloud Shuttle, modeled after the Ministry of War headquarters. Though, as you can see, it no longer requires the service of human soldiers.
Rover: Muyu... you've bound the Reverberations of the dead to these machines, but you still send Autopuppets to hunt them down. Why?
Muyu: Because they are failed experiments.
Muyu: Failing minds, faded memories, with nary a shred of self left to act on their own... It is time for a fresh batch of samples.
Qingxiao: You defile the souls of the innocent treating them as disposables for your experiment.
Muyu: I prefer to call it... "resource optimization."
Muyu: They were nothing but Reverberations haunting the ruins of Yuan Fortress. Left alone, they would have inevitably devolved into Tacet Discords.
Muyu: But now, they serve a great experiment. If Reverberations can be perfectly fused into mechanical shells, the line between life and death vanishes. Immortality becomes possible.
Muyu: If the shell wears out, we replace it. As long as consciousness remains, life is not extinguished. Death becomes obsolete, and the dead may rise once more.
[Dialogue Option]  Is this also Zhuojun Aterlier's true purpose?
Muyu: Please. The  Flowerveil Puppet  sees nothing beyond Mengzhou's gilded little playground. Do not compare me to that narrow-minded woman.
[Dialogue Option]  Then, the Séance Society...
Muyu: Ah, an amusing name. That little Jinzhou organization has not even come close to understanding the nature of the soul. They only use memories to fashion mockeries of life.
Muyu: Their ... A third-rate puppeteer. A man so mired in his own past that a few offhand remarks, and I saw the weakness eating him from the inside.
Muyu: How about we discuss a topic you find more pressing? Say... the Ministry of War in the real world?
Muyu: Take a guess. As the Censure Courts continue to release Tacet Discords, how long do you think those Wardens can hold the line?
Muyu: They might survive the wave from one Court. But two? Three? Even if they hold, what will it cost?
Rover: You underestimate the people of Xuanfang. Just as you never understood what they fight for.
Muyu: Hmph. You cling to the fragility of emotion and human will. Blind to the truth that only in superior technology will you master your fate.
Muyu: They will break soon enough. All I am doing... is accelerating the inevitable shutdown of the Censure Courts.
Qingxiao: ...Xuanfang Hold and its people will survive.
Muyu: No matter how great you are, Paragon Qingxiao, you cannot protect those beyond your reach.

title: Song of the Heart Sword
content:
Muyu: No matter how great you are, Paragon Qingxiao, you cannot protect those beyond your reach.



(Cutscene starts)
Qingxiao: As the heart wills, so the sword moves.
Yangyang: Victory will be ours!
(Cutscene ends)

title: Song of the Heart Sword
content:
(Cutscene starts)
Qingxiao: As the heart wills, so the sword moves.
Yangyang: Victory will be ours!
(Cutscene ends)



Muyu: You... what have you done?
Muyu: This can't be... your frequency is all but drained...
Muyu: This whole time, that unique frequency the Shuttles detected affecting the real world... that was you?
Muyu: How many are you propping up? The garrison? The entire city?
Muyu: Or could it be... the Land of Xuanfang itself?
Muyu: You are even more foolish than I thought, Sword Transcendent. Do you really think you can shield them forever?
Muyu: You of all people should know how fragile human lives are compared to a Resonator's. Xuanfang Hold will fall, and those people will fall with it.
Muyu: You cannot change what is coming. Everything you are doing is just piling more weight on your own—
Qingxiao: ...Hm?
Rover: Muyu's illusion being here means we're closing in on his real location.
Rover: You look pale. Leave the rest of the fighting to me.
Qingxiao: You need not worry about me... Keep your focus on the enemies.

title: Song of the Heart Sword
content:
[Objective: Keep destroying the incoming Autopuppets]
Qingxiao: Hahh... Rover.
Rover: What do you need me to do?
Qingxiao: I am fine...
Rover: Not good enough, Qingxiao. I'm your partner, and if I'm going to keep you safe, I need to know what's happening to you.
Qingxiao: ...Ever since the Siege of Xuanfang Hold, I've spread my Sword Intent among the people. I've been using most of my Resonance Energy to sustain the link.
Qingxiao: With the battle intensifying, I have had to... Overclock... to maintain the link. Once the pressure eases, I will recover.
Rover: ...Easy.
Qingxiao: Remember what you said last night? "See your choice through." This is me doing just that.
Qingxiao: I will not allow another tragedy to befall the Land of Xuanfang. To protect everyone, this is the only certain path.
Rover: You can't expect to carry the world on your own shoulders.
Qingxiao: If it had been you...
Qingxiao: The Sword Intent I gave out was only seeds. What made them grow was each person's will.
Qingxiao: Ungh... It is because they have the heart to protect that the Heart Sword answers.
[Dialogue Option]  Let's find a place to rest.
[Dialogue Option]  I'll take it from here.
Qingxiao: Cough... cough...
Rover: Let's go. Somewhere the fog can't reach.

title: Song of the Heart Sword
content:
[Objective: Help Qingxiao into the corridor]
Qingxiao: You should go after Muyu, Rover...
Rover: Partners should watch each other's backs.
Rover: You also taught me Sword Flight. And you've not stopped teaching me since.
Rover: We need to lose that Shuttle.
Qingxiao: Hahh... Y-yes...

title: Song of the Heart Sword
content:
[Objective: Keep supporting Qingxiao]
Qingxiao: Put me down... You will move faster without me.

title: Song of the Heart Sword
subsection: Destroy the Autopuppets blocking the way
content:
[Objective: Destroy the Autopuppets blocking the way]
Qingxiao: I... will aid you with my swords.
Rover: You need rest.
Qingxiao: ...Do not worry. I know my limits.

title: Song of the Heart Sword
content:
[Objective: Listen to the conversation]
Rover: I have to get that Shuttle out of our way.

title: Song of the Heart Sword
subsection: With the area cleared, go back to Qingxiao
content:
[Objective: With the area cleared, go back to Qingxiao]
Rover: You holding up? Let's get you inside that cabin above there.
Qingxiao: Mhm... I have burdened you.
Rover: Promise me, Qingxiao. No more carrying everything alone.
Qingxiao: I promise.

metadata.subsection: With the area cleared, go back to Qingxiao

title: Song of the Heart Sword
content:
[Objective: Help Qingxiao into the cabin]
Qingxiao: I will be fine... I just need a moment with my guqin (stringed instrument).
[Dialogue Option]  That will be enough?
Qingxiao: I have always had a fiery temperament... Each pluck of the string helps to restore my balance and calm my mind.
Rover: ...You? Fiery?
Qingxiao: ...Before I took to the mountain, I had only my sword. I fought the Tacet Discords as if my life did not matter.
Qingxiao: My master saw the unrest in my heart... and taught me the guqin to calm my spirit.
Qingxiao: Ngh... Please... watch over me for a moment. I will recover soon, then we may move forward.
Rover: ...Your playing sounds unsettled.
Qingxiao: I—Ugh...
Qingxiao: Promise me one thing... Rover.
Qingxiao: If, in the moments to come, I turn my sword on you... do not hesitate.
Qingxiao: Argh...!
???: Save me... Sword Transcendent...
???: Tacet Discords... They just keep coming!
???: Everyone is dead... Even the Xuanling Birds...
???: Sword Transcendent... Where were you? Did you... abandon us?
???: Sword Transcendent.
Qingxiao: ...Ruoyun.
Ruoyun?: Qingxiao, you don't have to be so tense all the time. I know you are not the ice-cold statue you pretend to be.
Ruoyun?: Inside, you are just like the rest of us. You feel joy, anger, resentment... and regret.
Qingxiao: You died... You died two centuries ago when Yuan Fortress was destroyed.
Ruoyun?: Dead? And? No one sewed my mouth shut.
Lingfang?: I should thank you for looking after my descendants.
Lingfang?: After all these centuries, it seems you still... cannot let go of that war.
Qingxiao: ...You are just a manifestation of my fractured mind. The Inner Demon I must destroy.
Qingxiao?: Heh... Once again, you stake mortal lives on your sword. All for a rescue that means nothing.
Qingxiao?: Come now. This long duel between us shall meet its end today.

title: Song of the Heart Sword
subsection: Feel the Sword Intent in the flying sword
content:
[Objective: Feel the Sword Intent in the flying sword]
Rover: (The cabin has been affected by the fog. Qingxiao...)

???: Those villagers... what were they to you?
Qingxiao of the Past: They gave me a bowl of food.
???: So you risked your life to protect the mortals from a whole tide of Tacet Discords.
Qingxiao of the Past: I was frail anyway. Not long for this world. Better to take those monsters with me.
Jingwei?: With a broken blade...? Jingwei is my name. Would you like to become my disciple and walk the path of cultivation with me?

metadata.subsection: Feel the Sword Intent in the flying sword

title: Song of the Heart Sword
subsection: Feel the Sword Intent in the flying sword
content:
Jingwei?: With a broken blade...? Jingwei is my name. Would you like to become my disciple and walk the path of cultivation with me?



Jingwei?: Your Resonance Ability has always been unstable. For longevity, you must anchor your heart in absolute stillness.
Qingxiao of the Past: Seeing people get hurt just... makes me sad. And when those monsters attack, it makes me so angry my blood boils.
Jingwei?: Then close your eyes. Cover your ears. Distance yourself from the world. Quiet your mind, and your desires will fade.
Jingwei?: Remember, do not let the world stir your heart. Forsake earthly attachments.

metadata.subsection: Feel the Sword Intent in the flying sword

title: Song of the Heart Sword
subsection: Feel the Sword Intent in the flying sword
content:
Jingwei?: Remember, do not let the world stir your heart. Forsake earthly attachments.



Jingwei?: ...You left the mountain to hunt evil again.
Qingxiao of the Past: I went only to purge the Tacet Discords. I formed no bonds. My heart did not waver.
Jingwei?: Saving mortals from the Lament is like trying to push back the tide. The tide always returns.
Qingxiao of the Past: If I sit back and do nothing, how is this long life of mine any different from the cold existence of a stone? Even you, Master... you saved me once.
Jingwei?: ...Then tell me, what is your  Way ?
Qingxiao of the Past: I have... yet to find my  answer .

Rover: (It looks like I'm in Qingxiao's inner world... I need to find her quickly.)

metadata.subsection: Feel the Sword Intent in the flying sword

title: Song of the Heart Sword
subsection: Move ahead and step into the lake
content:
[Objective: Move ahead and step into the lake]
Jingwei?: One need not rush. A few hours here are but a fleeting moment in the world outside.
Rover: Are you... Qingxiao's master?
Jingwei?: I am but a lingering frequency. Besides, my Qing already knew how to fight when she came to me. I merely taught her the methods of cultivation.
Rover: These bodies... what happened here?
Jingwei?: We who walk the path of cultivation must shed all worldly desires. Cut down our Inner Demons.
Jingwei?: What you see are the remnants of her past duels with herself. This duel... is the final reckoning.
Jingwei?: Fellow Cultivator, since you have found your way here, it means she has chosen you to be her sword.
Rover: Her... sword?
Jingwei?: Should she succumb to her demon...
Jingwei?: Strike her down.

metadata.subsection: Move ahead and step into the lake

title: Song of the Heart Sword
content:
[Objective: Check on Qingxiao]
Qingxiao?: Why do you involve yourself in Xuanfang's affairs? You don't belong here. Or have you forgotten?
Rover: ...Qingxiao. Wake up?
Qingxiao: Because—

title: Song of the Heart Sword
content:
[Objective: (cutscene start)]
Qingxiao: After bidding Master farewell
Qingxiao: I wandered the world
Qingxiao: eventually settling in Xuanfang
Qingxiao: I planned to cultivate in solitude...
Ruoyun: Please, Sword Transcendent. Tacet Discords are coming!
Ruoyun: Can you help us?
Qingxiao: Did you lead this child here?
Qingxiao: Just this once
Qingxiao: After that, more came to offer their thanks
Elderly Gentryman: Our gratitude for the rescue...
Lingfang: Good day, Sword Transcendent!
Qingxiao: Whenever I sought to leave...
Qingxiao: Xuanling Birds would bring another plea
Qingxiao: Years flowed like water...
Qingxiao: I had strayed so far from the path of cultivation
Painter: Just like that, yes! Perfect!
Lingfang's Husband: Sword Transcendent!
Lingfang: Over here, Sword Transcendent!
Ruoyun: Told you the Waking Moon would be good fun, Qingxiao!
Qingxiao: ...Mm.
Ruoyun: Here!
Qingxiao: Not long after
Qingxiao: The Threnodian... descended

title: Song of the Heart Sword
content:
[Objective: Check on Qingxiao]
Inner Demon: Two hundred years since the Fortress and Gorges War. And you still have not found peace.
Inner Demon: That day, the Xuanling Bird told you the Gorges of Spirits and Yuan Fortress were burning. Where did you go?
Qingxiao: I went to the Gorges of Spirits.
Inner Demon: Ah, yes. So confident. So sure your blade could cut down the Lament's source. Save everyone. And then—
Inner Demon: You were held back. Trapped by Retroact Rain. Pinned down by the Threnodian's blade of ruin. By the time you returned to Xuanfang, what did you find...?
Inner Demon: A brutal end. A silent battlefield.

title: Song of the Heart Sword
subsection: Check on the people of the past
content:
[Objective: Check on the people of the past]
Dying Soldier: Sword Transcendent... Yuan Fortress... is gone.
Qingxiao: I am here. You are safe now.
Qingxiao: (This man... He once sent a Xuanling Bird to beg for my help. Civilians were trapped in a mountain flood.)
Dying Soldier: Ugh... P-please... help them...
Qingxiao: I will. Rest now.
Inner Demon: Liar! You know he is beyond saving. Just like all the others.

Qingxiao: (I remember this man from the Waking Moon Festival. He was haggling over a lantern for his two-year-old child.)
Inner Demon: He even taught the child to cheer your name. "Sword Transcendent! Sword Transcendent!"

Qingxiao: (A Xuanling brought me her wish. She prayed for her missing family to come home.)
Inner Demon: You followed that stupid bird's lead and searched half the mountain. Eventually, you found her father at the bottom of a cliff.

metadata.subsection: Check on the people of the past

title: Song of the Heart Sword
subsection: Check on the people of the past
content:
Inner Demon: You followed that stupid bird's lead and searched half the mountain. Eventually, you found her father at the bottom of a cliff.



Qingxiao: Lingfang...
Inner Demon: Ruoyun's childhood friend. One of the first you saved in Xuanfang. A musician who marched off to war and threw her life away.
Lingfang: ...Ah, you've come, Sword Transcendent... Ruoyun... She is still in the Fortress... waiting for you...
Qingxiao: I understand. I will find her.
Lingfang: Then... I can rest my eyes now...
Inner Demon: Another hollow comfort. You searched every crater left by the Fortress's collapse. You never found anyone alive.

metadata.subsection: Check on the people of the past

title: Song of the Heart Sword
content:
[Objective: Follow the Inner Demon]
Inner Demon: The years pass. Your cultivation advances. But the memory of this failure only becomes clearer and clearer.
Inner Demon: Everything you once saved in Xuanfang was ground to dust by the Lament.
Qingxiao: ...
Inner Demon: So, let us begin.

Gorges of Spirits TheFortress and Gorges War two centuries ago

Inner Demon: You are back at the Gorges of Spirits... The battlefield that haunts you. Your fear. Your regret.
Qingxiao: I will destroy the source of this Tacet Discord outbreak.
Inner Demon: Show me, Sword Transcendent. Prove your resolve with your sword. Answer their pleas.
Inner Demon: This time, will the tragedy of the Fortress and Gorges War be redeemed?

title: Song of the Heart Sword
content:
[Objective: Question the gravely wounded soldier]
Heavily Injured Soldier: We lost the Central Plains... They came too fast...
Qingxiao: Save your breath, soldier. The bleeding has stopped for now.
Heavily Injured Soldier: Thank you... Please... The Threnodian is just ahead...
Qingxiao: I know. Leave the rest to me.
Inner Demon: How confusing. They are long dead, so why the tender words? They are only your memories. Proof of your futile rescue.

title: Song of the Heart Sword
content:
[Objective: Check on the supplies]
The supply crate has been destroyed by fire, but the inscriptions of "Mt. Firmament" and "Hongzhen" can still be faintly made out on its surface.

title: Song of the Heart Sword
content:
[Objective: Eliminate the Tacet Discords]
Inner Demon: Remarkable. These monsters cannot withstand your onslaught. You are faster than you ever were back then.
Inner Demon: A pity you cannot reach Yuan Fortress in time. The defense there is crumbling. One soldier after another...

title: Song of the Heart Sword
subsection: Face the Threnodian's blade of ruin
content:
[Objective: Face the Threnodian's blade of ruin]
Qingxiao: The Crownless... the Threnodian's blade of ruin.
Inner Demon: It now stands at the zenith of its strength. And you? You have already given away most of your Sword Intent to shield those mortals.

metadata.subsection: Face the Threnodian's blade of ruin

title: Song of the Heart Sword
subsection: Defeat the Crownless at the height of its power
content:
[Objective: Defeat the Crownless at the height of its power]
Qingxiao: Yes, as long as the Threnodian's power flows, it will continue to rise from the dead.
Inner Demon: Ovathrax is watching now. Its dominion is absolute, undefeated since the dawn of its birth.
Inner Demon: Your sword can split mountains and rivers. But it cannot shake war from its throne, nor the countless engines of war born from civilization's shadow.

Qingxiao: ...It will all be over soon.
Inner Demon: How do you endure this agony? Draining your Resonance Energy like having your nerves flayed from your body?
Inner Demon: Even at your limit, you refuse to cut the link. Why not stop this pointless waste?

metadata.subsection: Defeat the Crownless at the height of its power

title: Song of the Heart Sword
subsection: Sever the Threnodian's power to hold back the Tacet Discord outbreak
content:
[Objective: Sever the Threnodian's power to hold back the Tacet Discord outbreak]
Inner Demon: This time, it seems you have finally repelled the Threnodian's puppeted blade and cut down the source of the outbreak.

By the Yuan Fortress Entrance Shortly after...

metadata.subsection: Sever the Threnodian's power to hold back the Tacet Discord outbreak

title: Song of the Heart Sword
content:
[Objective: Rush to Yuan Fortress]
Inner Demon: Yuan Fortress still stands. You might actually make it in time.
Inner Demon: Truly impressive. You were still fighting the Crownless when you heard the Fortress explode into rubble all those years ago.

Inner Demon: Your Resonance Energy is nearly exhausted... how much longer can you force this?
Qingxiao: ...Hahh... Hahh...
Inner Demon: Onward... just a little further. The gates of Yuan Fortress are almost in sight.

title: Song of the Heart Sword
content:
[Objective: Rush to Yuan Fortress]
Inner Demon: You killed the Crownless and flew back to Xuanfang without a moment's rest. And still... too late.
Inner Demon: Mortal lives are but motes of dust. You know this. Even if this war had never come, another would. Or the Lament would burn it all to ash.
Inner Demon: Since this ending is already destined, why did you bother? Why destroy your inner peace for a lost cause?
Inner Demon: Qingxiao, this is your inner world. You can try again. But you know, every single time—
Qingxiao: Every single time, I realize my own weakness.
Qingxiao: From Yuan Fortress, to the Gorges of Spirits, to the Land of Xuanfang... No matter how hard I try, my sword cannot save everyone.
Qingxiao: But this is the path I chose. I must go. There are people waiting for me.
Inner Demon: No, no, no... That shouldn't be your reaction.
Inner Demon: You should be drowning in agony. You should be trapped in a loop of futile attempts until you break...
Inner Demon: ...Until you can endure no more and fight me. Like every time before.
Rover: ...Qingxiao?
Inner Demon: ...You didn't block?
Qingxiao: Ngh... Do not run.
Inner Demon: You want my power?!
Inner Demon: Have you lost your mind? I am the Sanshi Poison (Three Corpses Poison) in your body! The emotions and desires you cut away for the sake of cultivation!
Inner Demon: Every dark thought, every shadow your sword ever cast... They are me! Other Cultivators would have slain me long ago, yet you seek my help?
Qingxiao: ...Our Heart Swords were always meant to be one.
Inner Demon: You... You kept me for two centuries. Fed me your feeings. All so you could use me when the day came.
Qingxiao: You are Qingxiao too, after all.
Qingxiao: Cultivation is, above all, being true. If I killed you... how could I claim an honest heart?
Inner Demon: You will regret this. I will eat away at you until nothing is left. No mind. No heart. In the end, your own hand will tear down everything you tried to protect.
Qingxiao: Even if that day comes... I have someone by my side who can stop me. I am willing to entrust myself to him.
Inner Demon: Qingxiao, the things you treasure are not the things I treasure. You care for the world. But I...
Inner Demon: I only care about your Way.
Qingxiao: Yes. I know.
Inner Demon: From this day forth, you will never be able to sever the full tide of mortal feeling, or break free from the karma of this world.
Inner Demon: You will be bound to me forever. Never to see through the world's illusions. Never to transcend. Never to attain the Way.
Qingxiao: I was never a Transcendent. I need not bother with any great Way. Besides... I have already found my  answer .
Qingxiao: How very stubborn... I am (you are).

title: Song of the Heart Sword
content:
Qingxiao: How very stubborn... I am (you are).



Qingxiao: Rover... I am back.
[Dialogue Option]  You're a sight for sore eyes.
Qingxiao: I used my Inner Demon's strength to replenish my depleted Resonance Energy.
Qingxiao: Forgive me. I forced you to bear the risk of my losing control.
Rover: It's alright. If that Inner Demon had really taken control, I still would've found a way to wake you up.
Qingxiao: Now, I feel a flood of stray thoughts swirling within me. But I need not, and will not, suppress them.
Rover: Is that for the better or the worse?
Qingxiao: Neither. They are simply my thoughts.
Rover: At any rate, you're still the Qingxiao I know.
Qingxiao: I am nothing but a prideful mortal, always believing there was nothing my sword could not protect. Sometimes I even forgot—
Qingxiao: I started cultivating just to stay alive. Back then, I was only a wanderer whose hometown had been taken by the Lament.
Qingxiao: This thread is all my family left behind. It is the only link between the Sword Transcendent and Qing, the wandering village girl.
Qingxiao: I wear it to remember where I came from. No matter how many years pass, I cannot turn a blind eye to the suffering of others.
Qingxiao: Strength has its limits, but I only ask for a clean heart. Even if my sword cannot promise a perfect end, I will not stay my hand.
Rover: Even if it's not enough...
Rover: There will always be another to carry your (our) burden. And another after that. You (We) aren't walking this road alone.
Qingxiao: You... truly are different from who you were two centuries ago.
Qingxiao: At the end of the Fortress and Gorges War, when I was about to fall, I heard a Loong's roar echoing across the battlefield. I looked up and saw—

title: Song of the Heart Sword
content:
Qingxiao: The Golden-Eyed One and Jué.
Qingxiao: You struck the source of the disaster. You rewrote the fate of that war.

title: Song of the Heart Sword
content:
Qingxiao: I looked for you after the battle, but you were gone. I wanted to know if someone like you ever had to face such impossible choices.
Rover: I still don't know my past. And nothing I've been through since I woke up has been simple or easy.
Rover: But even though we didn't always know how things would turn out, we still followed our hearts anyway. And we gave it everything we had.
Qingxiao: Yes, we did. I must confess, Rover, I... lied to you.
Qingxiao: The Ministry of Foreign Affairs's reach is not that wide. I actually traced your footsteps by asking many people.
Qingxiao: Come, my disciple. Time to settle things in the world outside.
[Dialogue Option]  Say that again?
Qingxiao: ...I want to be honest with myself. Since I taught you Sword Flight, I do consider you my disciple.
Qingxiao: You need not answer, but I shall call you such... even if only for this short while.

title: Song of the Heart Sword
subsection: Leave the inner landscape when you're ready
content:
[Objective: Leave the inner landscape when you're ready]
Qingxiao: Before we depart, is there anything you wish to ask? Time flows much faster here than out there. We still have a moment.
[Dialogue Option]  I do have a few questions.
Qingxiao: I see. Ask away.
[Dialogue Option]  Is this place your inner world?
Qingxiao: Yes. This  manifests during my meditations. It is a reflection of my state of mind.
[Dialogue Option]  How did I get in here?
Qingxiao: ...That strand of  I gave you has, to a certain extent, bound our lives to the same wellspring.
Qingxiao: When my Resonance Energy ran dry, my Inner Demon surfaced. My inner landscape began to collapse. That is how you were pulled in. But...
Qingxiao: It was also my wish. If I failed, you would've had the strength to stop me.
[Dialogue Option]  What of your inner demon? Are you alright?
Qingxiao: Do not worry. My mind has settled. My Resonance Ability is stabilizing. I am far from full strength, but I will not lose control again.
[Dialogue Option]  You have me. No more soloing it, okay?
Qingxiao: Yes. I have you by my side.
[Dialogue Option]  What's the situation at the Ministry of War?
Qingxiao: I have been sensing the battle through my Sword Intent. The line is holding. The soldiers and people of Xuanfang stand united. They will protect the Hold.
Qingxiao: But that is all we can burden them with. The rest falls on us... We must end Muyu's schemes without delay.
[Dialogue Option]  I'll stay here a bit longer.
[Dialogue Option]  Let's head out.

content:
[Dialogue Option]  I'll stay here a bit longer.
[Dialogue Option]  Let's head out.



Di Realm Dark clouds gather. A heavy fog blankets the land. The higher one climbs toward the heavens, the deeper one plunges into the abyss.

title: Song of the Heart Sword
subsection: Move forward and leave the cabin
content:
[Objective: Move forward and leave the cabin]
Qingxiao: Looks like we don't need to do anything.
Rover: The pendant is reacting... It's guiding us forward.

metadata.subsection: Move forward and leave the cabin

title: Song of the Heart Sword
content:
[Objective: Follow the Qingfu pendant's guidance]
Qingxiao: While we were in the cabin, others were keeping watch outside.

title: Song of the Heart Sword
content:
[Objective: Follow the pendant's guidance]
???: Heh. Rover, Paragon Qingxiao. Took you long enough. Any later, and I wouldn't've held out.
???: That pendant and those notes I left... They did the trick, I s'pose?
[Dialogue Option]  Cat of the Nether Lamp.
"Cat of the Nether Lamp": Just a Jianghu alias to earn my keep. Let me introduce myself proper—
[Dialogue Option]  Our inside man. We meet again.
"Inside Man": Sounds a bit dull. I'd much rather you call me—
Jingran: The Nethermancer who went three years undercover in Zhuojun Atelier's snake spit without a single bite—Jingran. You didn't pull any punches back at the Sanctum, by the way.
[Dialogue Option]  Neither did you.
Jingran: Haha! Heard stories 'bout your style. Had to see for myself if the rumors were true.
Rover: Your cover must be blown now, right?
Jingran: I hit him first.
Jingran: While he was running his mouth at you, I gave him a little love tap in the back. Shame he slipped away behind a wall of Autopuppets.
Qingxiao: I see... that's why Muyu's phantom vanished so suddenly.
Jingran: Right, let's skip the chit‑chat. We're all hunting the same soulless fart, so why not team up?
Rover: You've helped a great deal, and I've no reason to refuse. I need your intel. But you... what do you need from me?
Jingran: You get right to it, huh? Love it. I want to stick with you because it's better odds for making sure Muyu doesn't get away again.
Jingran: I don't have any of your "noble" motives, just an old score to settle with that bastard.
Rover: That's your only condition?
Jingran: Yeah, well... if we trip over any Sanctum relics or Hsin's secret stash of treasure, maybe toss one my way? Hah. Kidding.
Jingran: Let me be clear, no Nethermancer stands by while someone toys with the dead's Reverberations (obsessions).
Rover: Then... pleasure working with you?
[Dialogue Option]  (Extend your hand to Jingran)
Jingran: Likewise.
Qingxiao: Where's Muyu's true body hiding?
Jingran: He took the Shuttle up to the top level. The Tian (Heaven) Realm. That's his playground.
Jingran: According to "Lucky," there's a sea of Reverberations up there. Almost like... all of Xuanfang's Reverberations got sucked into one place.
Lucky?: To hell with you, I told you that's not my name! You forgetful brat!
Jingran: Tch. Always so lively... That's just a foul-mouthed  I caught. Pay it no mind.
Qingxiao: ...What's Muyu's true intention?
Jingran: In a coded letter to Zhuojun Atelier, he claimed he'd get his hands on "Sentinel technology." The mechanistic mojo Hsin used to build the Hold.
Jingran: But think about it. If all he wanted was to steal something in the Sanctum... isn't all this chaos a bit unnecessary?
Rover: He's been running experiments on the mechanisms. It's like he's trying to figure out how they work before he does something.
Rover: Either way, we need to find him quickly.
Qingxiao: This is the last Shuttle, but I see no lightway to the Skyend Barrier.
Rover: Let's check near that Swordlight.

title: Song of the Heart Sword
content:
[Objective: Head over to the Swordlight]
Jingran: Huh, it's been quiet for a while... That's not a good sign.

title: Song of the Heart Sword
content:
[Objective: (Optional) Ask Jingran for more information]
Jingran: Looks like you still have questions. Go on. I got nothing to hide.
[Dialogue Option]  How did you get here?
Jingran: After our little run-in at the Sanctum, I used a  Spirit Portal  to enter this Mirage Realm. Landed in this level first.
[Dialogue Option]  Spirit Portal?
Jingran: Same portal I opened for you back then. It cuts a passage between any two places thick enough with Reverberations.
Jingran: As soon as I got there, I walked right into Muyu collecting data. Played along, got cozy. After my cover blew, I stole a Shuttle to give his toys the slip. That's how I ended up here.
Jingran: Lucky or not, you two showed up. With a parade of those things. Heh. Gotta say, you really know how to wear a guy out.
[Dialogue Option]  Why did you just leave that pendant behind?
Jingran: Right before the siege, Muyu and I reached a secret chamber in Fogveil Pagoda. He didn't find Hsin's trail, so he geared up for the Sanctum.
Jingran: Time was tight, so I left that pendant behind as a breadcrumb. Laced it with my Resonance Ability. Then I followed him.
Jingran: It was a gamble. Could've blown up in my face a hundred ways. But turns out... I bet on the right horse. Spent my life in the right place, too.
[Dialogue Option]  Wait... "spent your life"?
Jingran: Oh, I cut a deal with the "debt collector" in this lamp (Life Lamp). Traded a bit of my lifespan. Just enough to juice that pendant.
Jingran: Add in the passage to the Sanctum? A year or two off the clock. I figure that's a tidy price for you and the Paragon on my side.
[Dialogue Option]  How did you manage to get close to Muyu?
Jingran: The snake needed a hand from within Zhuojun Atelier to get supplies moving to lay the groundwork. That hand... just happened to be me.
Jingran: But he was paranoid. Notes at drop points, never a face. Didn't get a meet‑and‑greet 'til all hell broke loose with the Autopuppets.
Jingran: He kept me at arm's length. Used me like a doorman. If you two hadn't've scared him, he never would've let me come this far.
[Dialogue Option]  I'll ask later.

title: Song of the Heart Sword
subsection: Feel the Sword Intent carried by the Swordlight
content:
[Objective: Feel the Sword Intent carried by the Swordlight]
Fortress Warden Commander: ...We cannot let the escaped Tacet Discords into Mengzhou. We are running out of options...
Fortress Warden Commander: Anyone willing to follow me into the Fortress mainframe, step forward!
Voices of the People: I'm with you!
Fortress Warden Commander: The rest of you... Guanchuan is in command now. Stick to the plan. Cover the evacuation and withdraw immediately!
Ruoyun of the Past: I'm going with you. I know a shortcut to the mainframe.
Fortress Warden Commander: ...Savantae girl, this is not your fight. Get to safety.
Ruoyun of the Past: Commander, this is my home. I'm from Huanglong, but I'm a daughter of Xuanfang too.
Ruoyun of the Past: Just like everyone else here, I want to make sure more people can live to see the sunrise.
Qingxiao: ...These are memories and emotions from the past. From before Yuan Fortress self-destructed.
Jingran: My Shifu told me about this. The ones who stayed behind... They were all great heroes.
[Dialogue Option]  I can feel their "Sword Intent."
Qingxiao: I have never forgotten them.
Qingxiao: ...Stay alert. Something is coming.

Jadie: It's finally my turn to fight. Sheesh... Took me forever to fix these guys up.
Jadie: You go take down that Cloud Shuttle! Leave this place to me and my Lancers!

title: Song of the Heart Sword
content:
[Objective: Talk to Ruoyun]
Jadie: That big one's finally gone. Ugh, I'm so exhausted... Quite sure my parts are about to fall off one by one.
[Dialogue Option]  Thank you for your help back there.
Jadie: Hehe. After all, they are my proudest cre—ugh, partners!
[Dialogue Option]  Thanks, little riddle-box.
Jadie: Little riddle-box? Everything I say makes perfect sense!
Qingxiao: You... Why have you been helping us all this time?
Jadie: I want the city out there to be okay! If we don't fix things here, that place is gonna be in big, big trouble too.
Jadie: Alrighty! Now I'll scoot us along to the next level—
Rover: The Prism of Fate...?
Jingran: Whoa. So that's the Moon Fox's relic from Fogveil Pagoda? Figured it ended up with you.
Qingxiao: Ruoyun?
Ruoyun: ...Yes. Sword Transcendent Qingxiao... It has been... a very, very long time.
[Dialogue Option]  What? Jadie, what just happened?
[Dialogue Option]  Explain yourself. And don't try to dodge.
Ruoyun: Uhh... How was I supposed to know the Sentinel's relic would reveal my true form like that?!
Ruoyun: Wait, this Prism of Fate, the Lexicon Axis, and the Sanctum... Are the knowledge restrictions lifting?
Jingran: Now this is something. Have you two heard the legends about Xuanfang's  Celestials ?
[Dialogue Option]  I've heard bits of it.
Jingran: Good, saves time. The story goes that the Savantae crew didn't just vanish after building the Hold. They just... "upgraded." Celestials, they call 'em. Been watching over the city's mechanisms ever since.
[Dialogue Option]  "Celestials"? What are they?
Jingran: Celestials... That's the name they gave the Savanate crew that built the Hold. Soon after its completion, poof. Gone without a trace.
Jingran: But if you buy the old stories, they never really left. Just became invisible caretakers keeping the Hold's gears turning to this day.
Qingxiao: The Fortress and Gorges War broke out before Xuanfang Hold was even finished. Ruoyun, what exactly are you...?
Ruoyun: Very good. I am a Celestial. But my case... was a little different.
Ruoyun: Long ago, I triggered the self-destruct at Yuan Fortress's mainframe—

title: Song of the Heart Sword
content:
Ruoyun: Long ago, I triggered the self-destruct at Yuan Fortress's mainframe—



Ruoyun of the Past: ...I'm... still alive...? Did I... make it...?
Ruoyun of the Past: ...If that wasn't enough... What do I do now... Everyone has...
Hsin of the Past: You have already done more than enough.

title: Song of the Heart Sword
content:
Ruoyun of the Past: ...If that wasn't enough... What do I do now... Everyone has...
Hsin of the Past: You have already done more than enough.



Ruoyun of the Past: ...What...? Is that... the Sentinel's... voice?
Hsin of the Past: Your will and heart have reached me. The rest is for me to handle.
Hsin of the Past: Ruoyun. In a moment, you will die from your wounds. But I offer you a choice—
Hsin of the Past: Cast aside your mortal body and become part of Xuanfang Hold, guarding it for what may be eternity. Or accept the peace of death here.
Hsin of the Past: Endless restraint, or quiet release. I wish to know what you can truly accept.
Ruoyun of the Past: ...I gave my word that I'd be one of the Celestials... I want to keep... protecting my people.
Hsin of the Past: This path is not easy. Time may wither your spirit. There will be no turning back... even if you beg.
Ruoyun of the Past: ...I'll let... my future self... worry about the regrets.
Hsin of the Past: Then entrust the whole of your being to me (Xuanfang Hold).
Ruoyun: —To be a Celestial is to accept a leash. You bind your life to the Hold and swear never to reveal its secrets.
Ruoyun: But this crisis is endangering its people. I did what I had to and projected my consciousness into an Autopuppet to guide you.
Rover: And you can speak the truth now because of this? Why only now?
Ruoyun: The restrictions have been lifted for now. Likely because we're near the core data zone, and your connection to the Sentinel has grown stronger.
Rover: Then tell me, what is this place? And how is it connected to the Hold?
Ruoyun: You're in the Hold's control mainframe, a space called the  Xuanyuan Domain . It stores vast amounts of the region's historical data.
Ruoyun: Muyu uploaded outside Reverberations, twisting the execution logic. He tried to take full control of the Mirage Realm, but it ended up triggering all these anomalies.
Ruoyun: If this continues, his Reverberations will continue their contamination until everything collapses. In the end... the Hold itself will fall.
Muffled Voice: First Instance activated...
Muffled Voice: Simulating... Xuanfang Hold... Reconstructing... Future possibilities converged...
Rover: (This voice. It sounds like the one I heard in Rinascita's  Civilization Capsule . If Imperator wasn't the only Sentinel that left a relic storing legacy data...)
Rover: Is this control mainframe actually a ? Could we be inside it right now?
Ruoyun: I... That data is restricted under the highest clearance. Even now, it hasn't lifted.
Ruoyun: There's the lightway to the Skyend Barrier. This is as far as I can take you.
Ruoyun: Muyu turned guardians into killers, and souls of the departed into toys. I beg you... Please stop him.
Qingxiao: I accept your request. Take care.
Ruoyun: Qingxiao, do you remember... our farewell back then? You never gave me an answer.
Qingxiao: ...It was worth it.

title: Song of the Heart Sword
content:
[Objective: Begin Sword Flight]
Rover: Jingran, we'll fly up there on swords. What about you?
Jingran: All good. I got my own way of keepin' up.
Qingxiao: The road ahead is bound to be perilous. Allow me to lead the way.

title: Song of the Heart Sword
content:
[Objective: (Optional) Ask Ruoyun for more information]
Ruoyun: Before you go, are there any more questions? I'll tell you what I can.
[Dialogue Option]  (Ask about the Celestials' knowledge restrictions.)
Ruoyun: Xuanfang Hold's technology comes from the Sentinel Herself. It is far more advanced than anything else in this age. It can never be allowed to leak.
Ruoyun: The restrictions on us Celestials come from that consensus. We accepted our fate when we signed on to build the Hold. We knew what we would become when it was finished.
Ruoyun: Now... we are just consciousness in machines. Frequencies that watch over and maintain the Hold, never to leave.
[Dialogue Option]  Why haven't we seen any other Celestials?
Ruoyun: Right now, they... I'm sorry. That is another thing I cannot speak of.
[Dialogue Option]  (Ask about Hsin the Moon Fox's whereabouts.)
Rover: Is Hsin the Moon Fox in the Sanctum? If you can't say, just nod or shake your head.
Ruoyun: ...Forgive me. The restrictions are woven into our thoughts. Any attempt to reveal classified information is blocked.
Ruoyun: But I can say this... I only made it to the Xuanyuan Domain because of the Sentinel's help.
[Dialogue Option]  (Ask about the Swordlights.)
Ruoyun: Those Swordlights were imitations of Qingxiao's Sword Intent. I created them from stray frequencies in the Domain. They can restore one's Resonance Energy.
Ruoyun: I could not carry them in my Autopuppet body, so I left them near where I made them... Did they help?
[Dialogue Option]  They did. I even saw some of your memories.
Ruoyun: ...Huh? You didn't see anything embarrassing, I hope?
Ruoyun: I suppose it's because those frequencies are tied to the region's history... Or there's a chance I accidentally mixed in some of my own...
[Dialogue Option]  Goodbye, Ruoyun.
Ruoyun: I wish you both the best. Stay safe.

title: Song of the Heart Sword
subsection: Pass through the corrupted Skyend Barrier
content:
[Objective: Pass through the corrupted Skyend Barrier]
Qingxiao: Careful, the Skyend Barrier in this level has spiraled into chaos.
Jingran: Tch. Muyu really set a storm in motion. Now even he can't steer his own disaster.
Rover: No stopping... Let's get through this quickly.

Jingran: I'll handle it!

Tian Realm | （天境） The skies darken, and storm rage. Malfunctioning mechanical components fill the entire space. All before your eyes is spiraling into chaos and disorder...

metadata.subsection: Pass through the corrupted Skyend Barrier

title: Song of the Heart Sword
subsection: Fly forward and find a place to land
content:
[Objective: Fly forward and find a place to land]
Jingran: There it is. The Sanctum's Shuttle. Muyu's little fortress.
Qingxiao: That barrier of warped machinery won't yield to a simple strike.
Rover: Look. Two weak spots in the perimeter. We can force a breach there.
Jingran: Hold on. I got a better idea—See that Shuttle over there?
Jingran: I'll ram it straight through the barrier. You two fly through before the crack closes.
[Dialogue Option]  But then you'd be...
Qingxiao: That, over there, is worse than the Skyend's dangers. Even with a Shuttle as a shield, you'll be putting your life at risk.
Jingran: Safe paths don't lead to lost places. If there's an opening, I'm not letting it go to waste.
Rover: Jingran, what are your odds?
Jingran: Haha, ninety percent shot I get you two inside.
Rover: No, I mean, what are the odds you come back alive?
Jingran: Some things, you don't know 'til you try. Besides, we're running out of time. Those openings could disappear any second.
Jingran: Look, I've always known my wick was shorter than most. But how I burn it? That's my call, even if the gods themselves disagree.
Jingran: So go save Xuanfang, big hero. I'm not planning on checking out just yet.
Jingran: Once this is over, maybe you'll see me again at my Shifu's old lady's place in Xianling Village.
[Dialogue Option]  It's a promise then.
[Dialogue Option]  We're saving our chat for another day.
Qingxiao: This wisp of Sword Intent may not work miracles. But with your resolve fueling it, it will not fail you.
Jingran: Rover, Paragon Qingxiao...
Jingran: I'll leave that corpse-fiddling creep to you, then!

metadata.subsection: Fly forward and find a place to land

title: Song of the Heart Sword
subsection: Change course and head for the other weak spot
content:
[Objective: Change course and head for the other weak spot]
Jingran: Heads up. These Shuttles have gone completely haywire.

Jingran: ...Guh!
Rover: Jingran?!
Jingran: Hah... minor hiccup. Steering's busted on this clanker. Gotta find another way!
Rover: We'll head to the other opening!

Qingxiao: Watch the rampaging mechanisms!

(Cutscene starts)
(Cutscene ends)

metadata.subsection: Change course and head for the other weak spot

title: Song of the Heart Sword
subsection: Change course and head for the other weak spot
content:
Rover: We'll head to the other opening!

Qingxiao: Watch the rampaging mechanisms!

(Cutscene starts)
(Cutscene ends)



Rover: Think I see someone up ahead.
Qingxiao: He's dead. And this time, it's no puppet. This is his true body.
[Dialogue Option]  Muyu... is actually dead?
Qingxiao: The wound was fatal. It must have been the strike Jingran landed earlier.
Rover: If he's dead, then who's controlling those Reverberations? Who sent the Cloud Shuttles and the Autopuppets? This can't be over that easily.
Qingxiao: The Reverberations of the dead... They still pour in without end. They still cause the anomalies...
Muyu: The emotions in those Reverberations are weak little things. But they do make excellent fuel for transcendence.
Muyu: So... the two closest to the Sentinel. You've managed to find your way here.
Rover: Muyu, this corpse... Is this another one of your tricks?
Muyu: This is my true flesh. The mortal vessel I cast aside. I'm being entirely honest with you.
Qingxiao: You...
Muyu: Your vision has narrowed, Paragon Qingxiao. I expected someone as elevated as you to understand this path sooner.
Muyu: We were never enemies, truly. This time, you two (Xuanfang Hold) simply happened to stand in my way. Save or destroy. Neither has ever interested me.
Muyu: To break that fox's tedious restrictions and taste the fruit of true knowledge, I had to take a path... from which there is no retreat.
Qingxiao: I don't care about your plans. I came to take your life.
Rover: And this time, you will pay for everything you've done in Xuanfang Hold.
Muyu: Then you shall make ideal test subjects.
Muyu: ...I came here to dissect the Sentinel's design. To understand the blueprint of divinity. Then build myself into its equal.
Muyu: And now, I've reached the pinnacle of mechanist arts...
Qingxiao: He's above us.

metadata.subsection: Change course and head for the other weak spot

title: Song of the Heart Sword
content:
[Objective: (Cutscene start)]
Muyu: I have shed my mortal flaws—
Muyu: To become the perfect Celestial.
Muyu: And you, Qingxiao...
Muyu: Born to transcend
Muyu: Yet brought low by useless emotion and your pity for insignificant mortals.
Qingxiao: They matter to me.

title: Song of the Heart Sword
content:
[Objective: Defeat Calamity Effigy]
Rover: "Celestial"... You just copied the Savantae craftsmen and transferred your consciousness into an Autopuppet.
Muyu: Those slaves bound to the Sentinel are unworthy of the name. I am the true Celestial, free of all chains.
Muyu: I have taken the most fragile thing in this world and made it my road to perfection. I have arrived at a future you cannot even fathom.
Qingxiao: You are nothing but a monster feeding on the dead.

title: Song of the Heart Sword
content:
Qingxiao: You are nothing but a monster feeding on the dead.



Muyu: You both stand with mortals. Again and again, you protect. Have you ever thought about why they are weak?
Muyu: Flaws must be burned away. Excess must be shed. Only then can an ant one day stand beside a god.
Qingxiao: You just want the world to be a mirror of yourself.
Qingxiao: Every soul has its own light. The "perfection" you speak of is a hollow lie.
Qingxiao: I fight for the lights of the living. Each flame is a life, distinct and irreplaceable.

Muyu: This is not over. This is not my destination...
Muyu: Just a moment more... A moment more, and I will cast off this shell and ascend...
Rover: This grotesque puppet show ends now.

title: Song of the Heart Sword
content:
[Objective: Defeat Calamity Effigy again]
Muyu: The Reverberations from the Di (Earth) Realm... I'll have them all... Every last drop of rage, sorrow, and resentment—
Muyu: AHHH—What... did you do?
Qingxiao: I shared my Sword Intent with the Autopuppets you experimented on.
Muyu: ...You... The guqin you played... Has your cultivation addled your wits? You'd even protect the Reverberations of the dead?!
Qingxiao: Even Reverberations should not be sacrificed to conspiracy and ambition, nor stripped of their right to exist.
Muyu: ...What a Sword Transcendent. What a Xuan Paragon.
Rover: You infiltrated the Sanctum to steal the Civilization Capsule we're in, didn't you?
Muyu: Do not misunderstand. The Sentinel's knowledge is my only concern. The one who wanted this Capsule? Ask your old enemy.
[Dialogue Option]  ...The Fractsidus?
[Dialogue Option]  ...The Threnodian?
Muyu: Xuanfang is but one corner of the chaos in Mengzhou. Unfortunately, I have no interest in  Balanophora's  petty schemes.
Rover: So she's the "woman in red" you mentioned before? A Fractsidus Overseer?
Muyu: It's irrelevant now... You defeated me because you were strong enough. Not because my path was wrong.
Qingxiao: Unrepentant to the last.
Muyu: I accept the consequences of my work. To regret it now would be to dishonor all the "materials" I used to get here.
Muyu: Look at this sky (barrier) trying to stop us... Doesn't it remind you of the Etheric Sea?
Muyu: Soon, the Reverberations' corruption will bring it all down. You may escape to reality, but Xuanfang Hold is doomed.
Qingxiao: ...I will not let that happen.
Muyu: This wretched city was built on the Sentinel's meddling. Every life it saved was a debt (cause) that must eventually be paid.
Muyu: Just like your protection. It has only delayed the inevitable (effect).
Muyu: And now, above you, the bill has arrived. The Tacet Discords. The dead. The destruction Xuanfang was always meant to face.
Rover: So that was the plan? Trigger a collapse, destroy the barrier, and slip away in the chaos?
Muyu: I told you. I do not care about what happens to the Capsule. And I care even less for this Hold...
Muyu: I want the Sentinel's knowledge exposed to the light of Solaris. Whether it saves the world or sets it on fire... Frankly, you two, I don't give a damn.
Muyu: Leave it to the Sentinel? Better that knowledge in human hands. In my hands.
Qingxiao: You're driven by nothing but greed and a hollow ego.
Muyu: At least you understand my "madness." I never once hid my intentions from you.
Rover: Enough talk... Your delusion ends here.
[Dialogue Option]  (Execute Muyu yourself.)
[Dialogue Option]  (Let Qingxiao execute Muyu.)
Qingxiao: I will stay here.
Qingxiao: My Resonance Ability can purge the malice from these Reverberations. As long as someone stands against this "falling sky," this place will endure.
Qingxiao: Hahh... So...
Rover: Hsin asked me to vow that I would never forsake this city. And I promised you... that you wouldn't walk this road alone.
Rover: Master.
Qingxiao: ...Yes.
Rover: Whatever comes next, we'll face it together.

title: Song of the Heart Sword
content:
Rover: Master.
Qingxiao: ...Yes.
Rover: Whatever comes next, we'll face it together.



(Cutscene starts)
Protect Xuanfang!
Hold the line...
Our lives for the city! Never retreat!
Xuanfang stands in peril, the sky about to fall...
Everyone, will you lend me your swords?
There's a whole group of "people" here!
This is not the sword of one. It is the sword of all.
Heaven falls, earth splits. But this sword will bring the dawn.
SKY—BREAK!
(Cutscene ends)

title: Song of the Heart Sword
content:
[Objective: Return to the mysterious garden]
???: Oh, you have both worked very hard indeed.
Qingxiao: ...Hsin?
Hsin: Thanks to the two of you and the people of this city, the Reverberation corruption in the control mainframe was largely purged. I handled the anomalies that remained.
Hsin: With the mainframe restored, the Censure Courts and Autopuppets will function as they should. The Tacet Discords will be contained in due time.
Hsin: In short... Xuanfang Hold has weathered the storm.
Hsin: Uh... Paragon Qingxiao! Calm yourself!
Qingxiao: Where exactly have you been all this time?
Rover: Xuanfang has bled again and again, and its Sentinel was nowhere to be seen. Whatever your reasons were, you owe us an explanation.
Hsin: Very well. Then let us begin with the chaos Muyu sowed.
Hsin: When Muyu invaded the Sanctum, I was not blind to it. But for certain reasons, I could neither intervene directly nor send word.
Hsin: In desperation, I trapped him inside the Xuanyuan Domain, within the mainframe, and strengthened the barrier to keep him from escaping.
Hsin: I believed he sought to extract the mainframe's core data. But to break my restrictions, he weaponized the Reverberations to collapse the mainframe itself.
Rover: Hold on. Back in the Sanctum, the Prism of Fate flickered. Was that you? Did you guide us into the Xuanyuan Domain?
Hsin: Only by stopping Muyu's chaos from within, together with my power, could we minimize the harm that spilled beyond.
Rover: One more thing. Is the Hold's control mainframe actually Mengzhou's Civilization Capsule? Muyu certainly believed it was.
Hsin: Not entirely. It is merely one small part of it...
Hsin: This situation exceeded even my calculations. Fortunately, you two were there. You saved Xuanfang from far greater loss.
Qingxiao: The Rafter Kite that led me to Fogveil Pagoda... You used the excuse of a meeting to lead me straight to Rover, didn't you?
Hsin: Heh... so you figured it out after all.
Hsin: With my clever ally (Suisui) placing the Arbiter on the board as a wild card, I rather hoped you two would form a natural partnership.
Qingxiao: The visions of Xuanfang we saw in the Domain...
Hsin: I know your question. Those Cloud Shuttles and mechanisms were real, recorded blueprints. As for why they were never deployed during the Fortress and Gorges War...
Hsin: Qingxiao... the answer is simple. There was not enough time.
Qingxiao: ...Time.
Hsin: Besides, technology that outstrips its age is as much a curse as a blessing to the people of Mengzhou. It was never meant for the mortal world. It has already warped too many fates.
Hsin: Muyu's ruin is proof enough of where that path leads.
Rover: I'm not here to judge your past choices. But if some of Xuanfang's problems began with its Sentinel, then its Sentinel should see them through.
Hsin: Arbiter... I...
Hsin: Arbiter, Paragon Qingxiao. When the time is right, I will give you and Xuanfang the answers you deserve.
Hsin: When that day comes, bring the Prism of Fate and come see...

title: Song of the Heart Sword
content:
Hsin: When that day comes, bring the Prism of Fate and come see...



Storyteller: And so—thousands of swords pierced the heavens, scattering the darkness.
Storyteller: The ominous force over Xuanfang was swept away. Mechanisms whirred back to life, and Tacet Discords were locked away.
Storyteller: Above the Sanctum, it seemed as though a river of stars had descended.

Storyteller: As the dust settled, the righteous returned in triumph.
Storyteller: Soldier and citizen cheered as one. Peace, at last, filled the city once more.

Storyteller: Yet before the sounds of celebration had faded, a certain garden collapsed without warning.
Storyteller: As for the secrets it buried... that shall be a tale for another time.

title: Song of the Heart Sword
subsection: Meet up with Yangyang at the Ministry of War
content:
[Objective: Meet up with Yangyang at the Ministry of War]
Rover: (Suisui seems to want to discuss something. I'd better head to the Ministry of War and find Yangyang first.)

metadata.subsection: Meet up with Yangyang at the Ministry of War

title: Song of the Heart Sword
content:
[Objective: Listen to the conversation]
Storyteller: It's time for me to close up the stall. Until we meet again, dear listeners.

Resident: Patrolling by themselves, and skilled at combat... These Autopuppets are awfully clever, aren't they!
Another Resident: My second uncle once told me the mechanist arts aren't that advanced. Autopuppets used to be real people, you know...
Resident: Stop telling ghost stories in broad daylight!

Artisan: Those shut-down Autopuppets and mechanisms... they all sprang back to life in the blink of an eye...

title: Song of the Heart Sword
content:
Artisan: Those shut-down Autopuppets and mechanisms... they all sprang back to life in the blink of an eye...



Xuanfang Warden: A battle of this scale, and only a handful were wounded. It's a miracle...
Another Xuanfang Warden: If Paragon Qingxiao hadn't been there, I shudder to think what might have happened.
Xuanfang Warden: That's right. One moment I could barely stand. The next, I felt strength surging through me...
Another Xuanfang Warden: My mace tore through those Tacet Discords like they were nothing but overipe melons.

Xuanfang Warden: Brother, thank you. Truly, we couldn't have done this without you fighting beside us.
Midnight Ranger: Save your thanks. Jinzhou and Mengzhou have always been of one blood.
Midnight Ranger: Our ancestors fought side by side against the Threnodian horde during the Fortress and Gorges War.

title: Song of the Heart Sword
content:
Midnight Ranger: Our ancestors fought side by side against the Threnodian horde during the Fortress and Gorges War.



Xuanfang Warden: You know, the new Watcher Yangyang was truly something else out there on the battlefield.
Xuanfang Warden: Her and Watcher Liangyu together? Devastating. It's just a pity that... Ah.
Another Xuanfang Warden: Why the sigh?
Xuanfang Warden: I was just thinking... if only Duzhong and the others could've seen them. They would've been so proud.

title: Song of the Heart Sword
content:
Xuanfang Warden: I was just thinking... if only Duzhong and the others could've seen them. They would've been so proud.



Suisui: ...Thank goodness you're both safe. Yangyang, come closer and let me get a good look at you. Are you hurt?
Yangyang: Suisui, I really am fine... Rover and Paragon Qingxiao are the ones who went into the Sanctum. They faced all the real danger.
[Dialogue Option]  Yangyang didn't miss a single beat out there.
[Dialogue Option]  She's become one of Xuanfang's bulwarks now.
Yangyang: Rover, please don't praise me like that in front of my sister...
Suisui: Alright, alright. Enough flattery, you two. Let's talk business. I'm speaking as Chairwoman of the Zhaoming Commerce Guild now.
Suisui: After returning to Mengzhou, I used the Guild's connections to dig into Muyu's past and contacted the main branch of Zhuojun Atelier.
Suisui: Muyu was a prodigy in Automata Mechanics. He designed Yuan Fortress two centuries ago, was a senior figure in Zhuojun Atelier, and had deep collaborations with Huaxu Academy.
Suisui: About twenty years back, he was supposed to succeed the Flowerveil Puppet as the next Grand Helm. Instead, he announced his departure from the organization and vanished.
Yangyang: After that... he probably hid in Xuanfang under another identity. Biding his time. Refining his plan.
Suisui: The Atelier has officially cut ties with him. They even offered to share information to help with the Guild's investigation.
Suisui: But we know he was still receiving internal support through an informant. Oh, right, did you meet the Cat of the Nether Lamp?
[Dialogue Option]  (Tell Suisui about Jingran.)
Suisui: ...Really? So he hasn't been seen since the Sanctum... Typical. A proper ghost of the Jianghu. I wouldn't be surprised if he just shows up again one day.
Rover: I'm sure he also made it out safely.
Rover: But did Muyu have dealings with the Fractsidus? He mentioned an Overseer's name before we ended him.
Suisui: We've only got one lead, from the Grand Helm herself. She said Muyu traded technology with the Fractsidus years ago, but the relationship didn't last.
Suisui: Hard to say if that's true or just the Atelier trying to cover its tracks.
Suisui: These past few days... besides investigating the Atelier, I also made a trip to Mengzhou City Hall.
[Dialogue Option]  You went there again...?
Suisui: Hmph. In Jinzhou, at least they served me tea while I waited. This time... they shut the door in my face. Said Mengzhou's Magistrate wasn't receiving visitors.
Suisui: Xuanfang's been hit by one disaster after another, yet City Hall remains eerily quiet. It's suspicious.
Yangyang: At least it has made good on its promise: a group of personnel and supplies will arrive from Mengzhou City soon. Another shipment of aid from Jinzhou has also arrived.
Suisui: Things are indeed looking up. You two needn't worry about City Hall, I'll think of something.
Rover: Thank you, Suisui.
Suisui: Your tone betrays you, darling. I can tell there's a lot on your mind. But you'll try to unwind, won't you?
Rover: Yeah... Things are peaceful in Xuanfang for now.
Yangyang: I hope that won't change for a long, long time.
Suisui: Very soon, the Waking Moon Festival will be celebrated across Mengzhou. Xuanfang will be no exception. You should both take the chance to relax.
Suisui: Well then, see you soon. Don't forget about our... "next time," alright, Rover?
Yangyang: Rover, what did my sister mean by "next time"...?
Rover: ...One day, we're all gonna visit Jinzhou together.
Yangyang: I'd like that.

title: Song of the Heart Sword
content:
[Objective: Read Qingxiao's WavesLine message]
Friend sent a nudge
Friend sent a nudge
Qingxiao: Rover, I write to you thus: The skies are clear
Qingxiao: Rover, I write to you thus: The skies are clear today, the breeze is gentle, and the weather is most pleasant. Since our hurried parting the other day, I have been occupied handling the Tacet Discords. If you have the time, would you care to visit the training hall? There is something important I wish to discuss. Qingxiao, respectfully
[Choice]  Qingxiao? Isn't this a little too formal?
(Rover): You don't have to write WavesLine messages like letters. You can just talk normally.
Qingxiao: Understood. I only recently learned how to use WavesLine on the Terminal, so I'm still familiarizing myself with the proper etiquette.
[Choice]  It's okay.
(Rover): It's okay. Now that you've added me, we can chat whenever. You'll get the hang of it.
Qingxiao: Thank you.
Qingxiao: My training hall is at the summit of the Eastern Xuan Peaks. Are you available?
[Choice]  I'll head over now.
(Rover): Of course, I'm free. I'll be there in a flash.
Qingxiao: Good. I shall be waiting.}}

title: Song of the Heart Sword
subsection: Head to Qingxiao's training hall in the Eastern Xuan Peaks
content:
[Objective: Head to Qingxiao's training hall in the Eastern Xuan Peaks]
Qingxiao: You're here.
Rover: ...So this is your training hall?
Qingxiao: When I first settled here, it was nothing but an abandoned shack. Over the years, the local folk have helped me repair it of their own accord.
Qingxiao: I owe them a great debt. Cultivation may not need worldly comforts, but if I am to found a school, I should at least have a proper training hall.
Rover: ...Found a school?
Qingxiao: I want to open a school here in Xuanfang. Teach others the way of the sword.
[Dialogue Option]  So you're really coming down from the mountain after all.
[Dialogue Option]  The Sword Transcendent is taking disciples now?
Rover: Where are you at with this?
Qingxiao: ...Still at the very first step. Finding my first disciple.
Qingxiao: The first disciple is the foundation, the face the school shows to the world. I must choose with the utmost care.
Rover: Well, you did teach me to fly with a sword not long ago. Doesn't that mean...
Qingxiao: Back in the Xuanyuan Domain, I called you "disciple," yes. And you called me "master." But that journey has already ended.
Qingxiao: I have not truly guided you. Your swordcraft already stands on its own. I've no right to claim you as disciple.
Qingxiao: So... it must be your choice.
Rover: Qingxiao. If you'll have me, then our journey doesn't need to be over.
Qingxiao: ...Very well.
Qingxiao: According to how my own master accepted me, taking on a disciple requires two steps. This shall be the first.
Rover: This is...
Qingxiao: A sword talisman. I carved it myself over the last few days. My lifebound Sword Intent lives inside it.
Qingxiao: Think of it as a keepsake of our knowing each other... or as a bond between master and disciple. I hope you will take it.
[Dialogue Option]  (Accept it solemnly)
Jingwei of the Past: To be my disciple, you must sever worldly ties, cast aside the six desires, and leave karma behind.
Qingxiao of the Past: And if, in the end, I cannot?
Jingwei of the Past: Then by that time, you will have found a Way of your own.
Rover: So, now comes the second step, I guess?
Qingxiao: I treat you to a meal.
Qingxiao: I believe it's called an Initiation Feast. When my master accepted me, she broke years of fasting just to share a meal.
Qingxiao: Bring along your adorable little friend as well.
Rover: "Adorable"... You mean Abby?

metadata.subsection: Head to Qingxiao's training hall in the Eastern Xuan Peaks

title: Song of the Heart Sword
subsection: Fly to Xuanfang Hold with your sword
content:
[Objective: Fly to Xuanfang Hold with your sword]
Qingxiao: Up here, this land looks exactly as it was...

metadata.subsection: Fly to Xuanfang Hold with your sword

title: Song of the Heart Sword
content:
[Objective: Listen to the conversation]
Resident: No wonder the Fillet Fairmaiden's running around all day. She's hosting Paragon Qingxiao!

Resident: Hey, I heard Paragon Qingxiao recently took a disciple. You think it's the one beside her?
Another Resident: Could it be? But he's the great hero from Jinzhou!

title: Song of the Heart Sword
subsection: Have a meal with Qingxiao at Yuan's Flavors
content:
[Objective: Have a meal with Qingxiao at Yuan's Flavors]
Fillet Fairmaiden: Mengzhou Fish in Vinegar—coming right up! Caught from the Luo River just this morning. You won't find fresher!
Abby: Mmm, yum-yum-yum-yum-yum!
Abby: Blegh! So sour! What's wrong with this fish?!
Qingxiao: This was the signature dish of "Yuan's Flavors" in the late Fortress. I received an invitation to eat there once. One bite, and the taste has never left me.
Qingxiao: Disciple, would you like to try some?
Qingxiao: Before I always saw the people... as those who quietly waited to be protected.
Qingxiao: But the truth is, they've always had the heart to protect themselves.
Qingxiao: To save for a day, or to save for a lifetime... Neither compares to teaching them the means to save themselves.
Rover: So... that's the real reason you're founding a school?
Qingxiao: Many years ago, a fellow Cultivator passed through Xuanfang with his disciple during their travels across Huanglong. He came up the mountain to visit me.
Qingxiao: Only then did I learn that to solve Temporal Disruption for future generations, he had to set a plan in motion with a "golden-eyed one (you)" at Mt. Firmament. It cost him dearly. His lifespan was nearly spent.
Qingxiao: And yet, he was at total peace. He had a disciple to inherit his legacy, and his teachings were already taking root across the world.
[Dialogue Option]  Master Xuanmiao... and Changli?
Qingxiao: Even if one can no longer walk their Way, or devote their life to "peace under heaven," there will always be... someone to take their place.
Qingxiao: That is the lesson you taught me, not so long ago.
Rover: So, as your first and most devoted disciple, it looks like I'll be helping with the teaching too.
Qingxiao: ...You already have.
Qingxiao: To teach the sword is to offer someone a chance to find their own way with it. Even if they never master it, their body and spirit will still become stronger.
[Dialogue Option]  Speaking of which, what are you naming the school?
[Dialogue Option]  What should I say if someone asks where I've studied?
Qingxiao: Well...
Excited Kid: Did you hear? That Transcendent lady is incredible! They say she's the master of the greatest martial arts school in the whole wide world!
Confused Kid: What's it called again?
Excited Kid: Uh, Xuan... Xuanyuan School! Yeah, it's the best in the world!
Qingxiao: In that case... Xuanyuan School it shall be.
In this life, we part more than we gather. Nine times out of ten, the world is not as we wish.
But may we, humble as we are, pass the torch, and never cease to rise.
Fillet Fairmaiden: Hm? Did Paragon Qingxiao leave this behind?
Fillet Fairmaiden: ...Swordcraft of the Golden-Eyed One?
